name: U-Net (Ronneberger15)
access: architecture from 'U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation'

name: Swin U-Mamba
access: architecture described in 'Swin-UMamba: State Space UNet with Swin priors'

name: HPL Mesothelioma Encoder (ResNet-50 Barlow Twins)
organization: University of Glasgow / CRUK Scotland Institute

name: ByteTrack
params: Detection association with dual IoU thresholds

name: StrongSORT
params: NSA Kalman filter + Gaussian smoothing + ReID

name: SMART-tiny
inputs: 1s history of agent states + vectorized map
outputs: delta x-y trajectory tokens rolled out for 8s

name: PandaGPT
inputs: text + audio + image via ImageBind embeddings

name: DeepSeek-V3.1-Think
notes: Thinking/reasoning variant of DeepSeek-V3.1 with extended chain-of-thought reasoning mode

name: Qwen3-235B-Think
notes: Thinking/reasoning variant of Qwen3-235B-Instruct with extended chain-of-thought reasoning mode

name: SlovakBERT
architecture: RoBERTa

name: IceBERT
architecture: RoBERTa

name: BERTurk
architecture: BERT

name: BERTu
architecture: BERT-large class

name: MEGConformer Speech
organization: HiTZ Center / UPV-EHU (de Zuazo et al.)
params: ~10M (Conformer Small: 16 layers, hidden=144, 4 heads, FFN=576, kernel=31)

name: MEGConformer Phoneme
organization: HiTZ Center / UPV-EHU (de Zuazo et al.)
input_resolution: 306-channel MEG, 125 samples (0.5s @ 250Hz), 100-sample averaged at test time

name: AfroLID
notes: Specialized African language identification model covering 517 African languages and varieties; CPU-capable, very fast on short texts

name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B
notes: Called 'Llama3-8B-Distill' in UnsolvableQA paper (arXiv:2512.01661)

name: DeepSeek-V3.2-R
notes: Proprietary/unreleased model version used as SOTA baseline in arXiv:2512.01661; possibly refers to a DeepSeek reasoning model variant (e.g., R1 or post-training of V3)

name: GPT-5.1-Low
notes: Proprietary model used as SOTA baseline in arXiv:2512.01661; likely a low-compute or small variant of GPT-5.1

name: Gemini-3.0-Pro
notes: Proprietary model used as SOTA baseline in arXiv:2512.01661; equivalent to 'Gemini 3 Pro' in model sheet

name: Paraformer
architecture: non-autoregressive CTC-AED hybrid

name: Granite-4.0-Tiny-Preview
notes: Hybrid Mamba-Transformer architecture; used in arXiv:2512.01848 for cross-architecture safety alignment experiments

name: openassistant/reward-model-deberta-v3-large-v2
notes: DeBERTa-v3-large fine-tuned on OASST data as a reward model for harmlessness scoring; used in AttaQ evaluation (arXiv:2512.01848) to normalize outputs to [0,1]

name: Gemma3-270M
notes: Smallest Gemma 3 variant; text-only (no vision); 32K context; available via Ollama as gemma3:1b (270m is not separately named in Ollama)

name: Gemma3-1B
notes: Text-only Gemma 3 variant; 32K context; available via Ollama as gemma3:1b

name: Gemma3-12B
notes: Multimodal Gemma 3 variant (vision+text); 128K context; available via Ollama as gemma3:12b

name: Mistral-NeMo-12B
notes: Joint Mistral AI and NVIDIA collaboration; uses Tekken tokenizer; available via Ollama as mistral-nemo

name: Navarasa-2.0-7B
notes: Gemma-7B fine-tuned for 15 Indian languages (SFT); text completion model; also available as GGUF Q4_K_M via Ollama

name: Krutrim-2-12B
notes: Built on Mistral-NeMo architecture; multilingual (English + 22 Indian languages); instruction-tuned with DPO; available as FP16 and Q4_K_M GGUF via Ollama

name: Qwen2-0.5B
notes: Used as ~360M SLM initialization checkpoint in cross-lingual interleaving SLM paper (arXiv:2512.01865); non-embedding parameter count referred to as '360M' in that work

name: Mimi
notes: Neural audio codec from Moshi (Defossez et al., 2024); RVQ with 32 codebooks at 12.5 Hz; first codebook is semantically distilled from WavLM; used for speech tokenization in textless SLMs

name: WavLM-Large
notes: Self-supervised speech encoder trained on 94k hours of audio; used for speaker verification embeddings and semantic distillation for Mimi tokenizer

name: Qwen2.5-1.5B
notes: Base (pre-trained) variant of Qwen2.5-1.5B; used as SFT backbone in arXiv:2512.01970 for complementary reasoning experiments

name: E5-large-v2
notes: Text embedding model from 'Text Embeddings by Weakly-Supervised Contrastive Pre-training' (Wang et al. 2022). Used as the dense retriever in Search-R1 and INSPO for indexing and querying the Wikipedia 2018 dump. Output dimension 1024.

name: Claude Opus 4.1
notes: Frontier-class reasoning model from Anthropic; used as LLM coder in DEFT failure taxonomy construction (FINDER_DEFT paper, Dec 2025)

name: Grok 4
notes: xAI frontier model; used as LLM coder in DEFT failure taxonomy construction (FINDER_DEFT paper, Dec 2025)

name: Seed1.5-Embedding
notes: Top-ranked on MTEB eng-v2 leaderboard as of late 2025; used for cosine similarity computation in DEFT grounded theory coding process

name: GTA1-32B
notes: GUI Test-time Scaling Agent; fine-tuned 32B VLM on GUI grounding data; achieved SOTA on ScreenSpot-Pro (63.6%) before CoG; also available in 7B and 72B variants

name: GTA1-7B
notes: GUI Test-time Scaling Agent 7B variant; smaller sibling of GTA1-32B

name: Holo1.5-72B
notes: Open-weight VLM for computer-use agents; based on Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct; purpose-built for GUI localization and UI-VQA

name: Holo1.5-7B
notes: Open-weight VLM for computer-use agents; based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B; Apache 2.0 license (suitable for production)

name: SeeClick
notes: GUI grounding VLM based on Qwen-VL; fine-tuned on GUI screenshots with click annotations; designed for advanced visual GUI agents

name: CogAgent-18B
notes: Dual-resolution visual agent model; 18B parameters; designed for GUI understanding and visual web navigation; released at CVPR 2024

name: OS-Atlas-7B
notes: Foundation action model for generalist GUI agents; fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL-7B on GUI interaction data

name: UGround-72B
notes: Universal visual grounding model for GUI agents; based on 72B VLM fine-tuned on diverse GUI grounding data; ICLR 2025

name: Aria-UI
organization: Salesforce AI Research / Junnan Li group
notes: Visual grounding model for GUI instructions; MoE-based architecture (~3.5B active params); specialized for GUI agent grounding tasks

name: GUI-Spotlight
notes: Adaptive iterative focus refinement for GUI visual grounding; zoom-based iterative approach for localization

name: Seed-1.5-VL
notes: ByteDance proprietary VLM for visual understanding and GUI tasks; achieves 60.9% on ScreenSpot-Pro; closed-source

name: UI-TARS-72B
notes: 72B GUI grounding and agent model; earlier generation of UI-TARS before 1.5 series

name: SE-GUI-7B
notes: Self-Evolutionary RL-trained GUI grounding model; 7B variant achieving 47.3% on ScreenSpot-Pro

name: SE-GUI-3B
notes: Self-Evolutionary RL-trained GUI grounding model; 3B variant achieving 35.9% on ScreenSpot-Pro

name: GUI-G1-3B
notes: GUI grounding model with R1-Zero-like GRPO training; 3B variant achieving 37.1% on ScreenSpot-Pro

name: Jedi-7B
notes: Scaling computer-use grounding via UI decomposition; 7B variant achieving 39.5% on ScreenSpot-Pro

name: Jedi-3B
notes: Scaling computer-use grounding via UI decomposition; 3B variant achieving 36.1% on ScreenSpot-Pro

name: Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B
architecture: Hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE; 52 blocks: 6 Self-Attention, 23 MoE (128 experts, 6 active), 23 Mamba-2; hidden_dim=2688, GQA 32q/2kv heads
notes: Architecture from Nemotron 3 Nano (arXiv:2512.20856); used in arXiv:2512.02010 to demonstrate 4/6 NVFP4 pre-training; trained on 384x NVIDIA B200 GPUs

name: QwQ-32B
notes: Stable release of QwQ-32B (March 2025), reasoning-focused model with stronger MoE routing compared to preview; successor to QwQ-32B-Preview; commonly used in test-time scaling studies

name: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507
notes: Updated July 2507 instruct version of Qwen3-30B-A3B; supports only non-thinking mode; used as lightweight answer extractor in RESP pruning paper (2512.02185)

name: InternImage-XL
notes: Large-scale vision foundation model using deformable convolutions (DCNv3) as core operator; achieves strong performance on detection/segmentation when used as backbone in Cascade Mask R-CNN

name: GroundedSAM-v2
notes: Combines GroundingDINO open-vocabulary detection with SAM2 for open-set segmentation; successor to original GroundedSAM; used in TabletopGen for instance segmentation from MLLM-generated category labels

name: EfficientNet-B4
notes: EfficientNet scaled at compound coefficient 4; commonly used as deepfake detector backbone (e.g. FaceForensics++ challenge). Used in M4-BLIP as local facial deepfake detector (E_d).

name: EVA-CLIP ViT-g/14
notes: Giant ViT vision encoder from EVA (Exploring the Limits of Masked Visual Representation Learning at Scale, CVPR 2023). Used as the frozen image encoder in BLIP-2 and in M4-BLIP for global image feature extraction.

name: Prithvi-EO-2.0-300M
architecture: ViT-Large with 1024 embedding dim, spatiotemporal MAE pretraining on Harmonised Landsat-Sentinel-2 (HLS) dataset; processes multispectral satellite imagery
input_resolution: 224x224 spatial, variable temporal depth, variable spectral bands
notes: Geospatial foundation model pretrained on HLS dataset; supports multispectral EO tasks (cloud/flood/landslide detection, AGB estimation); teacher model for dual-MAE distillation in arXiv:2512.01181

name: DiT-XL/2
notes: Scalable Diffusion Model with Transformers (ICCV 2023); replaces U-Net with ViT-style transformer for class-conditional image generation on ImageNet; uses absolute positional embeddings and standard FFN layers

name: DiT-B/4
notes: Base-scale DiT model; dense (non-MoE) baseline used in diffusion MoE comparison papers

name: DiT-L/4
notes: Large-scale DiT model; dense baseline used in diffusion MoE comparison papers

name: DSMoE-3B-E16
notes: Diffusion MoE architecture using DeepSeek-style experts, 2D RoPE, shared experts, and narrowed intermediate widths; achieves best FID 2.38 on ImageNet 256x256 class-conditional at 700K steps; DSMoE family covers S/B/L/3B scales

name: JiTMoE-L/16-E16
notes: Pixel-space diffusion MoE model; applies DSMoE architectural recipe to JiT framework; achieves FID 3.10 comparable to JiT-L/16 (2.79) while being the first open MoE variant in this direction

name: DiffMoE-L-E16
notes: Diffusion MoE model with time-aware and space-adaptive expert routing (ICML 2025 DiffMoE paper); uses larger FFN intermediates than DSMoE; baseline for comparison in efficient diffusion MoE work

name: HPSv3
organization: Ma et al. (Shanghai AI Lab / CUHK)

name: U-Net
notes: Original encoder-decoder architecture with skip connections for biomedical image segmentation (MICCAI 2015). Foundation for most medical segmentation models.

name: UNet++
notes: Nested U-Net with redesigned skip pathways and deep supervision. Proposed at DLMIA 2018. Often used as baseline in medical segmentation papers.

name: ResUNet-a
notes: Residual U-Net variant with atrous convolutions for remote sensing and medical image segmentation (ISPRS Journal 2020). Used as ResUNet baseline in MedSegLatDiff.

name: MedSegDiff-V2
notes: Extension of MedSegDiff with Spectrum-Space Transformer for semantic feature interaction. Accepted at AAAI 2024 (selected as Most Influential Paper). Successor to MedSegDiff.

name: InternVL3.5-241B-A30B
notes: Large MoE variant of InternVL3.5; 241B total parameters, 30B active; reported in arXiv:2508.18265

name: SLANNet-plus
notes: Table structure recognition model based on split-and-merge approach; part of PaddleOCR 3.0 (arXiv:2507.05595)

name: UniTable
notes: Unified table recognition framework via self-supervised pretraining; processes images up to 448x448 with 512-token output cap; arXiv:2403.04822

name: dots.ocr
notes: Multilingual document layout parsing in a single VLM; specialized for document parsing including tables

name: PaddleOCR-VL
notes: Ultra-compact 0.9B VLM for multilingual document parsing; arXiv:2510.14528

name: MinerU2.5
notes: Decoupled VLM for efficient high-resolution document parsing; distilled from Gemini 2.5 Pro with millions of annotated samples; arXiv:2509.22186

name: DeepSeek-OCR
notes: Document OCR model using contextual optical compression; arXiv:2510.18234

name: EVA-CLIP ViT-G/14
notes: Largest EVA-CLIP model (ViT-Giant scale, 1.8B params). Used as frozen vision encoder in video/image understanding systems like InterLLaVA and TimeChat. Distinct from the smaller ViT-g/14 (~1B params) variant.

name: CLIP ViT-G/14
notes: CLIP ViT-bigG/14 (ViT-Giant, ~1.8B params) trained on LAION-2B via OpenCLIP. Used as backbone for ZS-CIR baselines including LinCIR, Pic2Word, and SEARLE. Distinct from EVA-CLIP ViT-G (similar scale but different pretraining approach).

name: Video-LLaMA
notes: Instruction-tuned audio-visual language model built on LLaMA-2-7B with a video Q-Former for frame-level feature aggregation. The Q-Former checkpoint is widely reused in video MLLM research (e.g., InterLLaVA, TimeChat).

name: Mask R-CNN
organization: Facebook AI Research (He et al., ICCV 2017)

name: RetinaNet
organization: Facebook AI Research (Lin et al., ICCV 2017)
notes: One-stage anchor-based detector with focal loss to address class imbalance

name: Point Transformer V3 (PTv3)
input: 3D point cloud with sparse convolutions + serialized attention

name: SPINE (Scalable Particle Imaging Network)
input: 3D LArTPC voxels, semantic seg -> clustering -> reconstruction

name: nnDetection
input_resolution: dynamic 3D patches for volumetric medical images

name: LangSAM
notes: Open-set detection and segmentation combining SAM2 and Grounding DINO; supports text-prompted segmentation in a zero-shot manner.

name: A-LCFCN
notes: Affinity LCFCN: weakly supervised segmentation using point annotations; learns segmentation from sparse point labels via affinity propagation; applied to fish segmentation on DeepFish dataset.

name: EasyR1
notes: Efficient, scalable multi-modality RL training framework supporting GRPO for VLMs like Qwen2.5-VL; used as training infrastructure for RLVR fine-tuning of MLLMs.

name: Flux.1-dev
architecture: MM-DiT (Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer)

name: NeuS2
notes: Fast learning of neural implicit surfaces for multi-view reconstruction. Extension of NeuS with instant-NGP hash encoding for much faster per-scene optimization (~5 min vs hours). Used for initial canonical mesh reconstruction in TagSplat.

name: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)
notes: Original 3D Gaussian Splatting for real-time radiance field rendering. Represents scenes as 3D Gaussians optimized per-scene. Core framework for TagSplat, Dynamic 3DGS, DG-Mesh, Deformable-GS, Dynamic 2DGS and many other works.

name: SMILY-APE
notes: Chemistry-specific small language model using SMILES/SELFIES tokenization; used as LLM backbone in GlassMol for molecular property prediction (arXiv:2603.01274). Leon et al., Scientific Reports 2024.

name: Dynamic 3DGS
notes: Dynamic 3D Gaussians: Tracking by Persistent Dynamic View Synthesis (Luiten et al., 3DV 2024). Tracks 3D Gaussians over time for dynamic scene reconstruction. Baseline in TagSplat.

name: DG-Mesh
notes: Dynamic Gaussians Mesh: Consistent mesh reconstruction from dynamic scenes (Liu et al., ICLR 2025). Attaches Gaussians to mesh representations for dynamic reconstruction. Baseline in TagSplat.

name: Deformable-GS
notes: Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting for Animatable Human Avatars (Jung et al., 2023). Uses deformation fields to animate 3D Gaussians. Baseline in TagSplat.

name: Dynamic 2DGS
notes: Dynamic 2D Gaussians: Geometrically accurate radiance fields for dynamic objects (Zhang et al., 2024). Uses 2D Gaussian primitives for more accurate mesh extraction from dynamic scenes. Baseline in TagSplat.

name: SigLIP2-1B
notes: SigLIP 2 (Tschannen et al., 2025): multilingual vision-language encoder with improved semantic understanding, localization, and dense features. Used as frozen semantic teacher in InternVideo-Next Stage 1.

name: SigLIP2-Large
notes: SigLIP 2 Large variant used in ablation study of InternVideo-Next.

name: ModernBERT-Large
notes: ModernBERT (Warner et al., 2024): modern bidirectional encoder for fast, memory-efficient, long-context fine-tuning and inference. Last 5 layers used to initialize the Predictor in InternVideo-Next.

name: MobileCLIP-B
notes: MobileCLIP-B (Vasu et al., CVPR 2024): fast image-text model trained with multi-modal reinforced training. Used as text encoder in LiT fine-tuning for zero-shot retrieval evaluation in InternVideo-Next.

name: VideoMAEv2-Base
notes: VideoMAE V2 Base (Wang et al., CVPR 2023): dual masking video masked autoencoder with improved masking and decoder strategies. Baseline in InternVideo-Next.

name: VideoMAEv2-Large
notes: VideoMAE V2 Large variant. Baseline in InternVideo-Next depth and action recognition evaluations.

name: VideoMAEv2-1B
notes: VideoMAE V2 ViT-g (giant) 1B parameter model. Baseline in InternVideo-Next.

name: V-JEPA-Large
notes: V-JEPA v1 (Bardes et al., arXiv 2024): self-supervised video model using feature prediction (latent-space prediction) objective. Baseline in InternVideo-Next.

name: V-JEPA2-Large
notes: V-JEPA 2 Large (Assran et al., arXiv 2025): second-generation self-supervised video model enabling understanding, prediction and planning. Baseline in InternVideo-Next.

name: InternVideo2-Base
notes: InternVideo2 Base (Wang et al., ECCV 2024): video foundation model combining video-only pretraining (Stage 1) with video-text alignment (Stage 2). Baseline in InternVideo-Next.

name: InternVideo2-Large
notes: InternVideo2 Large. Baseline in InternVideo-Next.

name: InternVideo2-1B
notes: InternVideo2 1B model used in scalability comparison in InternVideo-Next (30K A100 GPU-hrs).

name: InternVideo2-6B
notes: InternVideo2 6B model. Trained on 400M data with 200K A100 GPU-hrs. Baseline in InternVideo-Next.

name: InternVideo-Next-Base
notes: InternVideo-Next Base (Wang et al., arXiv 2512.01342): two-stage EPD self-supervised video pretraining with diffusion decoder and SigLIP semantic alignment. Stage 1: 1.5K A100-hrs, Stage 2: 3.4K A100-hrs total.

name: InternVideo-Next-Large
notes: InternVideo-Next Large (Wang et al., arXiv 2512.01342): Stage 1: 3.6K A100-hrs, Stage 2: 9.7K A100-hrs total. SOTA across video benchmarks without video-text supervision.

name: PointLLM-7B
notes: 3D multimodal LLM based on Vicuna-7B + Point-BERT encoder; ECCV 2024 Best Paper Candidate; pretrained on 660K simple + 70K complex point-text instruction pairs; used as LLM bridge in SRAM (arXiv:2512.01373)

name: Point-BERT
notes: Point cloud transformer pretrained with masked point modeling on ShapeNet; CVPR 2022; used as shape encoder in SRAM and PointLLM

name: FramePack
notes: MM-DiT based I2V model that packs multi-frame context into next-frame prediction; includes FramePack F1 variant. arXiv:2504.12626 (2025).

name: HunyuanVideo I2V
notes: Large-scale video generative model with dual-stream MMDiT architecture, supporting I2V generation. Kong et al. arXiv:2412.03603 (2024).

name: Skyreels-v2
notes: Infinite-length film generative model; includes I2V and diffusion-forcing (DF) variants. Chen et al. arXiv:2504.13074 (2025).

name: EasyAnimate
notes: High-performance long video generation based on Transformer architecture (CogVideoX-style). Xu et al. arXiv:2405.18991 (2024).

name: OmniGen2
notes: Advanced multimodal generation model supporting text-to-image and image editing; used for AlignVid generalization experiments on GenEval and ImgEdit benchmarks.

name: Stable Diffusion 2
notes: SD2 uses a U-Net backbone with OpenCLIP text encoder. Widely used as a backbone for downstream image restoration tasks including Super-Resolution. Used as backbone for FRAMER_U.

name: Stable Diffusion 3
notes: SD3 uses a DiT (Diffusion Transformer) backbone with rectified flow. Used as backbone for DiT4SR and FRAMER_D. Training requires ~89.65GB VRAM at batch size 16 for Real-ISR fine-tuning.

name: Real-ESRGAN
notes: Real-ESRGAN: Training Real-World Blind SR with Pure Synthetic Data (Wang et al., ICCV 2021). Widely used for both the degradation pipeline (high-order degradation synthesis) and as a SR model. The degradation pipeline is commonly adopted by downstream works like SeeSR, DiT4SR, FRAMER.

name: SeeSR
notes: SeeSR: Towards Semantics-Aware Real-World Image Super-Resolution (Wu et al., CVPR 2024). Uses Stable Diffusion 2.1 with semantic prompts for Real-ISR. Baseline compared in FRAMER.

name: DiT4SR
access: Not publicly released as of Dec 2024
notes: DiT4SR: Taming Diffusion Transformer for Real-World Image Super-Resolution (Duan et al., ICCV 2025). Uses Stable Diffusion 3 (DiT backbone) for Real-ISR. FRAMER_D is built on top of DiT4SR. Requires ~87GB VRAM baseline, 89.65GB with FRAMER on H200.

name: PiSA-SR
notes: PiSA-SR: Pixel-Level and Semantic-Level Adjustable Super-Resolution: A Dual-LoRA Approach (Sun et al., CVPR 2025). Uses dual LoRA on SD2.1 for pixel-level and semantic-level control in Real-ISR. FRAMER_U is built on top of PiSA-SR.

name: DiffBIR
notes: DiffBIR: Toward Blind Image Restoration with Generative Diffusion Prior (Lin et al., ECCV 2024). Two-stage approach: restoration module (SwinIR) + generative diffusion prior (SD2.1). Baseline mentioned in FRAMER.

name: DreamClear
notes: DreamClear: High-Capacity Real-World Image Restoration with Privacy-Safe Dataset Curation (Ai et al., NeurIPS 2024). DiT-based Real-ISR method. Baseline in the DiT group comparison in FRAMER.

name: SwinIR
notes: SwinIR: Image Restoration Using Swin Transformer (Liang et al., ICCVW 2021). Strong baseline for image restoration/SR using Swin Transformer. Compared as Swin-based baseline in FRAMER.

name: ResShift
notes: ResShift: Efficient Diffusion Model for Image Super-Resolution by Residual Shifting (Yue et al., NeurIPS 2023). Efficient diffusion-based SR that uses residual shifting to reduce sampling steps. Compared as U-Net-based baseline in FRAMER.

name: Qwen-14B
notes: Original Qwen-14B model from arXiv:2309.16609 (Sep 2023); distinct from later Qwen1.5/Qwen2/Qwen2.5 series. Used as backbone in DTS model merging experiments on MMLU, TruthfulQA, and BBQ.

name: CAT-Seg (ViT-B/16)
notes: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation (CVPR 2024). Uses CLIP ViT-B/16 as backbone + cost aggregation decoder. Trained on COCO-Stuff and ADE20K. Used as segmentation backbone in Clipomaly (arXiv:2512.01427) fine-tuned on Cityscapes.

name: RAM (Recognize Anything Model)
notes: Open-vocabulary image tagging model (CVPR 2024 Workshop). Can predict thousands of object tags in a single forward pass. Used in Clipomaly for generating semantic label candidates for detected anomaly regions.

name: SVTRv2-B
notes: SVTRv2: CTC Beats Encoder-Decoder Models in Scene Text Recognition (Du et al., ICCV 2025). Three-stage hierarchical backbone with local and global mixing blocks. Used as visual encoder in MDiff4STR.

name: MiMo-VL-7B-SFT
notes: SFT version of MiMo-VL-7B; multimodal model with strong reasoning ability from Xiaomi

name: MiMo-VL-7B-RL
notes: RL-trained version of MiMo-VL-7B using verifiable RL rewards; stronger reasoning capability than SFT version

name: R1-OneVision-7B-RL
notes: Open-source multimodal LLM with reasoning ability trained with RL; based on OneVision architecture

name: GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking
notes: Vision-language model with chain-of-thought thinking capability trained with scalable RL; from Zhipu AI

name: LLaVA-OneVision-7B
organization: Haotian Liu et al. / LLaVA team
notes: LLaVA-OneVision: Easy visual task transfer; supports image, multi-image, and video understanding

name: SMPL-X
organization: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems (Pavlakos et al., 2019)
license: SMPL-X Research License (non-commercial; free registration required)
notes: Expressive body model unifying body, face, and hands. Extends SMPL with 10 shape params, 63 body pose params, 45 hand pose params, 12 face expression params, 10475 vertices. Used as body prior in FastAnimate, X-Avatar, EX-Avatar, GauHuman, and many avatar animation papers.

name: TrajectoryCrafter
organization: ARC Lab Tencent PCG / NTU / HKU
notes: TrajectoryCrafter: Redirecting Camera Trajectory for Monocular Videos via Diffusion Models (Yu et al., ICCV 2025 Oral, arXiv:2503.05638). Dual-stream conditional video diffusion that takes point cloud renders and source videos as conditions for camera-controlled video generation. Requires >=28GB VRAM. Built on CogVideoX-5B.

name: MegaSAM
organization: Google DeepMind / UC Berkeley / University of Michigan
notes: MegaSaM: Accurate, Fast, and Robust Structure and Motion from Casual Dynamic Videos (Li et al., CVPR 2025, arXiv:2412.04463). Deep visual SLAM with mono-depth priors and uncertainty-aware bundle adjustment for robust depth/pose estimation from dynamic monocular video. Used in ChronosObserver for initialization.

name: Prior Depth Anything (PDA)
notes: Depth Anything with Any Prior (Wang et al., arXiv:2505.10565, 2025). Image depth completion using geometric priors (warped depth from known poses). Used in ChronosObserver to refine depth of generated views by combining monocular depth prediction with warped depth guidance. PDA pattern set to 500 in ChronosObserver.

name: ViewCrafter
notes: ViewCrafter: Taming Video Diffusion Models for High-Fidelity Novel View Synthesis (Yu et al., arXiv:2409.02048, 2024). First work to introduce point cloud representations for explicit pose guidance in camera-controlled video generation. Compared as baseline in ChronosObserver.

name: Reangle-A-Video
notes: Reangle-A-Video: 4D Video Generation as Video-to-Video Translation (Jeong et al., arXiv:2503.09151, 2025). Test-time fine-tuning approach for multi-view video generation. ~0.6756 hrs/view. Compared as baseline in ChronosObserver.

name: EX-4D
notes: EX-4D: Extreme Viewpoint 4D Video Synthesis via Depth Watertight Mesh (Hu et al., arXiv:2506.05554, 2025). Uses depth-based watertight mesh for extreme viewpoint 4D video synthesis. Compared as baseline in ChronosObserver.

name: TAESD (Tiny AutoEncoder for Stable Diffusion)
notes: Distilled tiny VAE for Stable Diffusion latent encoding/decoding. Encodes images to 16x32x32 latents (for 256x256 input). Used in FlowEO (arXiv:2512.05140) as the latent space backbone for flow matching-based UDA in Earth observation. Much faster than full SD3 VAE (0.24s vs 2.11s per batch of 256 images on A100).

name: ResNet-34
notes: Standard residual network backbone. Used as the encoder backbone for DeepLabv3+ segmentation in FlowEO (arXiv:2512.05140).

name: DeepLabv3+
notes: Encoder-Decoder with Atrous Separable Convolution for Semantic Image Segmentation. Used in FlowEO (arXiv:2512.05140) as the downstream segmentation model (ResNet-34 backbone, ImageNet init, batch 512, lr 0.001, one-cycle cosine schedule).

name: Pix2Pix
organization: Berkeley AI Research (Isola et al., CVPR 2017)
notes: Image-to-Image Translation with Conditional Adversarial Networks. Paired image translation using L1 + adversarial LSGAN loss. Baseline in FlowEO (arXiv:2512.05140) for UDA in Earth observation.

name: CycleGAN
organization: Berkeley AI Research (Zhu et al., ICCV 2017)
notes: Unpaired image-to-image translation using cycle-consistency adversarial training. Strong baseline in FlowEO (arXiv:2512.05140) for UDA in Earth observation; second-best overall on SpaceNet 8.

name: StegoGAN
organization: ETH Zurich / ENS Paris (Wu et al., CVPR 2024)
notes: Leveraging Steganography for Non-Bijective Image-to-Image Translation (CVPR 2024). Baseline in FlowEO for UDA in Earth observation; explicitly handles features impossible to match between domains.

name: UNSB (Unpaired Neural Schrödinger Bridge)
notes: Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation via Neural Schrödinger Bridge (ICLR 2024). Stochastic OT-based translation baseline in FlowEO. Training mem: 34 GB at batch 12 on A100; inference only supports batch 1 in official implementation.

name: Diffusion Bridge (Schrödinger Bridge Flow)
notes: Schrödinger Bridge Flow for Unpaired Data Translation (NeurIPS 2024). Diffusion-based bridge baseline in FlowEO for UDA in Earth observation.

name: U-Mamba
notes: U-Mamba: Enhancing Long-range Dependency for Biomedical Image Segmentation (arXiv:2401.04722). U-shaped encoder-decoder with Mamba (SSM) blocks for long-range context modeling in medical images. High FLOPs (842G) due to state-space sequence modeling over full 2D feature maps.

name: ScaleBridge-Det
organization: Zhao et al., Anhui University / Hefei University 2024

name: Cheng2020Anchor (CompressAI)
notes: Learned Image Compression with Discretized Gaussian Mixture Likelihoods and Attention Modules (CVPR 2020). Implemented in CompressAI library. Quality levels 1-3 use 128-dim latent, 4-6 use 192-dim latent.

name: Janus-Pro-7B
notes: Unified multimodal understanding and generation model with decoupled visual encoding. Evaluated in Envision benchmark.

name: Hunyuan Image 3.0
notes: Tencent Hunyuan unified image generation model. Evaluated in Envision benchmark.

name: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Flash
notes: Lightweight fast variant of SD 3.5. Evaluated in Envision benchmark.

name: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium
notes: Medium variant of SD 3.5. Evaluated in Envision benchmark.

name: Video-3D LLM
notes: Position-aware video representation for 3D scene understanding; uses 3D positional embeddings bound to 2D patch tokens. CVPR 2025.

name: VG-LLM
notes: Leverages VGGT to augment MLLMs' inputs with 3D vision geometry priors for spatial reasoning.

name: RoboRefer
notes: Embodied spatial referring with reasoning in VLMs for robotics. RefSpatial-Bench evaluation.

name: MILO
notes: Implicit spatial world modeling with visual generative tuning + RePE for enhanced spatial reasoning in MLLMs.

name: Deformable DETR
notes: Deformable Transformers for End-to-End Object Detection (Zhu et al., ICLR 2021). Uses deformable attention to efficiently attend to sparse spatial locations. ResNet-50 backbone + Transformer encoder-decoder with deformable attention modules.

name: DROID-SLAM
notes: Deep Visual SLAM for Monocular, Stereo, and RGB-D Cameras (Teed & Deng, NeurIPS 2021). Dense optical flow + differentiable bundle adjustment.

name: MoGe
notes: MoGe: Unlocking Accurate Monocular Geometry Estimation for Open-Domain Images (arXiv:2410.19115). Metric monocular depth and geometry.

name: UniDepth
notes: UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Depth Estimation (arXiv:2403.18913).

name: Metric3D v2
notes: Metric3D v2: A Versatile Monocular Geometric Foundation Model.

name: GeoCalib
notes: GeoCalib: Learning Single-Image Calibration with Geometric Optimization (arXiv:2409.06704).

name: Talk2DINO
notes: Talking to DINO: Bridging Self-Supervised Vision Backbones with Language for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation (arXiv:2411.19331). Learns a mapping from CLIP text embeddings to DINOv2 feature space.

name: Deep3DFaceRecon
notes: Accurate 3D Face Reconstruction with Weakly-Supervised Learning (CVPR Workshops 2019). Extracts FLAME-style 3DMM coefficients (expression, pose, shape) from single face images.

name: HyperReenact
organization: Bounareli et al. (Queen Mary / Univ. of Patras)
notes: HyperReenact: One-Shot Reenactment via Jointly Learning to Refine and Retarget Faces (ICCV 2023). Learns hypernetwork to offset StyleGAN2 weights for target pose.

name: DiffusionRig
notes: DiffusionRig: Learning Personalized Priors for Facial Appearance Editing (CVPR 2023). Trains DDPM conditioned on FLAME 3DMM buffers. Requires test-time fine-tuning with personal album.

name: ROME
notes: Realistic One-Shot Mesh-Based Head Avatars (ECCV 2022). Uses neural textures for one-shot face retargeting.

name: Arc2Face
params: ~860M (SD v1.5 UNet + retrained CLIP text encoder)
notes: Arc2Face: A Foundation Model for ID-Consistent Human Faces (ECCV 2024). Conditions SD solely on ArcFace embeddings via retrained CLIP text encoder for strong identity preservation.

name: ControlNet (SD v1.5)
notes: Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models (ICCV 2023). Adds spatial conditioning (edges, poses, depth) to SD via trainable copy of encoder blocks with zero convolutions.

name: LLaVA-Med-1.5 7B
notes: Medical VLM based on LLaVA-1.5 architecture, fine-tuned on biomedical image-text data. NeurIPS 2023.

name: LLaVA-Med 7B
notes: First version of LLaVA-Med, trained on biomedical image-text data from PMC. NeurIPS 2023.

name: Med-Flamingo
notes: Medical multimodal few-shot learner based on OpenFlamingo. ML4H 2023.

name: RadFM
notes: Generalist foundation model for radiology supporting 2D and 3D medical imaging.

name: MedVInT
notes: Medical visual instruction-tuned model for visual question answering.

name: BiomedCLIP
notes: Biomedical CLIP model trained on PMC-15M image-text pairs.

name: PubMedCLIP
notes: CLIP model fine-tuned on PubMed medical image-text pairs.

name: Qwen-VL-Chat
notes: Multimodal LLM supporting visual and language understanding.

name: Qwen-Image-Edit
notes: Instruction-based image editing model from Qwen team. Leading open-source editing model on UnicBench. Used as one of the editing models in UnicEdit-10M pipeline.

name: Qwen-Verify
notes: 7B dual-task expert model for image editing post-verification. Trained from Qwen2.5-VL-7B via SFT + D²PO. Performs failure detection and instruction recaptioning. Outperforms Qwen2.5-VL-72B at verification tasks.

name: Sentinel
params: n/a (zero-shot prompting framework on top of VLMs)

name: Cosmos-Predict2-2B-Video2World
architecture: Latent VAE + DiT backbone with temporal attention

name: MapAnything
notes: Universal feed-forward metric 3D reconstruction; provides relative pose estimates and per-frame depth maps

name: VideoAlign
notes: Provides visual quality, motion quality, and text alignment scores for video sequences

name: SGDiff
notes: Scene Graph Guided Diffusion Model for Image Collaborative SegCaptioning (AAAI 2025). Uses Swin-Transformer backbone + Mask2Former head + scene graph guided bimodal transformer with diffusion. 14.3GB VRAM for inference, 1.18 FPS.

name: Neural Motifs
notes: Scene graph parsing with global context (Zellers et al., CVPR 2018). Standard scene graph generation backbone used by many downstream methods.

name: GLM-4.5-Air-Base
notes: Base model used in KLong paper for training LLM agents on extremely long-horizon tasks

name: Kimi-VL-A3B
notes: MoE vision-language model with 3B active parameters; strong on vision reasoning tasks

name: GLM-4.1V-9B
notes: Vision-language model from Zhipu AI; part of GLM-4.1V family with versatile multimodal reasoning

name: GPT-5.1
notes: Proprietary OpenAI model released November 2025; multimodal capable

name: GPT-5.2
notes: Proprietary OpenAI model released January 2026; multimodal with advanced image generation

name: GPT-Image-1
notes: OpenAI image generation and understanding model; used for text-to-image tasks

name: Gemini-2.5-Image
notes: Google Gemini 2.5 with image generation capabilities

name: Imagen-4-Ultra
notes: Google Imagen 4 Ultra image generation model; successor to Imagen 3

name: Meditron-7B
access: epfl-llm/meditron-7b on HuggingFace; available via Ollama as meditron
notes: Domain-adapted LLM built on Llama-2-7B, further pretrained on PubMed articles, biomedical abstracts, and clinical practice guidelines. Base pretraining model WITHOUT instruction tuning.

name: Llama-4-Maverick
file_size_bf16: ~800GB total params (only 17B active per forward pass)

name: Mistral-3-3B
access: mistralai/Mistral-3-3B on HuggingFace (estimated, 2025 Mistral small model series)

name: Mistral-3-8B
access: mistralai/Mistral-3-8B on HuggingFace (estimated, 2025 Mistral model series)

name: Phi-4
notes: Dense 14B LLM from Microsoft trained on high-quality synthetic and web data; strong reasoning and math.

name: Qwen3-Embedding-8B
notes: Instruction-aware text embedding model from Qwen3 Embedding series (Zhang et al. 2025). Computes representations conditioned on instruction prompts. Used in S-VoCAL for attribute-specific semantic similarity evaluation.

name: Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507
notes: Thinking/reasoning variant released July 2025; enables extended chain-of-thought reasoning with /think and /no_think toggles

name: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507
notes: Thinking/reasoning variant released July 2025; used in CHIMERA (arXiv:2603.00889) for solution synthesis

name: DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B
notes: 8B distillation of DeepSeek-R1-0528, based on Qwen3 architecture; released May 2025

name: Phi-4-Mini-Instruct
notes: General-purpose instruction-following SLM; distinct from Phi-4-mini-reasoning which is specialized for math reasoning; used as baseline in GroupGPT MUIR evaluation

name: GTE-large-en-v1.5
notes: English text embedding model; used in MUIR evaluation as KNN classifier baseline

name: Jina-embedding-v3
notes: Multilingual text embedding model; used in MUIR evaluation as KNN classifier baseline

name: GPT-4.5 Preview
notes: Preview version of GPT-4.5; large multimodal model evaluated in DrawEduMath aftermath paper (2026)

name: Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview
notes: Preview version of Gemini 2.5 Pro; evaluated in DrawEduMath aftermath paper (2026)

name: Gemini 3 Flash
access: Gemini 3 Flash endpoint via Google AI Studio
notes: Fast, efficient variant of Gemini 3; used as LLM backbone in Semantic XPath ConvAI evaluation (arXiv:2603.01160)

name: facebook/bart-large-mnli
notes: BART-large fine-tuned on MultiNLI for zero-shot text classification via entailment; used as entailment-based semantic relevance scorer in Semantic XPath (arXiv:2603.01160)

name: DeepSeek-V3.2-exp
notes: Experimental version of DeepSeek V3.2, accessed via DeepSeek API; extremely cheap inference

name: Qwen3-Max
notes: Flagship Qwen3 MoE model (non-thinking variant); accessed via Alibaba DashScope API

name: Llama-2-7B-Chat
notes: RLHF-fine-tuned chat/instruction variant of Llama-2-7B; safety-aligned for dialogue use

name: Claude-Haiku-3
notes: Anthropic Claude 3 Haiku; smallest and fastest Claude 3 model released March 2024

name: GPT-5o-nano
notes: Compact variant of GPT-5 series (OpenAI 2025); likely equivalent to a nano/mini tier of GPT-5o

name: Gemini-3-flash-preview
notes: Preview version of Gemini 3 Flash model (Google 2025); fast and efficient tier of the Gemini 3 family

name: Qwen-Plus
notes: Qwen Plus is an API-served Qwen model offering a balance of capability and speed; not publicly released as weights

name: DeepSeek-V3.2
notes: DeepSeek-V3.2 is a successor to DeepSeek-V3 with 785B total parameters in MoE architecture; accessed via API in the DEP paper experiments

name: Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct
notes: Instruction-tuned variant of Qwen2-1.5B; used as evaluation model in KVSlimmer (arXiv:2603.00907) for KV cache compression benchmarks

name: LLaDA-8B-Instruct
notes: Masked Diffusion Language Model (MDLM). Uses bidirectional attention (non-causal). Generates text via iterative unmasking rather than autoregressive decoding. First MDLM scaled to 8B parameters comparable to modern LLMs. arXiv:2502.09992.

name: MedEmbed-large-v0.1
notes: Medical-domain text embedding model fine-tuned for biomedical NLP tasks; used for semantic clustering of medical questions in KG-Followup (arXiv:2603.01252)

name: Magistral-24B
notes: Reasoning-pretrained 24B model from Mistral AI; used in political opinion alignment experiments (arXiv:2603.01214)

name: Qwen3-4B-2507-Instruct
notes: July 2025 instruct variant of Qwen3-4B with strong reasoning and instruction following; used as base model in ReGFT (arXiv:2603.01223) for mathematical RL training on OmniMath

name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
notes: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6 (2026); current-generation frontier model used in SACD calibration drift study (arXiv:2603.01239) and as the underlying model for Claude Code assistant.

name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
access: Gemini 3.1 Pro endpoint via Google AI Studio
notes: Google Gemini 3.1 Pro (2026); frontier LLM evaluated in SACD calibration drift study (arXiv:2603.01239). Successor to Gemini 3 Pro with updated instruction-following and calibration properties.

name: ECAPA-TDNN
notes: Emphasized Channel Attention, Propagation and Aggregation in TDNN; trained on VoxCeleb for speaker verification; widely used as a strong baseline

name: Wav2Vec2-XLSR-1B
notes: XLS-R 1B parameter multilingual self-supervised speech encoder; trained on 436k hours of unlabeled speech across 128 languages

name: ERes2Net-Large
notes: Enhanced Res2Net with local and global feature fusion for speaker verification; arXiv:2305.12838

name: SDPN (Self-Distillation Prototypes Network)
access: ICASSP 2025 paper; no public checkpoint confirmed
notes: Self-distillation prototypes network for learning robust speaker representations without supervision; presented at ICASSP 2025

name: Mamba-130M
notes: Smallest Mamba state space model variant. Selective state space model with linear-time sequence modeling. Requires mamba_ssm package (CUDA required for fast scan). d_state=16, d_conv=4 typically used.

name: Claude Opus 4.5
notes: Frontier-class model from Anthropic; one of the four frontier models tested in semantic invariance study (Szeider 2026, arXiv:2603.01254); accessed via API at temperature=0

name: Qwen3-4B-Instruct
notes: Instruction-tuned (RLHF) variant of Qwen3-4B. Used in arXiv:2603.01297 for embedding-based safety classifier robustness analysis. Embedding dim: 1024.

name: Gemma-3-12B
notes: 12B parameter vision-language model in the Gemma 3 family; supports multimodal (image+text) input; used as baseline in hateful meme detection (arXiv:2603.01225).

name: Phi-3.5-Vision-Instruct
notes: Small but capable multimodal model; supports up to 128 frames for video; used as LLM-as-a-judge for CoT explanation quality evaluation in hateful meme detection (arXiv:2603.01225).

name: Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking
notes: Reasoning-enhanced variant of Qwen3-VL-8B with thinking/chain-of-thought mode enabled; released with the Qwen3-VL family (arXiv:2511.21631); used as base model for GRPO fine-tuning in hateful meme detection (arXiv:2603.01225).

name: IsoVEM
notes: Isotropic reconstruction for Volume Electron Microscopy based on Transformer (He et al., bioRxiv 2023). Uses attention mechanisms within a U-Net architecture for 3D EM isotropic reconstruction. 0.61T FLOPs per inference. Self-supervised training on lateral sections.

name: EMDiffuse
notes: Reference-Free Isotropic 3D EM Reconstruction using Diffusion Models (Lee & Jeong, 2023, arXiv:2308.01594). Also referred to as DiffuseEM. 22.51T FLOPs per inference — computationally very expensive due to iterative diffusion sampling. Self-supervised training on lateral sections of VEM data.

name: VEMamba
notes: VEMamba: Efficient Isotropic Reconstruction of VEM with Axial-Lateral Consistent Mamba. Proposes ALCSSM (3D dependency reordering via multi-directional scanning), DWAM (adaptive weight aggregation), and MoCo-based degradation learning. 0.28T FLOPs — 80x more efficient than EMDiffuse. Achieves SOTA on EPFL and CREMI datasets.

name: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct
notes: Instruction-tuned MoE variant of Qwen3-30B. Used as 'Qwen3-30B' in JailNewsBench evaluation (Kaneko et al. 2026). Requires ~60GB VRAM in BF16 (fits on 1x A100 80GB).

name: DeepSeek-8B-Instruct
notes: 8B parameter instruction-tuned DeepSeek model used as 'DeepSeek-8B' in JailNewsBench (Kaneko et al. 2026). Exact model version unclear from paper; likely DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B or a newer DeepSeek 8B release ca. 2025-2026.

name: SEA-RAFT
notes: Simple, Efficient, Accurate RAFT for optical flow (ECCV 2024). Improved RAFT variant with higher accuracy and efficiency. Used as pretrained optical flow estimator in SMART (arXiv:2603.00881) for coronary artery video segmentation.

name: MedSAM2
organization: Ma et al. (University Health Network / Vanderbilt)
notes: Segment Anything in 3D Medical Images and Videos (Ma et al., arXiv:2504.03600, 2025). Adaptation of SAM2 for 3D medical image and video segmentation. Used as baseline in SMART (arXiv:2603.00881).

name: Denver
notes: Deformable Neural Vessel Representations for Unsupervised Video Vessel Segmentation (Wu et al., CVPR 2025). Specifically designed for XCA video vessel segmentation using deformable neural representations. Used as baseline in SMART (arXiv:2603.00881).

name: KnowSAM
notes: Learnable Prompting SAM-Induced Knowledge Distillation for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation (Huang et al., IEEE TMI 2025, doi:10.1109/TMI.2025.3530097). Semi-supervised SAM-based segmentation using learnable feature prompts and knowledge distillation. Used as baseline in SMART (arXiv:2603.00881).

name: CPC-SAM
notes: Cross Prompting Consistency with Segment Anything Model for Semi-supervised Medical Image Segmentation (Miao et al., MICCAI 2024, LNCS 15011). Semi-supervised SAM-based approach using cross-prompt consistency regularization. Used as baseline in SMART (arXiv:2603.00881).

name: Depth Pro
notes: Monocular metric depth estimation producing sharp boundaries in <1s per image; presented at ICLR 2025. Used in ProFocus (arXiv:2603.05530) for computing per-object depth in ego-centric semantic map construction.

name: Qwen3-VL-Max
notes: Flagship Qwen3-VL vision-language model (API-only); corresponds to the largest Qwen3-VL variant accessed via Alibaba DashScope. Used as perception agent VLM in ProFocus (arXiv:2603.05530).

name: SnapGen
notes: SnapGen: Taming High-Resolution Text-to-Image Models for Mobile Devices (CVPR 2025). Lightweight diffusion U-Net architecture designed for mobile NPU deployment. Used as student backbone in MOBILE-VTON (arXiv:2603.00947). Authors re-implemented architecture from paper description due to no official code.

name: Ovis2.5-9B
notes: Ovis 2.5 multimodal LLM; used as base model for HDR-Q (arXiv:2603.00938); supports 10-bit HDR video input via custom HDR-aware encoder adapter.

name: Open-Sora-v2
resolution: variable resolution and duration video (e.g., 768x432 at 24fps)
architecture: Video DiT (Diffusion Transformer) with flow-matching objective, spatio-temporal patchification, 3D MMDiT architecture, T5 text encoder, supports variable resolutions and durations
notes: Open-Sora 2.0: Democratizing Efficient Video Production. State-of-the-art open video generation model using flow-matching objectives. Shares architectural principles with Flux.1 (flow-matching + transformer backbone + T5 encoder). Trained on large-scale video datasets. Supports 129-frame video generation at various resolutions.

name: MoGe-2 (moge-2-vits-normal)
notes: MoGe-2: Accurate Monocular Geometry with Metric Scale and Sharp Details (arXiv:2507.02546, 2025). Successor to MoGe (arXiv:2410.19115); adds metric scale estimation and sharper detail recovery. The 'vits-normal' variant uses ViT-S backbone for efficient deployment. Used in Dr.Occ (arXiv:2603.01007) to provide high-quality dense depth cues for 3D occupancy prediction.

name: BEVDet4D
notes: BEVDet4D: Exploit Temporal Cues in Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection (arXiv:2203.17054, 2022). Extends BEVDet with temporal feature fusion (4D = spatial 3D + time). Used as the primary baseline backbone in Dr.Occ (arXiv:2603.01007). Requires 6-camera surround-view setup with LiDAR-free inference (vision-only).

name: COTR
notes: COTR: Compact Occupancy Transformer for Vision-based 3D Occupancy Prediction (CVPR 2024). State-of-the-art 3D occupancy method using a dual forward-backward projection design with cross-view consistency. Used as the SOTA baseline in Dr.Occ (arXiv:2603.01007).

name: BEVFormer
organization: Li et al. (Nanjing University / Shanghai AI Lab / ECCV 2022)
notes: BEVFormer: Learning Bird's-Eye-View Representation from Multi-Camera Images via Spatiotemporal Transformers (ECCV 2022). Backward-projection BEV method using deformable attention. Foundational method for camera-based 3D perception in autonomous driving.

name: HunyuanVideo
notes: Text-to-video DiT model; Kong et al. arXiv:2412.03603 (2024). Uses dual-stream MMDiT architecture with MLLM text encoder.

name: Open-Sora 1.2
notes: Open-source text-to-video model based on STDiT3 architecture; Zheng et al. 2024. Democratized video generation with flexible frame rates and resolutions.

name: FlexiAct
notes: Implicit I2V motion transfer via frequency-aware motion tokens (Freq-aware Embedding). SIGGRAPH 2025.

name: I2VEdit
params: built on CogVideoX or SVD backbone
notes: First-frame-guided video editing via I2V diffusion models with motion LoRA. SIGGRAPH Asia 2024.

name: AnyV2V
params: built on I2V backbone (CogVideoX or SVD)
notes: Tuning-free video-to-video editing via inverted noise + feature injection. TMLR 2024 with Reproducibility Certification.

name: Go-with-the-Flow
notes: Motion-controllable video diffusion using real-time warped noise with optical flow guidance. CVPR 2025.

name: BLIP2-ITM-ViT-g
notes: BLIP-2 model with EVA-CLIP ViT-g/14 vision encoder, used specifically for Image-Text Matching (ITM) scoring. Outputs a scalar relevance score for an (image, text) pair without needing a full LLM decoder. Used in EFS (arXiv:2603.00983) and other frame selection pipelines for query-frame relevance scoring. Much lighter than full BLIP-2 generative models since only the ITM head is used.

name: CorrMLP
architecture: Correlation-aware coarse-to-fine MLP-based encoder-decoder for deformable medical image registration; 3D CNN encoder + MLP-based correlation matching; predicts dense displacement fields (DDF)
notes: CorrMLP: Correlation-Aware Coarse-to-Fine MLPs for Deformable Medical Image Registration. CVPR 2024. FlowReg (arXiv:2603.01073) extends this architecture with flow-matching timestep conditioning (+28K params, +0.7%).

name: VoxelMorph
architecture: U-Net based encoder-decoder that predicts a dense displacement field for unsupervised deformable image registration; uses local cross-correlation loss and gradient regularizer
notes: VoxelMorph: A Learning Framework for Deformable Medical Image Registration. TMI 2019. Classic and widely-used baseline for medical image registration.

name: TransMorph
architecture: Transformer-based U-Net for unsupervised deformable 3D medical image registration; combines Swin Transformer encoder with CNN decoder; outputs dense displacement fields
notes: TransMorph: Transformer for Unsupervised Medical Image Registration. Medical Image Analysis 2022.

name: FSDiffReg
architecture: Feature-wise and Score-wise diffusion-guided unsupervised deformable image registration; uses pre-trained diffusion score to guide registration in DDF space; requires pre-trained model
notes: FSDiffReg: Feature-wise and Score-wise Diffusion-Guided Unsupervised Deformable Image Registration for Cardiac Images. MICCAI 2023. Baseline in FlowReg (arXiv:2603.01073).

name: e5-base-v2
notes: Text embeddings by weakly-supervised contrastive pre-training; used as text retriever in MM-DeepResearch offline search engine; chosen over jina-embeddings-v4 for efficiency with comparable performance.

name: jina-embeddings-v4
notes: Universal embeddings for multimodal multilingual retrieval; used as image retriever (jina-CLIP based) in MM-DeepResearch offline search engine for cross-modal retrieval; slower than e5-base-v2 but supports multimodal queries.

name: Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct
notes: MoE LLM with 80B total parameters and ~3B active parameters per token; used as the offline judge model and knowledge-based search tool in MM-DeepResearch RL training; deployed on 8x H100 GPUs alongside the offline search engine.

name: LLaMA3-Med42-7B
organization: M42 Health / Mohamed bin Zayed University of AI
notes: Clinical LLM fine-tuned from Llama-3 on medical data. Med42-v2 suite, 2024.

name: BioMistral-7B
notes: Open-source medical domain LLM pretrained from Mistral-7B on PubMed Central. arXiv:2402.10373.

name: MedKLIP
notes: Medical knowledge enhanced language-image pre-training for X-ray diagnosis; used in ClinCoT for disease-conditioned activation maps.

name: ConvNeXt-Small
notes: ConvNeXt-Small from 'A ConvNet for the 2020s' (Liu et al., CVPR 2022). Modernized pure-convolutional backbone. No batch normalization (uses LayerNorm), making it compatible with per-sample gradient computation in DP-SGD.

name: DinoV3
notes: DinoV3 (Siméoni et al., arXiv 2508.10104, 2025). Successor to DINOv2 self-supervised vision foundation model with improved features. Used as initialization for DP-SGD fine-tuning in medical imaging.

name: VisionReasoner-3B
notes: Reasoning-integrated visual perception model trained via reinforcement learning; unified grounding and segmentation; achieves strong spatial reasoning for instance-level surgical tool grounding (arXiv:2603.01108).

name: VisionReasoner-7B
notes: 7B version of VisionReasoner: unified reasoning-integrated visual perception via RL. Best-performing model on GroundedSurg benchmark (arXiv:2603.01108) for spatial grounding and mask fidelity.

name: Migician-7B
notes: Migician: free-form multi-image grounding in multimodal LLMs. ACL 2025 Findings (arXiv:2603.01108 evaluation context).

name: MedMO-8B
notes: MedMO: Grounding and understanding multimodal LLM for medical images (arXiv:2602.06965, 2026). Medical-domain VLM evaluated on GroundedSurg benchmark (arXiv:2603.01108).

name: MedVLM-R1-2B
notes: MedVLM-R1: incentivizing medical reasoning via RL for VLMs (arXiv:2502.19634). 2B medical VLM evaluated on GroundedSurg (arXiv:2603.01108).

name: BiMediX2-8B
notes: BiMediX2: Bio-medical expert LMM for diverse medical modalities (arXiv:2412.07769). 8B bilingual medical VLM evaluated on GroundedSurg (arXiv:2603.01108).

name: VMamba-T
notes: Visual State Space Model backbone using 2D Selective Scan (SS2D) mechanism. Used as the encoder in ChangeMamba/MambaBDA.

name: MambaBDA (ChangeMamba)
notes: Building Damage Assessment variant of ChangeMamba. Siamese VMamba encoder with separate localization and damage classification decoder heads. Baseline for arXiv:2603.01116.

name: CONCH
notes: CONCH: A visual-language foundation model for computational pathology (Nature Medicine 2024, Lu et al.). Pretrained on 1.17M pathology image-caption pairs. Used as the frozen patch encoder in TC-SSA (arXiv:2603.01143). Requires license agreement from MahmoodLab.

name: UNI
notes: UNI: Towards a general-purpose foundation model for computational pathology (Nature Medicine 2024, Chen et al.). Pretrained on 100K+ WSIs from 20+ sources. Alternative patch encoder used in TC-SSA ablations (arXiv:2603.01143). Requires license agreement from MahmoodLab.

name: Seed-1.8
notes: ByteDance Seed Team proprietary VLM released 2025 (Bytedance Seed Team, 2025). Supports direct video ingestion via API. Competitive with Gemini-2.5-Pro on game benchmarks. Used as a reasoning VLM evaluated in GameVerse (arXiv:2603.06656). Specific model architecture undisclosed.

name: Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST)
notes: Audio Spectrogram Transformer (Gong et al., Interspeech 2021, arXiv:2104.01778). Transformer model applied to log mel spectrograms for audio classification. Used in TripleSumm (arXiv:2603.01169) for audio feature extraction at 1-second intervals via a 10-second centered window.

name: ViT-S SSL (TCGA+TULIP pathology)
access: https://github.com/mahmoodlab/CONCH or referenced in Kang et al. 2023
notes: Self-supervised ViT-S model pretrained on 36,666 whole slide images from TCGA and the internally collected TULIP dataset. Used as the primary feature extractor in ASMIL (arXiv:2603.06658) for WSI patch embedding to 384-dimensional features. Key dependency for state-of-the-art results.

name: LLaVA-OneVision-0.5B
organization: Haotian Liu et al. / LLaVA team
notes: Smallest LLaVA-OneVision model (0.5B), based on Qwen2-0.5B. Used in Wahl et al. arXiv:2603.01224 as a baseline for 3D object position estimation with QLoRA fine-tuning. Achieves lower performance than 7B variant on this task.

name: FoundationPose
notes: FoundationPose: Unified 6DoF Pose Estimation and Tracking of Novel Objects (CVPR 2024). Model-based 6DoF object pose estimation and tracking using neural object representation. Supports RGB-only or RGB-D input. Used in D-REX (arXiv:2603.01151) for real-world object trajectory capture during push interactions for mass identification.

name: HaMeR
organization: Rolphe Nithyananad et al. (UC Berkeley / Google)
notes: HaMeR: Reconstructing Hands in 3D with Transformers (CVPR 2024). Transformer-based 3D hand reconstruction from monocular video, producing MANO hand mesh parameters. Used in D-REX (arXiv:2603.01151) for recovering human hand pose from demonstration videos for policy retargeting.

name: MCC-HO
notes: MCC-HO: Multiview Consistent Correspondence for Hand-Object Reconstruction (NeurIPS 2023). Reconstructs 3D hand-held object meshes from monocular video of hand-object interaction. Used in D-REX (arXiv:2603.01151) to recover object shape from human demonstration videos.

name: DexGraspNet 2.0
params: N/A (pipeline combining grasp synthesis + contact modeling)
notes: DexGraspNet 2.0: Learning Generative Dexterous Grasping in Large-scale Synthetic Cluttered Scenes (CoRL 2024). Synthesizes dexterous grasps using contact-based optimization and neural refinement. Baseline in D-REX (arXiv:2603.01151) for tabletop dexterous grasping evaluation.

name: Human2Sim2Robot
notes: Human2Sim2Robot: Cross-Embodiment Transfer via Contact-Aware Simulation (2024). Real-to-sim-to-real pipeline for robot manipulation from human demonstrations using contact-aware simulation and hand retargeting. Baseline in D-REX (arXiv:2603.01151) for tabletop dexterous grasping.

name: Dex-Retargeting (AnyTeleop)
notes: AnyTeleop / Dex-Retargeting: A General Teleoperation System for Dexterous Robot Hands (RSS 2023). Optimization-based retargeting of human hand poses to dexterous robot hands (e.g., LEAP hand, Shadow hand). Used in D-REX (arXiv:2603.01151) to transfer human demonstration poses to LEAP robot hand for grasp policy training.

name: ShieldGemma2
notes: Safety classifier VLM built on Gemma 2; designed for multimodal content moderation across 6 fixed harm categories. Baseline in SafeGuard-VL (arXiv:2603.01228).

name: QwenGuard-7B
notes: Safety-specialized VLM based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, fine-tuned via SFT on LlavaGuard data for visual content safety classification. Key baseline in SafeGuard-VL (arXiv:2603.01228).

name: QwenGuard-3B
notes: Smaller safety-specialized VLM based on Qwen2.5-VL-3B, fine-tuned for visual content safety classification. Baseline in SafeGuard-VL (arXiv:2603.01228).

name: LlavaGuard-7B
notes: Open VLM-based safety guardrail for vision datasets and models, evaluates against 9 visual harm categories (O1-O9 taxonomy). arXiv:2406.05113.

name: LlavaGuard-0.5B
notes: Smaller variant of LlavaGuard for resource-constrained safety guardrail applications. arXiv:2406.05113.

name: GLM-4V-9B
notes: Vision-language model from THUDM; supports high-resolution image understanding and multilingual conversations. Part of GLM-4 series.

name: InstructBLIP-7B
notes: InstructBLIP: general-purpose instruction-tuned VLM built on BLIP-2 with Vicuna-7B backbone. NeurIPS 2023.

name: Gemma-2-27B-IT
notes: Instruction-tuned Gemma 2 27B; more permissive safety filters used in SafeGuard-VL (arXiv:2603.01228) for recaptioning unsafe image descriptions to recover suppressed unsafe semantics.

name: Llama Guard 3
notes: Safety classifier based on Llama 3; classifies inputs/outputs for 14 fixed harm categories. Baseline in SafeGuard-VL (arXiv:2603.01228).

name: QoQ-Med-7B
organization: CMU / MIT Media Lab (Dai et al.)
notes: 7B variant of QoQ-Med (Quality-of-Quality Medical); GRPO-style domain-aware RL post-trained medical VLM on Qwen2.5-VL-7B base. Used as RL-posttrained medical VLM baseline (M_RL) in arXiv:2603.01301.

name: MedVLThinker-7B
notes: MedVLThinker: Simple Baselines for Multimodal Medical Reasoning. 7B medical VLM with chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities. Baseline compared in arXiv:2603.01301 Table 3.

name: Med-R1-7B
notes: Med-R1: RL for Generalizable Medical Reasoning in Vision-Language Models. IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging 2026. Related to Med-R1-2B variant.

name: MedViT-v2
notes: Medical image classification model using KAN-integrated transformers and dilated neighborhood attention. Used as strong vision-only reference baseline for linear probing on MedMNIST-v2 in arXiv:2603.01301.

name: Attention U-Net
notes: Attention U-Net: Learning Where to Look for the Pancreas (MIDL 2018). Adds attention gates to U-Net skip connections to suppress irrelevant activations. Standard baseline for 2D medical image segmentation.

name: Swin-UNet
notes: Swin-Unet: Unet-like Pure Transformer for Medical Image Segmentation (ECCV Workshops 2022). First fully transformer-based U-Net using Swin Transformer encoder-decoder. Widely used transformer baseline for 2D medical segmentation.

name: MISSFormer
notes: MISSFormer: An Effective Medical Image Segmentation Transformer (IEEE TMI 2023). Enhanced Swin-Transformer U-Net with multi-scale inputs and efficient self-attention. Strong transformer baseline for 2D medical segmentation including breast ultrasound.

name: MTAN
notes: End-to-End Multi-Task Learning with Attention (CVPR 2019). Multi-task attention network that learns task-specific attention masks over shared encoder features. Classic MTL baseline applicable to image segmentation + classification tasks.

name: MTANet
access: architecture described in 'MTANet: Multi-task Attention Network for Medical Image Segmentation and Classification' (CVPR 2023)
notes: Multi-task attention network for joint medical image segmentation and classification with encoder-level task interaction. Baseline for breast ultrasound multi-task learning.

name: MTL-OCA
access: architecture described in 'Multi-task learning with optimal channel attention for breast ultrasound diagnosis' (Front. Oncol. 2025)
notes: Multi-task learning with Optimal Channel Attention for breast ultrasound diagnosis: joint segmentation and classification. Close state-of-the-art baseline in breast ultrasound MTL.

name: SAM-ViT-H
notes: Segment Anything Model (SAM) with ViT-H (huge) backbone (Kirillov et al., ICCV 2023). The largest SAM variant; used as pixel image encoder in AG-VAS (arXiv:2603.01305) and LISA for pixel-level feature extraction and mask decoding. Frozen during training.

name: MultiPUFFIN
organization: NTNU / KU Leuven / University of Surrey (Nogueira et al., 2025)
params: 34.96M total (GCN encoder + SMILES Transformer encoder + SchNet 3D encoder + experimental/descriptor auxiliary encoders + 9 domain-informed prediction heads)
access: not available (no code release as of arXiv:2603.00857)
notes: Multimodal Path-Unifying Foundation Fusion Interfaced Network. Predicts 9 physicochemical properties (solubility, logP, hydration free energy, boiling point, melting point, flash point, vapor pressure, viscosity, heat capacity) simultaneously. Uses thermodynamics-informed output heads (Wagner equation for vapor pressure, Andrade equation for viscosity, van't Hoff for solubility, etc.). Trained on 37,968 molecules from 9 public databases. 2-stage training: joint multi-task (83 epochs) + backbone-frozen head fine-tuning (26 epochs) on single RTX 5090 Laptop GPU in ~20 hours.

name: ChemBERTa-2
notes: SMILES-based transformer pretrained via masked language modeling (MLM) and multi-task regression (MTR) on 77 million molecules from PubChem. Per-property regression heads for fine-tuning. Cannot handle temperature-dependent properties (no condition encoding). arXiv:2209.01712.

name: Mistral-7B-v0.1
notes: Original Mistral-7B base model (v0.1); used in layer-wise capacity allocation and pruning experiments in arXiv:2603.00910 (MDL framework).

name: Gemma-7B
notes: Gemma 7B base (pre-trained) model from Google; used in layer-wise capacity allocation and pruning experiments in arXiv:2603.00910 (MDL framework).

name: Claude-3.7-Sonnet
notes: Claude 3.7 Sonnet by Anthropic; extended thinking / hybrid reasoning model. Benchmarked in MC-SEARCH (arXiv:2603.00873) for agentic multimodal RAG.

name: BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5
notes: Dense retrieval embedding model used for multimodal retrieval in MC-SEARCH (arXiv:2603.00873).

name: Gemini 2.0 Flash
access: gemini-2.0-flash via Google AI Studio or Vertex AI
notes: Google Gemini 2.0 Flash; fast, efficient LLM with 1M context window; used as a comparison model in AWE penetration testing evaluation (arXiv:2603.00960)

name: SANA-1.6B
notes: Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture using linear attention and Deep Compressed Autoencoder (32x compression). Efficient high-resolution image synthesis. arXiv:2410.10629.

name: Mistral-Large-2
access: mistral-large-latest via Mistral API or local via mistralai/Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407
notes: Mistral Large (2nd gen, 2024); flagship model from Mistral AI. Used as a panel evaluator in CollabEval (arXiv:2603.00993).

name: Claude-3-Sonnet
notes: Anthropic Claude 3 Sonnet; mid-tier Claude 3 model released February 2024. Used as a panel evaluator in CollabEval (arXiv:2603.00993).

name: Claude-3.5-Sonnet
notes: Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet; released June 2024. Used as final judge in CollabEval (arXiv:2603.00993).

name: Ministral-3B
notes: 3B parameter small model from Mistral AI; used as lightweight backbone in FastCode repository-scale code reasoning evaluation (arXiv:2603.01012)

name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B
notes: MoE code-specialized model from Alibaba; 30B total params with 3B active parameters per token; used as open-weights backbone in FastCode (arXiv:2603.01012) achieving competitive LOC-BENCH performance at 200x cost reduction vs. Claude 3.5 Sonnet

name: DeepSeek-R1-8B
notes: 8B reasoning-distilled variant of DeepSeek-R1; used as backbone LLM in FastCode repository-scale code reasoning (arXiv:2603.01012)

name: Jamba-1.5-Large-400B
notes: Hybrid Mamba SSM + Transformer architecture; 400B parameter model from AI21 Labs with 256K context window; evaluated on LongCodeQA long-context code understanding benchmark (arXiv:2603.01012)

name: MetaMath-LLaMA-7B
notes: MetaMath-7B built on LLaMA-2-7B fine-tuned on MetaMathQA dataset for mathematical reasoning (Yu et al., ICLR 2024). Used as backbone for OTV evaluation on GSM8K (arXiv:2603.01025).

name: MetaMath-Mistral-7B
notes: MetaMath-7B built on Mistral-7B fine-tuned on MetaMathQA dataset for mathematical reasoning (Yu et al., ICLR 2024). Used as backbone for OTV evaluation on GSM8K (arXiv:2603.01025).

name: AceMath-RM-7B
notes: Outcome-level reward model from AceMath suite (Liu et al., 2024). Scores full math solutions for correctness. Used as external verifier baseline in OTV paper (arXiv:2603.01025).

name: VersaPRM-8B
notes: Multi-domain process reward model trained on synthetic reasoning data (Zeng et al., arXiv:2502.06737, 2025). Assigns step-level rewards. Used as external verifier baseline in OTV paper (arXiv:2603.01025).

name: Math-Shepherd-Mistral-7B
notes: Math-Shepherd process reward model built on Mistral-7B, trained without human annotations using automatic step-level verification (Wang et al., arXiv:2312.08935). Used as external verifier baseline in OTV paper (arXiv:2603.01025).

name: Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B
notes: Process reward model from Qwen2.5-Math suite (Zhang et al., arXiv:2501.07301). Two variants used in OTV paper: PRM800K-7B (trained on MATH-PRM800K) and PRM-7B (RL-trained). Used as external verifier baselines (arXiv:2603.01025).

name: MiniMax M2.5
notes: MiniMax M2.5 (2026); frontier LLM from MiniMax positioned for real-world productivity. Used as one of the two primary models (alongside Claude Sonnet 4.6) in arXiv:2603.00991 (tacit framework) for safety and expressiveness evaluation across AgentDojo-based benchmark, τ²-bench, and SWE-bench Lite.

name: all-mpnet-base-v2
notes: Sentence-transformers model based on MPNet-base fine-tuned on 1 billion sentence pairs; state-of-the-art semantic similarity and clustering embeddings. Used in Alien Science (arXiv:2603.01092) as the embedding backbone for HDBSCAN clustering of 39,028 conceptual units into 2,457 idea atoms, and for novelty scoring of generated blog posts.

name: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct
notes: 4B variant of Qwen3-VL instruction-tuned model. Used as base model in DIVA-GRPO ablation experiments (Appendix D.3).

name: R1-ShareVL-7B
notes: GRPO-trained 7B VLM using global advantage from semantically consistent variants. Based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. Key baseline and training dataset source (R1-ShareVL-52K) for DIVA-GRPO.

name: MM-Eureka-7B
notes: GRPO-trained VLM with selective sample utilization (filters zero-advantage cases). Based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Also introduces MMK12 benchmark. Compared against in DIVA-GRPO (Table 1).

name: OpenVLThinker-7B
notes: Open-source 7B reasoning VLM trained with RL. Compared in DIVA-GRPO Table 1; 60.6 average on six multimodal benchmarks.

name: Adora-7B
notes: RL-trained 7B VLM for multimodal reasoning. Compared in DIVA-GRPO Table 1 achieving 58.1 avg across six benchmarks.

name: R1-Onevision-7B
notes: RL-trained 7B VLM based on LLaVA-OneVision architecture with GRPO. Compared in DIVA-GRPO Table 1; 42.27 avg on six benchmarks.

name: QVQ-72B-Preview
notes: 72B reasoning-focused VLM from Qwen team. Preview release with strong visual reasoning capabilities. Compared in DIVA-GRPO Table 1; 52.60 avg on six benchmarks.

name: InternVL2.5-8B-MPO
notes: InternVL2.5-8B fine-tuned with Mixed Preference Optimization (MPO). Compared in DIVA-GRPO Table 1; 36.95 avg on six benchmarks.

name: InternVL2.5-38B-MPO
notes: InternVL2.5-38B fine-tuned with Mixed Preference Optimization (MPO). Compared in DIVA-GRPO Table 1; 48.78 avg on six benchmarks.

name: Tongyi-DeepResearch-30B-A3B
notes: State-of-the-art deep-research agent from Alibaba used as teacher model in DeepResearch-9K (arXiv:2603.01152). Generates multi-step search trajectories with reasoning chains via iterative tool-use. Achieves 72.47%/71.33%/23.73% accuracy on L1/L2/L3 of DeepResearch-9K and 24.94% on BrowseComp-Plus. Based on Qwen3-30B-A3B architecture with deep-research fine-tuning. Not openly downloadable; accessible via Tongyi API.

name: HuatuoGPT-o1-8B
notes: Medical-domain LLM fine-tuned for complex reasoning using an o1-style training paradigm (verifiable medical reasoning). 8B model from HuatuoGPT-o1 paper (arXiv:2412.18925). Used as baseline in MedCollab (arXiv:2603.01131).

name: Baichuan4-Turbo
notes: Baichuan4-Turbo is a fast inference variant of the Baichuan4 frontier LLM series from Baichuan AI. Evaluated as baseline in MedCollab (arXiv:2603.01131) for full-cycle clinical diagnosis. Note: the reference (arXiv:2412.15270) is titled Baichuan4-Finance Technical Report, suggesting Baichuan4 series models.

name: GLM-4.7
notes: GLM-4.7 from z.ai (Zhipu AI); claimed advances in coding and complex reasoning (2026). Evaluated as baseline in MedCollab (arXiv:2603.01131) for clinical diagnosis.

name: Canary-1B-flash
notes: Fast encoder-decoder ASR model from NVIDIA. Used for Indian language ASR evaluation with finetuning on MahaDhwani.

name: IndicConformer
notes: Open-source multilingual Conformer ASR model supporting 22 Indian languages from AI4Bharat.

name: bart-large-mnli
notes: Fine-tuned BART model for Natural Language Inference (NLI) / entailment tasks

name: Llama-3.3-70B
notes: Improved version of Llama 3.1 70B; used for synthetic argument generation in opinion alignment research (arXiv:2603.01214)

name: Virchow2
notes: Virchow2: Scaling self-supervised mixed magnification models in pathology (arXiv:2408.00738). Foundation model pretrained on 1 million H&E-stained WSIs from multiple magnifications. Used as backbone in CRISP (arXiv:2510.04861) for intraoperative frozen section analysis.凍結果と以下の

name: Prov-GigaPath
notes: Prov-GigaPath: A vision foundation model for computational pathology (Nature Medicine 2024). Large-scale pathology foundation model pretrained on 1.3B pathology tiles from 31k WSIs. Compared against in CRISP (arXiv:2510.04861) for frozen section diagnosis.

name: PathChat
notes: PathChat: A multimodal generative AI assistant for pathology (Nature Medicine 2024). Vision-language model for pathology with chat capabilities. Compared against in CRISP (arXiv:2510.04861) for frozen section diagnosis.

name: DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-Base
notes: Base model for Goedel-Prover paper (arXiv:2502.07640); theorem prover based on DeepSeek language model; used as starting point for expert iteration SFT training in Goedel-Prover

name: GCN
params: varies by config (1-2 layers, 16-512 hidden dims)
notes: Graph Convolutional Network. First scalable spectral GNN. Layer: H = ReLU(AD~H W). Chebyshev filter approximation. Basis for many follow-up models.

name: GraphSAGE
params: varies by config (2-3 layers, 64-512 hidden dims)
notes: Graph Sample and Aggregate. Inductive learning on graphs. First to use neighbor sampling for scalability. Architectures: GCN, GraphSAGE-pool, GAT, LSTM aggregator.

name: GAT
params: varies by config (2-3 layers, 64-256 hidden dims, 4-8 attention heads)
notes: Graph Attention Network. Multi-head attention over graph structure. GATv2 (Brody et al., ICLR 2022) fixes an expressivity issues.

name: SIGN
params: varies by config (1 inception layer, 256-512 units, r diffusion operators)
notes: Scalable Inception Graph Neural Network. Decouples graph propagation from learning via precomputed diffusion operators. 30x faster inference than sampling-based methods. SOTA on ogbn-papers100M.

name: TGN
params: varies by config (1-2 graph layers, 64-256 hidden dims, GRU memory)
notes: Temporal Graph Network. First to combine node memory (GRU) with GNN for continuous-time dynamic graphs. State-of-the-art on temporal node classification and link prediction.

name: Dir-GCN
params: varies by config (2 layers, doubled params for in/out directions)
notes: Directed Graph Neural Network. Extends any MPNN to directed graphs with separate in/out aggregators. Large accuracy gains on heterophilic graphs, unchanged on homophilic.

name: S-GCN
notes: Shallow Graph Convolutional Network. Single graph convolutional layer with learned adjacency powers. Baseline for SIGN. Simpler than SIGN (one operator vs multiple).

name: EquiformerV2
notes: Equivariant Transformer for higher-degree representations. Uses spherical harmonic features up to degree 4 (lmax=4). SE(3)/SO(3)-equivariant for molecular structure prediction. Achieves SOTA on OC20 and molecular property prediction.

name: PaiNN
notes: PaiNN (Physically Informed Neural Network). Equivariant message passing with scalar and vector features. SO(3)-equivariant for molecular properties. Lightweight alternative to higher-order equivariant models.

name: GemNet-OC
notes: GemNet-OC (Omnidirectional Connection). SOTA ML force field for molecular dynamics. Uses directed edge embeddings and interaction blocks. Pre-trained on OC20 for catalyst structure prediction.

name: scGPT
notes: Transformer-based foundation model for single-cell transcriptomics. Trained on millions of cells across diverse tissues. Used for cell type annotation, perturbation prediction, and GRN inference.

name: Geneformer V2-316M
notes: Foundation model for single-cell transcriptomics with 316M parameters. Uses rank-based tokenization for gene expression. Trained on ~30M cells. Evaluated in arXiv:2602.17532 for attention-derived GRN inference.

name: Pythia-6.9B
notes: Pythia-6.9B is a decoder-only transformer trained on the Pile. Used in PRO paper (arXiv:2505.23316) for alignment experiments with Anthropic-HH dataset.

name: SONIC (Motion Tracking Policy)
notes: Universal humanoid motion tracking policy. Trained with PPO on 100M frames of motion capture data. Supports multiple input modalities (robot motion, human motion, hybrid) through universal token space. Deployed on Unitree G1 humanoid robot.

name: Unitree G1
notes: Humanoid robot with 23 degrees of freedom. Used as the physical platform for SONIC deployment. Supports real-time control at 50Hz with PD controllers.

name: GR00T N1.5
notes: Foundation model for generalist humanoid robots. SONIC uses fine-tuned GR00T N1.5 for autonomous mobile manipulation tasks. Outputs teleoperation-format commands (head/wrist poses, base height, navigation).

name: SingLEM
organization: Tokyo University of Agriculture and Technology
notes: Single-Channel Large EEG Model. Self-supervised foundation model for EEG that learns at single-channel level. Pretrained on 71 datasets (357K single-channel hours, 9,200+ subjects). Montage-independent, works with any electrode configuration including single-channel.

name: BENDR
notes: BERT-inspired EEG Deep Representations. Pretrained on clinical EEG data (Temple University Hospital). Requires fixed 19-channel montage. Uses contrastive learning.

name: BIOT
notes: Biosignal Transformer. Pretrained on 6 public EEG datasets. Uses 16 bipolar and 2 monopolar channels. Sensitive to channel configuration mismatches.

name: LaBraM
notes: Large Brain Model for EEG. Uses patch-based predictive coding with transformer. Fixed electrode positions with learnable positional embeddings. Pretrained on ~20 datasets.

name: CBraMod
notes: Criss-Cross Brain Foundation Model. Uses criss-cross attention to model inter-channel relations. Pretrained on fixed 19-channel setup (10-20 montage).

name: AlphaFold 3
notes: Foundation model for biomolecular cofolding (proteins, ligands, nucleic acids, cofactors). Released 2024. Uses a Pairformer trunk and diffusion-based structure module. Non-commercial license restricts use.

name: Boltz-1
notes: Open-source biomolecular interaction model. Trained on PDB structures up to 2021-09-30. Reference: bioRxiv 2024.11.19.624167.

name: Boltz-1x
notes: Improved version of Boltz-1. Trained on PDB structures up to 2021-09-30. Reference: bioRxiv 2024.11.19.624167.

name: Boltz-2
notes: Second generation Boltz model with improved binding affinity prediction. Trained with later data cutoff (2023-06-01), giving it an advantage on newer structures. Reference: bioRxiv 2025.06.14.659707.

name: Chai-1
notes: Decoding molecular interactions model for protein-ligand cofolding. Trained on PDB structures up to 2021-09-30. Reference: bioRxiv 2024.10.10.615955.

name: ProteniX
notes: AlphaFold3 reproduction for biomolecular structure prediction. Trained on PDB structures up to 2021-09-30. Reference: bioRxiv 2025.01.08.631967.

name: PEARL
notes: Foundation model for protein-ligand cofolding with SO(3)-equivariant diffusion module. Key innovations: large-scale synthetic data training, equivariant architecture, multi-chain templating for non-polymeric components. This paper: arXiv 2510.24670.

name: RAFT
notes: Recurrent All-Pairs Field Transforms for Optical Flow (ECCV 2020). Foundation model for iterative optical flow estimation using cost volumes. WAFT replaces cost volumes with high-resolution warping. RAFT provides the convex upsampling and iterative update architecture that WAFT builds upon.

name: DPT-Small
notes: Dense Prediction Transformer (ICCV 2021). WAFT uses a modified DPT-Small as the recurrent update module architecture. DPT provides the transformer-based processing of concatenated features (frame1 features + warped frame2 features + hidden state) for iterative flow refinement.

name: Twins-SVT-Large
notes: Twins-SVT-Large vision transformer (Chu et al., arXiv:2104.13840, 2021). Used as frozen ImageNet-pretrained backbone in WAFT-Twins-a2. WAFT paper shows competitive results using only this lightweight pretrained backbone, demonstrating that advanced backbones are not strictly necessary.

name: Depth-Anything V2 Small (DAv2-S)
notes: Depth-Anything V2 Small (Yang et al., arXiv:2406.17114, 2024). Depth-pretrained vision backbone used in WAFT-DAv2-a1 and WAFT-DAv2-a2 variants. The depth pretraining provides strong dense feature representations that benefit optical flow estimation. WAFT with DAv2 achieves the best overall performance across all benchmarks.

name: DINOv3-ViT-S/16
