notes: DINOv3 ViT-S/16 distilled (Siméoni et al., arXiv:2508.10104, 2025). Unsupervised-pretrained vision transformer used as backbone in WAFT-DINOv3-a2. Successor to DINOv2 with improved dense feature quality. WAFT-DINOv3-a2 achieves competitive performance with the DAv2 variants, showing the method works with different pretrained backbones.

name: HuBERT-base
notes: Self-supervised speech representation learning by masked prediction of hidden units. Base model with 12 transformer layers; trained on LibriSpeech 960h. Used in arXiv:2509.15655 for layer-wise minimal pair probing.

name: HuBERT-large
notes: Self-supervised speech representation learning by masked prediction of hidden units. Large model with 24 transformer layers; trained on 60k hours of audio. Key finding in arXiv:2509.15655: S3Ms match or surpass ASR encoders on every linguistic level despite never seeing text.

name: wav2vec2-base
notes: Self-supervised speech representation learning with contrastive learning and quantized latent space. Base model with 12 transformer layers. Used in arXiv:2509.15655 layer-wise minimal pair probing.

name: wav2vec2-large
notes: Self-supervised speech representation learning with latent space masking and contrastive learning. Large model with 24 transformer layers, 16 attention heads, 1024 hidden dim. Used in arXiv:2509.15655 layer-wise minimal pair probing.

name: S2T-small
notes: Speech-to-Text transformer model (S2T). Small variant for end-to-end ASR. Probed in arXiv:2509.15655 for linguistic encoding in ASR encoder components.

name: S2T-large
notes: Speech-to-Text transformer model (S2T). Large variant with transformer encoder-decoder architecture. In arXiv:2509.15655, ASR encoder layers show continued improvement in final layers (unlike S3Ms which crash).

name: Whisper-base
notes: Whisper base model for automatic speech recognition. Weakly supervised training on large-scale audio-text data. Probed in arXiv:2509.15655 for temporal asymmetry — shows flatter, gradually rising temporal profile unlike S3Ms.

name: Whisper-large (original)
notes: Whisper large model (original, not v3) for automatic speech recognition. Weakly supervised on 680k hours of audio. In arXiv:2509.15655, shows flatter temporal curve than S3Ms, accumulating evidence more evenly toward onset.

name: Qwen-Audio
notes: Multimodal LLM accepting speech, sounds, music and text. Uses multi-task learning across 30+ tasks. In arXiv:2509.15655, AudioLLM encoders maintain rising accuracy in final layers (unlike S3Ms) and show flatter temporal profiles.

name: EnCodec_24khz
notes: High fidelity neural audio compression model. Streaming encoder-decoder with quantized latent space. RVQ with multiple codebooks. In arXiv:2509.15655, EnCodec stays at chance on all probing tasks — confirming compression models lack linguistic structure.

name: Kokoro-82M
notes: State-of-the-art TTS model based on StyleTTS 2 architecture with ISTFTNet vocoder. Used in arXiv:2509.15655 to synthesize 116,300 audio minimal pairs from BLIMP and COMPS text. Output at 24kHz, downsampled to 16kHz to match speech model input.

name: LiSA 1.0
notes: AMBOSS LiSA (Large Language model Search Agent) is a medically-grounded RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) system specifically designed for clinical decision support. Queried via API with zero data retention. Used in NOHARM paper (arXiv:2512.01241) as a baseline. Best performer in NOHARM evaluation (Safety 69.5%). Combined with open-source and proprietary models in multi-agent configurations for harm mitigation.

name: AMBOSS (Medical RAG)
notes: AMBOSS is a medical knowledge platform with AI-powered clinical decision support. Provides RAG-based medical AI through API. LiSA 1.0 is the company's primary medical AI product. Both LiSA and AMBOSS appear as separate entries in the NOHARM paper evaluation.

name: Glass Health
notes: Glass Health is a medical AI company providing ambient clinical decision support through RAG systems. Accessed via API with zero data retention for NOHARM benchmark evaluation (arXiv:2512.01241). One of two commercial medical RAG systems that agreed to participate in the NOHARM evaluation.

name: DINOv2 ViT-L/14 (1.14B)
notes: Large variant of DINOv2 self-supervised vision model with 1.14B params. Used in arXiv:2601.21948 (Shallow Alignment) for neural visual decoding from EEG/MEG. Shows 58.4% Top-1 accuracy improvement when using intermediate layer alignment vs final layer.

name: EVA-02 (4.35B)
notes: EVA-02 large vision model with 4.35B params. Used in arXiv:2601.21948 (Shallow Alignment) for neural visual decoding. Achieves 79.0% Top-1 on THINGS-EEG with intermediate layer alignment.

name: InternViT (5.54B)
notes: InternViT visual encoder with 5.54B params from InternVL family. Used in arXiv:2601.21948 (Shallow Alignment) as the best-performing vision backbone for neural visual decoding, achieving 82.6% Top-1 on THINGS-EEG with intermediate layer alignment.

name: FourCastNet 3 (FCN3)
params: unknown (large; exceeds single 80GB GPU, requires spatial model parallelism)
notes: FourCastNet 3 (FCN3) is NVIDIA's probabilistic ML weather forecasting model using spherical neural operators with a hidden Markov model formulation. Achieves GenCast-level accuracy 8x faster than GenCast, 60x faster than IFS-ENS. Trains on ERA5 with spectral+spatial CRPS loss. Key innovation: stable spectra up to 60-day lead times. Trained on 1024 H100s for 78h (Stage 1) + 512 A100s for 15h (Stage 2) + 256 H100s for 8h (Stage 3).

name: GenCast
notes: GenCast is DeepMind's diffusion-based probabilistic weather forecasting model (Nature 2024). State-of-the-art probabilistic ML weather model. Generates 15-day forecasts in 8 minutes on Cloud TPU v5. Uses denoising diffusion for ensemble generation. Compared against in FourCastNet 3 paper as the primary baseline to beat.

name: GraphCast
notes: GraphCast is Google DeepMind's GNN-based global weather forecasting model (Science 2023). Uses graph neural networks on a latitude-longitude grid. One of the first ML models to surpass IFS deterministic forecasts at medium range. Open-sourced.

name: Pangu-Weather
notes: Pangu-Weather is Huawei's 3D high-resolution global weather forecasting model using 3D transformer architecture tailored for the Earth's sphere (Nature 2023). Achieved SOTA on deterministic weather forecasting benchmarks. Not publicly released.

name: VideoCLIP
notes: VideoCLIP: Contrastive Language-Video Pretraining. Pretrained on HowTo100M dataset for video-text alignment. Used as cross-modal encoder in GRACE (arXiv:2507.11892) for Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition. Paper: 'VideoCLIP: Contrastive Language-Video Pretraining' (ACL 2021).

name: MedAlpaca-7B
notes: Medical domain-adapted LLM based on LLaMA-2-7B, fine-tuned on medical instruction data

name: AlpaCare-7B
notes: Medical instruction-tuned LLM for clinical QA; trained on PubMed GPT responses and medical QA datasets

name: PMC-LLaMA-13B
notes: Medical LLM based on LLaMA-2-13B, further pretrained on PubMed articles and clinical notes

name: MedLM-Large
notes: Medical LLM powered by Med-PaLM 2; built on PaLM 2; fine-tuned for medical domain; available via Google Cloud

name: MedLM-Medium
notes: Medical LLM (medium variant) with longer context; built on PaLM 2; available via Google Cloud

name: MMed-LLaMA-3-8B
notes: Multilingual medical LLM based on LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct; trained on multilingual medical data

name: Gemini-1.5-Pro
notes: Google Gemini 1.5 Pro with 2M token context; used in paper for synthetic instruction generation

name: ConvNeXt-Large
notes: ConvNeXt-Large from 'A ConvNet for the 2020s' (Liu et al., CVPR 2022). Uses LayerNorm instead of BatchNorm, making it compatible with per-sample gradient computation. Used in DUSA paper (arXiv:2501.00873) for test-time adaptation experiments.

name: MedGemma
notes: Medical-specialized multimodal model built on Gemma 3 architecture, fine-tuned on biomedical literature and clinical text.

name: PMC-LLaMA
notes: LLaMA fine-tuned on PubMed Central biomedical literature for medical QA.

name: MedAlpaca
notes: LLaMA-based model fine-tuned on medical QA datasets including clinical text.

name: AlphaCare
notes: Alpaca-style LLaMA model further fine-tuned on medical QA datasets.

name: MOTR
notes: Query-based end-to-end multiple object tracking transformer, builds on DETR. OVTR builds upon this framework.

name: OrientAnything
notes: Foundation model for robust 3D object orientation estimation. Estimates azimuth, polar angle, and rotation as categorical probability distributions over one-degree bins. Used as reward function in ORIGEN for 3D orientation grounding. Trained on rendering 3D models from Objaverse.

name: Jukebox
notes: Music generation model used as frozen audio encoder in DanceMosaic for extracting music features. Processes audio at multiple levels (1s, 4s, 16s) and outputs hierarchical VQ-VAE latent codes. DanceMosaic uses this as a frozen feature extractor for music-conditioned dance synthesis.

name: MobileNet
notes: Original MobileNet (mobilenet_v1) from 'MobileNets: Efficient Convolutional Neural Networks for Mobile Vision Applications'. Uses depthwise separable convolutions for efficiency. Paper arXiv:1704.04861.

name: ResNeXt-101
notes: ResNeXt-101 with 64x4d configuration (cardinality 64, bottleneck width 4). From 'Aggregated Residual Transformations for Deep Neural Networks' (CVPR 2017). Paper uses the 64x4d variant with ~45M params (though other sources cite ~83M).

name: RegNetX-32GF
notes: RegNetX-32GF from 'Designing Network Design Spaces' (CVPR 2020). One of the largest RegNet variants with ~107M parameters.

name: Zephyr-7B-beta
notes: DPO-fine-tuned Mistral-7B-v0.1. Used in LLM unlearning research (e.g., WMDP benchmark for unlearning robustness).

name: MUSE-Books-ICLM-7B
notes: LLaMA-based 7B model fine-tuned on Harry Potter books for MUSE unlearning benchmark. From Shi et al. 2024 (MUSE: Machine Unlearning Six-way Evaluation).

name: CHGNet
notes: Pretrained universal neural network potential for atomistic modeling. Graph Neural Network-based MLIP incorporating magnetic moments for charge-informed modeling. Used as surrogate for DFT in crystal stability evaluation.

name: M3GNet
notes: Universal graph deep learning interatomic potential implementing three-body interactions. Used for crystal structure stability prediction and relaxation.

name: CDVAE
notes: Crystal Diffusion Variational Autoencoder. Score-based generative model for crystal structure generation with property optimization in latent space.

name: CrystalTextLLM-70B
notes: Fine-tuned Llama model for crystalline materials generation as text. Baseline for MatLLMSearch comparison.

name: Stable Audio Open (SAO)
notes: Text-to-audio latent diffusion model using rectified flow. Uses DiT in latent space (64-channel 21.5Hz latent), T5 text embedder. Optimized variant reduces DiT from 1536→1024 dim, 24→16 layers. Generates up to 11.89s 44.1kHz stereo audio.

name: Stable Audio Open DiT (ARC-accelerated)
notes: ARC post-trained version of SAO. Uses adversarial relativistic-contrastive loss for few-step generation. Generates ~12s audio in ~75ms on H100 (100x faster than original SAO). Discriminator initialized from 75% of pre-trained DiT blocks.

name: TimesFM
notes: Decoder-only transformer for time-series forecasting. Zero-shot forecasting on diverse domains. Uses autoregressive decoding.

name: TimeMoE
notes: Mixture of Experts transformer for time-series forecasting. Zero-shot capability across domains.

name: UniTS
notes: Universal time-series model with multi-task pretraining. Encoder-only architecture with non-autoregressive decoding.

name: Moirai
notes: Multi-variate time-series forecasting model. Uses patch-based input processing and non-autoregressive decoding.

name: Chronos
notes: Time-series language model using T5 architecture. Zero-shot forecasting trained on massive time-series corpus.

name: TabPFN-TS
notes: TabPFN adapted for time-series forecasting. Uses transformer architecture with instance normalization.

name: InternVL2-26B
notes: Earlier version of InternVL2 (before InternVL2.5). Used as teacher model in DREAM paper (arXiv:2504.18053) for MRD observation generation and preference scoring. Vision encoder pretrained on interleaved image-text data.

name: MiniCPM-Llama3-V-2.5
notes: Multimodal LLM built on SigLip-400M vision encoder and Llama3-8B-Instruct. Strong OCR capabilities and low hallucination rate. Used as baseline model in DREAM paper (arXiv:2504.18053) for safety alignment evaluation.

name: Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct
notes: Qwen2-VL is the latest iteration of Qwen-VL. Supports multiple languages and features dynamic resolution architecture. Used as baseline model in DREAM paper (arXiv:2504.18053) for safety alignment evaluation.

name: TabPFN v2
notes: Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network v2. Transformer-based foundation model for probabilistic classification and regression on tabular data via in-context learning. Pre-trained on synthetic data from structural causal models. Used in NPE-PFN as a training-free conditional density estimator for simulation-based Bayesian inference. Supports feature dimension up to 500 and context up to 10^4 samples.

name: Presto
notes: Distillation-based acceleration for music generation. Uses auxiliary score model to minimize reverse KL loss + GAN loss. Baseline in ARC paper (arXiv:2501.08316).

name: ESM-3
notes: Protein language model supporting multiple tasks including inverse folding. First protein foundation model that directly supports inverse folding without task-specific fine-tuning. Used as policy model in ProtInvTree.

name: ESM-2
notes: Evolved Transformers for protein sequences. Used in KW-Design and other protein inverse folding methods.

name: ESMFold
notes: Protein structure prediction model based on ESM-2. Fast alternative to AlphaFold. Used in ProtInvTree for reward evaluation during tree search.

name: ProteinMPNN
notes: Protein sequence design model using graph neural networks. Strong baseline for fixed-backbone protein design.

name: MPT-7B
notes: MosaicML Pretrained Transformer. Trained on ~1T tokens of RedPajama data. Uses MHA (no RoPE). Used in A3 paper as MHA-NoPE baseline.

name: SuperPoint
notes: Self-supervised interest point detection and description. DeTone et al., CVPRW 2018. Used in LSG-SLAM for feature extraction prior to LightGlue matching.

name: LightGlue
input_format: SuperPoint/DISK/ALIKED/SIFT keypoints + descriptors from two images
output: matched keypoint pairs with confidence scores
notes: Adaptive deep feature matcher with dynamic pruning in width and depth. ICCV 2023. Supports SuperPoint, DISK, ALIKED, SIFT. Used in LSG-SLAM for feature matching between keyframes.

name: OPT-125M
notes: Open Pretrained Transformer. Used in BAQ paper for quantization experiments.

name: OPT-350M
notes: Open Pretrained Transformer. Used in BAQ paper for quantization experiments.

name: OPT-1.3B
notes: Open Pretrained Transformer. Used in BAQ paper for quantization experiments.

name: OPT-2.7B
notes: Open Pretrained Transformer. Used in BAQ paper for quantization experiments.

name: OPT-6.7B
notes: Open Pretrained Transformer. Used in BAQ paper for quantization experiments.

name: OPT-13B
notes: Open Pretrained Transformer. Used in BAQ paper for quantization experiments.

name: OPT-30B
notes: Open Pretrained Transformer. Used in BAQ paper for quantization experiments.

name: LLaMA2-13B
notes: LLaMA2 13B parameter model. Used in BAQ paper for quantization experiments.

name: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct
notes: Code-specific LLM from Qwen2.5 family. Used as backbone in FORTUNE paper (arXiv:2505.23667) for formula-driven RL training on table understanding tasks.

name: Qwen2.5-Coder-14B
notes: Larger code-specific LLM from Qwen2.5 family.

name: xlm-roberta-base
notes: Unsupervised cross-lingual representation learning at scale (Conneau et al., ACL 2020). Trained on 2.5TB of CommonCrawl data across 100 languages. Used as baseline in code-switching CSntax-GNN paper (Sterner & Teufel, ACL 2025).

name: xlm-roberta-large
notes: Large variant of XLM-RoBERTa (Conneau et al., ACL 2020). Used as fine-tuning baseline in code-switching CSntax-GNN paper (Sterner & Teufel, ACL 2025).

name: XFeat
notes: Fast feature keypoint detector and descriptor (CVPR 2024). Generates 6144 keypoints per frame at high speed using GPU-optimized implementation. Used in the on-the-fly NVS paper for fast initial pose estimation.

name: CAT3D
notes: Create Anything in 3D with Multi-View Diffusion Models (Gao et al., NeurIPS 2024). Foundation multi-view diffusion model adapted from Stable Diffusion LDM. Expands self-attention to 3D attention across views. WildCAT3D extends CAT3D with appearance-aware conditioning and warp conditioning to enable training on in-the-wild images.

name: DepthAnything
notes: Monocular depth estimation model from HKUST/Zhejiang University (Yang et al., CVPR 2024). Used in WildCAT3D for depth estimation aligned to COLMAP point clouds for warp conditioning.

name: Aurora
notes: Microsoft's foundation AI model for the Earth system (Bodnar et al., 2024). 1.3B parameter transformer trained on ERA5, GFS, and IFS-HR. Sets SOTA in global forecasting at time of publication. Trained on 32x A100 GPUs for 18 days. Only provides forecasts at fixed 6h lead times (unlike EPT-2's dynamic conditioning). Publicly available model weights not released; evaluation/visualization available.

name: Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct
notes: Frontier-scale Llama-3.1 405B Instruct model. Used in safety gap evaluation paper (arXiv:2507.11544) to demonstrate that the safety gap widens with model scale. The paper uses FP8-quantized version (Neuralmagic/Meta-Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct-FP8) for fine-tuning on 8xH100 nodes.

name: Qwen-2.5-0.5B-Instruct
notes: Smallest Qwen-2.5 Instruct model. Included in safety gap evaluation paper (arXiv:2507.11544) across the Qwen-2.5 model family (0.5B to 72B). Note: refusal ablation fails for this model size (cannot identify a high-quality refusal direction).

name: Qwen-2.5-32B-Instruct
notes: Mid-size Qwen-2.5 Instruct model. Used in safety gap evaluation paper (arXiv:2507.11544) demonstrating that safety gaps widen with model scale across the full Qwen-2.5 family.

name: Seaweed-3B
architecture: MM-DiT (Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer)
notes: Video generation foundation model used in Captain Cinema (arXiv:2507.18634) for bottom-up interleaved-conditioned video synthesis. Cost-effective training of video generation.

name: Llama3-LLaVA-Next-8B
notes: Multimodal LLM from Li et al. (2024), building on Llama-3-8B as the language backbone. Used as baseline LVLM in RED paper (arXiv:2507.07685).

name: V-JEPA 2 Gigantic
notes: V-JEPA 2 Gigantic (Assran et al., arXiv 2025): second-generation self-supervised video model enabling understanding, prediction and planning. Used in TRIBE paper (arXiv:2507.22229) for brain encoding from video stimuli.

name: V-JEPA-2-Gigantic-256
notes: Video-JEPA 2 Gigantic model used in TRIBE paper (arXiv:2507.22229). Self-supervised video model trained with feature prediction objective. Extracts video embeddings at 2Hz temporal resolution for brain encoding.

name: Wav2Vec-Bert-2.0
notes: Wav2Vec-Bert 2.0 used in TRIBE paper (arXiv:2507.22229) for extracting audio embeddings at 50Hz, resampled to 2Hz for brain encoding.

name: Baichuan-Omni-1.5
notes: Omni-modal model evaluated in OmniPlay benchmark (arXiv:2508.04361). Technical report at arXiv:2501.15368.

name: DepthAnythingV2-L
notes: Improved depth estimation model (Yang et al., NeurIPS 2024). Backbone used in FoundationStereo encoder. Provides monocular depth features for FoundationSSC (arXiv:2508.13601).

name: DepthAnythingV2-S
notes: Small variant of DepthAnythingV2 (Yang et al., NeurIPS 2024). Lightweight backbone option for FoundationStereo encoder in FoundationSSC (arXiv:2508.13601).

name: FoundationStereo-L
notes: Zero-shot stereo matching model (Wen et al., CVPR 2025). Combines DepthAnythingV2-L with stereo cost filtering. Used as frozen foundation encoder in FoundationSSC (arXiv:2508.13601). Provides decoupled semantic and geometric priors.

name: FoundationStereo-S
notes: Small variant of FoundationStereo for efficient inference. Lightweight encoder option for FoundationSSC (arXiv:2508.13601). Slightly lower performance but much faster than FoundationStereo-L.

name: FuXi
access: Pre-computed forecasts available on WeatherBench 2 (Google Cloud)
notes: FuXi is a cascade machine learning global weather forecasting system from Fudan University (Chen et al., npj Climate 2023). Uses a cascade approach with multiple models at different lead times. Forecasts available on WeatherBench 2 but model weights not publicly released.

name: MiniGPT-4
notes: MiniGPT-4: Enhancing Vision Language Understanding with One Single Projection Layer (Zhou et al., 2023). Uses Vicuna-7B as LLM backbone with EVA-G visual encoder and a single projection layer. Paper: arXiv:2304.10592.

name: Shikra-7B
notes: Shikra: Unleashing Multimodal LLM's Referential Dialogue Magic (Chen et al., 2023). Referential dialogue model supporting spatial coordinate input/output. Based on Vicuna-7B. Paper: arXiv:2306.15195.

name: GIN
params: varies by config (2-3 layers, 32-512 hidden dims)
notes: Graph Isomorphism Network (GIN). Most expressive among MPNNs (WL test equivalent). Uses injective aggregation: x_i' = MLP((1+eps)*x_i + sum(x_j)). Simple but strong baseline for graph property prediction.

name: TRACE
params: Not publicly disclosed; uses Hierarchical Transformer encoder
notes: Transformer for Reasoning about Algebraic and Computational Expressions. Novel circuit graph model using hierarchical level-by-level Transformer processing with function shift learning. Models circuit computation as ordered prefix-notation sequences. Achieves SOTA on RTL, AIG, and PM netlist tasks.

name: DeepGate2
notes: Functionality-aware circuit representation learning on AIGs. Uses asynchronous message passing with disentangled representations for circuit functional modeling.

name: DeepGate3
notes: Scalable circuit representation learning. Uses edge-masked transformer attention for circuit graph encoding.

name: DeepGate4
notes: Efficient and effective representation learning for circuit design at scale. Uses GraphGPS-style architecture with edge-masked attention.

name: DeepSeq2
notes: Enhanced sequential circuit learning with disentangled representations. Asynchronous MPNN for sequential AIG modeling.

name: DeepCell
notes: Multiview representation learning for post-mapping netlists. Uses message passing on PM netlist graphs.

name: FGNN2
notes: Powerful pre-training framework for learning the logic functionality of circuits. Uses gated message passing with pre-training objectives.

name: CircuitEncoder
notes: Self-supervised pre-trained circuit encoder with cross-stage alignment for RTL representation learning.

name: GraphGPS
params: varies by config (3-8 layers, 64-256 hidden dims)
notes: General, powerful, scalable graph transformer. Combines local MPNN message passing with global attention. Used as baseline in circuit graph experiments.

name: SGFormer
notes: Simplifying and empowering transformers for large-graph representations. Tokenized graph transformer with linear complexity.

name: DIFFformer
notes: Scalable graph transformers induced by energy constrained diffusion. Used as baseline in circuit experiments.

name: PolarGate
notes: Breaking the functionality representation bottleneck of AIG neural networks. Uses polar coordinate gating for AIG representation.

name: MGVGA
organization: Multi-Grained Variational Graph Augmentation (Liu et al.)
notes: Multi-grained variational graph augmentation for circuit representation learning on AIGs.

name: ProGen2-xlarge
access: hugohrban/progen2-xlarge on HuggingFace (community upload); original ProGen2 models from Salesforce Research
notes: GPT-like autoregressive protein language model trained on diverse protein sequences. Fine-tuned with LoRA in ApexAmphion for antimicrobial peptide generation. Used as the base generator in the RLHF-style PPO fine-tuning pipeline. Largest model in the ProGen2 family.

name: ESM2-8M
notes: Smallest variant of ESM2 protein language model. Used in ApexAmphion for computing embeddings of peptide sequences for the ApexMIC classifier.

name: PhoGPT-4B
notes: Vietnamese LLM based on MPT architecture. Vietnamese-specific BPE tokenizer with 20,480 vocabulary. Trained on 102B Vietnamese tokens. Used as observer model in VietBinoculars.

name: PhoGPT-4B-Chat
notes: Instruction-tuned variant of PhoGPT-4B, fine-tuned on 70K instructional prompts and 290K dialogue segments. Used as performer model in VietBinoculars.

name: Sailor2-8B
notes: Multilingual LLM for Southeast Asian (SEA) languages built on Qwen2.5. Trained on 500B tokens (400B SEA-specific + 100B replay). Supports 13 SEA languages including Vietnamese. Used for generating AI-text in VietBinoculars experiments.

name: Llama3.1-8B-Instruct
notes: Meta's Llama 3.1 8B instruction-tuned model. Used as a base model in RESTRAIN experiments for test-time RL training.

name: Octothinker Hybrid-8B-Base
notes: Midtrained from Llama3.1-8B. From paper 'Octothinker: Mid-training incentivizes reinforcement learning scaling' (arXiv:2506.20512). Used as a base model in RESTRAIN experiments.

name: Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct
notes: Instruction-tuned code-specific LLM from Qwen2.5 family. Used in CATMARK paper (arXiv:2510.02342) for watermarking evaluation on code generation benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP, StackEval).

name: Qwen2.5-Coder-3B
notes: Code-specific LLM from Qwen2.5 family with 3B parameters. Used as base model in self-aware RL experiments (arXiv:2510.02752) for code generation and math reasoning tasks.

name: Pythia-14M
notes: 14M parameter decoder-only transformer from the Pythia Scaling Suite (Biderman et al., 2023). 6 layers, 128 model dimension, 4 attention heads. Trained on The Pile (299B tokens). Specifically designed for interpretability research with checkpoint availability at 154 steps. Used in paper arXiv:2510.12071 for stagewise data attribution via Bayesian Influence Functions.

name: Kimina-Prover-RL-1.7B
notes: From arXiv:2504.11354 'Kimina-Prover Preview: Towards Large Formal Reasoning Models with Reinforcement Learning'. Base model for PROOFBRIDGE paper (arXiv:2510.15681). RL-trained for Lean 4 theorem proving.

name: Kimina-Prover-Distill-8B
notes: Distilled version of Kimina-Prover for Lean 4 theorem proving. Used as baseline in PROOFBRIDGE paper.

name: Kimina-Prover-72B
notes: 72B parameter version of Kimina-Prover for Lean 4 theorem proving. Best zero-shot AFPS baseline in PROOFBRIDGE paper.

name: LeanDojo ByT5 (proof-state encoder)
notes: ByT5-based encoder for proof-state embeddings used in LeanDojo (NeurIPS 2023). Encodes linearized proof DAGs for proof-state representation. Used as FL encoder in PROOFBRIDGE joint embedding model.

name: VACE
notes: All-in-one video creation and editing model. Used as in-context video generator in Ditto pipeline (2510.15742). Conditions on reference images, depth videos, and text prompts. DiT-based architecture with context branch for visual conditioning.

name: TiRex
notes: Time series forecasting foundation model using xLSTM (extended LSTM). Zero-shot forecasting with state-tracking capabilities. Trained on synthetic Gaussian processes, Chronos datasets, and selected Gift-Eval subsets. Rank 2 on fev-bench.

name: TimesFM 2.0
notes: Decoder-only foundation model for time series forecasting. Transformer-based architecture for zero-shot forecasting.

name: MOIRAI
notes: Unified training of universal time series forecasting transformers using frequency-specific projections and masked modeling. Zero-shot forecasting.

name: TempoPFN
notes: Zero-shot time series forecasting foundation model using linear RNNs with GatedDeltaProduct recurrence. Trained exclusively on synthetic data. State-weaving mechanism enables bidirectional information flow. Rank 6 on fev-bench.

name: Mamba4Cast
notes: Zero-shot time series forecasting with state space models (Mamba). Synthetic-only pre-training approach.

name: PYTHIA-160M
notes: Part of the PYTHIA suite for analyzing LLMs across training and scaling. Used as smallest target model in MIMIR MIA benchmark (arXiv:2510.19492).

name: PYTHIA-1.4B
notes: Part of the PYTHIA suite for analyzing LLMs across training and scaling. Used as target model in MIMIR MIA benchmark (arXiv:2510.19492).

name: PYTHIA-2.8B
notes: Part of the PYTHIA suite for analyzing LLMs across training and scaling. Used as target model in MIMIR MIA benchmark (arXiv:2510.19492).

name: PYTHIA-6.7B
notes: Part of the PYTHIA suite for analyzing LLMs across training and scaling. Used as target model in MIMIR MIA benchmark (arXiv:2510.19492).

name: PYTHIA-12B
notes: Part of the PYTHIA suite for analyzing LLMs across training and scaling. Largest target model in MIMIR MIA benchmark (arXiv:2510.19492).

name: GPT-2-XL
notes: 1.5B parameter GPT-2 model. Used as a target generator in RAID machine text detection benchmark (arXiv:2510.19492).

name: MPT-30B-Chat
notes: Chat-tuned variant of MPT-30B. Used as a target generator in RAID machine text detection benchmark (arXiv:2510.19492).

name: LLaMA-2-70B-Chat
notes: Chat-tuned 70B LLaMA-2 model. Used as a target generator in RAID machine text detection benchmark (arXiv:2510.19492).

name: Step1X-Edit
notes: Training-based text-image-to-image (TI2I) editing method using Multimodal LLM + diffusion decoder. Based on FLUX.1-dev architecture. From arXiv:2504.17761.

name: Qwen-Image-Edit (Qwen-Edit)
notes: Training-based TI2I editing method using vision-language model (Qwen2.5-VL) to encode editing instructions, combined with MM-DiT architecture. From arXiv:2508.02324.

name: EditScore
notes: Reward model for evaluating instruction-guided image editing quality. Provides EditScore measuring consistency (Cons), prompt following (PF), and overall edit score. From arXiv:2509.23909.

name: FlowEdit
notes: Training-free text-based image editing method using flow matching. Constructs ODE between source and target distributions. Works with FLUX.1 and Stable Diffusion 3. From arXiv:2412.08629.

name: StableFlow
notes: Training-free image editing method for flow-based DiT models. Identifies vital layers for image formation and uses selective attention feature injection. Based on FLUX.1-dev. From arXiv:2411.14430.

name: ResNetV2-50
notes: Pre-activation residual network (ResNet v2). Paper: 'Identity Mappings in Deep Residual Networks' (He et al. 2016). Used in CertMask (arXiv 2511.09834) as a vision backbone.

name: ResMLP-S24
notes: ResMLP: Feedforward networks for image classification with data-efficient training (Touvron et al. 2022). All-MLP architecture (no attention). Used in CertMask (arXiv 2511.09834) as a lightweight vision backbone.

name: Kimi-K2-Instruct
notes: Kimi-K2 instruction-tuned variant. Open-source mixture-of-experts (MoE) LLM with 1T parameters and 128K context. Instruct variant for general instruction following. Used in SYNTHWORLDS paper (arXiv:2510.24427) for multi-hop QA and page navigation evaluation.

name: Kimi-K2-Thinking
notes: Kimi-K2 thinking/reasoning variant. Open-source mixture-of-experts (MoE) LLM with 1T parameters and 128K context. Thinking variant includes explicit chain-of-thought reasoning traces. Used in SYNTHWORLDS paper (arXiv:2510.24427) for multi-hop QA and page navigation evaluation.

name: LeanVAE
resolution: designed for latent-space video processing at 832x480 and above
notes: Ultra-efficient spatiotemporal video VAE with lightweight Neighborhood-Aware Feedforward (NAF) backbone and wavelet-based channel compression. Used in InstantViR (arXiv:2511.14208) as a drop-in replacement for WanVAE, providing >2x speedup in the decoder. Teacher-space regularized distillation bridges the latent space mismatch between LeanVAE and WanVAE.

name: CQL
organization: UC Berkeley / NVIDIA (Kumar et al., NeurIPS 2020)
notes: Conservative Q-Learning (CQL). Offline RL algorithm that learns a conservative Q-function to prevent out-of-distribution actions. Standard baseline in offline RL. Paper: Kumar et al., NeurIPS 2020.

name: BCQ
notes: Batch-Constrained Q-Learning (BCQ). Offline RL algorithm that constrains the learned policy to stay close to the batch data using a variational autoencoder. Standard baseline in offline RL. Paper: Fujimoto et al., ICML 2019.

name: BEAR
notes: Bootstrapping Error Accumulation Reduction (BEAR). Offline RL algorithm that uses MMD constraints to ensure learned policy stays within support of batch data. Standard baseline in offline RL. Paper: Kumar et al., 2020.

name: IQL
notes: Implicit Q-Learning (IQL). Offline RL algorithm using expectile regression for value estimation without maximizing Q-values for out-of-distribution actions. State-of-the-art offline RL method. Paper: Kostrikov et al., ICLR 2022.

name: Phi-3.5-mini-instruct
notes: Phi-3.5-mini-instruct. Used in arXiv:2512.02807 (SR-GRPO) as a baseline model for Best-of-N decoding experiments.

name: Skywork-Reward-V2-Qwen3-1.7B
notes: Skywork Reward V2 model based on Qwen3 architecture. Used as reward model baseline in arXiv:2512.02807 (SR-GRPO) for comparison.

name: NLF (Neural Localizer Fields)
notes: Neural Localizer Fields for continuous 3D human pose and shape estimation (arXiv). Estimates SMPL-H body parameters from monocular RGB. Used in CARI4D for human pose initialization aligned to metric depth.

name: f-BRS
notes: Rethinking Backpropagating Refinement for Interactive Segmentation (CVPR 2020). Used in CARI4D to obtain object masks from input images.

name: VolumetricSMPL
notes: Neural volumetric body model for efficient interactions, contacts, and collisions (ICCV 2025). Provides signed distance function for SMPL body for penetration loss computation. Used in CARI4D joint optimization.

name: SMPL-H
organization: Loper et al. (SMPL) / Romero et al. (SMPL-H)
notes: Skinned Multi-Person Linear Model with hand articulation. SMPL-H extends SMPL with hand parameters. Used in CARI4D as the human body representation.

name: PointPillars
input: LiDAR point clouds (N x 4: x, y, z, intensity)
notes: PointPillars: Fast Encoders for Object Detection from Point Clouds (CVPR 2019). Uses point cloud pillars (2D pseudo-images) with a single SSD detection head. Widely used as backbone in cooperative perception papers including JigsawComm (arXiv:2511.17843), Where2comm, ERMVP, CoST.

name: InstructPix2Pix
notes: InstructPix2Pix: Learning to Edit Images Following Instructions (CVPR 2023). Mask-free text-guided image editing using latent diffusion. Fine-tuned on MagicBrush dataset. Used in DEAL-300K for generating edited images.

name: Qwen-VL-7B
notes: Multimodal LLM used in DEAL-300K for generating image editing instructions. Fine-tuned on MagicBrush dataset using QLoRA for instruction generation.

name: DUSt3R
notes: Dense Unstructured Stereo 3D Reconstruction. Pointmap-based 3D vision foundation model that regresses dense pointmaps from image pairs. Forms the backbone for EAG3R and MonST3R.

name: MonST3R
notes: MonST3R extends DUSt3R for dynamic scenes by predicting per-frame pointmaps and using optical flow for motion handling. EAG3R builds on MonST3R backbone with event camera integration.

name: EAG3R (Event Adapter)
organization: University of Hong Kong & SUSTech (Wu et al. 2024)
notes: Event camera adapter for pointmap-based 3D reconstruction. Uses Swin Transformer for event feature extraction with SNR-aware fusion. EAG3R = MonST3R + Event Adapter + Retinex Enhancement + Event-based Photometric Loss.

name: InternVL3-1B
notes: Used in FROST-Drive paper (arXiv:2601.03460) as frozen vision encoder. Vision encoder has 300M params with 896-dim embeddings. Smaller than 14B/38B/78B variants but still outperforms fine-tuned baselines on Waymo E2E driving.

name: Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B
notes: Math-specialized base LLM (not instruction-tuned). Used as base model in PRL (arXiv:2601.10201) for math reasoning RL post-training. Same architecture as Qwen2.5-1.5B but trained on math-focused data.

name: Qwen2.5-Math-7B
notes: Math-specialized base LLM (not instruction-tuned). Used as base model in PRL (arXiv:2601.10201) for math reasoning RL post-training. Same architecture as Qwen2.5-7B but trained on math-focused data.

name: ReCamMaster
params: Unknown (~2B est., based on Cosmos backbone)
access: Not yet released (as of paper publication)
notes: ReCamMaster: Camera-Controlled Generative Rendering from a Single Video (Bai et al., ICCV 2025). Single-shot camera-controlled video re-rendering using diffusion models. Baseline in PlenopticDreamer paper. Uses Plucker raymaps for camera conditioning.

name: Trajectory-Attention
notes: Trajectory Attention for Fine-Grained Video Motion Control (Xiao et al., ICLR 2025). Uses trajectory attention mechanism for camera and motion control in video generation. Baseline in PlenopticDreamer paper.

name: Stable-Code-3B
notes: Code language model trained on 1.3T tokens across 18 programming languages. Supports fill-in-middle (FIM) and Flash Attention 2. Used in EZ-MIA paper (arXiv:2601.12104) for cross-domain generalization experiments.

name: Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct
notes: Instruction-tuned version of Qwen-2.5-7B. Used in multi-agent debate research (arXiv:2601.19921) for studying diversity and confidence in MAD.

name: SonicNet (SONIC)
organization: Netherlands Cancer Institute / University of Amsterdam / Maastricht University (Moens et al. 2025)
access: coming_soon (no official code released as of arXiv:2601.19884)
notes: SONIC = Spectral Oriented Neural Invariant Convolutions. Replaces standard convolutions with orientation-aware spectral filter blocks. Uses LTI-inspired resolvent parameterization with learnable modes for orientation, scale, damping, oscillation, and transverse penalty. Provides global receptive fields and resolution invariance. 10x fewer parameters than comparable ResNet-50 (1.34M vs 25.6M) with competitive accuracy.

name: UNI-2
notes: Pathology-specific foundation model. ViT-H/14 architecture adapted from DINOv2. Embedding dimension 1536. Trained on large-scale H&E histopathology slides. From Chen et al., Nature Medicine 2024.

name: Virchow-2
notes: Pathology-specific foundation model. ViT-H/14 with multi-resolution training (5x-40x magnification). Embedding dimension 1280. Domain-adapted DINOv2 objective. From Zimmermann et al., arXiv:2408.00738, 2024.

name: MuSK
notes: Vision-language foundation model for precision oncology. BEiT-3 multimodal architecture. Embedding dimension 1024. Vision-language fusion occurs in later layers. From Xiang et al., Nature 2025.

name: Dream-Base-7B
notes: Post-trained masked diffusion model from Qwen2.5-7B backbone. Used in mechanism shift analysis paper to study internal computational changes when converting ARMs to MDMs.

name: DiffuLLaMA-7B
notes: Post-trained masked diffusion model from LLaMA-2-7B backbone. One of the first works showing effective post-training of pretrained ARMs to masked diffusion language models.

name: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking
notes: Thinking/reasoning variant of Qwen3-30B-A3B with extended chain-of-thought reasoning. Used in arXiv:2602.09517 (KID paper) for search-augmented reasoning experiments. Requires ~60GB VRAM in BF16.

name: Phi-4-reasoning-plus
notes: Reasoning-specialized variant of Phi-4. Used as speaker and listener model in REMUL paper (arXiv:2602.16154) for multi-party RL faithfulness training. Apache-2.0 licensed.

name: Ministral-3-14B-Reasoning
notes: Reasoning-specialized variant of Ministral-3. Used as listener model in REMUL paper (arXiv:2602.16154) for multi-party RL faithfulness training.

name: TiTok-1D
notes: TiTok compact 1D image tokenizer (Yu et al., 2024). Represents an image as a fixed 32 discrete tokens, decoupling latent capacity from 2D spatial resolution. Used as basis for FUTURE-VLA's compact 1D visual tokenizer (which also uses 32 tokens per frame). Stage 1 warmup uses MaskGIT-VQGAN proxy codes; Stage 2 fine-tunes decoder for pixel reconstruction.

name: OpenVLA
organization: Stanford / Google DeepMind / ICSI / SC Studio
notes: Open-source VLA model from arXiv:2406.09246. Uses autoregressive action tokens rather than diffusion-based action head. 7B parameters combining Prismatic VLM backbone with action head. Evaluation on LIBERO shows 84.7% success rate. Different architecture from π0.5/GR00T which use DiT action heads.

name: PIPs++ (Particle Video++)
notes: Improved PIPs for long-term point tracking (CVPR 2023). Builds on Particle Video approach with transformer-based refinement. Uses cost volumes like PIPs.

name: DOT (Dense Optical Tracking)
notes: Dense Optical Tracking (CVPR 2024). Densifies CoTracker outputs for full-resolution tracking.

name: DELTA
notes: Dense Efficient Long-range 3D Tracking (arXiv:2024). 3D-aware point tracking approach.

name: WAFT (Warping-Alone Field Transforms)
notes: Warping-Alone Field Transforms for Optical Flow (arXiv:2506.21526). Shows cost volumes can be replaced by warping mechanism. CoWTracker adapts this warping approach from WAFT to point tracking.

name: SpatialTracker
notes: Off-the-shelf 3D point tracker used in ARM4R paper. Lifts 2D pixels into 3D with monocular depth estimates and iteratively refines 3D trajectories with as-rigid-as-possible motion priors. Generates pseudo-labels for 3D point tracks in ARM4R pre-training.

name: PerAct
organization: University of Oxford / Oxford Robotics Institute
notes: Perceiver-Actor: Multi-task transformer for robotic manipulation. Uses discrete voxel quantization for 3D input and language-conditioned behavior cloning. Baseline in ARM4R paper.

name: LLARVA
notes: Vision-action instruction tuning enhances robot learning. Uses 2D point prediction as auxiliary task. Baseline in ARM4R paper.

name: π0-FAST
notes: Fast action tokenization for vision-language-action models. Pretrained on OpenX-Embodiment. Baseline in ARM4R paper.

name: ATM (Any-point Trajectory Modeling)
notes: Predicts 2D point trajectories from human videos to condition robotic policies. Uses ground-truth point tracks from CoTracker. Baseline in ARM4R paper; performs poorly (6.4% avg) compared to ARM4R's 3D approach (83.1%).

name: ARM4R
notes: Auto-regressive Robotic Model with 4D Representations. Pre-trains on 3D point tracks from human videos (Epic-Kitchens100), then fine-tunes on robotic scenes for manipulation. Three-stage training: (1) human video pre-training for 3D point tracking, (2) robot video fine-tuning for 3D point tracking, (3) control fine-tuning. Outperforms PerAct (55.33% vs 59.47% on RLBench) and OpenVLA (37.2% vs 83.1% on Kinova).

name: DINO-X (Grounding DINO variant)
notes: DINO-X is an object detection expert model used in the JURE evaluation framework (arXiv:2504.07424). It provides bounding box detection for evaluating object presence/absence in instruction-based image editing.

name: GTR
notes: Generalizable T5 Retriever. Dual encoder (query encoder + passage encoder) trained on diverse retrieval tasks. Used as dense retriever in DUALREFORM experiments.

name: EVA-02-L
notes: Large variant of EVA-02 vision model. Used as vision encoder in ORION (arXiv:2503.19755) for E2E autonomous driving. Large variant has significantly more parameters than base EVA-02 (4.35B).

name: Qwen2-VL-72B
notes: 72B variant of Qwen2-VL. Used only for generating Chat-B2D VQA dataset annotations in ORION (arXiv:2503.19755), not used as the main LLM in the model itself.

name: GPT-Neo-2.7B
notes: GPT-Neo 2.7B from EleutherAI (Black et al., 2021). Used in paper 2505.19281 for RLHF experiments with LoRA PEFT.

name: Sa2VA-1B
notes: Segment Anything Vision Assistant. Unified vision-language model for video and image segmentation. Used as baseline in Omni-R1 paper. Available in 1B, 4B, 8B, and 26B parameter variants.

name: Sa2VA-4B
notes: Segment Anything Vision Assistant. 4B variant used as baseline in Omni-R1 paper.

name: Sa2VA-8B
notes: Segment Anything Vision Assistant. 8B variant used as baseline in Omni-R1 paper.

name: Sa2VA-26B
notes: Segment Anything Vision Assistant. 26B variant used as baseline in Omni-R1 paper; achieves 58.4% on ReVOS overall.

name: CheXDetector
organization: University of Texas at Austin / Texas A&M / University of Iowa
notes: Transformer-based detection model for localized chest X-ray disease and progression detection. Uses region-level attention for anatomical region progression analysis. Primary baseline for CheXLearner paper (arXiv:2505.06903). Localizes 12 anatomical regions for progression tracking. Two-stage paradigm: detection then classification.

name: o3-pro
notes: OpenAI o3-pro (o3-pro-2025-06-10). Used in A1 paper (arXiv:2507.05558) for smart contract exploit generation. Input: $20/M tokens, Output: $80/M tokens. Achieved 54.2% success rate on VERITE benchmark.

name: Gemini-2.5-Flash
notes: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash (gemini-2.5-flash-preview-04-17). Used in A1 paper (arXiv:2507.05558). Input: $0.10/M tokens, Output: $0.40/M tokens. Achieved 15.3% success rate on VERITE benchmark.

name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
notes: Qwen3 MoE model used in A1 paper (arXiv:2507.05558). Called 'Qwen3 MoE' in the paper with 235B total params and 22B active params. Input: $0.13/M tokens, Output: $0.60/M tokens via DashScope. Achieved 18.1% success rate on VERITE benchmark.

name: Mamba2-130M
notes: Mamba2 state-space model. Used as base for implicit SSM experiments in arXiv:2502.07827.

name: Mamba2-350M
notes: Mamba2 state-space model. Used as base for implicit SSM experiments in arXiv:2502.07827.

name: Mamba2-760M
notes: Mamba2 state-space model. Used as base for implicit SSM experiments in arXiv:2502.07827.

name: Mamba2-1.3B
notes: Mamba2 state-space model. Largest variant. Used as base for implicit SSM experiments in arXiv:2502.07827.

name: ECG-Founder
notes: ResNet-based ECG foundation model pretrained on 10.8M ECGs with 150 diagnostic categories from Harvard-Emory ECG Database. Used as baseline in LASAN paper (arXiv:2601.07124).

name: ECG-FM
notes: Transformer-based ECG foundation model pretrained on 1.5M ECGs using hybrid contrastive and generative self-supervised learning. Referenced in LASAN paper (arXiv:2601.07124).

name: HuBERT-ECG
notes: Self-supervised transformer encoder pretrained on 9.1M 12-lead ECGs encompassing 164 cardiovascular conditions using masked prediction of hidden units. Best performer in LASAN paper (arXiv:2601.07124).

name: Deep-ECG-SSL
notes: EfficientNet-based model employing self-supervised contrastive learning and masked lead modeling, trained on 1M+ ECGs and validated on 77 cardiac classification categories. Used in LASAN paper (arXiv:2601.07124).

name: SpatialLM
notes: Large language model for structured indoor modeling from point clouds; used in SpatialNav (arXiv:2601.06806) for object detection in spatial scene graph construction. Fine-tuned on Matterport3D training scans.

name: Lumina-mGPT-7B
notes: Unified multimodal autoregressive model for text-to-image generation. Uses FP-SFT (progressive fine-tuning). Used in DCoAR paper for personalized image generation via deep concept injection.

name: RDT-1B
notes: Diffusion-based foundation model for bimanual robot manipulation; supports both 2D image and 3D point cloud inputs

name: DP3 (3D Diffusion Policy)
notes: Lightweight 3D diffusion policy using point cloud encoder; designed for real-time robotic manipulation

name: PointNet++
notes: Deep hierarchical feature learning on point sets in a metric space; commonly used 3D encoder

name: Point Transformer
notes: Transformer architecture for 3D point cloud processing

name: Point-Voxel CNN
notes: Efficient 3D deep learning using point-voxel convolution; used as backbone in FVP for point cloud diffusion

name: LivePortrait
notes: Efficient portrait animation with stitching and retargeting control. Used as motion transfer model in cross-identity training for Stable Video-Driven Portraits (arXiv:2509.17476).

name: AniPortrait
notes: Audio-driven synthesis of photorealistic portrait animation. Uses landmarks as control signal. Baseline in Stable Video-Driven Portraits (arXiv:2509.17476).

name: X-Portrait
notes: Expressive portrait animation with hierarchical motion attention using masked facial regions (eyes, nose, mouth) as control signal. U-Net based. Inspiration for Stable Video-Driven Portraits (arXiv:2509.17476).

name: TPU-v3
notes: Google TPU-v3 used for ML training in Concorde paper (arXiv:2503.23076). ML training took 3 hours on TPU-v3-8 (8 TensorCores). Shapley value analysis (143M CPI evaluations) took ~1 hour on TPU-v3-8.

name: Semla
notes: 3D molecular structure generation model using SE(3)-equivariant message passing. Hierarchical encoding for proteins and ligands. Used as backbone for state flow model in 3DSynthFlow for 3D pose prediction.

name: word2vec (SGNS)
notes: Skip-gram with negative sampling (SGNS) word embedding model. Trains two embedding matrices W and W' to minimize contrastive loss. Global optimum is PMI matrix. Used as baseline in QWEM paper (arXiv:2502.09863).

name: ALIGNN
notes: Atomistic Line Graph Neural Network. Graph neural network for materials that represents atoms as nodes and explicitly includes both bonds and bond angles via line graph construction. Used in this paper for predicting distance to convex hull from crystal structures.

name: Matra-Genoa
notes: Autoregressive transformer for crystal structure generation using invertible tokenized representations of symmetrized crystals including free coordinates. Generates structures with correct symmetry that cluster near the convex hull of thermodynamic stability.

name: Orb-v2
notes: Universal machine learning interatomic potential. Improved version of Orb that achieves far superior accuracy than M3GNet with favorable accuracy-compute trade-off. Used for preliminary geometry relaxation in the Alexandria workflow.

name: GRACE-2L-OMAT-L
notes: Graph Atomic Cluster Expansion. Unified framework for local and message-passing graph neural network architectures for machine learning interatomic potentials. Pretrained on OMat24, fine-tuned on sAlex25 achieves SOTA on WBM benchmark.

name: SmolLM2-135M
notes: Small language model from HuggingFace. Used as retriever backbone and LM in Revela paper for self-supervised retriever learning.

name: LLaMA-3.2-1B
notes: LLaMA 3.2 1B model. Used as primary LM backbone in Revela paper for self-supervised retriever learning via in-batch attention.

name: LLaMA-3.2-3B
notes: LLaMA 3.2 3B model. Used as largest LM backbone in Revela paper, showing best performance on code retrieval tasks.

name: DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B
notes: Specialized Lean 4 theorem prover trained with RL and subgoal decomposition (arXiv:2504.21801). Used as weaker prover in HILBERT paper. Achieves 61.3% pass@4 on miniF2F; 96.7%/98.4% with HILBERT (Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro).

name: Goedel-Prover-V2-32B
notes: Stronger Lean 4 prover with self-correction (arXiv:2508.03613). Primary prover used in HILBERT paper experiments. Achieves 74.6% pass@4 on miniF2F; 99.2% with HILBERT (Gemini 2.5 Pro). On PutnamBench with HILBERT: 462/660 (70.0%).

name: I-JEPA ViT-L/16
notes: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for self-supervised learning from images (Assran et al., CVPR 2023). Used in paper 2510.05949 to validate JEPA-SCORE density estimation property.

name: MetaCLIP ViT-L/14
notes: MetaCLIP: Demystifying CLIP Data for vision-language models. CLIP variant trained on Meta's curated data. Used in paper 2510.05949 to validate JEPA-SCORE consistency across different JEPA-family models.

name: Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct
notes: Instruction-tuned 32B LLM from Qwen2.5 family. Used in LocFT-BF model editing paper (arXiv:2509.22072) for scaling experiments.

name: PaliGemma-3B
notes: VLM backbone used in LAP-3B (arXiv:2602.10556) for zero-shot cross-embodiment transfer. First-generation PaliGemma model. Paired with flow-matching action expert for real-time robot control at 25Hz.

name: o1-preview
notes: Reasoning model used in LLM+AL paper (arXiv:2501.00830) for action reasoning via neuro-symbolic approach. Uses test-time compute for complex reasoning tasks.

name: MITRE-466M
notes: Multilingual translation with registers. 24-layer decoder-only Transformer, embedding 1024, inner 4096, 16 heads. Supports 24 languages. Trained on 9.3B sentence pairs from NLLB dataset.

name: MITRE-913M
notes: Multilingual translation with registers. 36-layer decoder-only Transformer, embedding 1280, inner 5120, 20 heads. Supports 24 languages. Trained on 9.3B sentence pairs from NLLB dataset. Outperforms NLLB-3.3B and competes with GPT-4o mini.

name: mBART-50-large
notes: Multilingual BART model covering 50 languages. Used as base model in KG-TRICK (arXiv:2501.03560) for unified KGC and KGE task. Fine-tuned with batch size 48, lr 8e-4, 6 epochs.

name: DINOv2 ViT-G/14
notes: DINOv2 giant variant (ViT-G/14) used in FOCUS paper (arXiv:2501.05238) for universal foreground segmentation backbone. Pretrained on ADE20K for the FOCUS model. 1.2B trainable params when full model is fine-tuned, 0.1B when backbone is frozen.

name: mPLUG-base
notes: mPLUG (Li et al., 2022a): Effective and efficient vision-language learning by cross-modal skip-connections. Paper: arXiv:2205.12005. Used as base for reformulation model in arXiv:2501.04513 (reformulation feedback at inference time).

name: ClipCap
notes: ClipCap (Mokady et al., 2021): CLIP prefix for image captioning. Uses CLIP ViT-L/14 as image encoder and GPT2 as text decoder. Paper: arXiv:2111.09734. Used as off-the-shelf captioning model in arXiv:2501.04513.

name: GIT (Generative Image-to-Text)
notes: GIT (Wang et al., 2022): Generative image-to-text transformer for vision and language. Paper: arXiv:2205.14100. Used as off-the-shelf captioning model in arXiv:2501.04513.

name: CodeLlama-7B
notes: Code-specific LLM from Meta's CodeLlama family. Base 7B version used in CGP-Tuning paper (arXiv:2501.04510) for code vulnerability detection. Supports up to 16K context with RoPE scaling.

name: CodeGemma-7B
notes: Code-specific LLM from Google's CodeGemma family. Base 7B version used in CGP-Tuning paper (arXiv:2501.04510) for code vulnerability detection.

name: MedNeXt
notes: Transformer-driven scaling of convolutional networks for 3D medical image segmentation. Used as baseline in ScaleMAI paper, achieves 0.846 AUC on pancreatic tumor detection.

name: STU-Net
notes: Scalable and transferable medical image segmentation model empowered by large-scale supervised pre-training. Used as baseline in ScaleMAI paper.

name: UniSeg
notes: Universal and extensible language-vision model for organ segmentation and tumor detection from abdominal CT. Used as baseline in ScaleMAI paper.

name: GLiNER-large-v2.1
notes: GLiNER: Generalist Lightweight model for zero-shot Named Entity Recognition. Architecture inspiration for GLiREL (arXiv:2501.03172). Zero-shot NER model that classifies entities with arbitrary labels at inference time.

name: CodeLlama-7B-Instruct
notes: Code-specialized instruct-tuned variant of Llama-2-7B. From paper arXiv:2308.12950. Used in FairCoder bias evaluation benchmark (2501.05396).

name: CodeLlama-13B-Instruct
notes: Code-specialized instruct-tuned variant of Llama-2-13B. From paper arXiv:2308.12950. Used in FairCoder bias evaluation benchmark (2501.05396).

name: CodeGemma-7B-Instruct
notes: Code-specialized instruction-tuned Gemma model from Google. Used in FairCoder bias evaluation benchmark (2501.05396).

name: Qwen2-7B-Instruct
notes: Base Qwen2-7B instruction-tuned model. Used in FairCoder bias evaluation benchmark (2501.05396).

name: CogVideoX-2B
notes: Pretrained video diffusion model used in StarGen (CVPR 2025) as the video generation backbone. StarGen does not fine-tune CogVideoX-2B, only uses it with ControlNet conditioning.

name: GS-LRM
notes: Large Reconstruction Model for 3D Gaussian Splatting. Uses transformer architecture to regress depth maps and feature maps from posed image pairs. Paper: Zhang et al., ECCV 2024. StarGen's LRM is inspired by GS-LRM but uses additional depth maps and Plucker coordinates as input.

name: DPR
notes: Dense Passage Retriever. Used for retrieving top-k passages in the KV-Fusion paper.

name: Stable Video Diffusion (SVD) v1.1
notes: Latent video diffusion model for high-quality video generation. Paper: Blattmann et al., arXiv:2311.15127. Used as initialization for FramePainter (2501.08225). Generates 2-25 frame videos at 768x768 or custom resolutions.

name: VQ-GAN
notes: VQ-GAN: Taming Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis (CVPR 2021). Used as encoder-decoder backbone in PVQAE for unsupervised defect detection. The VQ component uses a codebook for discrete latent representation; the GAN component uses adversarial training.

name: Gemini-1.5-Flash
notes: Google Gemini 1.5 Flash used in arXiv:2501.09891 (Mind Evolution paper) as the primary inference model for evolutionary search. Input: $0.35/M tokens, Output: $1.05/M tokens.

name: ALMA-R-13B
access: Based on Llama-2-13B, fine-tuned with Contrastive Preference Optimization for translation (Xu et al., 2024). See: https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.14782

name: ChartLlama
notes: Multimodal LLM for chart understanding and generation. Used as a baseline in PlotEdit paper. Paper: ChartLlama: A Multimodal LLM for Chart Understanding and Generation (Han et al., arXiv:2311.16483).

name: ChartReformer
notes: Natural language-driven chart image editing model. Introduced ChartCraft dataset. Used as a baseline in PlotEdit paper. Paper: ChartReformer: Natural Language-Driven Chart Image Editing (Yan et al., ICDAR 2024).

name: DePlot
notes: One-shot visual language reasoning by plot-to-table translation. Used in PlotEdit for numeric feedback to extract quantitative measures from chart images. Paper: DePlot (Liu et al., arXiv:2212.10505). Available as a Python package.

name: x264
notes: H.264/AVC video encoder. Used as the base encoder in RL-RC-DoT paper (2501.12216). The paper modifies x264 to accept external per-block QP delta values and expose internal encoder statistics (per-MB energy, intra encoding cost, etc.).

name: TranSalNet
notes: Transformer-based visual saliency prediction network. Used in RL-RC-DoT paper (2501.12216) to generate saliency maps for ROI encoding evaluation. TranSalNet evaluates saliency-weighted PSNR as a downstream task metric.

name: Pixtral-12B
notes: Mistral AI's vision-language model. Used in arXiv:2501.13620 as a baseline VLM for Bongard-OpenWorld evaluation. Paper: Pixtral 12B (arXiv:2410.07073). Achieved 87.2% accuracy on Bongard-OpenWorld using CA paradigm.

name: Llama-3.2-90B-Vision-Instruct
notes: Meta's large vision-language model from Llama 3.2 family. Used in arXiv:2501.13620 as a baseline VLM. Called 'Llama-Vision-90B' in the paper. Achieved 55.1% accuracy on Bongard-OpenWorld using CA paradigm (self-generated descriptions), but 90.98% when using GPT-4o-generated descriptions, revealing a perception bottleneck.

name: CTransPath
notes: Transformer-based unsupervised contrastive learning for histopathological image classification (Wang et al., Medical Image Analysis 2022). Used as WSI feature extractor in gene expression prediction pipelines. Self-supervised pretrained on ~15 million pathology patches.

name: Yi-34B
notes: From Yi paper (arXiv:2403.04652). Used in HyGen (2501.14808) as a larger model in ablation studies with tensor parallelism and pipeline parallelism.

name: Sheared-LLaMA-2.7B
notes: From Sheared LLaMA paper (arXiv:2310.06694) - structured pruning of Mistral-7B to 2.7B. Used in HyGen (2501.14808) on A5000 24GB GPU to test hardware-constrained scenarios.

name: Versatile Diffusion
organization: Xingqian Xu et al. (SHI Labs / ICCV 2023)
notes: First unified multi-flow multimodal diffusion framework supporting image-to-text, image-variation, text-to-image, and text-variation. Used as frozen image reconstruction prior in BRAINGUARD (arXiv:2501.14309) for fMRI-to-image decoding. Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.08332

name: PixArt-alpha
notes: Text-to-image diffusion transformer. Used as base model in ILF paper (arXiv:2501.13107). The paper adds a 21.3M parameter feedback module for inference acceleration.

name: PixArt-sigma
notes: Improved text-to-image diffusion transformer from ByteDance. Builds on PixArt-alpha with improved quality. Used in ILF paper (arXiv:2501.13107) for high-resolution generation experiments.

name: NVIDIA H800
notes: China-specific export-restricted Hopper GPU. Peak FP16/BF16 Tensor Core throughput: 989 TFLOPS. Used in arXiv:2501.16103 for MoE inference kernel evaluation.

name: NVIDIA H20
notes: China-specific export-restricted Hopper GPU (lower compute variant). Peak FP16/BF16 Tensor Core throughput: 146 TFLOPS. Used in arXiv:2501.16103 for MoE inference kernel evaluation.

name: Alpha-CLIP ViT-B/16
notes: Alpha-CLIP extends CLIP with RGBA input and focus mechanism for masked regions. Used as backbone in MatCLIP (arXiv:2501.15981) for both part encoder (RGBA masked images) and material encoder (CLIP transformer with linear projection). Paper: arXiv:2312.03818.

name: Segment Anything Model (SAM)
notes: Original SAM (Kirillov et al., ICCV 2023). Used in SketchYourSeg paper for adapted baseline S-PerSAM. Provides zero-shot segmentation capabilities; generates masks from various prompts (points, boxes, masks).

name: SBIR (Category-level)
access: Pre-trained models from Sain et al. (referenced as [69] in SketchYourSeg paper)
notes: Pre-trained category-level Sketch-Based Image Retrieval model. Trained on Sketchy-Extended dataset. Used in SketchYourSeg as frozen critic network (F) to provide SBIR loss signal for mask-free training.

name: FG-SBIR (Fine-grained)
access: Pre-trained models from Sain et al. (referenced as [69] in SketchYourSeg paper)
notes: Pre-trained fine-grained Sketch Based Image Retrieval model. Trained on Sketchy dataset with hard triplet loss and N-class cross-entropy loss. Used in SketchYourSeg fine-grained segmentation model as frozen critic network.

name: Llama-3-70B
notes: Base Llama-3 70B model used in InnerThoughts paper (arXiv:2501.17994). The paper cites Dubey et al. 2024 which is the Llama 3 herd of models paper. Has 80 layers, 8192 hidden dimension, 64 attention heads with 128 dimensions each.

name: deepseek-math-7b-base
notes: Base model specialized for mathematical reasoning. From DeepSeekMath paper (arXiv:2402.03300). Used in ProofAug (arXiv:2501.18310) for neural theorem proving in Isabelle/Isar via few-shot prompting.

name: Lightning-Drag
notes: Fast drag-based image editing method using point embeddings injected into self-attention modules of Stable Diffusion inpainting backbone. Used as the 2D drag guidance model in DYG (Drag Your Gaussian) paper arXiv:2501.18672.

name: PyNet
notes: Full pipeline ISP replacement with CNN. Replaces entire ISP (demosaic, denoise, white balance, color correction, etc.) with a single end-to-end model.

name: AWNet
notes: Attentive wavelet network for image ISP. Stage-wise ISP with attention mechanisms. 120 GFLOPS, ~0.21s per image at full resolution.

name: CameraNet
notes: Two-stage framework for camera ISP. Divides ISP into restoration and enhancement stages. No official PyTorch version; paper used converted version.

name: UNet (ISP)
notes: Baseline ISP model used in HVS-ISP benchmark. UNet (Ronneberger et al. 2015) as RAW-to-RGB converter. 4.52 GFLOPS, ~0.01s per image.

name: Swin-Transformer ISP
notes: Swin Transformer adapted for ISP tasks. Used as image enhancement backbone in HVS-ISP benchmark.

name: eSL-Net
notes: Event-enhanced high-quality image recovery. Lightweight event-based backbone used in HVS-ISP benchmark. Limited receptive field leads to poor global illumination estimation.

name: EV-UNet
notes: Proposed simple event-guided ISP method: UNet encoder merged with event voxel-grid. Outperforms UNet in outdoor scenes (PSNR 30.11 vs 28.17) but worse indoors due to flickering.

name: InvertISP
notes: Invertible ISP for RAW-to-RGB conversion. Excels in computational efficiency (1.41 GFLOPS). Used as baseline in HVS-ISP benchmark.

name: MV-ISPNet
notes: Multi-variance ISP network. Compact full-pipeline ISP model. Used as baseline in HVS-ISP benchmark.

name: Command-R-7B
notes: Cohere's Command-R model used as RAG generator in Riddle Me This (CCS 2025) membership inference attack paper. Compared against Llama 3.1, Phi-4, Gemma-2-2B as RAG generators.

name: Slim-ResNet-18
organization: University of Pisa / Scuola Normale Superiore (OCAR paper, arXiv:2502.01866)
notes: Lightweight ResNet-18 used in OCAR (Online Curvature-Aware Replay) continual learning paper. Trained with SGD in online continual learning setting on Split-CIFAR100 and Split-TinyImageNet benchmarks. Architecture is standard ResNet-18; 'slim' refers to the training configuration (small batches, lightweight compute) rather than a modified architecture.

name: SAM-Med3D
organization: Wang et al. (NVIDIA / Shanghai Jiao Tong / others)
params: ~312M (3D image encoder + 3D prompt encoder + 3D mask decoder)
notes: SAM-Med3D: General-purpose 3D extension of Segment Anything Model for volumetric medical image segmentation (ECCV 2024). Replaces all 2D operations with 3D counterparts (3D convolutions, normalization, positional encodings). Pretrained on large-scale 3D medical imaging data. Used in arXiv:2502.02756 for prostate cancer lesion segmentation on PSMA PET/CT. Both zero-shot and fine-tuned performance evaluated.

name: SegResNet
notes: SegResNet: 3D MRI brain tumor segmentation using autoencoder regularization (BrainLes MICCAI 2018). Encoder-decoder architecture with GroupNorm, residual blocks, and variational autoencoder regularization branch. Used in arXiv:2502.02756 as a strong baseline CNN for prostate cancer lesion segmentation in PSMA PET/CT, where it achieved the highest median DSC (0.68) with L1DFL loss among all tested architectures.

name: Qwen2.5-Math-72B-Instruct
license: Qwen License (Apache 2.0 for base, custom for instruct)
notes: Math-specialized instruction-tuned LLM. Used as short CoT teacher model in demystify-long-cot paper (2502.03373) for comparison with long CoT approaches.

name: LongT5-base
notes: LongT5-base used in OntoSCPrompt (arXiv:2502.03992) for KGQA generalization via ontology-guided hybrid prompt learning. Uses two-stage SPARQL generation architecture with discrete and continuous prompts.

name: Pythia-2.8B
notes: Pythia-2.8B is a decoder-only transformer trained on the Pile. Used in FaRMA paper (arXiv:2502.04517, ICML 2025) as base model for HH-RLHF dialogue alignment experiments.

name: ViLT (ViLT-B/32)
notes: Vision-and-Language Transformer (ICML 2021). Used as VLM backbone in Time-VLM (ICML 2025) for multimodal time series forecasting. Generates 156-token multimodal embeddings (11 text tokens + 145 image tokens). Lightweight VLM that outperforms larger VLMs (BLIP-2) on time series tasks.

name: LlamaGuard
notes: LLM-based content moderator for human-AI conversations, built on Llama-2-7B. Used as baseline content moderator in Multi-Faceted Attack paper (arXiv:2502.05772). Classifies user prompts and model responses as safe or unsafe across 6 harm categories. Paper: arXiv:2312.06674.

name: LlamaGuard2
notes: Second generation LlamaGuard content moderator, built on Llama-3-8B. Used as content moderator in Multi-Faceted Attack paper (arXiv:2502.05772) for evaluating adversarial signature attacks. Paper: Llama Team 2024b.

name: LlamaGuard3-8B
notes: Third generation LlamaGuard content moderator, built on Llama-3.1-8B. Used in Multi-Faceted Attack paper (arXiv:2502.05772) for both white-box attack victim and weak supervision in transfer attack. Paper: Llama Team 2024c.

name: DeepSeek-Math-7B-Instruct
notes: Math-specialized instruction-tuned LLM. Used as base model in PIPA paper (2502.05773, ICML 2025) for preference alignment experiments on GSM8K and MATH benchmarks.

name: Prompt-DDG
params: IPA-style backbone (~hundreds of M params, not publicly disclosed)
access: Referenced in paper as available; arXiv:2405.10348
notes: State-of-the-art ΔΔG predictor using hierarchical prompt codebook to capture microenvironmental information. Used as teacher model in knowledge distillation for Light-DDG. IPA-style (AlphaFold2-like) backbone is heavy but accurate. Paper: Wu et al. 2024c.

name: Light-DDG
notes: Lightweight ΔΔG predictor proposed in this paper. Distilled from Prompt-DDG via knowledge distillation. Uses E(3)-invariant Transformer encoder with geometric features. Achieves 89.7x inference speedup over Prompt-DDG while improving accuracy by 15.45% on per-structure Pearson correlation. Core contribution: supervised pre-training on SKEMPI-Aug (670k) + KD fine-tuning on SKEMPI v2.0.

name: XLS-R-300M
notes: Cross-lingual self-supervised speech encoder at 300M params; trained on 436k hours of unlabeled speech across 128 languages (Babu et al., 2022). Used in arXiv:2502.07029 for frozen feature extraction in MixGoP pronunciation assessment.

name: DeBERTa-large-mnli
notes: DeBERTa-large fine-tuned on MultiNLI (MNLI) for Natural Language Inference. Used in NOVA paper (2502.07340) for Semantic Equivalence Identification (SEI) clustering. Reports 91.5% accuracy on MNLI test set.

name: DeBERTa-large
notes: Original DeBERTa-large model (prior to v3). Used in NOVA paper (2502.07340) as the base for the quality reward model.

name: ResNet-32
organization: Microsoft Research (He et al., 2016; Wide ResNet)
access: widely available in PyTorch and timm libraries (e.g., torchivision.models.resnet18 with modified depth)
notes: ResNet variant with 32 layers designed for CIFAR-size images (32x32). Standard architecture for class-IL experiments on CIFAR-100. Used in arXiv:2502.07274 (Forget Remembering paper) for continual learning experiments.

name: Stable Video Diffusion (SVD)
notes: Latent video diffusion model for video generation. Base model processes 14-25 frames. Used as the pretrained backbone in FloVD (arXiv:2502.08244) for camera-controllable video synthesis. Paper: Blattmann et al., 2023.

name: SAM 2
notes: Segment Anything Model 2 for image and video segmentation. Used in FloVD (arXiv:2502.08244) to generate binary masks for moving objects (M_obj) to separate object motion from camera motion in the flow integration stage. Paper: Ravi et al., 2024.

name: TorchMD-Net
notes: Equivariant transformer for molecular potentials. Uses SO(3)-equivariant message passing with tensor product operations. Based on prior work from Doerr et al. (2021). Used as backbone in EMPP paper for PCQM4Mv2 pre-training experiments.

name: SEGNN
notes: SE(3)/SO(3)-equivariant graph neural network using geometric and physical quantities. Uses tensor product operations for equivariant message passing. Baseline in EMPP paper for QM9 and MD17 experiments.

name: o1-mini
notes: Fast reasoning model used in ShapeLib paper (arXiv:2502.08884) for interface creation, function implementation proposal, and synthetic data sampler authorship. Deployed as the primary LLM in the library discovery pipeline.

name: AlphaFlow
notes: AlphaFold2 repurposed within flow matching framework to generate diverse protein conformations. Used in AffinityFlow paper (2502.10365) as backbone for structure-conditioned antibody affinity maturation. Pretrained on single proteins, no fine-tuning required for guided generation.

name: GeoDock
organization: Johns Hopkins / Gray Lab (Chu et al., 2023)
notes: Multi-track iterative transformer for flexible protein-protein docking. Used in AffinityFlow paper (2502.10365) for generating antibody-antigen complex structures. Accepts separate antibody and antigen structures.

name: GVP
notes: Geometric Vector Perceptron for protein structure-based property prediction. Takes 3D graph coordinates and learns equivariant representations. Used in AffinityFlow paper (2502.10365) as structure-based affinity predictor with ESM2 embeddings.

name: IgFold
organization: Johns Hopkins / Gray Lab (Ruffolo et al., 2023)
notes: Fast antibody structure prediction from sequences using graph neural networks. Used in AffinityFlow paper (2502.10365) for structure prediction of mutated antibodies during evaluation.

name: OpenAI o1
notes: Frontier reasoning model by OpenAI used in KernelBench paper (arXiv:2502.10517) for LLM-based GPU kernel generation. Performs best out-of-the-box among evaluated models on kernel writing tasks, achieving <20% match rate with PyTorch baseline. Uses test-time compute for complex reasoning. Distinct from o1-preview and o1-mini.

name: CSA (Self-Attention in Colors)
organization: Menegaux et al. (Trans. Mach. Learn. Res. 2023)
notes: Graph transformer that encodes edge structural information using random walk probabilities (RWSE) as color-coded features. SPSE replaces RWSE with simple path counts. Used in SPSE paper (arXiv:2502.09365) as a baseline and with SPSE as a drop-in replacement. Three configurations: ZINC (40 GFLOPs), PATTERN (100 GFLOPs), CIFAR10 (280 GFLOPs).

name: GRIT
notes: Graph inductive biases in transformers without message passing. Uses random walk structural encoding (RWSE/RRWP) for edge features. SPSE replaces RWSE with simple path counts in SPSE paper (arXiv:2502.09365). Drop-in replacement demonstrated.

name: DINO
organization: IDEA Research / Shanghai AI Lab (Zhang et al., ICLR 2023)
notes: DETR with Improved DeNoising anchor boxes for end-to-end object detection. Uses denoising training with noisy GT labels for stability. Paper: arXiv:2203.03605.

name: DAB-DETR
organization: Tencent AI Lab / Peking University (Liu et al., ICLR 2022)
notes: Dynamic Anchor Boxes are Better Queries for DETR. Introduces 4D anchor box coordinates (x,y,w,h) as positional queries in the decoder. Paper: arXiv:2201.12329.

name: KD-DETR
notes: Knowledge Distillation for Detection Transformer with Consistent Distillation Points Sampling. Previous state-of-the-art DETR distillation method. Paper: CVPR 2024.

name: Dolly-v2-12B
notes: Open-source instruction-tuned LLM based on GPT-NeoX 20B. Used as one of three text generators in M4 LLM detection benchmark (Wang et al., 2024), evaluated in ExaGPT paper (Koike et al., 2025).

name: Stable Diffusion v1.4
notes: Latent diffusion model used as the 'known generator' in PDA (arXiv:2502.10803). Widely used baseline generative model. Paper uses SD v1.4 as the known generator for the detection framework.

name: Kandinsky 2.2
notes: Latent diffusion model with DALL-E 2-inspired architecture. Used in ablation study in PDA paper (arXiv:2502.10803) as an alternative known generator to validate robustness of the method to generator choice.

name: TinyLlama-v1.1
notes: Small open-source LLM with same architecture and tokenizer as Llama 2. Used in arXiv:2502.11196 for knowledge circuit analysis during continual pre-training.

name: Phi-1.5
notes: 1.3B parameter model trained on synthetic data. Used in arXiv:2502.11196 for knowledge circuit analysis during continual pre-training.

name: DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B
notes: Code-specialized LLM from DeepSeek. Base model used in GiFT paper (2502.11466) for self-training experiments on code generation. The paper also uses CodeLlama-7B as a base model. GiFT uses iterative Gibbs sampling inspired self-training to draw codes from marginal distribution instead of conditional distribution.

name: GPT-4 Turbo
notes: OpenAI GPT-4 Turbo model used in arXiv:2502.10961 (Privileged Information for LLM grading) as a candidate model for evaluation. Also used as one of the response generators for Vibe-Eval pairwise comparisons.

name: GLM-4-9b-chat
notes: Chat model used as teacher in watermark radioactivity paper arXiv:2502.11598. Generates watermarked QA pairs using KGW and SynthID-Text schemes.

name: SiT-XL/2
notes: Scalable Interpolant Transformers (CVPR 2024); flow-based diffusion model using optimal transport interpolants; same ViT-style transformer architecture as DiT-XL/2; Ma et al., 2024. Used as backbone in Model-guidance (MG) paper (2502.12154) which applies MG training objective to achieve FID 1.34 on ImageNet 256.

name: EyeFound
notes: Multimodal generalist foundation model for ophthalmic imaging. Pre-trained via self-supervised reconstruction on 11 multimodal ophthalmic imaging modalities. Used in Fundus2Globe (arXiv:2502.13182) to encode color fundus photographs into 1024-dimensional latent vectors.

name: EVA-ViT-G (eva02_giant_patch14_448)
notes: EVA ViT-Giant used as frozen vision encoder in BLIP-2. Paper: Fang et al. 2023 'EVA: Exploring the Limits of Masked Visual Representation Learning at Scale'. Used in mllm-video-captioner (Zhang et al. 2025) for video captioning by processing video frames independently.

name: EVA-CLIP-8B
notes: EVA-CLIP-8B (695M params) from Sun et al. 2023. Used in ComPaSS paper (arXiv:2502.13464) as a VLM backbone for commonsense plausibility estimation. Achieved best results on CoDa (62.87%) and ViComTe Color (51.73%) among all tested models.

name: CLIP-ViT-L/14 (124M)
notes: CLIP ViT-L/14 with 124M params as reported in ComPaSS paper (arXiv:2502.13464). Note: standard CLIP ViT-L/14 has ~428M params per the official OpenAI release; this 124M variant may refer to a specific architecture configuration used in the paper.

name: TTM (Tiny Time Mixers)
notes: Lightweight time series FM using TSMixer architecture. Designed for efficient zero-shot and few-shot forecasting. Much smaller than LLM-based time series FMs. Revision 2 used in ELF paper (Lee et al., 2025).

name: VisionTS
notes: Time series FM using masked autoencoder (MAE) pretrained on ImageNet (not time series data). Uses vision transformer architecture. Zero-shot forecasting by treating time series as 1D signals. From Chen et al., 2024.

name: Mistral-Small-Instruct-2409
notes: Used in R2-KG paper (arXiv:2502.12767) as a low-capacity Operator model for KG-based reasoning. Performance between Mistral-Small and larger models like Llama-3.1-70B.

name: Snap Video DiT
notes: DiT-based text-to-video model from Snap Research (Menapace et al., CVPR 2024). 32 DiT blocks, 4096 hidden dim, 32 attention heads, 6144 window size, 3D-RoPE, T5 text conditioning. Used as base model in Set-and-Sequence video personalization framework (2502.14844).

name: MAGVITv2
access: Language Model Beats Diffusion - Tokenizer is key to visual generation (ICLR 2024)
notes: Causal video autoencoder used for latent space compression in Snap Video DiT. Compression ratio 8x16x16 on time and spatial dimensions with 32 bottleneck channels. From Yu et al., ICLR 2024.

name: LLaMA-3.1-8B
notes: From Meta's Llama 3.1 series with 128K context length. Used in LongPO paper (2502.13922) as a baseline comparison.

name: LLaMA-3.1-70B
notes: From Meta's Llama 3.1 series with 128K context length. Used in LongPO paper (2502.13922) as a baseline comparison.

name: LWM-Text-Chat-1M
notes: Large World Model with 1M context length. Used in LongPO paper (2502.13922) as a baseline comparison.

name: YaRN-Mistral-7B-128k
notes: Mistral-7B with YaRN position interpolation for 128K context. Used in LongPO paper (2502.13922) as a baseline comparison.

name: Molmo-7B
notes: Molmo (Deitke et al., 2024): VLM using CLIP ViT-L/14 336px vision encoder + MLP projector + Mistral-7B LLM. Architecture used as base by CoSyn (arXiv:2502.14846). Pretrained on PixMo-Cap dense captions.

name: CLIP ViT-L/14 336px
notes: Higher-resolution CLIP ViT-L/14 variant at 336px (vs standard 224px). Used as vision encoder in Molmo and CoSyn (arXiv:2502.14846).

name: CodeT5+-220m (codet5p-220m-bimodal)
notes: Encoder-decoder code foundation model. Base model for DeepRTL-220m (arXiv:2502.15832). Shallow encoder deep decoder architecture. Used with 2048 token context (extended from default 512).

name: CodeT5+-16b (instructcodet5p-16b)
