notes: 16B encoder-decoder code foundation model. Base model for DeepRTL-16b (arXiv:2502.15832). Shallow encoder deep decoder architecture.

name: Mixtral-8x22B-v0.1
notes: Used in arXiv:2502.15603 (Do Multilingual LLMs Think In English?) for analyzing English-centric routing in multilingual models.

name: Aya-23-35B
notes: 23-language multilingual model used in arXiv:2502.15603. Shows least English-routing behavior among the models studied.

name: ESM2-t33-650M-UR50D
notes: Specific ESM2 variant (650M params, UR50D training dataset) used in MBGNN (2502.16189) for residue-level protein embeddings. Generates 1280-dimensional embeddings per residue.

name: MSA Transformer
notes: Transformer model that processes Multiple Sequence Alignments (MSAs) to generate residue-level and MSA-level representations. Used in MBGNN (2502.16189) and MetalNet2 to generate co-evolutionary contact maps from MSAs.

name: ColabFold MMseq2
notes: Fast protein structure prediction and MSA generation tool combining MMseq2 with AlphaFold2. Used in MBGNN (2502.16189) to generate MSAs for co-evolved residue network construction. ColabFold generates MSAs from input protein sequences, which are then processed by MSA Transformer.

name: DeepProfiler
notes: Deep learning method for extracting phenotypic profiles from cell painting images. Uses EfficientNet backbone, processes single-cell crops, requires segmentation. Used as baseline in PhenoProfiler paper.

name: ResNet50
notes: 50-layer Residual Network for image recognition. Used as backbone in PhenoProfiler and as baseline in cell painting experiments.

name: CellProfiler
notes: Open-source software for quantitative image analysis of cells. Extracts morphology features (size, shape, intensity, texture) from cell images. Used for baseline comparison and generating morphology profiles as regression targets in PhenoProfiler.

name: MedCPT
notes: Contrastive pre-trained Transformer with large-scale PubMed search logs for zero-shot biomedical information retrieval. Used as frozen text encoder in SuPreME (arXiv:2502.19668) for encoding cardiac query embeddings.

name: VAR-d16
notes: Visual Autoregressive Modeling: Scalable Image Generation via Next-Scale Prediction (arXiv:2404.02905). Scale-wise autoregressive model with residual prediction. FlexVAR builds on this work but replaces residual prediction with GT prediction.

name: VAR-d20
notes: Visual Autoregressive Modeling: Scalable Image Generation via Next-Scale Prediction (arXiv:2404.02905). Scale-wise autoregressive model with residual prediction. FlexVAR builds on this work but replaces residual prediction with GT prediction.

name: VAR-d24
notes: Visual Autoregressive Modeling: Scalable Image Generation via Next-Scale Prediction (arXiv:2404.02905). Scale-wise autoregressive model with residual prediction. FlexVAR builds on this work but replaces residual prediction with GT prediction.

name: VAR-d36
notes: Visual Autoregressive Modeling: Scalable Image Generation via Next-Scale Prediction (arXiv:2404.02905). Scale-wise autoregressive model with residual prediction. Trained at 512x512 resolution for zero-shot transfer to higher resolutions.

name: H2OTR
notes: Transformer-based unified framework for two hands and object pose estimation. Uses 300 queries and 6 decoder layers. Main baseline for QORT-Former. Achieves 26 FPS on RTX 3090TI but is not real-time capable. QORT-Former improves upon H2OTR with query optimization, contact maps, and three-step decoder update.

name: WideResNet-28-10
notes: Wide residual network (depth=28, widen_factor=10). Pre-trained on CIFAR-10 with adversarial training. Used in FoCTTA (arXiv:2502.20677) for CIFAR10-C experiments.

name: WideResNet-40-2
notes: Wide residual network (depth=40, widen_factor=2). Pre-trained on CIFAR-100 with adversarial training. Used in FoCTTA (arXiv:2502.20677) for CIFAR100-C experiments.

name: PointGPT
notes: Point cloud transformer with auto-regressive masked point modeling pretraining; NeurIPS 2023; used as representation baseline in HAMNET paper

name: MusicGen-Small
notes: Autoregressive transformer for music generation using Encodec audio tokenizer with multiple codebooks. Generates ~30s music at 32kHz. Baseline in InspireMusic paper (arXiv:2503.00084).

name: MusicGen-Medium
notes: Medium variant of MusicGen autoregressive transformer for music generation. Baseline in InspireMusic paper (arXiv:2503.00084).

name: MusicGen-Large
notes: Large variant of MusicGen autoregressive transformer for music generation. Generates ~30s music at 32kHz. Baseline in InspireMusic paper (arXiv:2503.00084).

name: Stable Audio 2.0
license: Stability AI Creative ML Open RAIL++-M License
notes: Latent diffusion model for high-fidelity long-form music generation. Uses CLAP for text conditioning and generates up to 3min audio at 44.1kHz. Baseline in InspireMusic paper (arXiv:2503.00084).

name: HyGCN
notes: HyGCN: Hybrid GNN Accelerator. First major FPGA accelerator for GNNs. Uses SIMD cores for aggregation and systolic array for transformation. Key limitation: double-buffering mechanism causes pipeline gaps for graphs with non-uniform node degree distribution. Addressed by AMPLE (arXiv:2502.21196).

name: GenGNN
notes: Generic FPGA Framework for GNN Acceleration. Model-agnostic HLS-based GNN accelerator. Adds prefetching support for incoming messages. Key limitation: requires on-chip buffering for all node embeddings, limiting scalability for large graphs (>100K nodes). Addressed by AMPLE (arXiv:2502.21196) with node-centric prefetching.

name: Degree-Quant
notes: Quantization-Aware Training for Graph Neural Networks. First QAT approach for GNNs. Key insight: quantization error in GNNs is predominantly due to the aggregation phase and is correlated with node degree. Uses stochastic protection mask: high-degree nodes preserved in float, low-degree nodes in int8/int4. AMPLE (arXiv:2502.21196) implements this in hardware.

name: Surgformer
backbone: Vision Transformer (ViT) with hierarchical temporal attention
notes: Surgical Transformer with Hierarchical Temporal Attention for Surgical Phase Recognition (MICCAI 2024). Sliding-window ViT architecture for surgical phase recognition. Baseline for MoSFormer. Uses patch embedding, spatial-temporal tokenization, hierarchical temporal attention.

name: SCAN (Self-supervised Class-agnostic Segmentation)
notes: SCAN: Learning to Classify Images Without Labels (ECCV 2020). Uses nearest-neighbor consistency loss + entropy regularization for representation-aware clustering. DISCOVER (arXiv:2503.01733) adapts SCAN for smart home sensor sequences with BERT encoder pre-trained via masked language modeling.

name: CropFormer
notes: High Quality Entity Segmentation (ICCV 2023). Generates entity-level 2D masks from images. Used in OnlineAnySeg (2503.01309) for VFM-based mask generation. Produces higher quality masks than SAM for entity-level segmentation.

name: FCGF
notes: Fully Convolutional Geometric Features (ICCV 2019). Extracts 32-dimensional geometric features from 3D point clouds using ResUNetBN2C architecture. Pretrained weights available for 3DMatch and KITTI. Used in OnlineAnySeg (2503.01309) for geometric similarity computation in mask merging.

name: ORB-SLAM 3.0
notes: Feature-based visual-inertial SLAM system. Multi-map management via Atlas. Supports monocular, stereo, RGB-D, and IMU. Baseline for vS-Graphs paper (arXiv:2503.01783).

name: S-Graphs
notes: LiDAR-based scene graph SLAM. Hierarchical scene graph representation (building components, structural elements). Inspiration for vS-Graphs (vision-only adaptation). S-Graphs+ version: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters 2023.

name: Hydra
notes: Real-time spatial perception system for 3D scene graph construction and optimization. Builds scene graphs from 3D data without camera pose estimation. Baseline in vS-Graphs paper (arXiv:2503.01783).

name: ElasticFusion
notes: Dense RGB-D SLAM using surfel-based global fusion. Computes camera pose via image alignment. Baseline in vS-Graphs paper (arXiv:2503.01783).

name: BAD SLAM
notes: Bundle adjusted direct RGB-D SLAM. Jointly optimizes camera poses, intrinsics, and 3D points via direct photometric alignment. Baseline in vS-Graphs paper (arXiv:2503.01783).

name: Panoptic-FCN
notes: Fully Convolutional Networks for Panoptic Segmentation. Real-time panoptic segmentation used in vS-Graphs for wall/ground detection. Paper: CVPR 2021.

name: YOSO
notes: You Only Segment Once: Real-time panoptic segmentation. Alternative segmentation backbone used in vS-Graphs. Paper: CVPR 2023.

name: Voxblox
notes: Incremental 3D Euclidean signed distance fields for onboard MAV planning. Used in vS-Graphs for volumetric representation of free-space clusters.

name: PROD-SLAM
notes: Point, Rich and Deep Data SLAM. RGB-D SLAM baseline mentioned in vS-Graphs paper (arXiv:2503.01783) comparison.

name: Mamba-1.4B
notes: Mamba state space model (1.4B parameters). Selective state space model with linear-time sequence modeling. Used in arXiv:2503.03499 for PEFT experiments.

name: Mamba-2.8B
notes: Mamba state space model (2.8B parameters). Largest Mamba-1 variant. Selective state space model with linear-time sequence modeling. Used in arXiv:2503.03499 for PEFT experiments.

name: InSerter
notes: From Wang et al. 2025 (arXiv:2503.02769). Pre-trained with InSerter interleaved speech-text pre-training on 301,540 hours of TTS-generated speech. State-of-the-art on SpeechInstructBench and VoiceBench.

name: GLM-4-Voice
notes: End-to-end spoken chatbot from THUDM. Baseline in InSerter paper (arXiv:2503.02769). Competitive on VoiceBench and SpeechInstructBench.

name: Mini-Omni
notes: Streaming LLM that can think while hearing and talking. Baseline in InSerter paper. Limited to English-only responses.

name: Mini-Omni2
notes: Improved version of Mini-Omni with vision+speech+duplex capabilities. Baseline in InSerter paper.

name: BLSP
notes: Bootstrapping Language-Speech Pre-training via Behavior Alignment of Continuation Writing. Baseline in InSerter paper.

name: DIVA
notes: Distilling end-to-end voice assistant from speech recognition data. Baseline in InSerter paper using distillation-based behavior alignment.

name: Megrez-3B-Omni
notes: 3B parameter omni model from Infinigence AI. Baseline in InSerter paper.

name: BNT (Brain Network Transformer)
input_resolution: FCN graphs (116 nodes from AAL atlas, Pearson correlation edge features)
access: https://github.com/xxx/BNT (paper does not provide explicit code URL)
notes: Brain Network Transformer for fMRI functional connectivity network analysis. Uses multi-head self-attention over brain region nodes. Used as network encoder backbone in CINP paper (arXiv:2503.04205). Paper: NeurIPS 2022.

name: Isaac Gym
notes: GPU-accelerated physics simulation platform for robot learning. Enables massively parallel simulation (4000+ environments) on a single GPU. Used for quadrupedal locomotion training in QuietPaw.

name: Unitree Go2
notes: quadrupedal robot platform used for real-world validation of QuietPaw. Weight: ~15kg. Degrees of freedom: 12. Max speed: ~3.3 m/s. Equipped with PD controllers for joint position control at 50Hz.

name: Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410
notes: 8B parameter instruction-tuned model from Mistral AI, October 2024 release. Used as a target victim model in UDora red-teaming paper (arXiv:2503.01908), where it was found more susceptible to the attack than Llama-3.1-8B.

name: BirdAVES (AVES)
notes: Animal Vocalization Encoder based on Self-Supervision. Pretrained on animal sound datasets. Used as backbone encoder in Voxaboxen paper and as a baseline SED model. Paper: Hagiwara 2023 (ICASSP).

name: Frame-ATST
notes: Audio Temporal Sinc Transformer for sound event detection. Pretrained on AudioSet at 25Hz output frame rate. Used as a baseline frame-based SED model. Paper: Shao et al. 2024 (ICASSP).

name: SEDT (Sound Event Detection Transformer)
notes: Transformer-based end-to-end model for sound event detection. Uses 1D event-based approach adapted from spectrograms. Poor performance in Voxaboxen paper due to pre-training on city noises not transferring well to animal vocalizations. Paper: Ye et al. 2021.

name: CRNN (Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network)
notes: Standard CRNN for polyphonic sound event detection. Architecture: 2D conv layer, mean pooling, residual blocks, bi-LSTM with hidden size 1024. Weights randomly initialized. Used as baseline in Voxaboxen paper. Paper: Cakir et al. 2017.

name: P2PNet
notes: Point-based end-to-end nucleus detector. Base detector for this paper's context-aware approach.

name: Hover-Net
organization: Graham et al., Medical Image Analysis 2019
notes: Simultaneous segmentation and classification of nuclei in multi-tissue histology images. Joint detection + segmentation.

name: CellViT
organization: Horst et al., Medical Image Analysis 2024
notes: Vision transformer for precise cell segmentation and classification.

name: MFOV-P2PNet
notes: Multi-Field-of-View P2PNet. Prior context-aware nucleus detection using LFoV patches. Baseline in this paper.

name: MFOVCE-Net
notes: Multi-field of view context encoding for nucleus recognition. Prior explicit context-aware approach.

name: InternVL2.5-2B
notes: VLM backbone used in GO-1 robot policy (AgiBot World, arXiv:2503.06669).

name: π0
notes: Generalist robot policy using pre-trained VLM backbone with flow-based action expert for dexterous manipulation. Baseline in AgiBot World paper (arXiv:2503.06669).

name: VGG-19
notes: Used in this paper for style score computation (Gram matrix features) in photo stylization tuning task.

name: SoViT-400m
notes: Scalable Vision Transformer 400m used as the vision encoder backbone in DOFA-CLIP-Large (Xiong et al., arXiv:2503.06312). Pretrained on WebLI dataset. This is the base architecture for SigLIP-So400m models.

name: SigLIP-So400m-SigLIP-384
notes: SigLIP model variant using SoViT-400m backbone at 384 resolution. Used as frozen teacher model in DOFA-CLIP-Large (Xiong et al., arXiv:2503.06312). The text encoder uses a learned 64-token context length.

name: ViT-Huge-14-384 (ImageNet)
notes: ViT-Huge with patch size 14 at 384 resolution, pretrained on ImageNet. Used as a frozen teacher model for knowledge distillation in DOFA-CLIP (Xiong et al., arXiv:2503.06312). This is distinct from the CLIP ViT-L/14 model.

name: DOFA (Dynamic-One-For-All)
notes: DOFA: Dynamic-One-For-All foundation model for multimodal Earth observation (Xiong et al., 2024a). Introduces a hypernetwork-based dynamic encoder that adapts to different sensor wavelengths. DOFA-CLIP adopts DOFA's wavelength-aware dynamic encoder architecture (Xiong et al., arXiv:2503.06312). Supports joint training across 5 EO modalities (RGB, SAR, multispectral, hyperspectral, elevation).

name: Exphormer
params: varies by config (3-8 layers, 64-256 hidden dims)
notes: Sparse graph transformer using expander graphs for global attention. Linear complexity O(N) attention. Used as baseline in City-Networks paper (2503.09008).

name: GCNII
params: varies by config (2-64 layers, 64-512 hidden dims)
notes: Simple and Deep Graph Convolutional Networks. Uses initial residual and identity mapping to address over-smoothing. Used as baseline in City-Networks paper (2503.09008).

name: Grounding DINO Tiny
notes: Lightweight variant used in DitHub paper (arXiv:2503.09271) for incremental open-vocabulary detection with LoRA fine-tuning.

name: OSTrack
notes: One-stream framework for visual object tracking. Joint feature learning and relation modeling. Used as base tracker in TPF (2503.11247) RGBT tracking paper. DropMAE pretrained backbone.

name: CLAP-ASM
access: not publicly released (from CLAP paper, arXiv:2407.21256)
notes: Assembly code encoder from CLAP paper ('Learning Transferable Binary Code Representations with Natural Language Supervision', Wang et al., 2024). Used in ASMA-Tune paper (arXiv:2503.11617) as the assembly encoder component. Generates 768-dim embeddings from assembly code. Not publicly released at time of ASMA-Tune publication.

name: VideoMamba-M
notes: VideoMamba: State space model for efficient video understanding (Li et al., ECCV 2024). Mamba-based video backbone. Suffers from overfitting issues when scaled beyond 100M parameters. Used as baseline in VideoMAP paper.

name: VideoMamba-B
notes: VideoMamba-Base variant with 98M params. Experiences performance drop vs M variant due to overfitting (as noted in VideoMAP paper).

name: VideoMamba-L
notes: VideoMamba-Large variant with 301M params. Can be effectively pretrained with VideoMAP for improved scalability.

name: UMT-B (Unmasked Teacher)
notes: Unmasked Teacher: Towards training-efficient video foundation models (Li et al., ICCV 2023). Uses CLIP-aligned pretraining with unmasked teacher. Baseline for VideoMamba and VideoMAP comparisons.

name: PVT-V2-B5
notes: Pyramid Vision Transformer V2, B5 variant. Used as visual backbone in audio-visual segmentation papers including RAVS (arXiv:2503.12847).

name: HTSAT (Hierarchical Token-Semantic Audio Transformer)
notes: HTSAT: hierarchical token-semantic audio transformer. Used as audio encoder backbone in RAVS (arXiv:2503.12847) for audio-visual segmentation, achieving better results than VGGish.

name: PLIP
notes: Pathology Language and Image Pre-training (PLIP). Visual-language foundation model for pathology trained on medical Twitter image-text pairs. Based on CLIP architecture with a ViT vision encoder. Described in Huang et al., Nature Medicine 2023.

name: QuiltNet
notes: QuiltNet: VLM for histopathology trained on Quilt-1M dataset (1M histopathology image-text pairs). Based on CLIP ViT architecture. Described in Ikezogwo et al., arXiv:2306.11207.

name: MI-Zero (PubmedBERT)
notes: Multiple Instance Zero-shot Transfer (MI-Zero) for histopathology VLMs. Uses PubmedBERT as the text encoder. Described in Lu et al., CVPR 2023.

name: MI-Zero (BioclinicalBERT)
notes: MI-Zero variant using BioclinicalBERT as text encoder instead of PubmedBERT. Described in Lu et al., CVPR 2023.

name: text-embedding-3-large
notes: Largest OpenAI embedding model. Used in KG-Prover (arXiv:2503.11657) to embed ProofWiki nodes (~60K nodes) for semantic similarity retrieval.

name: LoFTR
notes: Detector-free local feature matching with transformers (Sun et al., CVPR 2021). Used in SED-MVS for extracting feature point correspondences between reference and source images for sparse point generation.

name: TowerInstruct-7B-v0.2
notes: Translation-focused instruct model used for MCTS token generation in MT-RewardTree paper (arXiv:2503.12123). Used with temperature 0.95 to generate top-2 candidate tokens for MCTS expansion.

name: COMETKiwi
notes: Lightweight translation quality metric used for rollout evaluation in MCTS-based preference pair generation in MT-RewardTree paper (arXiv:2503.12123). Evaluates quality of translation rollouts during the simulation step.

name: WavCaps
notes: WavCaps: A chatgpt-assisted weakly-labelled audio captioning dataset for audio-language multimodal research. Contains ~400k audio clips with paired text. Used in MAG paper (2503.14040) to extract audio features (HTSAT encoder) and text features (BERT-based text encoder) for motion-text-audio alignment via contrastive learning.

name: SMPLX
organization: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems (MPI-IS)
notes: Expressive Body Capture: 3D hands, face, and body from a single image (Pavlakos et al., CVPR 2019). Used in BEATv2 and SHOW datasets for 3D full-body mesh representation at 30fps. Used in MAG paper (2503.14040) for gesture generation output format.

name: HTSAT
notes: Hierarchical Token-Semantic Audio Transformer for sound classification and detection (Chen et al., ICASSP 2022). Used in WavCaps for audio feature extraction. Used in MAG paper (2503.14040) as the audio encoder within WavCaps framework for extracting frozen audio embeddings.

name: StableNormal
notes: StableNormal: Reducing diffusion variance for stable and sharp normal estimation. Used in Niagara (2503.12553) as frozen pretrained normal estimator. Diffusion-based approach for high-quality surface normal prediction.

name: LayoutXLM
notes: Multimodal pre-trained model for multilingual visually-rich document understanding (Xu et al., 2021). Extends LayoutLMv3 with cross-modal alignment. Used in UniHDSA for text embedding extraction from OCR text-lines.

name: Stable Audio Open 1.0
params: undisclosed (~0.5-1B estimate, smaller than Stable Audio 2.0's 1.1B)
notes: Open-weights text-to-audio generation model using latent diffusion (autoencoder + T5 text encoder + transformer DiT). Generates variable-length stereo audio up to 47s at 44.1kHz. Used in Imagine to Hear (ITH) paper (arXiv:2503.16853) for generating auditory knowledge. Paper: arXiv:2407.14358.

name: LAION-Audio CLAP
notes: Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining model (CLAP, Elizalde et al., ICASSP 2023, arXiv:2211.06687). Uses HTSAT audio encoder and BERT-based text encoder with contrastive learning. Used in Imagine to Hear (ITH) paper (arXiv:2503.16853) for CLAP-based rejection sampling to filter generated audio by text relevance. Default checkpoint: 630k-audioset-best.pt.

name: SMPL
notes: Skinned Multi-Person Linear Model — parametric 3D body model. Input: pose (joint angles) + shape (beta). Output: 3D mesh with skinning weights. Used as the body representation in DiffusedWrinkles paper.

name: EVF-SAM
organization: IDEA Research / THU (Zhang et al., arXiv:2406.20076)
notes: Early Vision-Language Fusion for Segment Anything Model. Combines SAM with vision-language understanding for text-prompted open-vocabulary segmentation. Used in SparseGS-W (2503.19452) for generating occlusion masks based on user text prompts (e.g., 'tourist' to mask pedestrians).

name: BodyMAP
outputs: SMPL pose (72-dim) and shape (10-dim) parameters, 3D body mesh
notes: Jointly predicts body mesh and 3D applied pressure map from depth images. Used as backbone in VIM-PSE (arXiv:2503.19405) for depth-based pose estimation. Modified version in VIM-PSE uses only depth input (not pressure maps) and outputs only pose parameters.

name: RankT5
notes: Fine-tuned T5 reranker with ranking losses for passage reranking. State-of-the-art supervised LLM-based ranker used in arXiv:2503.19092 (SIGIR 2025) for studying LLM judge biases.

name: FLAN-UL2
notes: Unified Language Learning (UL2) model fine-tuned with FLAN instruction tuning. Used as LLM ranker (RG method) in arXiv:2503.19092 (SIGIR 2025) for studying LLM judge biases.

name: Whisper-large-v2
notes: Whisper Large v2 model used for multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) in MMMORRF video retrieval pipeline (SIGIR 2025). Pre-trained on 680k hours of multilingual audio.

name: VAST
notes: Vision-Audio-Subtitle-Text omni-modality foundation model. Used as baseline in MMMORRF paper (SIGIR 2025). Achieved SOTA on various vision tasks but underperforms on MultiVENT 2.0.

name: LanguageBind
notes: Video-language pretraining extending CLIP to multiple modalities (video, audio, etc.) via language-based semantic alignment. Used as baseline in MMMORRF paper (SIGIR 2025).

name: VideoLLaMA2-7B
notes: Audio-visual LLM evaluated in AVUT benchmark (arXiv:2503.19951). Receives video with audio track. One of the evaluated audio-visual MLLMs.

name: video-SALMONN-13B
notes: Speech-enhanced audio-visual LLM (13B). Evaluated in AVUT benchmark (arXiv:2503.19951). Receives video with audio. Upgraded version of SALMONN with video input support.

name: VILA-1.5-8B
notes: Visual MLLM evaluated in AVUT benchmark (arXiv:2503.19951). Receives video with audio track removed (visual-only input). Part of the VILA family.

name: VideoLLaVA-7B
notes: Visual MLLM evaluated in AVUT benchmark (arXiv:2503.19951). Receives video with audio track removed (visual-only input). Unified visual representation approach.

name: IgCraft
notes: Multi-purpose Bayesian Flow Network for paired human antibody sequence generation. Supports unconditional sampling, sequence inpainting, inverse folding, and CDR grafting. Two-track transformer architecture with ~300M parameters.

name: p-IgGen
notes: Paired antibody generative language model. Baseline for unconditional paired antibody sequence generation in IgCraft paper.

name: AbLang2
notes: Antibody language model for sequence design and inpainting. Used as baseline for sequence inpainting in IgCraft paper.

name: Antifold
notes: Antibody structure-based design using inverse folding. Uses deep learning for antibody sequence design conditioned on structure. Baseline for inverse folding in IgCraft paper.

name: HuDiff
notes: Adaptive autoregressive diffusion approach for antibody humanization. CDR grafting method specifically fine-tuned to maximize AbNatiV humanness score. Baseline for CDR grafting comparison in IgCraft paper.

name: E2VID
notes: Event-to-Video reconstruction network. Recurrent, convolutional architecture that reconstructs intensity images from event camera data. Used as backbone in EventFly and ESS papers.

name: ESS (Event Semantic Segmentation)
notes: Event semantic segmentation network built on E2VID backbone. Takes event voxel grids and produces per-pixel semantic labels. Used as segmentation head in EventFly paper.

name: LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct
notes: Instruction-tuned LLaMA 3.1 8B model used in RocketPPA paper (arXiv:2503.21971) as the LLM backbone for PPA (Power, Performance, Area) estimation from Verilog HDL code. 128K context length supports long code fragments.

name: ViG-S (Vision GNN Small)
notes: Vision GNN (ViG) treats image patches as graph nodes and uses k-NN to establish relationships. Used as baseline in arXiv:2503.22079 (flexible object recognition). Proposed model builds on ViG-S architecture.

name: R²-GS (Radiative Gaussian Splatting)
notes: Rectifying radiative Gaussian splatting for tomographic reconstruction. Extends 3DGS with Beer-Lambert law for X-ray rendering. Baseline for X²-Gaussian paper.

name: X-GS (Radiative Gaussian Splatting for X-ray)
notes: First 3DGS-based method for X-ray novel view synthesis. Used as baseline in X²-Gaussian paper.

name: GatorTron-Base
notes: Clinical domain-specific language model trained on clinical texts. Used as base model for fine-tuning and prompt-based learning in menstrual characteristics extraction (arXiv:2503.24116). The larger GatorTron models go up to 8.9B params, but GatorTron-Base is the ~345M version used in this paper.

name: Meditron-70B (Meditron-3)
notes: Clinically fine-tuned LLaMA 3.1-based model. Used for In-Context Learning (ICL) baseline in menstrual characteristics extraction (arXiv:2503.24116). Also available in 7B version. Adapted from LLaMA 3.1 (arXiv:2407.21783).

name: ClinicalLongformer
notes: Long-sequence transformer for clinical text using sparse attention (sliding window + global attention). Used as PBL baseline in menstrual characteristics extraction (arXiv:2503.24116). Paper sets max length to 2048 tokens.

name: MedEmbed-small-v0.1
notes: Medical-domain embedding model fine-tuned from BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 for clinical/biomedical text. Used in hybrid retrieval (BM25 + semantic similarity) pipeline for menstrual characteristics extraction (arXiv:2503.24116). MedEmbed-large-v0.1 is the larger variant (~335M, ~0.7GB).

name: PSPNet
notes: Pyramid Scene Parsing Network. Used in CrossTooth (arXiv:2503.23702) as the image segmentation module for extracting boundary features from multi-view rendered dental images. Contains ~7.08G FLOPs, lightweight for dental imaging tasks.

name: Janus-1.4B
notes: Base model used in RIG paper (2503.24388) for end-to-end embodied agent with reasoning and imagination. Uses SigLIP vision encoder and VQ tokenizer. Supports autoregressive generation of text, actions, and visual tokens.

name: SigLIP-Large-Patch16-384
notes: SigLIP vision encoder used in RIG paper (2503.24388) for visual understanding in embodied agent. Dual loss combining RGB and SigLIP-guided feature reconstruction.

name: ShieldGemma2-4B
notes: Safety classifier VLM built on Gemma 3 4B-IT; fine-tuned for image content moderation across 3 harm categories (sexual, danger, violence) with policy-aware classification. Introduces BADG (Borderline Adversarial Data Generation) pipeline for adversarial training data. This paper (arXiv:2504.01081) is the primary reference.

name: TransE
notes: Translating Embeddings (TransE) - classic KGE method. Represents relations as translations: h + r ≈ t. Simple and effective. Used in ReaLitE paper (2504.00852) as base model.

name: DistMult
notes: DistMult - bilinear diagonal model for KGE. Uses triple scoring with h * r * t. More parameters than TransE. Used in ReaLitE paper (2504.00852) as base model.

name: ComplEx
notes: ComplEx - complex-valued KGE model extending DistMult to complex space. Handles asymmetric relations. ReaLitE enhances both real and imaginary parts of relation embeddings. Used in ReaLitE paper (2504.00852) as base model.

name: RotatE
notes: RotatE - rotation-based KGE in complex space. Represents relations as rotations: h * r = t. Models symmetry/antisymmetry. Used in ReaLitE paper (2504.00852) as base model.

name: TuckER
notes: TuckER - tensor factorization model using Tucker decomposition. More expressive but more parameters. Used in ReaLitE paper (2504.00852) as base model.

name: SAM (ViT-B)
notes: Original Segment Anything Model with ViT-B image encoder. Used in CMaP-SAM paper (arXiv:2504.05049) for few-shot segmentation. Produces 64x64 feature maps at 1024x1024 input resolution to match DINOv2 features.

name: SAM (ViT-L)
notes: Original Segment Anything Model with ViT-L image encoder (SAM-L). Higher capacity variant with 304M params in the image encoder. Used in CMaP-SAM paper (arXiv:2504.05049).

name: PVTv2-B3
organization: Nanjing University / Tongji University / HKUST (Wang et al., CVM 2022)
notes: Pyramid Vision Transformer V2, B3 variant. Used as backbone in RCCFormer (arXiv:2504.04935) for crowd counting. Pre-trained on ImageNet-1K. B3 has 4 stages with progressively reduced spatial resolution and increased channel dimensions.

name: Granite-3.1-2B-Instruct
notes: IBM Granite 3.1 2B instruction-tuned model. Used in EvoTune (arXiv:2504.05108) as one of three base LLMs for evolutionary search + DPO fine-tuning for algorithm discovery. Paper citation: 'Granite 3.0 language models' (GitHub: ibm-granite/granite-3.0-language-models).

name: YOLOX-L
notes: YOLOX-L (large) variant used as backbone in Park et al. (2504.05636) for mammography lesion detection. Modified with attention-based image-level prediction aggregation.

name: YOLOX-X
notes: YOLOX-X (extra-large) variant used in Park et al. (2504.05636) for mammography lesion detection. Modified with attention-based image-level prediction aggregation.

name: GMIC (Globally-Aware Multiple Instance Classifier)
notes: Baseline model for mammography cancer detection. Used as comparison in Park et al. (2504.05636). Shen et al., Medical Image Analysis 2021.

name: 3D-GMIC
notes: 3D extension of GMIC for DBT mammography. Used as baseline in Park et al. (2504.05636). Park et al., IEEE TMI 2023.

name: HRNet-W18
notes: High-Resolution Network for image classification. Used as the SelfMAD classifier backbone in SelfMAD (arXiv:2504.05504). Pretrained on ImageNet, fine-tuned with SAM optimizer.

name: CelebAMask-HQ
notes: Face segmentation dataset with 19 semantic labels. Used to train SegFormer face parser for generating blending masks in SelfMAD.

name: General-Verifier (Tiger-Lab)
notes: Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-1.5B-Math model used as semantic clustering verifier in EMPO (arXiv:2504.05812) for free-form natural reasoning tasks. Determines whether two model outputs are semantically equivalent.

name: T5-Large
notes: Large variant of the T5 encoder-decoder model. Used in the paper 'Sculpting Subspaces: Constrained Full Fine-Tuning in LLMs for Continual Learning' (2504.07097) for continual learning experiments on 5-task and 15-task benchmarks.

name: SAM ViT-H (Segment Anything Model)
notes: Original Segment Anything Model with ViT-H backbone. Used in DetAny3D (arXiv:2504.07958) as promptable backbone for 3D detection. Frozen during training.

name: UI-I2E-VLM-4B
notes: GUI instruction grounding VLM fine-tuned from InternVL2-4B on 9.9M synthesized UI-E2I-Synth instructions. Outperforms prior GUI grounding models with substantially less training data. Handles implicit instructions and long-tailed element types better than baselines.

name: UI-I2E-VLM-7B
notes: GUI instruction grounding VLM fine-tuned from Qwen2-VL-7B on 9.9M synthesized UI-E2I-Synth instructions. Achieves SOTA on ScreenSpot (86.5%), UI-I2E-Bench (69.5%), ScreenSpot-Pro (23.6%). Trained on 16xA100 80GB for ~60 hours.

name: OmniParser
notes: Screen parsing tool for GUI agents. Combines icon detection, text recognition, and GPT-4o for element parsing. Used in UI-E2I-Synth paper as a baseline, where OmniParser+GPT-4o achieves competitive implicit instruction performance but struggles with small elements.

name: ShowUI
notes: One vision-language-action model for generalist GUI agents. Evaluated in UI-E2I-Synth paper as a baseline on GUI grounding benchmarks. Shows high ScreenSpot scores but drops significantly on more challenging benchmarks.

name: Qwen-1.5-7B-Chat
notes: Qwen-1.5 series chat model. Used in GRAIL paper (arXiv:2504.12681) for multi-domain unlearning experiments alongside LLaMA-2-7B-Chat. Qwen-1.5 is the predecessor to Qwen2/Qwen2.5 series.

name: Granite-3.2-8B-Instruct
notes: IBM Granite 3.2 8B instruction-tuned model. Used as base model for intrinsics experiments in Activated LoRA paper (arXiv:2504.12397).

name: SmolLM-360M
notes: Small language model from HuggingFace. Used as a base pLLM in XPerT (arXiv:2504.13938) for on-device LLM personalization experiments.

name: Seed1.5-Thinking
notes: Reasoning model trained with RL (VAPO/DAPO). Achieves 86.7% on AIME 2024, 55.0% pass@8 on Codeforces, 77.3% on GPQA Diamond. MoE architecture with 20B activated parameters out of 200B total. Competitor to DeepSeek R1, OpenAI o3-mini, Gemini 2.5 Pro.

name: S3D
notes: Spatio-Temporal 3D ConvNet for video classification. Used in AV-CIL-FFIA paper (arXiv:2504.15171) as visual encoder pretrained on Kinetics-400. Extracts temporal dynamics of fish movement and feeding behavior from video clips.

name: PANNs (MobileNetV2)
notes: Pretrained Audio Neural Networks framework. Used in AV-CIL-FFIA paper (arXiv:2504.15171) as audio encoder (MobileNetV2 architecture) pretrained on AudioSet for extracting spectral features of feeding intensities.

name: MViTv2-S
notes: Multiscale Vision Transformers v2. Used as encoder backbone in SAIP-Net paper (arXiv:2504.16564). Hierarchical structure with 4 stages, pooling attention for efficiency. Supports variable input resolutions for dense prediction tasks.

name: ESM-IF1 (Inverse Folding)
notes: Inverse folding model that takes a protein structure (backbone coordinates) and a corrupted sequence, then predicts the original sequence. Uses structure encoder + sequence-to-sequence transformer. Trained on AlphaFold2 predicted structures. Used for zero-shot fitness prediction in ProteinGym benchmark.

name: GEMME
notes: Global Epistatic Model for Mutational Effects. Predicts protein function from MSA by presenting homologous sequences as a tree and extracting conserved residues. Zero-shot method for fitness prediction without training.

name: VESPA
notes: Uses PLM embeddings and conservation information to compute log-probability odds for variants. Zero-shot fitness prediction without MSA requirement.

name: SaProt
notes: Structure-aware protein language model using Foldseek to generate residue tokens from 3D structure. Masked language modeling on structure-sequence tokens. Takes confidence of predicted structures into account (masks low pLDDT residues).

name: TranceptEVE L
notes: Combines signals from PLM (Tranception transformer) and MSA (EVE/Tranception retrieval). Conditionally independent sequence and alignment signals combined. Large variant (L) used in ProteinGym benchmarks.

name: SSEmb
notes: Joint embedding of protein sequence and structure using GNN for structure graph and MSA Transformer for evolutionary information. Makes predictions from combined embeddings.

name: ProtSSN
notes: Graph neural network that processes protein structure graph with PLM embeddings as initial node features. Multi-modal model combining sequence and structure information.

name: GraphCLIP
notes: Graph Foundation Model for text-attributed graphs (TAGs). Uses GraphGPS as graph encoder and MiniLM as text encoder. Enables zero-shot transfer to unseen datasets via text-label alignment. Used in GLIP-OOD for zero-shot graph OOD detection.

name: TinyCLIP-8M/16
notes: TinyCLIP from Wu et al. (ICCV 2023): CLIP distillation via affinity mimicking and weight inheritance. 8M parameter variant with ViT-B/16 architecture at reduced dimensions.

name: TinyCLIP-39M/16
notes: TinyCLIP from Wu et al. (ICCV 2023): CLIP distillation via affinity mimicking and weight inheritance. 39M parameter variant.

name: TinyCLIP-40M/32
notes: TinyCLIP from Wu et al. (ICCV 2023): CLIP distillation via affinity mimicking and weight inheritance. 40M parameter variant with ViT-B/32 architecture.

name: TinyCLIP-61M/32
notes: TinyCLIP from Wu et al. (ICCV 2023): CLIP distillation via affinity mimicking and weight inheritance. 61M parameter variant.

name: DINO ViT-B/8
notes: Self-supervised vision transformer used in CostFilter-AD (ICML 2025) for multi-layer feature extraction. ViT-B/8 produces 28x28 feature maps vs 14x14 for ViT-B/16, enabling finer spatial matching for anomaly detection.

name: RemoteCLIP ViT-L/14
notes: Remote-CLIP: vision-language foundation model for remote sensing, adapted from CLIP ViT-L/14. Used as vision encoder in LISAT for geospatial imagery.

name: GeoSAM
notes: GeoSAM: fine-tuned SAM with multimodal prompts for mobility infrastructure segmentation. Used in LISAT for generating ground truth masks in the GRES dataset.

name: USM (Universal Speech Model)
notes: Self-supervised speech model pretrained on 12 million hours of YouTube audio in 300+ languages (BEST-RQ). Used as frozen feature extractor in Miipher-2. 13th layer features used for speech restoration. From Zhang et al. (2023).

name: WaveFit
notes: Iterative and non-autoregressive neural vocoder based on fixed-point iteration (SLT 2023). Used in Miipher-2 for waveform synthesis from USM features. Memory-efficient version modified with simplified FiLM layers and feature pre-upsampler.

name: Sentence-T5-base
notes: Sentence-T5 from Ni et al. (2021): scalable sentence encoders from pre-trained T5. Uses T5-base encoder only. Used in Lay-Your-Scene (arXiv:2505.04718) for encoding object descriptions as local condition tokens in the diffusion Transformer architecture.

name: Isaac Lab
notes: GPU-accelerated robot learning simulation platform successor to Isaac Gym. Enables massively parallel simulation (4000+ environments) on a single GPU. Used for training PPO policies across 4096 parallel environments in the embodiment scaling laws paper. Supports IsaacGymEnvs, Orbit framework, and RLGames integration.

name: Unitree H1
notes: Humanoid robot with 19 degrees of freedom (later version has 23 DoF). Used for real-world zero-shot transfer validation in the embodiment scaling laws paper. Weight: ~47kg. Height: 1.7m. Max speed: ~1.3 m/s. Equipped with PD controllers for joint position control.

name: URMA (Unified Robot Morphology Architecture)
organization: Technical University of Darmstadt / UC San Diego
notes: Unified Robot Morphology Architecture for cross-embodiment robot control. Handles arbitrary numbers of joints via attention-based joint encoding. Extended with multi-head attention in the embodiment scaling laws paper. Conditions on embodiment descriptor phi(e) to generalize across robot morphologies. Two-stage training: RL expert policies + behavior cloning distillation.

name: multilingual-e5-large
notes: Multilingual text embedding model supporting 100+ languages. Used in MacRAG paper for fine-grained slice-level retrieval in the hierarchical RAG pipeline.

name: PointNeXt-S
notes: Point cloud encoder used in GRACE (arXiv:2505.06575) for extracting geometric features from human point clouds. Based on PointNet++ with improved training and scaling strategies. Pretrained on ShapeNet. Used as encoder paired with HRNet image encoder for cross-modal 3D human-scene contact estimation.

name: ALFEE
notes: Adaptive Large Foundation model for EEG Representation. Hybrid transformer with channel encoder + temporal encoder + EEG decoder. Pretrained on 25,000 hours EEG. Multi-task pretraining: GPT forecasting, MAE-TP, MAE-CH, task prediction. Handles variable channel configurations via cross-attention.

name: NeuroLM
access: Not publicly released at time of publication
notes: EEG foundation model bridging neurosignal-language modality gaps by embedding EEG signals into pretrained LLM frameworks. Pretrained on 25,000 hours of EEG data. Uses LaBraM encoder with GPT-2 architecture.

name: EEGPT
notes: EEG Pretrained Transformer. Dual self-supervised paradigm combining spatiotemporal representation alignment with mask-based reconstruction. Hierarchical architecture with spatial features from short-term EEG segments and temporal dependencies across extended sequences.

name: DRCT (Real-DRCT-GAN)
notes: Dual Restoration CT — state-of-the-art super-resolution model used in DHECA-SuperGaze (arXiv:2505.08426) for enhancing head images before gaze estimation. DHECA-SuperGaze uses Real-DRCT-GAN as a frozen SR feature extractor to upscale head images from low resolution to 224x224.

name: DCVC-B
organization: Microsoft Research Asia / Shanghai Jiao Tong

name: ECVC
input_resolution: variable (learned video compression with non-local contexts)

name: BiECVC
input_resolution: variable (learned bidirectional video compression with gated context diversification)

name: DiCo-S
notes: Diffusion ConvNet Small — pure ConvNet backbone for diffusion models with Compact Channel Attention (CCA); 4.25 GFLOPs at 256x256; aligned with DiT-S/2 scale; achieves FID ~36 at 400K steps (no CFG)

name: DiCo-B
notes: Diffusion ConvNet Base — 16.88 GFLOPs at 256x256; aligned with DiT-B/2 scale; efficient ConvNet alternative to transformer-based diffusion

name: DiCo-L
notes: Diffusion ConvNet Large — 60.24 GFLOPs at 256x256; aligned with DiT-L/2 scale; 2.7x faster than DiT-XL/2 with better FID

name: DiCo-XL
notes: Diffusion ConvNet XL — 87.30 GFLOPs at 256x256; aligned with DiT-XL/2 scale; achieves FID 2.05 at 256x256 and 2.53 at 512x512 (with CFG); 2.7x faster than DiT-XL/2; available in 400K and 3750K iteration versions

name: DiCo-H
notes: Diffusion ConvNet Huge — ~1B params; largest variant scaled up from DiCo-XL architecture; achieves FID 1.90 at 256x256 (best in DiCo family); uses U-ViT training hyperparameters (larger batch/lr)

name: CLIP ResNet50x64
notes: CLIP with ResNet50x64 backbone (64x wider final layer than standard ResNet50). Used in arXiv:2505.10169 for global scene encoding in saliency prediction. RN50x4 has ~102M params, so RN50x64 is estimated ~4x that.

name: MobileSAM
notes: Faster Segment Anything Model. 64x smaller than original SAM (615M params). Uses Tiny-ViT as lightweight image encoder instead of ViT-H. Same prompt-guided mask decoder as SAM. Used in GA3CE paper (arXiv:2505.10671) for exhaustive instance mask generation via segment-everything approach.

name: ZoeDepth
notes: Zoedepth: Zero-shot depth estimation by combining relative and metric depth. Flagship model ZoeD-M12-NK pre-trained on 12 datasets (relative depth) and fine-tuned on NYU Depth v2 and KITTI (metric depth). Used in GA3CE paper (arXiv:2505.10671) as zero-shot depth estimator for depth map generation.

name: 3D Human Pose Estimator (smpl+head)
notes: Geometry-aware autoencoder for 3D human pose estimation. Outputs 3D poses in smpl+head 30 format (30 keypoints: body + head). Used in GA3CE paper (arXiv:2505.10671) for extracting 3D body keypoints as subject representation.

name: LongConv
notes: Simple hardware-efficient long convolutions for sequence modeling. Used as sequence backbone in Set-Sequence model (arXiv:2505.11243). Kernel length=30 in paper experiments.

name: S4 (Structured State Space Sequence Model)
notes: Efficiently modeling long sequences with structured state spaces. Used as baseline and sequence backbone in Set-Sequence paper. dstate=64 in paper experiments.

name: H3 (Hungry Hungry Hippos)
notes: Hungry hungry hippos: towards language modeling with state space models. Used as baseline in Set-Sequence paper (arXiv:2505.11243). dstate=64, head dim=1, mode=diag in paper experiments.

name: Hyena
notes: Hyena hierarchy: towards larger convolutional language models. Used as baseline in Set-Sequence paper (arXiv:2505.11243). Order=2, filter order=64 in paper experiments.

name: Skywork-o1-Open-PRM-Qwen-2.5-1.5B
notes: Process Reward Model (PRM) for step-wise reward scoring during reasoning. Built on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct. Used as verifier in VG-Search paper (arXiv:2505.11730).

name: Skywork-o1-Open-PRM-Qwen-2.5-7B
notes: Process Reward Model (PRM) for step-wise reward scoring during reasoning. Built on Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct. Used as larger verifier in VG-Search paper (arXiv:2505.11730).

name: I3D (Inflated 3D ConvNet)
notes: Inflated 3D ConvNets (CVPR 2017) for video action recognition. Pre-trained on Kinetics-400. Used for extracting spatiotemporal features in WSVAD pipelines. Paper: arXiv:1705.07750.

name: YOLOv7-pose
notes: YOLOv7 with pose estimation head for 2D keypoint detection (17 body keypoints based on COCO format). Used as pose modality backbone in PI-VAD (arXiv:2505.13123) for weakly-supervised video anomaly detection.

name: ViFiCLIP
notes: Video-language fine-tuned CLIP for video understanding. Trained on Kinetics-600 with video-text pairs. Used as text modality backbone in PI-VAD (arXiv:2505.13123) for generating language cues in weakly-supervised video anomaly detection.

name: Parakeet-RNNT-1.1b
notes: Conformer-RNNT pretrained on Librispeech (960h) + LibriLight (60kh). Used in WIND paper (arXiv:2505.13765) as the primary evaluation model. BPE vocab size 1024. 80-dimensional filter bank features (25ms frames, 10ms stride).

name: Parakeet-RNNT-0.6b
notes: Conformer-RNNT pretrained on Librispeech (960h) + LibriLight (60kh). Smaller variant used in WIND paper (arXiv:2505.13765). BPE vocab size 1024. 80-dimensional filter bank features (25ms frames, 10ms stride).

name: Granite-Speech-3.2-8B
audio_encoder: 10-Conformer blocks with Q-former (3 learnable queries, 5x downsampling)
notes: Extends granite-3.2-8b-instruct by incorporating a speech encoder for ASR (English) and speech translation (English to other languages). From Granite Team (2025b).

name: TOTO (Toto-Open-Base-1.0)
notes: Decoder-only transformer for observability time series forecasting. Novel components: patch-based causal instance normalization, proportional factorized attention, Student-T mixture head, composite robust loss. Trained on 2.36T points (43% observability, 33% synthetic, rest public). Zero-shot forecasting.

name: OLMo-1.7-7B
notes: OLMo 1.7 7B base model. Decoder-only LLM pretrained on Dolma corpus (~1.7T tokens). Used in arXiv:2505.14824 for tracing multilingual factual knowledge acquisition across pretraining checkpoints.

name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L4-v2
notes: Cross-encoder and SBERT model for document reranking. Used as baseline in METEORA paper (2505.16014). Jointly encodes query-document pairs.

name: bge-reranker-large
notes: Large cross-encoder for document reranking. Used as baseline in METEORA paper (2505.16014).

name: E5-Large-v2
notes: Embedding model for bi-directional late interaction (E5). Used in SBERT baseline in METEORA paper (2505.16014).

name: Stern5497/sbert-legal-xlm-roberta-base
notes: Domain-adapted SBERT for legal text. Fine-tuned version used as baseline in METEORA paper (2505.16014).

name: Dream-7B
access: https://huggingface.co/yu-rp/Dimple-7B (Dimple uses Dream backbone); Dream paper: arXiv:2501.14758
notes: Discrete diffusion language model fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-7B. Uses absorbing-state discrete diffusion with masked language modeling loss. Supports both autoregressive and diffusion generation modes. Backbone of Dimple-7B (arXiv:2505.16990).

name: Qwen2.5-70B-Instruct
notes: 70B variant of Qwen2.5 instruction-tuned model. Used in LongMagpie paper (arXiv:2505.17134) as the source model for synthesizing long-context instruction data via self-synthesis.

name: Llama-3-8B-NExtLong-512K-Base
notes: Long-context base model from Gao et al. (2025). Extended from Llama-3-8B with extensive long-context continued pretraining. Used as base model in LongMagpie paper for fine-tuning experiments on long-context instruction data.

name: Llama3.1-Aloe-Beta-8B
notes: Domain-specific medical LLM fine-tuned on healthcare data. Used as backbone in FLAME (arXiv:2505.20218) for medication recommendation. Part of the Aloe family of healthcare LLMs.

name: Mole-BERT
notes: Molecular graph encoder pretrained with masked modeling for drug representation learning. Used as collaborative embedding encoder for medication-level representations in FLAME (arXiv:2505.20218). From Xia et al. 2023.

name: MAmmoTH2-7B
organization: Yue et al. (UC Santa Barbara / multiple institutions)
notes: MAmmoTH2: Scaling Instructions from the Web (arXiv:2405.03548). Math-specialized instruction-tuned LLM based on Qwen2.5-7B. Trained on large-scale math instruction data from the web. Used as LLM backbone in MMGeoLM (arXiv:2505.20152) for geometric reasoning tasks.

name: WideResNet50-2
notes: Wide Residual Network (depth=50, widen_factor=2). Pre-trained on ImageNet. Used as frozen feature extractor in hyperbolic medical anomaly detection paper (arXiv:2505.21228). Features extracted from layer_2 and layer_3 (1024-dim each) before hyperbolic projection.

name: WenHai
notes: WenHai: deep neural network for eddy-resolving ocean forecasting (Cui et al., Nature Communications 2025). State-of-the-art ocean foundation model that has surpassed traditional numerical methods in computational efficiency and accuracy. Uses Swin Transformer with domain knowledge incorporation. Baseline in NEURALOM paper (arXiv:2505.21020).

name: CirT
notes: CirT: geometry-inspired transformer for global subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) forecasting (Liu et al., ICLR 2025). Uses circle as the underlying geometry to model the Earth's spherical surface. State-of-the-art on S2S atmospheric forecasting. Baseline in NEURALOM paper (arXiv:2505.21020).

name: PIXEL-M4
notes: Multilingual pixel language model pretrained on 4 languages (English, Hindi, Ukrainian, Chinese) using MAE-style pretraining. Based on ViT-Base architecture. From Kesen et al., 2025 (arXiv:2505.21265).

name: PIXEL-BIGRAMS
access: referenced in original PIXEL paper (Rust et al., 2023)
notes: English-only pixel language model baseline. Same architecture as PIXEL-M4 but pretrained on English only. From Lotz et al., 2023.

name: CANINE-S
notes: Character-level multilingual model pretrained on 104 languages. Used as character-level baseline in PIXEL-M4 paper. From Clark et al., 2020.

name: Pythia-1.4B
notes: Pythia-1.4B is a decoder-only transformer trained on the Pile. From the Pythia Scaling Suite (Biderman et al., ICML 2023). Used in arXiv:2505.22251 to train contaminated vs uncontaminated models from scratch to measure effects of test set contamination on LLM-based ASR systems.

name: MedSAM
organization: Ma et al. (University Health Network / Vanderbilt)
notes: Segment Anything in Medical Images (Ma et al., Nat Commun 2024). Adapts SAM's ViT-H backbone for medical image segmentation. Trained on 50,000+ medical images across multiple modalities. Used as encoder backbone in ScarNet (arXiv:2501.01372).

name: LaBSE
notes: Language-Agnostic BERT Sentence Embedding. Multilingual sentence embedding model supporting 109+ languages. Maps sentences from different languages into a shared vector space for cross-lingual similarity. Used in UNEA paper (arXiv:2502.10044) for initializing entity and relation embeddings.

name: Video Swin Transformer (Tiny)
organization: Microsoft Research Asia (Liu et al., CVPR 2022)
notes: Used as backbone in KVQ paper (2503.10259). Pretrained on Kinetics-400 action recognition dataset. KVQ fine-tunes Video Swin-T Tiny with dual-branch saliency + texture heads, Fusion-Window Attention (FWA) module, and Local Perception Constraint (LPC). GFlops: 353.0 for KVQ.

name: ToolACE-2-Llama-3.1-8B
notes: Specialized tool-calling model winning points in BFCL leaderboard. Trained specifically for function-calling tasks. Used as a task model in PLAY2PROMPT paper (arXiv:2503.14432).

name: Hammer-2.1-7B
notes: Specialized tool-calling model with function masking for robust function-calling. High ranking on BFCL leaderboard. Used as a task model in PLAY2PROMPT paper (arXiv:2503.14432).

name: Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking
access: gemini-2.0-flash-thinking via Google AI Studio or Vertex AI
notes: Google Gemini 2.0 Flash with explicit reasoning/thinking mode; used in arXiv:2503.18809 (Classical Planning with LLM-Generated Heuristics) for generating domain-dependent heuristic functions; version 01-21 was used in that paper

name: o1
notes: Frontier reasoning model evaluated in HCAST benchmark (arXiv:2503.17354). Used with Triframe agent scaffold. Shows strong performance on short-duration tasks (70-80% success on tasks taking humans <1hr) but drops below 20% on tasks taking humans >4hrs. o1 is the full OpenAI o1 model, distinct from o1-preview.

name: Yi-1.5-9B-Chat
notes: Chinese LLM from 01.AI. Yi-1.5 series trained on 3.1T tokens with focus on English and Chinese. Used in arXiv:2504.00289 for multilingual evaluation of Chinese vs Western LLMs.

name: InternLM3-8B-Instruct
notes: InternLM3 instruction-tuned model. Trained on 4T tokens with Chinese and English data comprising 86.46% of web page data. Used in arXiv:2504.00289.

name: Baichuan2-7B-Chat
notes: Chinese LLM from Baichuan AI. Trained on 2.6T tokens from web pages, books, research papers, codebases. Used in arXiv:2504.00289.

name: xLAM-2-1b-fc-r
notes: xLAM-2-fc-r series trained on APIGen-MT synthetic multi-turn trajectories. 1B model achieves 43.12% multi-turn accuracy on BFCL v3, outperforming o1 (36%) and GPT-4o in function-calling mode (41%). Top-2 on BFCL v3 leaderboard.

name: xLAM-2-3b-fc-r
notes: xLAM-2-fc-r series trained on APIGen-MT synthetic multi-turn trajectories. 3B model achieves 56.00% multi-turn accuracy on BFCL v3, with 94.44% hallucination detection. Outperforms much larger models in multi-turn settings.

name: xLAM-2-8b-fc-r
notes: xLAM-2-fc-r series trained on APIGen-MT synthetic multi-turn trajectories. 8B model achieves 69.25% multi-turn accuracy on BFCL v3, ranking 4th on leaderboard. Outperforms GPT-4o (47.62% multi-turn) significantly.

name: xLAM-2-32b-fc-r
notes: xLAM-2-fc-r series trained on APIGen-MT synthetic multi-turn trajectories. 32B model achieves 75.83% overall accuracy on BFCL v3, ranking 2nd on leaderboard. Outperforms GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet on multi-turn function calling.

name: xLAM-2-70b-fc-r
notes: xLAM-2-fc-r series trained on APIGen-MT synthetic multi-turn trajectories. 70B model achieves 78.19% overall accuracy on BFCL v3, ranking 1st on leaderboard. Achieves 67.1% on τ-bench Retail and 45.2% on τ-bench Airline, outperforming GPT-4o (52.9%) overall.

name: Aya-23-8B
notes: 8B variant of Aya-23 multilingual model (Aryabumi et al., 2024). Used in arXiv:2504.09378 for studying cross-lingual alignment in multilingual LLMs.

name: Visual-CoT-7B
access: Not publicly released at time of analysis (arXiv:2501.XXXXX, NeurIPS 2025)
notes: First visual chain-of-thought method for MLLMs. Uses supervised fine-tuning with human-annotated bounding boxes for image-level CoT reasoning. Baseline in UV-CoT paper (arXiv:2504.18397).

name: OmniLMM-12B
notes: Used as evaluator model in UV-CoT paper (arXiv:2504.18397) for scoring preference responses. Larger than target model (LLaVA-1.5-7B) to provide reliable quality assessment.

name: GPT-4-Turbo
notes: GPT-4-Turbo (April 2024) was OpenAI's faster, cheaper variant of GPT-4 with 128K context. Used in AdAEM paper (arXiv:2505.13531) as part of P2 model set for value scoring.

name: Mistral-Large
license: Mistral Research (non-commercial for API; Apache 2.0 for local)
access: mistral-large-latest via Mistral API or mistralai/Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407 on HuggingFace
notes: Mistral-Large (early 2024) was Mistral AI's flagship model. Used in AdAEM paper (arXiv:2505.13531) as part of P2 model set for value scoring.

name: DeepSeek-V2.5
notes: DeepSeek-V2.5 (mid 2024) is DeepSeek AI's latest chat model. Used in AdAEM paper (arXiv:2505.13531) as part of P1 model set for question generation and exploration.

name: ProGen2-small
access: https://github.com/salesforce/progen (original); also on HuggingFace via community uploads
notes: Smallest variant of ProGen2 autoregressive protein language model. Used as pretrained sequence decoder initialization in DS-ProGen (arXiv:2505.12511). GPT-like transformer trained on diverse protein families.

name: PiFold
notes: Graph neural network for protein inverse folding using novel residue featurizer and PiGNN layers. One-shot sequence generation. Baseline in DS-ProGen paper (arXiv:2505.12511) achieving 51.74% recovery rate on PRIDE.

name: e5-small-v2
notes: Smaller variant of e5-base-v2; used as text encoder in TabSTAR (arXiv:2505.18125) for tabular data with textual features. Unfrozen during pretraining and finetuning with LoRA.

name: SECOND
notes: Sparsity CNN-based 3D object detector for point clouds. Uses sparse convolution for efficiency. Paper: Yan et al., ECCV 2018. Used as base detector in TTA experiments (CodeMerge paper arXiv:2505.16524).

name: SparseDrive
notes: Sparse transformer-based end-to-end autonomous driving model performing 3D detection, multi-object tracking, online mapping, motion prediction, and planning in a unified architecture. Paper: Liu et al., CVPR 2024. Used as main base model in CodeMerge TTA experiments (arXiv:2505.16524).

name: Llama3.1-70B-Instruct
notes: Meta's Llama 3.1 70B instruction-tuned model. Used as base model for AlphaMed(70B) in arXiv:2505.17952, trained via minimalist rule-based GRPO without SFT on distilled CoT data.

name: Qwen1.5-1.8B
notes: Used in BitHydra BICA attack paper (arXiv:2505.16670) as a victim model. Requires only 1 bit flip to reach 98% MaxRate with 2009 avg output length.

name: Samantha-1.1-7B
notes: Fine-tuned on Llama-2 7B using qLoRA. Used in BitHydra paper (arXiv:2505.16670) as victim model; requires 3 bit flips to achieve 93% MaxRate.

name: Vicuna-7B-v1.3
notes: Fine-tuned from Llama-1 on ShareGPT conversations. Used in BitHydra paper (arXiv:2505.16670) as victim model; requires 2 bit flips to achieve 90% MaxRate.

name: TxGemma-9B-CHAT
notes: Therapeutics-focused fine-tuned Gemma-2 model from Wang et al. 2025. Specialized for medical/therapeutics applications. Used as specialized evaluation model in JBDISTILL paper (2505.22037).

name: Med-RLVR-MEDQA-3B
access: Based on Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct; full model may require access request
notes: Medical reasoning model fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-3B using reinforcement learning from medical value reasoning (Med-RLVR). From Zhang et al. 2025b. Used as specialized evaluation model in JBDISTILL paper (2505.22037).

name: Llama-3-8B-Instruct-RR
notes: Llama-3-8B-Instruct with Circuit Breakers inserted via Representation Rerouting (RR). From Zou et al. 2024. Used as evaluation model with safety modifications in JBDISTILL paper (2505.22037).

name: CheXagent
notes: Foundation model for chest X-ray interpretation (arXiv:2401.12208). Used as initialization backbone for CXRTrekNet in CXRTrek paper (arXiv:2505.23143). Includes visual encoder + LLM + text encoder. CXRTrekNet extends RoPE to 8192-token context and applies LoRA fine-tuning.

name: Wav2Lip
notes: Lip sync expert approach: GAN-based talking face generation. Uses pre-trained sync discriminator to guide mouth generation. Strong audio-visual correspondence but struggles with temporal consistency and blending.

name: LatentSync
notes: Audio-conditioned latent diffusion model for lip sync. Uses shared initial noise and synchronization loss to reduce temporal inconsistencies. Conditions on reference images and HuBERT features.

name: DiffDub
notes: Person-generic visual dubbing using inpainting renderer with diffusion auto-encoder. Two-stage: diffusion autoencoder for inpainting lip area, plus transformer for embedding sequence prediction from reference and HuBERT features.

name: Mamba2-8B
notes: Mamba2 state-space model (8B parameters). From empirical study of Mamba-based LMs (Waleffe et al., 2024). Used as primary model for document souping experiments in arXiv:2505.24033.

name: AASIST
architecture: Graph Attention Network (GAT) with spectro-temporal attention; uses Wav2Vec2 or RawNet2 as frontend
notes: Audio Anti-Spoofing with Integrated Spectro-Temporal Graph Attention Networks (ICASSP 2022). Used in RAIS paper (2505.24486) as the backbone deepfake detector combined with Wav2Vec2-xls-r-300m frontend.

name: DETR
organization: Facebook AI Research (Carion et al., ECCV 2020)
notes: End-to-end object detector with transformers. DETR-101 uses ResNet-101 as backbone. Paper: Carion et al., ECCV 2020. Used in SeqCRC conformal object detection paper (arXiv:2505.24038).

name: RGCN
params: varies by config (2 layers, 64-512 hidden dims)
notes: Relational Graph Convolutional Network. Extends GCN to handle multiple edge types in knowledge graphs. Uses relation-specific transformation matrices. Basis for many heterogeneous GNN models.

name: HetGNN
params: varies by config (2 layers, 64-512 hidden dims)
notes: Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network. Uses random walk to sample heterogeneous neighbors, then processes by node type with two-module architecture (content embedding + neighbor aggregation). KDD 2019.

name: HAN
params: varies by config (1-2 layers, 64-256 hidden dims, 4-8 attention heads)
notes: Heterogeneous Graph Attention Network. Employs hierarchical attention mechanisms at node and semantic levels to capture importance of different node and relation types. WWW 2019.

name: HGT
params: varies by config (2 layers, 64-256 hidden dims, 4-8 attention heads)
notes: Heterogeneous Graph Transformer. Incorporates type-specific parameters for heterogeneous attention and relative temporal encoding for dynamic dependencies. Uses efficient sampling for scalability. WWW 2020.

name: Point-E
notes: Point-E: system for generating 3D point clouds from complex text/image prompts. Uses CLIP text/image encoder + prior network + decoder. Paper: arXiv:2212.08751. Used in TIGeR (arXiv:2506.00953) for text-instructed prior generation stage.

name: MANO
organization: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems (Romero et al., SIGGRAPH Asia 2017)
notes: MANO (Manipulation Oriented hand model) is a learned 3D hand model from RGB images. Used for hand pose estimation in TIGeR and many other hand-object interaction papers. Maps 21 keypoints to MANO parameters via inverse kinematics.

name: MADLAD-3B
notes: Multilingual NMT model (3B params) trained on MADLAD-400 dataset. Used in CSntax-GNN paper (Sterner & Teufel, ACL 2025) for monolingual translation of code-switching sentences.

name: nnU-Net
params: varies by configuration (2D, 3D full resolution, 3D low resolution; ~30M-150M params typical)
notes: Self-configuring method for biomedical image segmentation. No manual hyperparameter tuning - automatically configures U-Net based on dataset properties. Used as anatomy segmentator in CARE paper (2506.02093) for CT reconstruction evaluation with NSD and clDice metrics. JHH dataset version trained on 3,151 annotated CT scans.

name: NVILA-8B
notes: Used as MLLM backbone in AnimeShooterGen (arXiv:2506.03126). Larger variant of NVILA; fine-tuned with LoRA for reference-guided multi-shot video generation.

name: Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct
notes: Code-specific instruction-tuned LLM from Qwen2.5-Coder family. Used in REFORM paper (arXiv:2506.01215) for repository-level code completion evaluation.

name: DKM
notes: Dense Kernelized Feature Matching for Geometry Estimation. Produces semi-dense correspondences (10K+ matches per image pair). Used as dense matcher baseline in Dense Match Summarization paper (arXiv:2506.02893). Significantly more accurate than sparse matchers but slower in RANSAC due to many matches.

name: RoMA
notes: Robust Dense Feature Matching. CVPR 2024. Robust dense matcher with improved accuracy over DKM. Used as dense matcher baseline in Dense Match Summarization paper (arXiv:2506.02893).

name: ASpanFormer
notes: Detector-free image matching with adaptive span transformer. ECCV 2022. Produces variable number of dense correspondences. Used as dense matcher baseline in Dense Match Summarization paper (arXiv:2506.02893).

name: Meta-LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct
notes: LLaMA-3.2 instruction-tuned variant with 3B parameters. Used in MedEditBench (2506.03490) for medical knowledge editing experiments.

name: snowflake-arctic-embed-m-1.5
notes: Sentence embedding model used for neural retrieval in the DOS RAG paper (Laitenberger et al., 2025, arXiv:2506.03989). Embeds queries and passages into shared embedding space for cosine similarity ranking.

name: GMFlow
organization: HKUST / Shanghai AI Lab (Xu et al., CVPR 2022)
notes: Global Matching Optical Flow. Reformulates optical flow as global matching task computing dense correspondences. Used in JointSplat (arXiv:2506.03872) for flow branch initialization. Pretrained on FlyingThings3D.

name: GMDepth
organization: HKUST / Shanghai AI Lab / University of Tübingen (Xu et al., IEEE TPAMI 2023)
notes: Unifying Flow, Stereo and Depth Estimation. Joint depth and flow estimation model. Used in JointSplat (arXiv:2506.03872) for multi-view depth branch initialization. Pretrained on FlyingThings3D.

name: DepthSplat (ViT-B)
organization: ETH Zurich / University of Tübingen / Microsoft (Xu et al., arXiv:2410.13862)
notes: Connecting Gaussian Splatting and Depth. Sparse-view 3D reconstruction with 3D Gaussian Splatting using monocular depth features. ViT-B backbone variant used in JointSplat (arXiv:2506.03872) as baseline backbone (125M params with flow integration).

name: DepthSplat (ViT-L)
organization: ETH Zurich / University of Tübingen / Microsoft (Xu et al., arXiv:2410.13862)
notes: Connecting Gaussian Splatting and Depth. ViT-L backbone variant (354M params). JointSplat (arXiv:2506.03872) with 359M params outperforms DepthSplat ViT-L across all metrics.

name: CodeLlama-34B-Instruct
notes: Code-specialized instruct-tuned variant of Llama-2-34B. From paper arXiv:2308.12950. Used in AdaDecode (arXiv:2506.03700) as backbone model for inference acceleration experiments.

name: Llama3.2-1B-Instruct
notes: Llama 3.2 1B instruction-tuned model. Used as lightweight drafter model in AdaDecode (arXiv:2506.03700) speculative decoding baseline.

name: FinBERT-Prosus
notes: BERT-based model fine-tuned on Financial Phrase-Bank for 3-class financial sentiment classification (positive/neutral/negative). Trained on 3,101 sentences from the Financial Phrase-Bank dataset. Paper: arXiv:1908.10063.

name: FinBERT-Tone
notes: BERT-based model fine-tuned on 10,000 analyst report sentences for 3-class financial sentiment classification (positive/neutral/negative). Pretrained on 4.9B tokens of financial text. Paper: Huang et al., Contemporary Accounting Research (2022).

name: Ola-Omni
notes: Base omni-modal LLM for AV-Reasoner. Progressive modality alignment for audio-visual understanding. From arXiv:2502.04328. Used as starting point for GRPO fine-tuning in AV-Reasoner (arXiv:2506.05328).

name: AV-Reasoner
notes: GRPO-trained omni-modal LLM for audio-visual counting. Trained from Ola-Omni with cold-start SFT, curriculum-based GRPO, and full-task RL. Achieves SOTA on MusicAVQA (85.01), LLP (64.70), UnAV (65.18 mAP), ARIG (46.73), DVD-Counting (44.00). From arXiv:2506.05328.

name: StegaStamp
notes: Invisible watermarking model for embedding imperceptible hyperlinks in physical photographs. Used as backdoor trigger embedding method in arXiv:2506.04879.

name: VINE (Robust Watermarking via Generative Priors)
notes: Robust watermarking using generative priors. Lower ASR as backdoor trigger vs StegaStamp (arXiv:2506.04879).

name: RoSteALS (Robust Steganography using Autoencoder Latent Space)
notes: Robust steganography using autoencoder latent space. Used as backdoor trigger in arXiv:2506.04879, high ASR with moderate imperceptibility.

name: DeSTA2
notes: Instruction-following speech language model without speech instruction-tuning data (ICASSP 2025). Built on Qwen2-Audio. Studied in AudioLens (arXiv:2506.05140) for internal auditory attribute perception analysis.

name: Gigapath
notes: Pathology foundation model for computational pathology. Used as frozen encoder in STFlow paper (arXiv:2506.05361). The paper uses 'gigapath_slide_enc12l1536d' variant (12 layers, 1536-dim hidden). From 'Gigapath: A foundation model for computational pathology' (Xu et al. 2024).

name: Anole-7B
license: Chameleon Research License and MIT License
notes: Chameleon-7B-based VLM used as the base model in the paper. The paper fine-tunes the Anole-7B checkpoint (not vanilla Chameleon) for IDP and FDP tasks. From Chern et al. (2024).

name: Liquid-8B
notes: Unified multi-modal VLM used as the second VLM family in the paper (alongside Chameleon/Anole-7B). From Wu et al. (2024b).

name: ImageBind
notes: One embedding space to bind them all. Extends contrastive alignment beyond vision-text to audio and other input types. Used as multimodal baseline in CLAMR paper (arXiv:2506.06144). Paper shows ImageBind averaging across modalities performs worse than vision-only due to noise from irrelevant modalities.

name: mCLIP (multilingual CLIP)
notes: Multilingual CLIP model for aligning vision and text in multiple languages. Used as single-modality baseline in CLAMR paper (arXiv:2506.06144) with different modality inputs (video+CLIP, audio+Whisper+CLIP, OCR+CLIP, metadata+CLIP).

name: Pixtral-large-latest
notes: Large version of Mistral AI's Pixtral vision-language model. Used in DesignBench (arXiv:2506.06251) as a baseline MLLM for UI-to-code generation, achieving competitive performance across React, Vue, Angular, and vanilla HTML/CSS frameworks.

name: Matcha
notes: Chart-specific vision-language model for chart derendering and math reasoning. Base model from Liu et al. (2023). Used as baseline in CLIMATEVIZ paper (arXiv:2506.08700). Variants: Matcha-ChartQA (pretrained on ChartQA), Matcha-PlotQA (trained on PlotQA), Matcha-CLIMATEVIZ (fine-tuned on CLIMATEVIZ for fact-checking).

name: Step-Omni
notes: Pre-trained 130B parameter multi-modal LLM from StepFun (arXiv:2502.11946). Backbone for Step-Audio-AQAA. Supports text, speech, and image modalities. Used in Step-Audio-AQAA paper (arXiv:2506.08967) as the pre-trained backbone, extended with 5120 audio tokens and further post-trained via SFT + DPO + model merge.

name: Step-Audio-TTS-3B
notes: StepFun's 3B TTS model used to generate the AQTAA (Audio Query-Text Answer-Audio Answer) dataset from AQTA text answers in the Step-Audio-AQAA paper (arXiv:2506.08967). From arXiv:2502.11946.

name: Kimi-Audio
notes: End-to-end LALM from Moonshot AI (arXiv:2504.18425) capable of understanding and generating Chinese and English speech. Supports real-time voice interactions with adaptation for emotion, tone, speed, and dialect. Used as a baseline in Step-Audio-AQAA paper (arXiv:2506.08967) on StepEval-Audio-360 benchmark.

name: Qwen-2.5-72B-Instruct
notes: Used in arXiv:2506.09853 (Causal PNS for CoT optimization) as base model for PNS-based reasoning chain optimization. Qwen-2.5 family instruction-tuned model with strong reasoning capabilities.

name: DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview
notes: Small reasoning language model from DeepScaler project. Used in arXiv:2506.09853 for SFT experiments comparing Causal vs Noncausal fine-tuning on reasoning tasks.

name: Mammo-CLIP
notes: Vision-language foundation model for mammography. From Ghosh et al. (MICCAI 2024). Trained on mammography images and reports. Used in MAMBO paper (2506.08677) for embedding-based memorization analysis (nearest-neighbor retrieval in CLIP space) and as a frozen feature extractor. Achieves state-of-the-art on mammography retrieval and classification tasks.

name: Flan-T5-Large
notes: Flan-T5-Large (780M) used as LLM ranker in GCCP paper (arXiv:2506.10859, SIGIR 2025) for zero-shot document ranking experiments alongside Flan-T5-XL and Flan-UL2.

name: Llama-1-8B
notes: Llama-1 8B base model (Touvron et al., 2023). Used in PropInfer paper (arXiv:2506.10364) for property inference attack evaluation alongside Pythia-v0-6.9B and Llama-3-8B-instruct. Pre-dates ChatDoctor to avoid data contamination.

name: LUKE-Large
notes: Deep contextualized entity representations with entity-aware self-attention (Yamada et al., EMNLP 2020). Used in VIB-based entity bias mitigation for relation extraction (Mensah et al., arXiv:2506.11381).

name: Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501
notes: Mistral Small 3.1 24B Instruct model (dated variant 2501 = Jan 2025). Used in LEA paper (arXiv:2506.12100) for RAG attribution analysis across 500 CVEs. Training cutoff approximately Oct 2023.

name: GPT-4o-2024-08-06
notes: GPT-4o snapshot from August 6, 2024. Used in memorization detection study (arXiv:2506.12286) alongside other dated snapshots for controlled comparison.

name: GPT-4o-2024-05-13
notes: GPT-4o snapshot from May 13, 2024. Used in memorization detection study (arXiv:2506.12286) alongside other dated snapshots for controlled comparison.

name: Flan-PaLM 2 (8K)
notes: Flan-PaLM 2 with 8K token context window. Used as short-context baseline in Refract ICL paper (arXiv:2506.12346). From Anil et al., 2023.

name: Gemini (32K)
notes: Original Gemini model with 32K token context window. Used as long-context baseline in Refract ICL paper (arXiv:2506.12346). From Gemini Team et al., 2023.

name: Llama-Nemotron-Super-49B-v1
license: NVIDIA AI Foundation Models Community License
notes: NVIDIA's reasoning-augmented Llama model. Used in arXiv:2506.13726 as the reasoning variant compared against Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct. Llama family reasoning model.

name: Qwen-2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct
notes: Instruction-tuned version of Qwen-2.5-Coder-32B. Used in arXiv:2506.13726 as the non-reasoning counterpart to QwQ-32B in security vulnerability comparison.

name: NLUT (Neural LUT)
notes: Neural-based 3D lookup table for video photorealistic style transfer. Fine-tunes a 3D LUT per video keyframe for efficiency. Baseline in SA-LUT paper (2506.13465). Achieves LPIPS 0.36 vs SA-LUT's 0.12 on PST50.

name: Ovis2-34B
notes: Ovis2-34B multimodal LLM; vision encoder: aimv2-1B-patch14-448; text backbone: Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct; arXiv:2405.20797.

name: TerraMind v1.0-B
architecture: Multi-modal geospatial foundation model; pretraining modalities include Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, DEM, geo-location, LULC labels, and NDVI
notes: State-of-the-art GFM with multi-modal pretraining. In arXiv:2506.14765, TerraMind v1.0-L achieves ~70% land cover accuracy at n=500 shots. Multi-modal pretraining with LULC labels provides strong semantic priors for land cover segmentation.

name: TerraMind v1.0-L
architecture: Multi-modal geospatial foundation model (large variant); pretraining modalities include Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, DEM, geo-location, LULC labels, and NDVI
notes: State-of-the-art GFM with multi-modal pretraining (large variant). In arXiv:2506.14765, TerraMind v1.0-L achieves ~74% land cover accuracy at n=500 shots. Strong performance attributed to LULC-based pretraining providing semantic priors.

name: Prithvi-EO-2.0-600M-TL
architecture: ViT-H (Huge) with spatiotemporal MAE pretraining on Harmonised Landsat-Sentinel-2 (HLS) dataset at 30m resolution, 6 bands
notes: Geospatial foundation model pretrained on global HLS archives. Used in arXiv:2506.14765 as baseline. Larger variant (600M) compared to the 300M version.

name: s1-32B
notes: Reasoning model from simplescaling team. Evaluated in Leaky Thoughts (arXiv:2506.15674) for privacy leakage in reasoning traces. Base model: Qwen 2.5 32B.

name: RA-SAE on DINOv2 ViT-L/14
notes: Archetypal Sparse Autoencoder trained on DINOv2 ViT-L/14 features. Largest SAE of its kind at time of publication (32,000 concepts). Used to identify conceptual blindspots in generative image models (Stable Diffusion 1.5/2.1, PixArt, Kandinsky). Top-K sparsity constraint ensures stable, reproducible concept discovery.

name: Skywork-SWE-32B
notes: Fine-tuned code agent model for SWE tasks. Base model: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct. Trained on 8,209 validated SWE trajectories from Skywork-SWE dataset. Achieves 38.0% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified (47.0% with TTS). From arXiv:2506.19290.

name: Qwen-2.5-14B-Instruct
notes: Instruction-tuned variant of Qwen-2.5-14B. Used in COIN paper (arXiv:2506.20178) for selective QA with FDR control.

name: MERT-v1-95M
notes: Music understanding foundation model. CNN feature extractor + 12-layer Transformer encoder (768-dim). Self-supervised masked language modeling on RVQ-VAE tokens (EnCodec) + CQT spectrogram reconstruction. Trained on ~1M hours of predominantly Western music. From Li et al., ICLR 2024. Used as base model in CultureMERT (arXiv:2506.17818) for cross-cultural continual pre-training.

name: SV3D
resolution: 576x1024 training, generates 8 views at 512x512 or 4 views at 1024x1024
notes: Novel multi-view synthesis and 3D generation from a single image using latent video diffusion. Paper: Voleti et al., ECCV 2024. Generates N=6 or N=8 novel views given a single input image with camera pose control. Used in Shape-for-Motion (arXiv:2506.22432) to generate augmented views for dynamic 3D reconstruction.

name: SD-Turbo (Stable Diffusion Turbo)
notes: Distilled version of Stable Diffusion 2.1 enabling 1-4 step image synthesis. Used in StableCodec (arXiv:2506.21977) for one-step diffusion-based extreme image compression. Based on Adversarial Diffusion Distillation (Sauer et al., ECCV 2024).

name: ELIC (Efficient Learned Image Compression)
params: not disclosed (typical neural codec scale ~10-50M params)
notes: Neural image compression method with unevenly grouped space-channel contextual adaptive coding. Used in StableCodec (arXiv:2506.21977) as frozen auxiliary encoder for entropy-aware semantic information. CVPR 2022.

name: InternLM2.5-7B-Chat
notes: InternLM2.5 chat model (7B). Used in arXiv:2506.21967 for tool-integrated LLM agent stability evaluation.

name: InternLM2.5-20B-Chat
notes: InternLM2.5 chat model (20B). Used in arXiv:2506.21967 for tool-integrated LLM agent stability evaluation.

name: MAIRA-2
notes: Grounded radiology report generation model. Generates findings from chest X-rays with bounding box localization. Architecture: RAD-DINO (frozen) + projection + Vicuna-7b-v1.5 (fine-tuned). Trained on MIMIC-CXR, PadChest, and USMix. From Bannur et al., arXiv:2406.04449.

name: RAD-DINO
notes: Medical image feature extraction model optimized for radiology. Produces 768-dimensional embeddings. Used as visual encoder in MAIRA-2 and other medical VLM pipelines. From Perez-Garcia et al., Nature Machine Intelligence 2025.

name: Llama-3.1-8B-Dragonfly-Med-v2
notes: Medical VLM based on Llama 3.1 8B with CLIP vision backbone. Multi-resolution zoom-in encoding for biomedical tasks. Instruction-tuned for medical VQA. From Chen et al., arXiv:2406.00977.

name: DeiT-Tiny
