notes: Data-efficient Image Transformer Tiny (DeiT-Tiny). Distilled from DeiT-Base. ~5.9M params. Used as teacher model in DIDB-ViT binary ViT paper (arXiv:2507.02222). From Touvron et al., ICML 2021.

name: DeiT-Small
notes: Data-efficient Image Transformer Small (DeiT-Small). Distilled from DeiT-Base. ~22M params. Used as teacher model and main backbone in DIDB-ViT binary ViT paper (arXiv:2507.02222). From Touvron et al., ICML 2021.

name: Swin-Tiny
notes: Swin Transformer Tiny. ~28M params. Used as backbone in DIDB-ViT binary ViT paper (arXiv:2507.02222) for ImageNet-1K classification and ADE20K segmentation. From Liu et al., ICCV 2021.

name: CHIEF
notes: CAncer History estimation via Integrated Foundation model. Pathology foundation model for cancer diagnosis and prognosis prediction. Outputs 768-dimensional embeddings per WSI patch. Used in frozen state for feature extraction in MurreNet (arXiv:2507.04891). From Wang et al., Nature 2024.

name: BELM (Bidirectional Explicit Linear Multi-step)
notes: DDIM inversion with bidirectional explicit linear multi-step sampler for exact inversion in diffusion models. Used as teacher diffusion model in SPADE (arXiv:2507.05798) for cross-attention map extraction. Paper: Wang et al., NeurIPS 2025.

name: DeepSeek-LLM-7B-Chat
notes: DeepSeek LLM 7B Chat model (Bi et al. 2024). Used in ConfGuard backdoor detection paper (arXiv:2508.01365) as one of three victim models alongside Llama-3.1-8B-INST and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct.

name: ARIA
notes: Open multimodal native MoE model. Used as base model in TimeExpert (arXiv:2508.01699). Visual tokens: ~3.9B active params; Text tokens: ~3.5B active params. From Li et al., arXiv:2410.05993.

name: Uni3D
notes: Unified 3D object detection model used as frozen point cloud encoder in DAG (arXiv:2508.01651) for 3D affordance grounding. Pre-trained on multiple 3D detection datasets. Used to extract point cloud features for cross-modal affordance prediction.

name: Gemini 3.0 Pro Preview
notes: Google DeepMind's latest Pro-class model evaluated as AI shopping agent in ACES framework. As of December 2025, represents state-of-the-art for the Gemini family.

name: Pythia-12B
notes: Pythia-12B is a decoder-only transformer trained on the Pile. Used in arXiv:2508.02573 for analyzing memorization taxonomies via CNN classification of attention weights.

name: Qwen-2-7B-Instruct
notes: Qwen-2 7B instruction-tuned model. Used in AttnTrace (arXiv:2508.03793) as one of the evaluation LLMs for context traceback experiments.

name: Claude-Haiku-3.5
notes: Anthropic Claude 3.5 Haiku; updated version of Haiku released October 2024 with improved capabilities. Used in AttnTrace (arXiv:2508.03793) as one of the evaluation LLMs for context traceback experiments.

name: LLaMA-Omni
notes: End-to-end speech-language model for seamless speech interaction with LLMs (ICLR 2025). English-only. Baseline in SpeechRole paper (arXiv:2508.02013), where it shows substantial performance gaps vs GPT-4o Audio across interaction ability and speech expressiveness metrics.

name: F5-TTS
notes: Flow-matching based text-to-speech system that fakes fluent and faithful speech (arXiv:2410.06885). Uses flow matching for speech generation with Hifigan vocoder. Used as TTS component in cascaded SRPA baselines in SpeechRole paper (arXiv:2508.02013).

name: UniCOM
notes: Universal and compact representation learning for image retrieval. Used as image encoder in UniFGVC paper (2508.04136). Combines visual and textual features for retrieval tasks.

name: Jina-CLIP-V2
notes: Multilingual multimodal embeddings for text and images. Used as text encoder in UniFGVC paper (2508.04136) for encoding generated textual descriptions alongside UniCOM image features.

name: H-NET++ Base
architecture: Hierarchical dynamic chunking with BiGRU routers (L levels), 4-head Transformer mixer (1.9M params), 3-layer LSTM decoder with mixture density network, two-level VAE hyper-prior
access: Coming soon (code to be released upon acceptance)
notes: Tokenizer-free byte-level language model for morphologically-rich languages. Achieves 1.183 BPB on Persian corpus, 76.6% ParsGLUE. Paper: arXiv:2508.05628.

name: H-Net-Base
architecture: Original H-Net hierarchical router without transformer mixer or hyper-prior
notes: Baseline for H-NET++ in arXiv:2508.05628. Dynamic Chunking for End-to-End Hierarchical Sequence Modeling.

name: GPT-2-fa
architecture: BPE-32k vocabulary trained on Persian corpus
notes: Persian GPT-2 used as baseline in H-NET++ paper (arXiv:2508.05628). Achieves 1.342 BPB.

name: ParsBERT
notes: Persian BERT model used as baseline in H-NET++ paper (arXiv:2508.05628). Achieves 73.8% on ParsGLUE.

name: mT5-small (Persian)
notes: Multilingual T5 small variant fine-tuned on Persian used as baseline in H-NET++ paper (arXiv:2508.05628). Achieves 1.387 BPB.

name: ByT5-fa
architecture: Byte-level T5 trained from scratch on Persian
notes: Byte-level T5 Persian model used as baseline in H-NET++ paper (arXiv:2508.05628). Achieves 1.425 BPB, 52.3% seg F1.

name: MegaByte-fa
architecture: Fixed 256-byte chunks with hierarchical reduction
notes: MEGABYTE with fixed 256-byte chunks used as baseline in H-NET++ paper (arXiv:2508.05628). Achieves 1.398 BPB, 31.2% seg F1.

name: PE_score-L (Perception Encoder)
notes: CLIP variant pre-tuned on 22M video dataset for enhanced video understanding (Bolya et al., 2025). Used as frozen backbone in Q-CLIP (arXiv:2508.06092) for video quality assessment. The perception encoder addresses CLIP's limitation with temporal modeling by training on video data.

name: JAV (Joint Audio-Visual)
notes: Joint Visual and Audio Learning for Video Highlight Detection (Badamdorj et al., ICCV 2021). Audio-visual multimodal model for video highlight detection using bimodal attention. Base model for Highlight-TTA paper (arXiv:2508.04924). Extracts visual features via 3D-CNN (ResNet-34) and audio features via PANNs.

name: UMT (Unified Multi-modal Transformers)
input_resolution: 224x224 frames (8-16 clip), audio + visual + text modalities
notes: Unified Multi-modal Transformers for Joint Video Moment Retrieval and Highlight Detection (Liu et al., CVPR 2022). Multimodal transformer using visual, audio, and text encoders with cross-modal fusion. Highlight-TTA paper uses audio-visual variant (excluding text). Paper: arXiv:2203.14836.

name: QD-DETR (Query-Dependent DETR)
notes: Query-Dependent Video Representation for Moment Retrieval and Highlight Detection (Moon et al., CVPR 2023). Text-visual model using cross-attention transformer. Highlight-TTA paper replaces text modality with audio to create audio-visual variant. Paper: arXiv:2303.13860.

name: SlowFast
notes: SlowFast Networks for Video Recognition (Feichtenhofer et al., ICCV 2019). Dual-pathway model with slow pathway (low frame rate, high spatial resolution) and fast pathway (high frame rate). Used for visual feature extraction on QVHighlights dataset in Highlight-TTA paper.

name: PANNs (Pre-trained Audio Neural Networks)
notes: Large-scale Pre-trained Audio Neural Networks for Audio Pattern Recognition (Kong et al., IEEE/ACM TASLP 2020). Pre-trained on AudioSet (2M+ audio clips). Used for audio feature extraction in Highlight-TTA paper across all three datasets (YouTube, TVSum, QVHighlights).

name: GTX TITAN
notes: Used in ATOP paper for cross-topic AES experiments. Consumer GPU from 2013.

name: Falcon3-1B-Instruct
notes: Used in arXiv:2508.06753 for benchmarking ultra-low-bit (1-bit, 2-bit) LLM inference on AI-PCs and Intel Xe2 GPUs. The paper uses both real QAT-quantized weights (MobileLLM-ParetoQ) and dummy weights for performance evaluation.

name: HuatuoGPT-o1-72B
notes: Medical-domain LLM fine-tuned for complex reasoning with o1-style training paradigm. 72B model variant evaluated in PrinciplismQA paper (arXiv:2508.05132).

name: HuatuoGPT-o1-70B
notes: Medical-domain LLM fine-tuned for complex reasoning with o1-style training paradigm. 70B model variant evaluated in PrinciplismQA paper (arXiv:2508.05132).

name: HuatuoGPT-o1-7B
notes: Medical-domain LLM fine-tuned for complex reasoning with o1-style training paradigm. 7B model variant evaluated in PrinciplismQA paper (arXiv:2508.05132).

name: MiDaS v3.1 (DPT-Large)
notes: Monocular depth estimation model. Used in CObL (arXiv:2508.08498) as frozen depth estimator for image conditioning adapter. Also used in SeeSR and other image restoration tasks.

name: pix2gestalt
notes: Amodal segmentation by synthesizing wholes (CVPR 2024). Uses Stable Diffusion for zero-shot amodal completion of objects given partial observation + oracle mask. Compared as baseline in CObL (arXiv:2508.08498).

name: LaMa (Large Mask Inpainting)
access: adv活了/LaMa on HuggingFace (unofficial); original: https://github.com/advad Lad/LLaMA
notes: Resolution-robust large mask inpainting with Fourier convolutions (WACV 2022). Uses Fourier convolutions for fast, resolution-robust inpainting. Compared as baseline in CObL (arXiv:2508.08498).

name: ControlNet-depth (SD v1.5)
notes: ControlNet variant for depth-conditioned control. Used in CObL (arXiv:2508.08498) for generating textured object layers from depth maps in the synthetic data generation pipeline. Differs from generic ControlNet entry (lllyasviel/ControlNet on HuggingFace) by being depth-specific variant.

name: CN-CLIP ViT-B/16
notes: Chinese CLIP (Yang et al., arXiv:2211.01335): CLIP variant trained on Chinese image-text pairs. Uses same ViT-B/16 architecture as OpenAI CLIP. Used as text encoder in CLIPin experiments on MUGE (e-commerce) and Tongren (medical) datasets.

name: YOLO-World (yolov8s-worlddv2)
notes: Open-vocabulary object detection model. The SegDAC paper (arXiv:2508.09325) uses yolov8s-worlddv2 variant for text-grounded detection in robotic manipulation tasks. Text inputs guide bounding box proposals to SAM segmentation. Supports text prompts for flexible object detection without retraining.

name: EfficientViT-SAM-L0
notes: Accelerated Segment Anything Model without accuracy loss. The SegDAC paper (arXiv:2508.09325) uses EfficientViT-SAM-L0 as the segmentation backbone, reporting ~48x speedup over original SAM while maintaining segmentation quality. Replaces iterative mask refinement with lightweight morphological post-processing for real-time RL.

name: Smoothie-Qwen3-14B
access: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-14B (base); Smoothie variant from Ji et al. arXiv:2507.05686
notes: In-house variant of Qwen3 14B calibrated for balanced multilingual generation via post-hoc smoothing to reduce language bias. Virtually identical performance to Qwen3 14B. Used as base model in arXiv:2508.10355 for Korean reasoning fine-tuning.

name: LMDrive
organization: Shao et al. 2024 (CUHK / Shanghai AI Lab)
notes: Closed-loop end-to-end driving with large language models. Uses multi-view camera and LiDAR perception for scene understanding and planning via natural language instructions. Deployed on CARLA Leaderboard. Evaluated in SCENGE paper (arXiv:2508.14527) to test cross-model generalizability of generated adversarial scenarios.

name: MonoBERT
notes: BERT-based monoencoder re-ranker for document ranking. Fine-tuned on MS MARCO passage ranking. Used as a neural ranking model (NRM) in FSAP adversarial attack paper (arXiv:2508.15283).

name: MonoT5
notes: T5-based monoencoder re-ranker for document ranking. Fine-tuned on MS MARCO and Natural Questions. Used as a neural ranking model (NRM) in FSAP adversarial attack paper (arXiv:2508.15283).

name: DeepSeek-R1-claude3.7
notes: 14.8B parameter DeepSeek model with Claude 3.7 Sonnet system prompt. Used as adversarial document generator in FSAP paper (arXiv:2508.15283). This is a specific variant mentioned in the paper but not a standard public release — availability is unclear.

name: text-embedding-3-small
notes: Small OpenAI embedding model (text-embedding-3-small). Used as zero-shot neural ranking model in FSAP adversarial attack paper (arXiv:2508.15283). Cheaper than text-embedding-3-large.

name: H-Optimus-0
notes: H-Optimus-0: Pathology foundation model from Bioptimus team. One of five tile-level foundation models used in ELF (Ensemble Learning of Foundation models, arXiv:2508.16085). Pretrained on large-scale histopathology data. Used as frozen patch encoder alongside UNI, CONCHV1.5, GigaPath, and Virchow2.

name: Gemma3-4B
notes: Multimodal Gemma 3 variant (vision+text); 128K context; smaller 4B parameter version of Gemma3; used in paper arXiv:2508.16762 for cultural competence evaluation.

name: SmolVLM2-2B-Instruct
notes: Small efficient multimodal VLM using SigLIP for image understanding; 2.2B parameters; from HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM2 collection; used in paper arXiv:2508.16762 for cultural competence evaluation.

name: RoentGen-v2
notes: Fine-tuned Stable Diffusion 2.1 on MIMIC-CXR chest X-rays with demographic conditioning (sex, age, race/ethnicity). Uses CLIP ViT-L/14 text encoder with 77-token context. Jointly fine-tuned text encoder and U-Net. Training: 68k CXR-report pairs, selected checkpoint at 10k steps (28 epochs). From Moroianu et al. 2025 (arXiv:2508.16783).

name: BioViL
notes: CXR-specific vision-language foundation model. Used in RoentGen-v2 paper for embedding similarity metrics (cosine similarity between real and synthetic image embeddings). From Boecking et al. 2022.

name: ViT-Adapter-Small
notes: Vision Transformer Adapter for dense predictions. Uses DINOv2 as frozen backbone with adapter structure for multi-scale feature extraction. Paper: 'Vision Transformer Adapter for Dense Predictions' (ICLR 2023). Used in FedMox paper (arXiv:2508.16568) for federated learning object detection with frozen backbone.

name: HuBERT-Large
notes: Self-supervised speech encoder trained on 94k hours of audio; masked prediction of hidden units with k-means clustering; base model for SpeechLLM research

name: Goku-I2V
notes: Flow-based video generative foundation model used as pretrained backbone for InfinityHuman. Goku: Flow based video generative foundation models (Chen et al. 2025, CVPR). Used as initialization for both LR-A2V and PG-Refiner training in InfinityHuman. Comparable scale to HunyuanVideo I2V (~13B).

name: Sapiens-0.3B
notes: Sapiens pose estimator variant used in InfinityHuman for human and background keypoint extraction. Khirodkar et al. 2024. Provides robust 2D pose keypoints for the pose-guided refiner conditioning.

name: Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct
notes: Used in arXiv:2509.00529 for role-conditioned legal summarization of Swiss Federal Supreme Court decisions. Selected for strong long-context performance. Generates summaries conditioned on legal roles (judge, prosecutor, defense attorney, plaintiff/respondent attorney).

name: Robix-7B
notes: Unified VLM for robot reasoning, task planning, and human-robot interaction. Three-stage training: continued pretraining on 200B tokens + SFT with synthesized interaction data + GRPO RL. Chain-of-thought reasoning for embodied tasks. From arXiv:2509.01106.

name: Robix-32B
notes: Unified VLM for robot reasoning, task planning, and human-robot interaction. Three-stage training: continued pretraining on 200B tokens + SFT with synthesized interaction data + GRPO RL. Chain-of-thought reasoning for embodied tasks. Outperforms GPT-4o and Gemini-2.5-Pro on robot task execution benchmarks. From arXiv:2509.01106.

name: RoboBrain-2.0-7B
notes: Robot VLM with spatial-temporal reasoning and thought traces. 7B variant. Compared in Robix paper (arXiv:2509.01106).

name: RoboBrain-2.0-32B
notes: Robot VLM with spatial-temporal reasoning and thought traces. 32B variant. Baseline in Robix paper (arXiv:2509.01106).

name: GR-3
notes: ByteDance's VLA model used as low-level controller in Robix robot system. GR-3 teleoperation data used for Robix SFT training. Technical report: arXiv:2507.15493.

name: ByteMini
notes: ByteDance's robot platform used for online evaluation of Robix. Used with GR-3 as low-level VLA controller.

name: RETFound-MAE
notes: Retinal foundation model pre-trained with MAE on ~904K retinal images from AlzEye cohort. From Zhou et al., Nature 2023. Used as baseline in arXiv:2509.03421 comparison with DINOv2/DINOv3.

name: RETFound-DINOv2
notes: Retinal foundation model initialized from DINOv2-ViT-Large, further pre-trained on ~904K retinal images from AlzEye cohort. Developed by Zhou et al. (2025). Outperforms generalist DINOv2/DINOv3 models on ocular disease detection per arXiv:2509.03421.

name: NVIDIA Tesla V100
notes: Used in arXiv:2509.04463 (DREAM-GNN paper) for training DREAM-GNN multiscale GNN for turbulent flow-thermal prediction. Training on 700 graphs, 100 epochs, ~6 hours wall time on single V100.

name: ViT-B/32
notes: Standard ViT-B with 32x32 patches (vs 16x16 in ViT-B/16). Used in REMOTE paper (Lin et al., ACM MM 2025) for visual feature extraction alongside RGB and depth information.

name: SSD
notes: Single Shot MultiBox Detector. One-stage object detector. Used as victim detector in APRICOT adversarial patch benchmark (arXiv:1904.04692).

name: Qwen2.5-Math-32B
notes: Math-specialized 32B base LLM from Qwen2.5 family. Used as base model in BFS-Prover-V2 (arXiv:2509.06493) for neural theorem proving in Lean4 via multi-stage expert iteration RL.

name: Hunyuan-MT-7B
notes: Open-source multilingual translation model supporting 33 languages, with emphasis on Mandarin-minority language pairs (Kazakh, Uyghur, Mongolian, Tibetan). Technical report arXiv:2509.05209.

name: Hunyuan-MT-Chimera-7B
notes: Weak-to-strong fusion model for high-quality translation. Takes multiple translation candidates and synthesizes them into a superior output. Part of Hunyuan-MT series (arXiv:2509.05209).

name: CLAP (audio)
notes: Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining. Audio encoder trained jointly with text encoder using contrastive loss. Used in this paper for semantic audio embeddings in SELD task. Paper: Wu et al., ICASSP 2023.

name: OWL-ViT
notes: Simple open-vocabulary object detection. Vision Transformer trained with language supervision for zero-shot detection. Used in this paper for spatial-semantic visual embeddings in audio-visual SELD. Paper: Minderer et al., ECCV 2022.

name: SciBERT
notes: SciBERT is a BERT model pre-trained on a large corpus of scientific text (Papers with Citation network). Used as the base encoder in FLeW paper (arXiv:2509.07531) for scientific document representation learning.

name: Whisper-medium (English)
notes: English-only version of Whisper Medium used in Falcon3-Audio 7B/3B models (arXiv:2509.07526). The paper reports 307M parameters for the audio encoder component.

name: Whisper-small (English)
notes: English-only version of Whisper Small used in Falcon3-Audio 1B model (arXiv:2509.07526). The paper reports 88M parameters for the audio encoder component.

name: Falcon3-Instruct-1B
notes: Instruction-tuned 1B LLM used in Falcon3-Audio 1B (arXiv:2509.07526).

name: Falcon3-Instruct-3B
notes: Instruction-tuned 3B LLM used in Falcon3-Audio 3B (arXiv:2509.07526).

name: Falcon3-Instruct-7B
notes: Instruction-tuned 7B LLM used in Falcon3-Audio 7B (arXiv:2509.07526). The paper notes using an internal version trained with less code/math data than the released model.

name: Falcon3-Audio-1B
access: not yet released at time of paper
notes: Smallest variant of Falcon3-Audio family. From arXiv:2509.07526.

name: Falcon3-Audio-3B
access: not yet released at time of paper
notes: Mid-size variant of Falcon3-Audio family. From arXiv:2509.07526.

name: Falcon3-Audio-7B
access: not yet released at time of paper
notes: Largest variant of Falcon3-Audio family, achieving 64.14 on MMAU benchmark matching R1-AQA. From arXiv:2509.07526.

name: FastSpeech 2
notes: Fast and high-quality end-to-end TTS. Used as TTS baseline in WhisTLE paper (arXiv:2509.10452). Trained on batches of 48 sentences for 160K steps. Requires HiFi-GAN vocoder.

name: SpeechT5
notes: Unified-modal encoder-decoder pretraining for spoken language processing. Used as TTS baseline in WhisTLE paper (arXiv:2509.10452). Jointly pretrains on text and audio with 12K-token batches before TTS fine-tuning. Requires HiFi-GAN vocoder.

name: HiFi-GAN
notes: HiFi-GAN vocoder used for high-quality audio synthesis from mel-spectrograms. Required by FastSpeech2 and SpeechT5 in WhisTLE paper (arXiv:2509.10452).

name: BitNet b1.58
notes: 1-bit LLM variant where weight parameters are restricted to ternary values {-1, 0, 1}. Used in ENSI (arXiv:2509.09424) for efficient homomorphic encryption-based secure inference — the ternary weights enable multiplication-free plaintext-ciphertext matrix multiplication.

name: AceMath-72B-Instruct
notes: AceMath-72B-Instruct from the AceMath suite (Liu et al., 2024). Outperforms Qwen2.5-Math-72B-Instruct, GPT-4o, and Claude 3.5 Sonnet on math reasoning benchmarks. Used as reward model baseline in arXiv:2509.06870 (AggLM paper).

name: AceMath-7B-Instruct
notes: AceMath-7B-Instruct from the AceMath suite (Liu et al., 2024). Math reasoning LLM used as reward model baseline in arXiv:2509.06870 (AggLM paper).

name: GLM-Z1-9B-0414
license: TBD (premium API access via Zhipu AI)
access: API access via Zhipu AI (not widely released as model weights)
notes: Reasoning-focused GLM variant used as backbone model in DeepDive (arXiv:2509.10446). Cold-start SFT data generated using Claude-4-Sonnet-Thinking with tool-calling. Used alongside QwQ-32B for ablation studies.

name: Llava-v1.6-7B
notes: Multimodal LLM for UI2Code task; used as backbone in EfficientUICoder (arXiv:2509.12159). Architecture: CLIP ViT-L/14 visual encoder + projector + Vicuna-7B LLM.

name: Llava-v1.6-34B
notes: 34B variant of Multimodal LLM for UI2Code task; used as backbone in EfficientUICoder (arXiv:2509.12159). Architecture: CLIP ViT-L/14 visual encoder + projector + NousHermes-2-Yi-34B LLM.

name: FireRed-LLM
notes: FireRed-LLM is an industrial-grade Mandarin/English ASR model that integrates speech encoders with LLM backbones. Used as the backbone model in the PAC paper (arXiv:2509.12647). The 7B version is fine-tuned with LoRA for contextual ASR. Supports both English (LibriSpeech) and Mandarin (AISHELL-1) speech recognition.

name: DINOv3-ViT-L/16
notes: DINOv3 ViT-L/16 (Large) backbone used in AD-DINOv3 (arXiv:2509.14084). First adaptation of DINOv3 to zero-shot anomaly detection. 24 transformer layers, extracts patch tokens from multiple stages (6th, 12th, 18th, 24th) for multi-level feature fusion. Large variant (~300M params) vs Small variant (~21M params).

name: MedImageInsight (MI2)
notes: CLIP/UniCL-style medical image encoder trained on ~500k CXR + 3.3M other medical images. Uses DAViT (Dual Attention Vision Transformer) architecture. Excels at findings classification and retrieval tasks. Open weights available for continual pretraining. From Codella et al., arXiv:2410.06542.

name: OWLv2-Large
notes: OWLv2: Scaling Open-World Object Detection and Recognition (arXiv:2308.19721). Uses ViT-Huge backbone with improved training. Significantly outperforms OWL-ViT. Used in SMOV3D (arXiv:2509.15924) as the 2D open-vocabulary detector for generating initial object proposals from text queries.

name: FeatUp
notes: Model-agnostic framework for restoring fine-grained spatial details in deep features at any resolution. Works with any vision backbone (DINOv2, CLIP, etc.). Used in DiffEye paper (arXiv:2509.16767) to upsample DINOv2 features from 14x14 to 32x32 spatial resolution. From Fu et al., ICLR 2024.

name: LXMERT
notes: LXMERT: Learning Cross-Modality Encoder Representations from Transformers (Tan & Bansal, EMNLP 2019). The paper uses precomputed Faster RCNN RoI features from LXMERT for MS-COCO images as visual inputs to the VGS+ model. Features are pre-extracted and frozen; LXMERT model itself is not trained in this work.

name: LLaDA-8B-Base
notes: Masked Diffusion Language Model (MDLM) base model. Uses bidirectional attention (non-causal). Generates text via iterative unmasking. Base model for Spiffy speculative decoding experiments (arXiv:2509.18085). arXiv:2502.09992.

name: VI LoRA (Variational Inference LoRA)
organization: Pokel, Moure, Bohringer, Liu, Gao (ETH Zurich / UZH)
params: Same base model + variational adapters (LoRA rank r, diagonal Gaussian distributions over A and B matrices)
file_size_bf16: ~same as base model + adapters (LoRA rank r adds ~2*r*d_model parameters)
notes: Variational Low-Rank Adaptation: extends LoRA by modeling adapter matrices A and B as variational distributions (diagonal Gaussians) rather than fixed weights. Enables epistemic uncertainty estimation via Bayesian adapters without masking representations. From Pokel et al. (arXiv:2509.20397). Used in PhDScore paper (arXiv:2509.20396) for uncertainty-guided oversampling in ASR personalization for non-normative speech.

name: LLaMA-Omni2
notes: Improved version of LLaMA-Omni with autoregressive streaming speech synthesis and instruction tuning (arXiv:2505.02625). Supports English speech interaction. Multi-size variant: 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B parameters. Used in arXiv:2509.21125 for acoustic-based gender differentiation analysis.

name: Titanet-large
notes: Speaker representation model using 1D depth-wise separable convolutions and global context. From Koluguri et al., ICASSP 2022. Used in ALIGN2SPEAK paper (arXiv:2509.21718) for SSIM speaker similarity rewards during GRPO alignment.

name: Titanet-small
notes: Smaller variant of Titanet for speaker verification. Used in ALIGN2SPEAK (arXiv:2509.21718) for SSIM evaluation of generated speech (separate from Titanet-large used in GRPO rewards).

name: Koel-TTS 380M
access: NVIDIA/Koel-TTS on HuggingFace or NVIDIA GitHub
notes: Autoregressive encoder-decoder TTS model based on LLM. Uses NanoCodec audio representation at 21.5 FPS. Conditions on text encodings via cross-attention. From Hussain et al., EMNLP 2025. ALIGN2SPEAK (arXiv:2509.21718) builds on this model with GRPO alignment.

name: NanoCodec
access: NVIDIA/NanoCodec on HuggingFace or NVIDIA GitHub
notes: Low-frame-rate (21.5 FPS) neural audio codec for speech. Used as audio representation in Koel-TTS and ALIGN2SPEAK. From Casanova et al., INTERSPEECH 2025.

name: Qwen3-VL-2B
notes: Base vision-language model used in GenesisGeo-2B (arXiv:2509.21896). GenesisGeo fine-tunes Qwen3-VL-2B with multi-task learning on GENESISGEO-1M dataset for geometry theorem proving.

name: Llama-3.3-Nemotron-70B-Reward
license: NVIDIA AI Foundation Models Community License
notes: Scalar reward model trained with Bradley-Terry on HelpSteer3-Preference data. Used as baseline in RLBFF paper (arXiv:2509.21319).

name: Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B-Reward
license: NVIDIA AI Foundation Models Community License
notes: Scalar reward model from NVIDIA's Nemotron series. Used as baseline in RLBFF paper (arXiv:2509.21319).

name: Llama-3.3-Nemotron-Super-49B-GenRM
license: NVIDIA AI Foundation Models Community License
notes: Generative reward model (GenRM) trained with GRPO. Used as baseline in RLBFF paper (arXiv:2509.21319).

name: Flexible Principles ScalarRM
license: NVIDIA AI Foundation Models Community License
notes: Binary flexible reward model from RLBFF paper (arXiv:2509.21319). Takes (prompt, response, principle) as input and outputs binary yes/no. Top performer on RM-Bench (83.6%), JudgeBench (76.3%). <0.1s per evaluation.

name: Flexible Principles GenRM
notes: Generative reward model with reasoning from RLBFF paper (arXiv:2509.21319). Top performer on JudgeBench (81.4%, #1 on leaderboard as of Sept 2025) and RM-Bench (86.2%). ~10s per evaluation due to reasoning chain.

name: NV-Embed-v2
notes: Generalist embedding model for LLM. Used in RLAG paper (2509.20162) as the embedding model for retrieval. Paper: Lee et al., arXiv:2405.17428.

name: Grok-3
notes: xAI's Grok-3 model used in RLAG paper (2509.20162) for evaluating explanation win rates alongside GPT-4 Turbo.

name: VideoLLaMA3-7B
notes: State-of-the-art video understanding multimodal LLM. Base model for DeepTraceReward fine-tuned model (arXiv:2509.22646). Fine-tuned VideoLLaMA3-7B achieves 70.2% overall on DEEPTRACEREWARD deepfake trace detection benchmark, surpassing GPT-5 by 34.7%. Training: 1 epoch, batch_size=1, lr=1e-5, fps=2, max_frames=180, on 8x H100 80GB (~40min per epoch). From Zhang et al. (2025).

name: uniGradICON
organization: Massachusetts General Hospital / Harvard / MIT (Tian et al.)
architecture: Foundation model for unsupervised medical image registration via gradient inverse consistency; covers brain, cardiac, abdomen, lung anatomies; generalizes to out-of-distribution tasks
notes: uniGradICON: A Foundation Model for Medical Image Registration. MICCAI 2024.

name: SynthMorph
organization: Massachusetts General Hospital / Harvard (Hoffmann et al.)
architecture: Contrast- and resolution-agnostic unsupervised registration network trained on synthetic brain MRI; highly generalizable to real brain scans and different modalities
notes: SynthMorph: Learning Contrast-Invariant Registration Without Acquired Images. IEEE TMI 2021.

name: SigLiP-so400M
notes: SigLIP (Scalable Image-Language Pretraining with Language Image Expert Regularization) SO400M variant at 384px resolution. Used as visual encoder in StreamForest (arXiv:2509.24871) for streaming video understanding.

name: Pseudo-Roberta-Large
access: fine-tuned from roberta-large for OOD detection
notes: Used as OOD detection backbone in RCU unlearning paper (arXiv:2509.25743) and o3 baseline (Gao et al. 2025)

name: Intern-S1
notes: Scientific multimodal foundation model; top-ranked open-source MLLM on HiPhO leaderboard; used in PHYSICSMINIONS (arXiv:2509.24855) as the primary open-source backbone; achieves gold-medal performance on physics Olympiads with multi-agent coevolution framework

name: VideoXL-2
organization: Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence / Shanghai Jiao Tong University
context_length: very long (designed for long video processing)
notes: Backbone MLLM for TimeScope (arXiv:2509.26360). Supports very long video sequences with task-aware KV sparsification. Interleaves timestamp tokens for temporal awareness. TimeScope fine-tunes VideoXL-2 for task-oriented temporal grounding.

name: Geo-R1
notes: Geospatial reasoning VLM post-trained from Qwen2.5-VL-7B using SFT scaffolding (12.6K synthetic CoT samples from GPT o3) + GRPO RLVR on cross-view pairing task (CV-Cities dataset). Introduces cross-view pairing as a proxy task for geospatial RLVR. Achieves SOTA among open-source VLMs on GeoChain and IMAGEO benchmarks. Paper: arXiv:2510.00072.

name: Gemma-3n-E2B-it
notes: Gemma 3n (native audio) E2B variant. Evaluated in TAU benchmark paper (arXiv:2509.26329) achieving 29.6% single-hop / 25.8% multi-hop accuracy, near random baseline (25%). Part of Gemma 3 native audio model family (Gemma 3 tech report, arXiv:2503.19786).

name: Gemma-3n-E4B-it
notes: Gemma 3n (native audio) E4B variant. Evaluated in TAU benchmark paper (arXiv:2509.26329) achieving 29.0% single-hop / 25.9% multi-hop accuracy with default prompt, 34.0% / 33.4% with culturally-grounded prompt. Part of Gemma 3 native audio model family (Gemma 3 tech report, arXiv:2503.19786).

name: DeSTA2.5-Audio
notes: DeSTA2.5 is an improved version of DeSTA2 (arXiv:2507.02768, ICASSP 2025). Built on Qwen2-Audio with self-generated cross-modal alignment. Evaluated in TAU benchmark paper (arXiv:2509.26329) achieving 43.3% single-hop / 41.7% multi-hop with default prompt, 38.2% / 38.9% with culturally-grounded prompt. Parameters from paper (8.8B).

name: NoisyRollout-7B
notes: Multimodal RLVR baseline that injects noise into training images for visual robustness. Based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Compared in DUPL paper (arXiv:2510.01444).

name: ThinkLite-VL-7B
notes: Lightweight visual language model with thinking mechanism for multimodal reasoning. Based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Compared in DUPL paper (arXiv:2510.01444).

name: VLAA-Thinker-7B
notes: Vision-language reasoning model with unified visual and textual signals in a policy-learning framework. Based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Compared in DUPL paper (arXiv:2510.01444).

name: FireFlow
notes: Fast inversion algorithm for rectified flow models (FLUX.1, SD3). Used in DragFlow (arXiv:2510.02253) for image inversion before drag-based editing. From Deng et al. (arXiv:2412.07517).

name: InstantCharacter
notes: Personalization adapter for FLUX.1-dev enabling subject-consistent image generation from reference images. Used in DragFlow (arXiv:2510.02253) for adapter-enhanced inversion to preserve subject identity during drag editing. From Tao et al. (arXiv:2504.12395).

name: VGG-Face
access: Available from original paper: Parkhi et al., 2015; weights available from model authors
notes: Deep CNN face recognition model. Used in EFCT experiments (paper: arXiv:2510.02570). AUC=0.9467 on EFCT face pairs. Pre-trained on large-scale face dataset.

name: A2017b (L2-Constrained Softmax)
organization: University of Maryland / Amazon (Ranjan et al., 2017)
access: Available from original paper: Ranjan et al., 2017 (arXiv:1703.09507); weights available from authors
notes: L2-constrained softmax loss for discriminative face verification. Used in FET experiments (paper: arXiv:2510.02570). AUC=0.9583 on FET face pairs. One of 4 DCNNs tested in Phillips et al., 2018 (PNAS) — was the most accurate among them.

name: Command A
notes: Enterprise LLM used as fusor and teacher model in FusioN paper (2510.00931). Also used as 111B baseline for SFT experiments. The paper uses Command A as the primary fusor model for synthesizing N samples into one output.

name: AlphaFold3
notes: End-to-end model for predicting 3D structures of protein, DNA, RNA, and ligand complexes. Supports some NSAAs but lacks binding site specification. Used as baseline in NS-PEP (2510.03326) for peptide folding comparison. Achieved 10.49% success rate vs NS-PEP's 28.25% on peptide folding.

name: InternVL3-8B-Instruct
notes: Instruction-tuned version of InternVL3-8B. Used as base model in IQA-Select (arXiv:2510.03880) for explainable IQA fine-tuning. Pretrained InternVL3-Instruct achieves 75.59% on Q-Bench vs full fine-tuning 77.73%, showing limited improvement room.

name: SALAMANDRATA-7B-Instruct
notes: Translation LLM derived from SALAMANDRA, supporting 35 European languages. Used as base model for CoT S2TT experiments in arXiv:2510.03115. Extended with DSU token embeddings for speech input.

name: TWIST-mHuBERT
notes: Distilled mHuBERT speech encoder from TWIST (Textually Pretrained Speech Language Models). Downsamples to 25Hz temporal resolution. Used to encode speech into continuous representations before quantization into 500 DSU clusters for the SALAMANDRATA-7B S2TT model.

name: FAFormer
notes: Frame Averaging Transformer. Equivariant transformer that integrates frame averaging within each transformer block for protein-nucleic acid complex modeling. Achieves SOTA on contact map prediction for protein-aptamer binding.

name: G-Hyena
notes: Geometric Hyena Networks. First equivariant long-convolutional model for geometric systems. Sub-quadratic complexity, SE(3)-equivariant for molecular property prediction. Processes 30k tokens 20x faster than equivariant transformers.

name: GPT-5-nano
notes: Smallest tier of GPT-5 series. Used as base model in JEF-Hinter paper (arXiv:2510.04373) for web agent experiments. Comparable to gpt-5-mini but smaller.

name: LLaDA-1.5
notes: LLaDA variant with variance-reduced preference optimization. Used in Self Speculative Decoding paper (arXiv:2510.04147).

name: Dream-v0-Base-7B
notes: Dream base model (v0). Masked diffusion LLM from Qwen2.5-7B backbone. Used in Self Speculative Decoding paper (arXiv:2510.04147) achieving up to 3.46x speedup with SSD on Dream-Instruct.

name: Dream-v0-Instruct-7B
notes: Dream instruction-tuned model (v0). Achieved 3.46x speedup with SSD in arXiv:2510.04147, the highest among all tested models.

name: GPT-OSS-20B
notes: Open-source MoE LLM from OpenAI. Used in multilingual routing analysis paper (Bandarkar et al., arXiv:2510.04694). 24 layers.

name: Phi-3.5-MoE-instruct
notes: Microsoft's MoE LLM. Used in multilingual routing analysis paper (Bandarkar et al., arXiv:2510.04694). 32 layers. Paper: arXiv:2404.14219.

name: Gemma-3-12B-IT
notes: Google Gemma-3 12B instruction-tuned model. Used in SOCIALHARMBENCH (arXiv:2510.04891) for evaluating sociopolitical safety vulnerabilities.

name: Detic (Swin-Base)
notes: Open-vocabulary object detector using CenterNet2 with CLIP visual features. Trained on LVIS/COCO/ImageNet-21k. Used in paper arXiv:2510.06277 for real-world mask generation in GCRL experiments.

name: Falcon3-10B-Instruct
notes: Instruction-tuned 10B LLM from TII Falcon3 family. Used in CULNIG paper (arXiv:2510.08284) for neuron-level analysis of cultural understanding in LLMs.

name: ZipNeRF
params: N/A (per-scene optimization, multi-res hash encoding MLP)
file_size_fp32: scene-dependent (MLP + hash grid, typically <1GB per scene)
notes: Grid-based neural radiance field with anti-aliasing. Used as backbone in NExF paper (arXiv:2510.08279). Multi-resolution hash encoding for efficiency. Paper: Barron et al., ICCV 2023.

name: AgentLM-7B
notes: AgentLM-7B from AgentTuning (Zeng et al., 2023). Fine-tuned on WebShop environment for agentic tasks. Used as base model in CoTri backdoor attack paper (arXiv:2510.08238).

name: AgentEvol-7B
notes: AgentEvol-7B from Agent-Gym (Xi et al., 2025b). Fine-tuned on WebShop environment for agentic tasks. Used as base model in CoTri backdoor attack paper (arXiv:2510.08238).

name: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
notes: Qwen2.5-VL 7B instruction-tuned vision-language model (Bai et al., 2025). Used for multimodal agent backdoor experiments in CoTri paper (arXiv:2510.08238).

name: Whisper-tiny
notes: Multilingual Whisper tiny model (39M params). Used in arXiv:2510.08047 for ASR domain adaptation on African accented English.

name: Whisper-small
notes: Multilingual Whisper small model (244M params). Used in arXiv:2510.08047 for ASR domain adaptation experiments.

name: Whisper-medium
notes: Multilingual Whisper medium model (769M params). Used in arXiv:2510.08047 for ASR domain adaptation experiments.

name: Claude-Sonnet-4
notes: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4, released May 2025. Used in BIGCODEARENA paper (arXiv:2510.08697) for code generation evaluation.

name: Claude-Opus-4
notes: Anthropic Claude Opus 4, released May 2025. Used in BIGCODEARENA paper (arXiv:2510.08697) for code generation evaluation, where it achieved top-tier performance along with Claude-Sonnet-4.

name: U-KAN
notes: U-Net variant using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) as backbone replacing MLPs. Learnable activation functions instead of fixed ReLU/sigmoid. Demonstrated comparable or better performance than U-Net with similar parameter count. Used as backbone for Evidential U-KAN paper (arXiv:2510.08949).

name: Deformable DETR (D-DETR)
organization: SenseTime / CUHK / Tsinghua (Zhu et al., ICLR 2021)
notes: End-to-end object detector with multi-scale deformable attention. Base architecture used in BOUND paper (arXiv:2510.09173) for Open-World Object Detection. Uses deformable attention instead of standard transformer attention for better convergence and small object detection.

name: GPT-2-Large
notes: GPT-2 Large (774M) used in A-IPO paper (arXiv:2510.10077) as policy model for pluralistic preference alignment. Also used in GDPO paper (Yao et al., 2024).

name: BAGEL-7B
organization: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
notes: Unified multimodal model for understanding and generation, evaluated in GIR-Bench paper. Pretrained on trillions of interleaved multimodal tokens. Shows emergent capabilities in complex multimodal reasoning.

name: Gemini-2.5-Flash-Image
notes: Google's unified multimodal model with image generation capability, evaluated in GIR-Bench. Achieves SOTA results on reasoning-centric image generation tasks.

name: HiDream-I1-Full
notes: High-efficiency image generative foundation model with sparse diffusion transformer, evaluated in GIR-Bench.

name: Show-o2-7B
notes: Improved unified multimodal model for understanding and generation, evaluated in GIR-Bench paper.

name: BLIP3o-NEXT-SFT-3B
notes: Unified multimodal model using diffusion transformer for image generation, evaluated in GIR-Bench. Uses sequential pretraining (understanding followed by generation).

name: Ovis-U1-3B
notes: Unified multimodal model for understanding and generation, evaluated in GIR-Bench.

name: UniWorld-V1
notes: High-resolution semantic encoders for unified visual understanding and generation, evaluated in GIR-Bench. Uses frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B.

name: UniPic2-Metaquery-9B
notes: Kontext model with online RL for unified multimodal model, evaluated in GIR-Bench.

name: ICEdit
notes: In-context image editing model evaluated in GIR-Bench. Uses in-context generation in large-scale diffusion transformer.

name: FLAME
organization: Timo Bolkart, Tianye Li, Michael J. Black, Hao Li, Javier Romero (MPI-IS, USC ICT)
notes: FLAME: Faces Learned with an Articulated Model and Expressions (ACM ToG 2017). Parametric 3D head/face model with pose, expression, and shape parameters. Used as the expression space and fitting target in imHead paper. The paper uses FLAME expression parameters to condition the expression warping module.

name: NPHM
organization: Simon Giebenhain, Tobias Kirschstein, Markos Georgopoulos, Martin Runz, Lourdes Agapito, Matthias Nießner (TU Berlin, Imperial College, Stanford)
params: Not publicly specified (DeepSDF-based auto-decoder with per-region networks)
notes: Neural Parametric Head Models (CVPR 2023). State-of-the-art implicit 3D morphable model for head modeling. Uses forward deformation and global+local latent space. imHead builds upon NPHM and uses NPHM fitting in their data curation pipeline. imHead achieves 8.5x more compact latent space (256 vs 2176 dims) and 3x faster fitting.

name: BFM
organization: Pascal Paysan, Reinhard Knothe, Brian Amberg, Sami Romdhani, Thomas Vetter (University of Basel)
notes: Basel Face Model (IEEE AVSS 2009). Classic linear 3D morphable model for face reconstruction. One of the foundational 3DMM methods alongside FLAME. Used as a baseline in imHead.

name: MVDream
notes: Multi-view diffusion model for 3D generation. Generates 4 orthogonal views from text prompt. Used as backbone in InfiniHuman (arXiv:2510.11650) for multi-view generation in Gen-Schnell.

name: PSHuman
notes: Photorealistic Single-view Human reconstruction using cross-scale diffusion. Used in InfiniHuman (arXiv:2510.11650) for high-fidelity 3D mesh reconstruction from multi-view images via SMPL-driven volumetric carving.

name: OminiControl
notes: Minimal and universal control for diffusion transformer. Fine-tuned in InfiniHuman (arXiv:2510.11650) as Instruct-Virtual-TryOff for garment extraction from full-body images.

name: OminiControl2
notes: Efficient conditioning for diffusion transformers. Fine-tuned in InfiniHuman (arXiv:2510.11650) as Gen-HRes for high-resolution avatar generation from multi-modal inputs (text, SMPL, clothing).

name: Human-3Diffusion
organization: University of Tübingen (Xue et al., NeurIPS 2024)
notes: Realistic avatar creation via explicit 3D consistent diffusion models. Inspiration for Gen-Schnell in InfiniHuman (arXiv:2510.11650), which combines 2D multi-view generation with 3D-GS decoder.

name: DeepResearcher-7B
notes: Open-source DR agent framework using end-to-end reinforcement learning (GRPO) for deep web search. Multi-stage agent architecture that issues real search queries, retrieves webpages, and processes content through a hierarchically structured browser agent. Used in Deep Research security analysis paper (arXiv:2510.11851).

name: CodeQwen 2.5 (32B)
notes: Code-specialized Qwen model, best 32B open-source coding model that fits on consumer hardware. Used in NL2Contract paper (arXiv:2510.12702) for LLM-based contract inference from natural language for software verification.

name: BEVDet
notes: High-performance multi-camera 3D object detection in Bird's-Eye-View. Adapted in MCOP (arXiv:2510.12679) for multi-UAV occupancy prediction by converting BEV features to occupancy via FlashOcc. Uses ResNet101-DCN backbone with FPN at multiple scales.

name: PanoOcc
notes: Unified occupancy representation for camera-based 3D panoptic segmentation. Uses voxel queries with deformable attention to generate 3D occupancy features. Adapted in MCOP (arXiv:2510.12679) as a baseline method (with Where2comm collaboration module) for multi-UAV occupancy prediction.

name: SDXL-Inpainting
notes: SDXL-based inpainting model with modified UNet (+5 input channels for masked image and mask). Base model for Patch-Adapter paper.

name: BGE-small-en-v1.5
notes: Small sentence-transformer embedding model (384-dim). Used in UrbanFusion (arXiv:2510.13774) as frozen POI text encoder to embed textual descriptions of points-of-interest near each location. Part of BGE embedding family; competitive on MTEB benchmark.

name: Hibou
organization: Pathology foundation model authors (Nechaev et al., 2024)
notes: Hibou: A family of foundational vision transformers for pathology (arXiv:2406.05074). Used in PRISM paper (arXiv:2510.14800) as the feature extractor backbone for training the morphology-informed classifier on the Hist-AI colorectal dataset.

name: MiniCPM-V-2_6
notes: MLLLM backbone used in MLLMA for chip physical design (arXiv:2510.15872). SigLIP-like vision encoder.

name: MMaDA-8B
organization: Yang et al. (Multimodal DLM from LLaDA-8B)
notes: Multimodal Masked Diffusion Language Model (MMaDA) trained from LLaDA-8B. Uses bidirectional attention with iterative denoising. Paper: arXiv:2505.15809. Used in dlms-sinks attention analysis paper (arXiv:2510.15731).

name: PosterLlama
notes: LLM-based content-aware layout generation method. Reformulates layout generation as code generation using Llama. First LLM-based method for poster layout generation. SEGA paper uses it as a baseline.

name: Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite
access: gemini-2.0-flash-lite via Google AI Studio or Vertex AI
notes: Google Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite; lightweight variant of Gemini 2.0 Flash with lower pricing; used for code translation many-shot ICL experiments (arXiv:2510.16809).

name: KPConv
notes: Kernel Point Convolution for Point Clouds (Thomas et al., ICCV 2019). Flexible and deformable convolution for 3D point cloud processing. Used in Reg2Inv as backbone (KPConv-FPN) for multi-scale feature extraction.

name: KPConv-FPN
organization: South China University of Technology (Reg2Inv paper)
notes: Feature Pyramid Network with KPConv backbone for multi-scale point cloud feature extraction. Used in Reg2Inv for hierarchical feature encoding across multiple resolutions.

name: RIConv++
notes: Effective Rotation Invariant Convolutions for 3D Point Cloud Deep Learning (Zhang et al., IJCV 2022). Captures rotation-invariant features by encoding relationships between central points and neighbors, plus internal geometric relations among neighbors. Used in Reg2Inv for local feature extraction.

name: Geometric Transformer
notes: Geometric Transformer for Fast and Robust Point Cloud Registration (Qin et al., CVPR 2022). Uses geometric structure for robust registration. Used in Reg2Inv for patch-level feature extraction and registration.

name: PointMAE
notes: Masked Autoencoders for Point Cloud Self-Supervised Learning (Pang et al., ECCV 2022). Self-supervised pretraining for point clouds using mask reconstruction. Used in Reg2Inv and baselines (Reg3D-AD, ISMP) as feature extractor.

name: Mistral-Nemo-Base-2407
notes: Joint Mistral AI and NVIDIA collaboration; uses Tekken tokenizer; BASE model (not instruct). Used in arXiv:2510.16819 as backbone for authorship attribution reranker.

name: YOLOv7
notes: Real-time object detector (Chien-Yao Wang et al., CVPR 2023). Used in DIV-Nav (arXiv:2510.16518) for open-vocabulary object detection on MS-COCO classes during robot navigation.

name: Fast-LIO2
notes: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry (Xu et al., ICRA/IJRR 2022). Used in DIV-Nav (arXiv:2510.16518) for real-time robot odometry on Boston Dynamics Spot with Livox Mid 360 LiDAR.

name: MAPPO (Multi-Agent PPO)
notes: Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization. Used in R2BC paper (2510.18085) as the oracle demonstrator to generate synthetic joint-action demonstrations for VMAS multi-agent tasks.

name: HeRo+ Robot
notes: Low-cost differential drive robot for swarm robotics research. Used in R2BC paper (2510.18085) for physical robot experiments in navigation and block-pushing tasks.

name: Open-Reasoner-Zero
notes: Qwen 2.5 base model post-trained with PPO using ORZ dataset (~57k samples). Used in arXiv:2510.18554 for studying RL data extraction. Model regurgitates RL training samples when prompted with chat templates.

name: gemini-embedding-001
notes: General-purpose text embedding model used in arXiv:2510.18554 for measuring semantic similarity between generated samples and training data. Shows 10x higher memorization detection rate compared to string matching metrics.

name: VideoMAE (original)
notes: Tong et al., NeurIPS 2022. Self-supervised video pretraining via masked autoencoding. Used in SONAR-SLT (arXiv:2510.19398) for spatiotemporal motion feature extraction. Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.12602

name: Gemma-3-1B
notes: Google Gemma 3 1B instruction-tuned model. Used in Stream paper (arXiv:2510.19875) for needle-in-a-haystack experiments on the RULER benchmark.

name: Phi-2
notes: 2.7B parameter small language model trained on synthetic data. Used in AdaSPEC paper (arXiv:2510.19779) as target model paired with CodeGen-350M draft model.

name: CodeGen-350M
notes: 350M parameter code generation model from CodeGen family (arXiv:2203.13474). Used in AdaSPEC paper (arXiv:2510.19779) as draft model paired with Phi-2 target model for speculative decoding experiments.

name: iIBRnet
notes: Inverse Image-Based Rendering network for 4D light field generation from single images. Uses ray Transformer with Plucker coordinates and disparity positional encoding. Trained on synthetic Pov-ray data, generalizes zero-shot to real images. Paper: arXiv:2510.20132.

name: SinMPI
notes: Single-image novel view synthesis via expanded Multiplane Images. Baseline compared in iIBR paper (arXiv:2510.20132).

name: TMPI
notes: Tiled Multiplane Images for practical 3D photography. Baseline compared in iIBR paper (arXiv:2510.20132). ICCV 2023.

name: ZeroMVS
notes: Zero-shot 360-degree view synthesis from a single real image. Baseline compared in iIBR paper (arXiv:2510.20132). CVPR 2023.

name: NViST
notes: In-the-wild novel view synthesis from a single image with transformers. Baseline compared in iIBR paper (arXiv:2510.20132). CVPR 2024.

name: Meta-LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct
notes: Meta LLaMA 3.1 8B instruction-tuned model. Used as the LLM backbone in BTB3D (2510.20639) for radiology report generation, combined with LoRA fine-tuning.

name: XMem
notes: Long-term video object segmentation with Atkinson-Shiffrin memory model. Used in OnlineSplatter paper for online video object segmentation to generate object masks for pose-free 3D reconstruction.

name: Llama3.2-3B
notes: Base model (not instruct). Used as encoder backbone in ARC-Encoder paper (2510.20535) - last 2 layers removed to create ~2.8B encoder. Same model family enables good compatibility with Llama3.1 8B decoder.

name: Llama3.1-8B
notes: Base model (not instruct). Used as decoder in ARC-Encoder paper (2510.20535). The paper shows that Llama3.2 3B encoder has good affinity with Llama3.1 8B decoder due to same model family.

name: Yi-1.5-34B-Chat
notes: Yi-1.5-34B-Chat used as candidate LLM in Lookahead routing paper (arXiv:2510.19506).

name: Phi-3-Medium-4K-Instruct
notes: Phi-3-Medium-4K-Instruct (14B) used as candidate LLM in Lookahead routing paper (arXiv:2510.19506).

name: ModernBERT-base
notes: ModernBERT-base (149M) used as MLM-based router backbone in Lookahead routing paper (arXiv:2510.19506). Paper uses ModernBERT-base while registry also has ModernBERT-Large (395M).

name: TinySAM
notes: Efficient Segment Anything Model variant. Uses full-stage distillation with mask-weighted losses, quantization, and hierarchical segment-everything strategy. Half the inference time of MobileSAM with minimal accuracy loss. Paper: arXiv:2312.13789. Used in ProFSAM paper (arXiv:2510.21782) for fire segmentation evaluation alongside SAM2.1 and MobileSAM.

name: Emotion2vec
notes: Self-supervised speech emotion embedding model. Pre-trained on large-scale emotional speech corpus. Extracts frame-level emotion embeddings (768-dim) from raw audio waveforms. Used in LSF-Animation (arXiv:2510.21864) for label-free speech-driven 3D facial animation. Outputs at 50Hz with 768-dim frame-wise features.

name: FaceFormer
notes: FaceFormer: Speech-driven 3D facial animation with transformers. First transformer-based method for speech-driven 3D facial animation. Uses HuBERT for audio features and autoregressive transformer for temporal modeling. Baseline in LSF-Animation (2510.21864).

name: CodeTalker
notes: CodeTalker: Speech-driven 3D facial animation with discrete motion prior (VQ-VAE). Uses discrete codebook for facial motion representation. Baseline in LSF-Animation (2510.21864).

name: EMOTE
notes: EMOTE: Emotional speech-driven 3D facial animation. Uses temporal VAE with non-autoregressive transformer. Introduces 3DMEAD dataset. Deterministic baseline in LSF-Animation (2510.21864).

name: FaceDiffuser
notes: FaceDiffuser: Speech-driven 3D facial animation using diffusion model (DDPM/DDIM). Non-deterministic generation. Baseline in LSF-Animation (2510.21864). Supports both DDPM and DDIM sampling.

name: ProbTalk3D
notes: ProbTalk3D: Non-deterministic emotion-controllable speech-driven 3D facial animation using VQ-VAE. Previous SOTA. Uses one-hot labels for emotion and identity (not label-free). LSF-Animation (2510.21864) improves upon this method.

name: MobileViT-S
notes: Light-weight, mobile-friendly vision transformer. Used in Med-Hammer (arXiv:2510.24976) as a primary evaluation target. The paper fine-tunes MobileViT on ISIC, Brain Tumor MRI, and MedMNIST for Trojan/Bit-flip attack evaluation.

name: Baichuan-M1-14B-Instruct
notes: Medical-specialized LLM trained from scratch with 20T tokens. Baichuan-M1 series specifically designed for medical applications. From Wang et al., arXiv:2502.12671. Used as baseline in DiagAgent paper (arXiv:2510.24654).

name: Baichuan-M3-235B
notes: Next-generation medical-enhanced LLM with reinforcement learning framework for clinical decision-making. Features proactive information acquisition, long-horizon reasoning, and adaptive hallucination suppression. Achieves SOTA on HealthBench, HealthBench-Hallu, and ScanBench. From Baichuan-M3 Team, 2025. Used as baseline in DiagAgent paper (arXiv:2510.24654).

name: T5-XXL
notes: XXL variant of T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer). Used as text encoder in ViMoGen (arXiv:2510.26794) for motion generation, where T5-XXL significantly outperforms CLIP and MLLM for generalization to diverse text prompts.

name: FishSpeech V1.4
notes: Dual autoregressive (AR) TTS model leveraging LLMs for rich linguistic feature extraction. Paper: arXiv:2411.01156. Used in SP-MCQA paper (2510.26190) as one of 4 evaluated SOTA TTS models.

name: MaskGCT
notes: Fully non-autoregressive (NAR) TTS with mask-and-predict paradigm. Published at ICLR 2025. Used in SP-MCQA paper (2510.26190) as one of 4 evaluated SOTA TTS models. Paper: Wang et al. (CUHK Shenzhen).

name: Eagle-2
notes: VLM backbone used in GR00T-N1.5 VLA model. From Li et al., arXiv:2501.14818 (2025). Provides semantic features for VLA conditioning. SIGLIP-2 embeddings used as world-modeling target.

name: Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-FP8-dynamic
notes: FP8-dynamic quantized variant of Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct used in the Glia paper (arXiv:2510.27176) for larger-scale LLM serving experiments on 8x NVIDIA H100 GPUs. Dynamic quantization allows flexible precision scaling at runtime.

name: RSBuilding-ViT-L
notes: SAM ViT-L backbone architecture pre-trained on remote sensing imagery. Used as vision backbone in UniChange (arXiv:2511.02607) for change detection. Shares same architecture as SAM-L but with RS-specific pre-training.

name: LLaMA-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct
notes: Vision-language model pairing LLaMA 3.1 text backbone with vision adapter via cross-attention layers. Trained on 6B image-text pairs. Used in SPOT THE BALL benchmark (2511.00261).

name: BrainSegFounder
organization: Cox et al., Medical Image Analysis 2024
notes: 3D foundation model for neuroimage segmentation. Used in arXiv:2511.03376 (CIM-LLM) for automated tumor segmentation in subjects without ground-truth labels. Per-voxel class probabilities aggregated across cross-validation folds by soft voting.

name: StarCoder2-15B-instruct-v0.1
notes: Open-source code LLM from BigCode/StarCoder2 series. Used as one of 3 subject LLMs in RefAgent (arXiv:2511.03153), a multi-agent LLM framework for automated software refactoring. Paper: Lozhkov et al., 2024.

name: DeepSeekCoder-33B-instruct
notes: DeepSeek's code-specialized LLM, 33B parameter instruction-tuned version. Used as one of 3 subject LLMs in RefAgent (arXiv:2511.03153), a multi-agent LLM framework for automated software refactoring. Paper: DeepSeek, 2024.

name: Music2Latent
params: Not publicly disclosed; encoder-decoder consistency autoencoder (CAE) for audio compression to latent space
notes: Consistency autoencoder (CAE) for compressing audio into latent representations. Encoder-decoder pair (E, D) where D is a stochastic consistency model conditioned on E's outputs. Used as the base autoencoder in arXiv:2511.05350 for noise-augmented training with perceptual alignment. Pretrained checkpoint available on GitHub.

name: SAM2.1-L
notes: Improved version of SAM2 with enhanced architecture and training. Used in TubeletGraph paper (arXiv:2511.04678) for spatiotemporal video partitioning and tracking through object transformations.

name: CropFormer-Hornet-3X
notes: High-quality entity segmentation model. Used in TubeletGraph paper (arXiv:2511.04678) to obtain complete spatial partition of initial frame for spatiotemporal tubelet construction.

name: FC-CLIP-COCO
notes: Frozen CLIP for open-vocabulary segmentation. Used in TubeletGraph paper (arXiv:2511.04678) for masked CLIP features to compute semantic consistency between candidate tracks and prompt objects.

name: Apertus-8B-2509
notes: Open-weight LLM from Swiss AI team, optimized for multilingual and compliant language generation. Used in arXiv:2511.04195 for computational Turing test evaluation of LLM human-likeness in social media text generation.

name: BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5
notes: Chinese sentence embedding model used as KB encoder in SR-KI (arXiv:2511.06446) for embedding (subject, relation) key pairs and object values into vector representations for KV cache injection.

name: Voyage-03
notes: State-of-the-art embedding model selected for embedding RAG baseline comparison in GSW episodic memory paper (arXiv:2511.07587). Strong performance on retrieval benchmarks (BEIR). Used as the embedding model for the Embedding RAG baseline.

name: SmolLM3-3B
notes: Smol, multilingual, long-context reasoner. Used as the LLM backbone for DimFusion in FIBO text-to-image model (2511.06876). Also available in 135M and 360M variants.

name: GPT-3.5-turbo-instruct
notes: Legacy instruct-tuned GPT-3.5 model. Used in Dynamic Stability of LLM-Generated Code (arXiv:2511.07463) for evaluating opcode-based code stability metrics.

name: Codestral-22B
notes: Mistral AI's code-specialized 22B instruct model. Used in Dynamic Stability of LLM-Generated Code (arXiv:2511.07463) for evaluating algorithmic stability of LLM-generated code.

name: HuBERT-Base
notes: Self-supervised speech encoder: 13 layers, 768 hidden dim, 95M params. Trained with masked prediction of hidden units using k-means clustering. Used in arXiv:2511.08389 for model fusion experiments.

name: WavLM-Base+
notes: Self-supervised speech encoder: 13 layers, 768 hidden dim, 95M params. Enhanced version of wav2vec 2.0 with improved training curriculum. Used in arXiv:2511.08389 for model fusion experiments.

name: Data2Vec-Base
notes: Self-supervised speech encoder: 13 layers, 768 hidden dim, 95M params. Uses multi-modal masked prediction (speech, vision, language). Used in arXiv:2511.08389 for model fusion experiments.

name: Data2Vec-Large
notes: Self-supervised speech encoder: 24 layers, 1024 hidden dim, 316M params. Multi-modal masked prediction across speech, vision, language. Large variant used in arXiv:2511.08389 fusion experiments.

name: Whisper-Small
notes: Whisper small model: ~244M total params (~39M encoder). Weakly supervised on 680k hours audio. English and multilingual variants. Used in arXiv:2511.08389 as supervised speech model for SSL+SL fusion.

name: ChatTTS
notes: Text-to-speech engine used to synthesize harmful and benign speech for SSO and MSD attack construction in SACRED-Bench (Yang et al., arXiv:2511.10222). Multi-speaker capability used for MSD (assigning distinct vocal characteristics to each speaker).

name: BigBird-Base
notes: Sparse attention Transformer using block sparse attention (64-token blocks), random attention, and global tokens. Paper: Zaheer et al. (NeurIPS 2020). Used as baseline in π-Attention paper.

name: Longformer-Base
notes: Sparse attention Transformer using sliding window (512 tokens) + global attention tokens. Paper: Beltagy et al. (2020). Used as baseline in π-Attention paper.

name: Longformer-Large
notes: Large variant of Longformer (24 layers, 1024 hidden). Paper: Beltagy et al. (2020). Used as baseline in π-Attention paper.

name: Reformer
notes: Transformer with LSH (locality-sensitive hashing) attention and reversible residual layers. Paper: Kitaev et al. (ICLR 2020). Used as baseline in π-Attention paper.

name: RingAttention
notes: Distributed attention technique for near-infinite context via ring-based device communication. Paper: Liu et al. (2023). Used as primary baseline in π-Attention paper. Backbone-dependent (paper uses 125M-1.5B models).

name: MedSigLIP-448
notes: Medical vision-language model combining SigLIP contrastive learning with a medical text encoder. Used as frozen backbone in 'Prompt-Conditioned FiLM and Multi-Scale Fusion on MedSigLIP for Low-Dose CT Quality Assessment' (arXiv:2511.12256). Vision encoder outputs 1152-dim patch tokens modulated via FiLM conditioned on clinical text prompts.

name: VGGSNN
notes: VGG-style Spiking Neural Network for event-based vision. From 'Temporal Efficient Training of SNN via gradient re-weighting' (TET, ICLR 2022). Uses Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons with surrogate gradient training. Used as backbone in PACE paper (arXiv:2511.12095) for dataset distillation experiments.

name: SNN-ConvNet
notes: Standard convolutional SNN architecture with LIF neurons. Used in PACE paper for cross-architecture transfer experiments. Smaller than VGGSNN, straightforward architecture for event-based classification.

name: SEW-ResNet
notes: Residual SNN architecture (Spiking ResNet / SEW-SNN variant). Used in PACE paper for cross-architecture generalization experiments. Larger receptive field but larger inductive gap compared to feedforward SNNs for dataset distillation.

name: ALIGN
access: google/align-base or open-source ALIGN implementations on HuggingFace
notes: ALIGN (Jia et al., ICML 2021): Scaling up visual and vision-language representation learning with noisy text supervision. Trained on 1.8B image-text pairs (much larger than CLIP's 400M). Architecture similar to CLIP with ViT-L/14 vision encoder and text encoder. Used in SAGE paper (arXiv:2511.13005) for zero-shot spurious bias mitigation experiments.

name: AltCLIP
notes: AltCLIP (Chen et al., ACL 2023 Findings): Altering the Language Encoder in CLIP for Extended Language Capabilities. Replaces CLIP's text encoder with a multilingual XLM-RoBERTa while keeping the vision encoder. Available in multiple sizes (B/16, L/14). Used in SAGE paper (arXiv:2511.13005) for zero-shot spurious bias mitigation experiments.

name: Qwen3-80B-A3B-Instruct
notes: MoE model with 1 shared expert per layer; total 48 layers; weight size ~41GB at INT4 (fits single A6000 48GB). Used in DynaExq (arXiv:2511.15015) for dynamic expert quantization experiments.

name: Evo-2 7B
notes: DNA foundation model built on StripedHyena 2 architecture (hybrid SSM-attention). Trained on ~9.3T nucleotides from 128,000+ genomes across all domains of life. Supports ~1Mb context at single-base resolution. Used as backbone in Focus paper (arXiv:2511.14694). Not publicly released at paper time; requires research agreement for access.

name: GME-Qwen2-VL-2B
notes: Multimodal embedding model used in FADS paper (arXiv:2511.15986) for computing query-demonstration similarity in ICL. Based on Qwen2.5-VL architecture, distilled for efficient embedding computation.

name: UniMatch
notes: Weak-to-strong consistency framework for semi-supervised semantic segmentation. Used in CORA paper (arXiv:2511.17755) as off-the-shelf semi-supervised segmentation model to generate pseudo-labels for unlabeled images.

name: SemiVL
notes: Semi-supervised semantic segmentation with vision-language guidance. Used in CORA paper (arXiv:2511.17755) as an alternative off-the-shelf semi-supervised segmentation model for generating pseudo-labels on unlabeled images.

name: Llama 4 Maverick
notes: Part of the Llama 4 family (Scout 17B/109B total, Maverick 17B/400B total, Behemoth 288B). Maverick is used as a backbone LLM in AI research agent experiments in arXiv:2511.15593.

name: Devstral-Small
notes: Devstral is fine-tuned for coding agent applications. The 24B 'Small' variant is described in the Devstral paper (arXiv:2509.25193). Used as a backbone LLM in AI research agent experiments in arXiv:2511.15593.

name: CWM (Code World Model)
notes: CWM (Code World Model) is an open-weights LLM for research on code generation with world models. 32B dense decoder-only architecture. Mid-trained on observation-action trajectories from Python interpreter and agentic Docker environments, followed by multi-task RL in coding, math, and software engineering. Used in arXiv:2511.15593.

name: LLaVA-OneVision-1.5-8B-Instruct
organization: Haotian Liu et al. / LLaVA team
notes: LLaVA-OneVision 1.5 8B instruction-tuned vision-language model for image, multi-image, and video understanding. Used in FlashCache paper (arXiv:2511.16786) for KV cache compression experiments.

name: VoiceCraft
notes: Zero-shot speech editing and text-to-speech in the wild. From Peng et al. (2024). Multilayer audio codec prediction TTS. Used in W3AR paper (2511.17555) as one of the TTS models evaluated with W3AR optimization.

name: OpenThinker-32B
notes: Community-developed reasoning-tuned model from OpenThoughts project (arXiv:2506.04178). Used in cognitive foundations analysis paper (arXiv:2511.16660).

name: DeepHermes-3-Llama-3-8B-Preview
notes: Reasoning-tuned model from NousResearch. Used in cognitive foundations analysis paper (arXiv:2511.16660) for text reasoning trace analysis.

name: ScaleCrafter
params: N/A (applies to any pre-trained diffusion model)
notes: Training-free method for higher-resolution image generation using diffusion models. Introduces resolution-aware U-Net and windowed attention to handle duplication and quadratic self-attention costs at high resolutions. Used as baseline in UltraFlux paper (arXiv:2511.18050).

name: FouriScale
params: N/A (applies to any pre-trained diffusion model)
notes: Training-free approach for ultra-high resolution image synthesis using Fourier-domain low-pass guidance and dilated convolutions. Improves global structure while injecting high frequencies. Used as baseline in UltraFlux paper (arXiv:2511.18050).

name: AVLP (Audio-Visual Language Model)
organization: Google / Imperial College London (Shi et al. 2022)
notes: Self-supervised audio-visual speech representation model. Learns by masked multimodal cluster prediction. Used as frozen backbone in AuViRe (arXiv:2511.18993) for extracting speech representations from both visual (lip movements) and audio (waveform) modalities. Provides d-dimensional features (t x d) for cross-modal reconstruction.

name: Omnilingual ASR
notes: Multilingual CTC-based ASR supporting 1600+ languages. From arXiv:2511.09690 (Omnilingual et al., 2025). Used in paper 2511.18774 for proxy-guided n-best selection experiments.

name: XTTS
notes: Massively multilingual zero-shot text-to-speech model. From arXiv:2406.04904 (Casanova et al., 2024). Used in paper 2511.18774 for speaker-conditioned synthesis of contextual prefix audio.

name: Llava-1.5-7B
notes: Standard open-source MLLM benchmark. Architecture: CLIP ViT-L/14 visual encoder (frozen) + linear projection + Vicuna-7B LLM. Used in SAUP/Semantic Router paper (arXiv:2511.20002) as one of three evaluated MLLMs.

name: BLD-SD3.5
notes: Training-free inpainting method that blends denoising in masked region with ground-truth denoising trajectory of unmasked region. Used in SONIC paper (arXiv:2511.19985) as the base inpainter. Adopted by diffusers library as default inpainting pipeline.

name: BrushNet
notes: Trained inpainting method that separates masked-image features and noisy latents. Provides two model subtypes: one trained with random masks, another with segmentation masks. Used as baseline in SONIC paper (arXiv:2511.19985).

name: FLAIR
notes: Training-free variational posterior sampling method for inverse problems including inpainting. Formulates a variational method that updates both initial noise and final estimates. Used as baseline in SONIC paper (arXiv:2511.19985).

name: FlowChef
notes: Training-free method that improves trajectories and stability for flow/diffusion models when solving inverse problems. Used as baseline in SONIC paper (arXiv:2511.19985).

name: FlowDPS
notes: Flow-based posterior sampling method for inverse problems with explicit guidance. Used as baseline in SONIC paper (arXiv:2511.19985).

name: DeepEyes-7B
notes: Visual agent model trained with RL to think with images via active perception. Based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. From Zheng et al. (arXiv:2505.14362), accepted at ICLR 2026. Uses cropping-based tool use for visual reasoning. Used as baseline in CodeV paper (arXiv:2511.19661).

name: Pixel-Reasoner-7B
notes: Visual agent model using curiosity-driven RL for pixel-space reasoning. Based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. From Su et al. (NeurIPS 2025). Uses cropping-based visual tool use. Compared in CodeV paper (arXiv:2511.19661).

name: TITAN
params: ~300-400M (CONCHv1.5 patch encoder + BERT-style text encoder, aggregated)
access: https://github.com/mahmoodlab/TITAN; model weights on HuggingFace (requires license agreement)
notes: TITAN: A multimodal whole-slide foundation model for pathology (Nature Medicine 2025, Ding et al.). Pretrained on 335,645 WSIs, 182,000+ pathology reports, 423,122+ synthetic captions. Uses CONCHv1.5 as frozen patch encoder. Applied in zero-shot WSI classification and VQA. Compared against in GIANT paper (arXiv:2511.19652).

name: SlideChat
notes: SlideChat: A Large Vision-Language Assistant for Whole-Slide Pathology Image Understanding (CVPR 2025, Chen et al.). LLaVA-style model trained on TCGA whole-slide images and reports. The paper introduces SlideBench benchmark. SlideChat performs well on in-distribution VQA but struggles on questions outside its training distribution. Compared against in GIANT paper (arXiv:2511.19652).

name: AMPLIFY Motion Tokenizer
notes: Actionless motion priors for robot learning from videos (Collins et al., 2025). Temporal quantized autoencoder with transformer encoder-decoder + FSQ (Finite Scalar Quantization). Takes dense keypoint tracks as input, outputs discrete latent action tokens. Training objective: cross-entropy classification of relative displacement over discrete spatial grid. LAPS paper (2511.21428) derives its motion tokenizer M_theta directly from AMPLIFY architecture. Lightweight training (~25 mins).

name: Depth-Pro
notes: Sharp monocular metric depth estimation model (Bochkovskii et al., ICLR 2025). Used in PAT3D (arXiv:2511.21978) for depth-based layout initialization. Achieves sub-second inference on a single image.

name: OpenPose
outputs: 2D body keypoints (body_25), hand keypoints, facial keypoints via Part Affinity Fields
notes: Real-time multi-person 2D pose estimation using Part Affinity Fields (Cao et al., CVPR 2017). Used in EASL (arXiv 2511.22135) for extracting sign language pose keypoints from videos.

name: CUT (Contrastive Unpaired Translation)
organization: UC Berkeley / Adobe (Park et al., ECCV 2020)
notes: Contrastive Unpaired Translation (CUT, ECCV 2020). Uses contrastive learning with a patch-based contrastive loss (NCE loss) for unpaired image-to-image translation, avoiding cycle consistency. Strong baseline in SP-I2I paper (arXiv:2511.22668) for both JunoCam2HST calibration and pansharpening tasks. Outperforms CUT on spatial fidelity but CUT achieves better chi^2 spectral distance.

name: AudioSeal
notes: Proactive detection of voice cloning with localized watermarking. Generator-detector architecture for zero-bit watermarking. Used as victim watermarking method in HarmonicAttack paper (arXiv:2511.21577). Paper: Roman et al., arXiv:2401.17264.

name: WavMark
notes: Watermarking for audio generation using spread-spectrum approach. Embeds binary string watermarks into frequency domain. Used as victim watermarking method in HarmonicAttack paper (arXiv:2511.21577). Paper: Chen et al., arXiv:2308.12770.

name: Silentcipher
notes: Deep audio watermarking with multi-bit capacity embedding binary strings. Uses generator-detector architecture. Used as victim watermarking method in HarmonicAttack paper (arXiv:2511.21577). Paper: Singh et al., Interspeech 2024.

name: EnCodec
notes: High-fidelity neural audio compression. Used as codec baseline in HarmonicAttack paper (arXiv:2511.21577). Also used as audio compression attack method. Paper: Defossez et al., NeurIPS 2022.

name: WorldMirror (HunyuanWorld-Mirror)
notes: Feed-forward 3D foundation model for universal geometric prediction. Generates camera poses, depth maps, point clouds, surface normals, and multi-view depths in a single forward pass. Uses multi-modal prior prompting to integrate diverse geometric priors. Architecture inherits VGGT's alternating attention backbone with additional prior encoding layers. Fine-tuned variant (WorldMirror-FT) improves extreme-view rotation estimation with minimal bias-only fine-tuning.

name: Granite-3.3-8B-base
notes: IBM Granite 3.3 8B base model trained on permissively licensed data. Used as base model in Verified-Code-CoT paper (arXiv:2512.00127) for execution-trace-grounded CoT fine-tuning. Fine-tuned bi-directional model achieves 44.3% on CruxEval-Output (+30.2 over base) and 68.2% on LiveCodeBench-Exec.

name: MERT-v1
notes: MERT: Acoustic Music Understanding Model with large-scale self-supervised training (ICLR 2024, Li et al. 2024). Pretrained with MLM-style acoustic pre-training using RVQ-VAE teacher (acoustic) and CQT-based musical teacher (Constant-Q Transform). Scales from 95M to 330M parameters. Achieves SOTA on 14 music understanding tasks. Used as frozen music-centric encoder in CLAM dual-stream architecture for synthetic music detection (arXiv:2512.00621). Paper mentions MERT but does not specify which variant.

name: PointDif
notes: Point cloud pre-training with diffusion models (Zheng et al., CVPR 2024). Uses diffusion-based reconstruction for self-supervised learning on point clouds. Static pretraining baseline in AFRO paper (2512.00074).

name: DynaMo
notes: Dynamic-aware visual pretraining method (Oquab et al., 2024). Uses temporal modeling on 2D images for robot manipulation. 2D version used as baseline in AFRO paper (2512.00074).

name: DynaMo-3D
notes: 3D extension of DynaMo applied to point clouds (Oquab et al., 2024). Dynamic-aware 3D pretraining baseline in AFRO paper (2512.00074).

name: FVP
notes: 4D Visual Pretraining for Robot Learning (Hou et al., ICCV 2025). Uses diffusion-based future prediction on point cloud sequences. Dynamic-aware 3D pretraining baseline in AFRO paper (2512.00074).

name: SMPLest-X
outputs: SMPL-X parameters (3D body mesh, pose, shape)
notes: Scaling up expressive human pose and shape estimation (NeurIPS 2023). Used in OmniPerson for 3D human mesh recovery from pedestrian images to extract pose conditions.

name: AnimateAnyone
notes: Consistent character image-to-video synthesis (CVPR 2024). OmniPerson's temporal attention module for video generation is adapted from AnimateAnyone.

name: CLIP-ReID
notes: CLIP fine-tuned for person re-identification. Used in OmniPerson for identity feature extraction, CLIP-ReID similarity scoring, and as a frozen encoder in the guidance pipeline.

name: VLM2Vec-V2
notes: Multimodal encoder for visual memory retrieval. Used to encode video segments into visual features for feature-based retrieval. From Meng et al., 2025 (arXiv:2507.04590).

name: DIFT (Diffusion Feature Tracking)
params: N/A (frozen diffusion features, no additional params)
access: https://github.com/TangLuming/DIFT (unofficial) or feature extraction from SD U-Net
notes: Diffusion feature extraction method for finding correspondences across images. From 'Emergent correspondence from image diffusion' (Tang et al., NeurIPS 2023). Used for MD (mean distance) metric in drag-based editing benchmarks. Not a model with trainable params — uses intermediate features from pretrained diffusion models.

name: Readout Guidance
organization: Luo et al. / UC Berkeley / Adobe
notes: Lightweight readout network trained to extract appearance-preserving features from intermediate U-Net layers of frozen diffusion models. Trained with triplet loss on DAVIS video dataset. From 'Readout guidance: Learning control from diffusion features' (Luo et al., CVPR 2024). Used as a component in DirectDrag for feature alignment without prompts.

name: Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B
notes: Text-to-video model used as teacher model in Reward Forcing paper (arXiv:2512.04678). Distilled into few-step autoregressive streaming model via Re-DMD.

name: GeoVideo (CogVideoX1.5-5B)
organization: Bai et al. (UT Austin / Alibaba DAMO)
notes: Video generation model with geometric regularization via depth prediction and cross-frame consistency loss. Two-stage fine-tuning: Stage 1 (15K steps) joint RGB-D generation, Stage 2 (5K steps) geometric regularization. Adds depth decoder, camera pose head, and motion probability head to CogVideoX1.5-5B. arXiv:2512.03453.

name: OPERA-GT (OPERA-OGT)
input: 16kHz audio, 8-second segments, log-mel spectrograms (64 mel bins)
notes: Respiratory acoustic foundation model from 'Towards open respiratory acoustic foundation models: Pretraining and benchmarking' (NeurIPS 2024). Used as the audio encoder backbone in AcuLa. Three variants: OCT (contrastive), OCE (contrastive+self-supervised), OGT (generative teacher). AcuLa uses OGT as the primary backbone.

name: WanS2V
notes: Audio-driven cinematic video generation model. Used as teacher model in Live Avatar paper (arXiv:2512.04677) for DMD distillation into causal streaming model.

name: DINOv2
notes: Self-supervised visual feature extractor. Used in Live Avatar paper (arXiv:2512.04677) for identity consistency evaluation (Dino-S metric: cosine similarity between generated frames and reference image).

name: EfficientNet-B1
notes: EfficientNet-B1 backbone used in palette-invariant thermal embedding in arXiv:2512.06504 (UAV PV inspection). Pretrained on ImageNet. Selected for balance of performance and computational efficiency suitable for onboard edge deployment.

name: π_0.6
input_modalities: RGB images + language goal + robot actions
