notes: Proprietary VLA from Physical Intelligence used as base model in training-time RTC paper (arXiv:2512.05964). Built on diffusion-transformer architecture with flow matching. Used for real-world box building and espresso making tasks in π_0.6* evaluation. Inference at 108ms end-to-end latency with 5 denoising steps on H100.

name: ImageReward
notes: CLIP-based reward model for text-to-image generation. Trained on human preference data. Used as verifier in test-time scaling methods (Best-of-N, FlowRBF, Verifier-Threshold). From Xu et al., NeurIPS 2023.

name: VQAScore
notes: CLIP-based text-image alignment score using VQA (Visual Question Answering) for evaluation. Evaluates text-to-visual generation via image-to-text generation. Used as verifier in test-time scaling for image generation. From Lin et al., ECCV 2024.

name: NLFPose (Neural Localizer Fields)
notes: Neural Localizer Fields for continuous 3D human pose and shape estimation (NeurIPS 2024). Used in SCAIL paper for 3D keypoint estimation to create 3D-consistent pose representation.

name: Samurai
outputs: instance segmentation masks with temporal tracking
notes: Adapts SAM 2 for zero-shot visual tracking with motion-aware memory. Used in SCAIL for multi-person tracking and mask splitting in multi-character animation.

name: ViTPose
notes: Simple Vision Transformer baselines for human pose estimation (NeurIPS 2022). Used as alternative 2D pose estimator in some character animation works. Reference [43] in SCAIL paper.

name: DimensionX
organization: SUN Yat-sen University / Shanghai AI Lab
notes: 4D scene generation model that creates any 3D and 4D scenes from a single image with controllable video diffusion. Jointly generates video and 3D geometry (depth, point clouds) via a world-space representation. ICCV 2025. Used as baseline in WorldReel paper.

name: 4DNeX
organization: NTU / Shanghai AI Lab / University of Cambridge
notes: Feed-forward 4D generative modeling that jointly generates videos and point cloud geometry. Models dynamic scenes by combining video generation with 3D point cloud outputs. Used as baseline in WorldReel paper. arXiv:2508.13154.

name: Med42-v2-70B
organization: M42 Health / Mohamed bin Zayed University of AI
notes: 70B parameter variant of Med42-v2 clinical LLM fine-tuned from Llama-3 on medical data. Used in AutoMedic paper (arXiv:2512.10195) for clinical conversational agent evaluation.

name: AudioMAE
notes: Masked spectrogram autoencoder pretrained on AudioSet. Yields 768x512 feature map per clip. From Huang et al. (ICLR 2023). Used in VOCSIM paper (arXiv:2512.10120).

name: EAT (Efficient Audio Transformer)
notes: Efficient self-supervised audio transformer with masked spectrogram modeling. From Chen et al. (IJCAI 2024). Used in VOCSIM paper (arXiv:2512.10120).

name: TARFlow-XL/8@pix
notes: TARFlow integrates Transformer into autoregressive flows for NFs. From arXiv:2305.14499. Pixel-space variant with patch size 8. The latent-space variant (patch size 2) has ~118M params. Used as forward model in BiFlow paper (2512.10953).

name: STARFlow-XL/1
notes: STARFlow: Scaling latent normalizing flows for high-resolution image synthesis. NeurIPS 2025. Extends TARFlow with deep-shallow design. From reference [21] of BiFlow paper (2512.10953).

name: BiFlow-B/2
access: No official code release found (as of 2026-04-02)
notes: Bidirectional Normalizing Flow: learns a reverse model (bidirectional ViT) with hidden alignment instead of using explicit analytic inverse. Achieves FID 2.39 at 1-NFE on ImageNet 256x256. From paper arXiv:2512.10953. The forward model is an improved TARFlow (iTARFlow-B/2). Full pipeline: forward model (120M) trained 960 epochs + reverse model (133M) trained 350 epochs.

name: Qwen3-Max-Preview
notes: Thinking/reasoning variant of Qwen3-Max used in OPV paper (arXiv:2512.10756) as a verification baseline; achieves 84.4% F1 on ProcessBench without standard answers.

name: Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-72B
notes: 72B process reward model from Qwen2.5-Math suite. Used as a baseline verifier in the OPV paper (arXiv:2512.10756), where it achieves 77.2% F1 on ProcessBench (with standard answers).

name: Video-LLaMA-7B
notes: Video-LLaMA: Video-Language Large Multi-modal Assistant. Used as LLM backbone in LMPM++ (MeViS paper, arXiv:2512.10945). LMPM++ uses Video-LLaMA-7B with LoRA fine-tuning for motion reasoning in referring video object segmentation.

name: DDColor
notes: Dual decoder image colorization model using both color query and image decoder. Used as plug-and-play image colorization model in LoGoColor (arXiv:2512.09278). Paper: Kang et al., ICCV 2023.

name: pix2pix-Turbo
notes: One-step image-to-image translation using adversarial diffusion distillation. LoGoColor (arXiv:2512.09278) fine-tunes SD-Turbo following pix2pix-Turbo's image-to-image training scheme. Paper: Parmar et al., arXiv:2403.12036.

name: DIFIX3D+
notes: Single-step diffusion model for 3D reconstruction. Provides the reference mixing layer architecture used in LoGoColor (arXiv:2512.09278) — DIFIX3D+'s self-attention mixing layer is integrated into SD-Turbo to enable multi-view color referencing. Paper: Wu et al., CVPR 2025.

name: YOLO11n-seg
notes: YOLO11 nano segmentation variant. Used in arXiv:2512.11884 for apple instance segmentation comparison with SAM3.

name: YOLO11m-seg
notes: YOLO11 medium segmentation variant. Used in arXiv:2512.11884 for apple instance segmentation comparison with SAM3. Best F1 among YOLO11 variants at 72.2%.

name: YOLO11l-seg
notes: YOLO11 large segmentation variant. Used in arXiv:2512.11884 for apple instance segmentation comparison with SAM3.

name: H0-mini
input_resolution: 224x224 tiles at variable mpp, outputs 768-dim embeddings for CLS + 256 patches
notes: Distilled ViT-B/14 from H-optimus-0 using DINOv2 distillation. Foundation model for histopathology feature extraction. Used in IMILIA paper (2512.13440).

name: HistoPLUS
notes: Cell detection and segmentation model based on CellViT. Supports 13 cell types. Used in IMILIA paper (2512.13440) for interpretability module. Non-commercial only.

name: PMC-CLIP
notes: CLIP model fine-tuned on PubMed Central biomedical image-text pairs. From Lin et al., Lecture Notes in Computer Science 14221, 2023. Used in CMAC-MMD paper (arXiv:2512.15249) as a biomedical-adapted VLM baseline.

name: MedCLIP
notes: Contrastive learning from unpaired medical images and text. From Wang et al., EMNLP 2022. Used in CMAC-MMD paper (arXiv:2512.15249) as a biomedical-adapted VLM baseline.

name: LightGBM
notes: LightGBM v4.1.0 used in this paper for radiomics-based DCCD-ccRCC classification. High-performance gradient boosting framework.

name: XGBoost
organization: Distributed Machine Learning Community (Chen & Guestrin, KDD 2016)
notes: XGBoost v2.0.0 used in this paper for radiomics-based DCCD-ccRCC classification.

name: Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B
notes: Qwen3 series reranker model for query-document relevance scoring; used in GRAST-SQL for schema filtering; outputs relevance score based on first-token 'yes' logit; trained with LoRA

name: Qwen3-Reranker-4B
notes: Qwen3 series reranker model for query-document relevance scoring; used in GRAST-SQL for schema filtering; outputs relevance score based on first-token 'yes' logit; trained with LoRA

name: Qwen3-Reranker-8B
notes: Qwen3 series reranker model for query-document relevance scoring; used in GRAST-SQL for schema filtering; outputs relevance score based on first-token 'yes' logit; trained with LoRA

name: FreeFlux
notes: Training-free image editing method for RoPE-based MM-DiT models. Analyzes layer sensitivity to RoPE and performs attention sharing in position-insensitive blocks. SynPS (arXiv:2512.14423) builds upon FreeFlux by dynamically modulating positional embeddings to address attention collapse. From arXiv:2504.03118.

name: CharaConsist
notes: Training-free fine-grained consistent character generation via attention sharing with correspondence-based position embedding adaptation. Uses pre-generated target for correspondence and point-tracking attention. Compared in SynPS (arXiv:2512.14423). From arXiv:2507.XXXXX.

name: RF-Solver-Edit
notes: Training-free image editing method using rectified flow models. Inverts source image using RF-Solver and performs attention/value injection in specific layers. Compared in SynPS (arXiv:2512.14423). From arXiv:2504.XXXXX.

name: Seed1.5-VL
notes: Proprietary MLLM from ByteDance Seed team (Guo et al., arXiv:2505.07062). Used in EmoCaliber (arXiv:2512.15528) for synthesizing structured CoT annotations from image-label pairs in VEC-CoT dataset construction.

name: HuatuoGPT-Vision-7B-Qwen2.5VL1
notes: Medical VLM based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, further trained on biomedical image-text and instruction data. Used as base model for MRG-R1 (arXiv:2512.16145) with GRPO fine-tuning. Paper: Chen et al., 2024.

name: CheXbert
notes: BERT-based automatic radiology report labeler for 14 chest X-ray observations (Atelectasis, Cardiomegaly, Lung Opacity, Pneumonia, Pneumothorax, Pleural Effusion, etc.). Provides positive/negative/uncertain/blank labels. Widely used for CheXpert-based rewards in medical report generation. Paper: Smit et al., arXiv:2004.09167.

name: cuRobo
notes: cuRobo: Parallelized collision-free minimum-jerk robot motion generation (Sundaralingam et al., 2023). Used in LVP paper (arXiv:2512.15840) for inverse kinematics (IK) solving to obtain arm joint trajectories from wrist pose trajectories. Supports articulated robots, parallel grippers, and dexterous hands.

name: AV-HuBERT Large
notes: Self-supervised audio-visual speech representation learning. Uses ResNet backbone + Transformer. Paper uses noise-augmented AV-HuBERT Large with 12 of 24 layers. Pretrained on audio-visual speech (LRS3, VoxCeleb2).

name: ACT (Action Chunking Transformer)
organization: Tony Z. Zhao et al. (UC Berkeley / Stanford / Google)
notes: Action Chunking with Transformers from 'Learning Fine-Grained Bimanual Manipulation with Low-Cost Hardware' (arXiv:2304.13705). Transformer encoder-decoder trained as Conditional VAE. Chunk size 90, 50Hz inference. Used as baseline in MiVLA paper (2512.15411).

name: H-RDT (Human-to-Robotics Diffusion Transformer)
notes: Human manipulation enhanced bimanual robotic manipulation using diffusion transformer. Pre-trained on EgoDex human egocentric videos. Used as baseline in MiVLA paper (2512.15411).

name: MomaGraph-R1
organization: UC Berkeley / UMD / University of Toronto
notes: From arXiv:2512.16909 (MomaGraph). 7B VLM trained with DAPO RL on MomaGraph-Scenes. Based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. Generates task-oriented scene graphs (unifying spatial and functional relationships) and serves as zero-shot task planner via Graph-then-Plan. Achieves 71.6% on MomaGraph-Bench (+11.4% over base model). Code: https://github.com/HybridRobotics/MomaGraph

name: DeepSeek-VL2-4.5B
notes: DeepSeek-VL2 4.5B variant. Compared in MomaGraph paper (arXiv:2512.16909) as baseline, achieving 54.3% overall on MomaGraph-Bench (w/ Graph).

name: VISTA-3D
notes: Unified 3D CT segmentation foundation model combining automatic multi-organ branch and interactive point-driven branch. Pretrained on 11,000 CT scans to segment up to 127 classes. Used in NodMAISI (arXiv:2512.18038) for organ-level anatomical segmentation.

name: MAISI-v2
notes: Medical AI for Synthetic Imaging version 2: Accelerated 3D high-resolution medical image synthesis with rectified flow and region-specific contrastive loss (arXiv:2508.05772). Pretrained on large-scale medical CT datasets. Frozen backbone in NodMAISI; only ControlNet is trained.

name: MAISI
notes: Medical AI for Synthetic Imaging (MAISI): generative model for 3D medical image synthesis with anatomical label conditioning (WACV 2025). Foundation model for MAISI-v2 and NodMAISI.

name: Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct
notes: Code-specific instruction-tuned LLM from Qwen2.5-Coder family. Used as base model in PSV-VERUS (arXiv:2512.18160) for self-play verified code generation with formal verification in Verus/Rust.

name: Keye-VL-1.5-8B
notes: Kwai Keye-VL 1.5 8B variant. Evaluated in GroundingME benchmark (arXiv:2512.17495) at 8.5% accuracy (no-thinking).

name: Llama-Nemotron-8B
license: NVIDIA AI Foundation Models Community License
notes: Llama-Nemotron 8B with NVIDIA optimizations. Evaluated in GroundingME benchmark (arXiv:2512.17495) at 10.4% accuracy (no-thinking).

name: Mistral-3.2-24B
notes: Mistral 3.2 24B vision-language model. Evaluated in GroundingME benchmark (arXiv:2512.17495) at 1.7% accuracy (no-thinking).

name: Seed-1.6-Vision-250815
notes: Seed-1.6-Vision model from ByteDance, version 250815. Commercial API-only model. Evaluated in GroundingME benchmark (arXiv:2512.17495) at 42.6% accuracy (no-thinking), second best overall.

name: Llama-4-Scout-VL
notes: Llama-4-Scout multimodal variant (vision-language). Evaluated in GroundingME benchmark (arXiv:2512.17495) at 8.9% accuracy (no-thinking). Note: separate from text-only Llama-4-Scout in registry.

name: umT5-XXL
notes: Unified Multimodal Text-to-Text Transfer model (umT5). Multilingual T5 variant used as text encoder in ActAvatar paper (arXiv:2512.19546) for encoding structured prompts. XXL variant is the largest in the umT5 family.

name: ViCLIP
access: https://github.com/OpenGVLab/InternVideo (see Wang et al., InternVid paper, ICCV 2023)
notes: Video CLIP model from InternVid (Wang et al., ICCV 2023). Used in StoryMem paper for computing video-text similarity metrics to evaluate prompt following and cross-shot consistency on ST-Bench.

name: Qwen3-embedding-4B
notes: Text embedding model used in LogicLens (arXiv:2512.21482) for computing cosine similarity reward in the explanation quality reward function. Generates sentence embeddings for comparing generated explanations with ground-truth explanations.

name: ConvLSTM (Convolutional LSTM)
notes: First convolutional LSTM for precipitation nowcasting. Shi et al. NeurIPS 2015. Encoder-forecaster architecture with convolutions integrated into LSTM cells. Used as baseline in STLDM paper.

name: PredRNN
notes: Predictive RNN with ST-LSTM units and zigzag memory flow. Wang et al. NeurIPS 2017. Baseline in STLDM paper.

name: SimVP
notes: Simpler video prediction with U-Net encoder-translator-decoder. Gao et al. CVPR 2022. STLDM uses gSTA module from SimVP-V2 for its conditioning network. Baseline in STLDM paper.

name: Earthformer
notes: Space-time transformer for earth system forecasting. Gao et al. NeurIPS 2022. Uses cuboid attention. Baseline in STLDM paper.

name: LDCast
notes: Latent diffusion for precipitation nowcasting with adaptive Fourier neural operators. Leinonen et al. arXiv:2304.12891. Two-stage: pre-trained VAE + latent diffusion. Baseline in STLDM paper.

name: PreDiff
notes: Precipitation nowcasting with latent diffusion + knowledge-control network. Gao et al. NeurIPS 2023 AI for Science Workshop. Two-stage training. Baseline in STLDM paper.

name: DiffCast
notes: Unified framework with residual diffusion for precipitation nowcasting. Yu et al. CVPR 2024. Combines deterministic model with pixel-space diffusion. Baseline in STLDM paper.

name: SAM3 (Segment Anything Model 3)
notes: Segment Anything Model 3. Paper: Carion et al., arXiv:2511.16719. Stronger visual representations and more conservative memory update strategy than SAM2. Used as backbone in SAM3-Tacking-Zoo paper (2512.22624) for hybrid memory mechanism evaluation.

name: IDT (Intrinsic Decomposition Transformer)
notes: Feed-forward multi-view intrinsic decomposition transformer. Decomposes images into diffuse reflectance, diffuse shading, and specular shading. Built on VGGT backbone with appearance adapters for factor-specific routing. Paper: Du et al., arXiv:2512.23667.

name: Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct
notes: Text-only instruction-tuned LLM from Mistral Small 3.2 family. Used in multi-vulnerability detection benchmark paper (arXiv:2512.22306) for evaluating LLM security auditing capabilities across C/C++/Python/JavaScript.

name: OneFormer
organization: Jain et al., Georgia Tech / UIUC
notes: One Transformer for Universal Image Segmentation (CVPR 2023). Universal architecture conditioned on task token (panoptic/semantic/instance) to produce corresponding outputs. Used in GSCG paper (arXiv:2512.23024) fine-tuned on merged COCO Panoptic + DMS ontology for joint panoptic and material segmentation with 175 unified labels.

name: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507
notes: From Qwen3 technical report (arXiv:2505.09388). Variant with 2507 training tokens. Used in HiR paper (arXiv:2512.23457).

name: Llama3.2-3B-Instruct
notes: From Llama 3.2 release (2024). Edge-optimized instruction-tuned model.

name: VideoChat2-HD
notes: Video understanding MLLM from MVBench paper (Li et al., CVPR 2024). Used as baseline in DNA-Train paper (arXiv:2512.24271) for video hallucination experiments.

name: LLaVA-Next-Video-7B
organization: Haotian Liu et al. / LLaVA team
notes: LLaVA-Next-Video from Liu et al. 2024. Zero-shot video understanding model. Used as baseline in DNA-Train paper (arXiv:2512.24271) showing DNA-Train improves it by 42.0 points on hallucination benchmarks.

name: Lingshu-7B
notes: Generalist foundation model for unified multimodal medical understanding and reasoning. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Evaluated on PET-Bench (arXiv:2601.02737) where it achieves 21.23% diagnosis accuracy in zero-shot setting. Fine-tuning with AVA yields 35.88% (AVA+CoT).

name: Shizhen2.5VL-7B
organization: China University of Petroleum, et al.
notes: Multimodal LLM for traditional Chinese medicine. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Evaluated on PET-Bench (arXiv:2601.02737) where it achieves 36.31% diagnosis accuracy (zero-shot).

name: Shizhen2.5VL-32B
organization: China University of Petroleum, et al.
notes: Multimodal LLM for traditional Chinese medicine (32B variant). Built on Qwen2.5-VL-32B. Evaluated on PET-Bench (arXiv:2601.02737) where it achieves 36.73% diagnosis accuracy (zero-shot) and 44.80% with CoT prompting.

name: MuRIL-base-cased
notes: Multilingual Representations for Indian Languages. Pretrained on 17 Indian languages including Hindi and Telugu. Used as encoder for Hindi and English hate speech detection in X-MuTeST paper (arXiv:2601.03194, AAAI 2026).

name: XLM-RoBERTa-base
notes: Base variant of XLM-RoBERTa. Used as encoder for Telugu hate speech detection in X-MuTeST paper (arXiv:2601.03194, AAAI 2026).

name: MiMo-V2-Flash
notes: Mixture-of-Experts LLM with hybrid sliding window attention (SWA) and global attention (GA). 48 layers (39 SWA + 9 GA), 256 experts with 8 activated per token. Uses Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) with 3 lightweight MTP layers (0.33B each) for speculative decoding. Pre-trained on 27T tokens. Post-trained with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD). Achieves 73.4% on SWE-Bench Verified, 94.1% on AIME 2025, 2.6x decoding speedup via MTP speculative decoding.

name: Janus-Pro-1B
notes: Unified multimodal understanding and generation model with decoupled visual encoding. Base model: DeepSeek-LLM-1.5b-base. Used as base T2I RL model in reward hacking analysis paper (arXiv:2601.03468).

name: RGCA (Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars)
notes: Person-specific relightable 3D Gaussian avatars extending 3DGS with physically-based reflectance parameters (diffuse albedo, SH coefficients, specular roughness, normals, visibility). Foundation for RelightAnyone. Predicts Gaussian parameters in UV texture space of a coarse template mesh. Each new subject requires light-stage capture and retraining.

name: VHAP (Versatile Head Alignment with Adaptive Appearance Priors)
notes: Face tracker that deforms FLAME template to fit multi-view or single-image input. Used in RelightAnyone paper for consistent mesh topology and canonical space across all datasets.

name: URAvatar (Universal Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars)
notes: Universal relightable avatar method requiring large-scale OLAT dataset. RelightAnyone addresses the same problem but with a two-stage approach that only needs a small OLAT dataset, avoiding the data acquisition bottleneck of URAvatar.

name: Claude-Opus-4.5
notes: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.5, released January 2026. Used as a judge model in the Evaluative Fingerprints paper (arXiv:2601.05114), which found it to be systematically harsh (mean harshness -0.429) with 98.5% presence-valid receipt rate.

name: Claude-Sonnet-4.5
notes: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.5, released January 2026. Used as a judge model in the Evaluative Fingerprints paper (arXiv:2601.05114), which found it to be systematically harsh with the highest shotgun index (8.2) among the 9 judges evaluated.

name: Llama-405B
access: meta-llama/Llama-4.5-405B-Instruct on HuggingFace or via Meta AI API
notes: Meta Llama 4.5 405B Instruct model. Used as a judge model in the Evaluative Fingerprints paper (arXiv:2601.05114), which found it to be lenient (+0.198 harshness) and have the lowest presence-validity rate (80.3%) among the 9 judges, with 19% of citations referencing non-existent content.

name: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct
notes: Multimodal LLM from Qwen2.5-VL family (Bai et al., 2025b). Used as a base model in SceneAlign paper (arXiv:2601.05600) for scene-graph-guided DPO alignment experiments.

name: LLaVA-Next-8B
notes: Multimodal LLM combining CLIP vision encoder with LLaMA3-8B backbone (Dubey et al., 2024). Used as a base model in SceneAlign paper (arXiv:2601.05600) for scene-graph-guided DPO alignment experiments.

name: Gemini-2.5-flash
notes: Used as optimization and Judge LLM in JUDGEFLOW paper (arXiv:2601.07477). Achieved competitive score (84.4) on MBPP benchmark compared to GPT-4o (84.5) in the LLM impact ablation study.

name: LLaMA-13B
notes: LLaMA-2 13B. Used in PDR paper (arXiv:2601.06827) for pre-training data detection experiments.

name: GPT-NeoX-20B
notes: GPT-NeoX 20B. Used in PDR paper (arXiv:2601.06827) for pre-training data detection experiments.

name: OPT-66B
notes: OPT 66B. Used in PDR paper (arXiv:2601.06827) for pre-training data detection experiments.

name: LLaVA-OneVision-4B
organization: Haotian Liu et al. / LLaVA team
notes: 4B variant of LLaVA-OneVision, based on Qwen3-VL-4B. Used as cognitive backend in LLMTrack (arXiv:2601.06550) for semantic multi-object tracking, achieving GPT-S of 3.8 on BenSMOT and 75.23% HOTA.

name: DeepSeek-V3-0324
notes: Timestamp checkpoint of DeepSeek-V3 released March 2024 (arXiv:2412.19437). Used as LLM-as-judge in VideoDR benchmark (arXiv:2601.06943) for semantic equivalence judgment between model predictions and reference answers.

name: Gemini-3-pro-preview
notes: Google's Gemini 3 Pro preview model, multimodal (text, image, video). Evaluated in VideoDR benchmark (arXiv:2601.06943) where it achieved top performance (69% Workflow / 76% Agentic). Reference: Team et al., 2023 (arXiv:2312.11805).

name: Baichuan-M2-32B
notes: Baichuan-M2 32B parameter model. Despite smaller size, achieved exceptional safety alignment score (90.64%) on MedSE dimension in MLB benchmark (arXiv:2601.06193).

name: Citrus1.0
notes: JD.com's 72B parameter medical/alignment-specialized LLM evaluated in MLB medical LLM benchmark (arXiv:2601.06193).

name: Swin Transformer V2-Base (SwinTv2-Base)
notes: Swin Transformer V2 Base. Used as backbone in SEED (arXiv:2601.07805) for remote sensing change detection. Larger variant than Swin-Tiny/Swin-Base (original). Updated with shifted window mechanism V2.

name: GPT-o3
notes: OpenAI reasoning model used in SCOPE paper (arXiv:2601.09097). Specific version: o3-2025-04-16. Input: $2.00/M tokens, Output: $8.00/M tokens.

name: GUI-Eyes-3B
notes: Tool-augmented perception framework for GUI grounding via GRPO reinforcement learning. Based on Qwen2.5-VL-3B backbone. Two-stage reasoning: active perception planning (crop/zoom tool) + reasoning with focused perception. Achieves 44.8% on ScreenSpot-Pro, 87.8% on ScreenSpot.

name: GUI-R1-3B
notes: RL-based GUI grounding model using rule-based rewards for GUI automation. Achieves 30.2% on ScreenSpot-Pro. Compared in GUI-Eyes paper (arXiv:2601.09770).

name: GUI-R1-7B
notes: RL-based GUI grounding model (7B variant). Achieves 32.4% on ScreenSpot-Pro. Compared in GUI-Eyes paper (arXiv:2601.09770).

name: InfiGUI-R1-3B
notes: GUI grounding model with Actor2Reasoner framework (think-before-act, reflect-after-execution). 3B variant. Achieves 35.7% on ScreenSpot-Pro. Compared in GUI-Eyes paper (arXiv:2601.09770).

name: ShowUI-2B
notes: GUI-specific VLM with visual token selection strategy. 2B variant. Achieves 7.7% on ScreenSpot-Pro. Compared in GUI-Eyes paper (arXiv:2601.09770).

name: Aguvis-7B
notes: GUI grounding model. 7B variant. Achieves 84.4% on ScreenSpot, 18.9% on ScreenSpot-Pro. Compared in GUI-Eyes paper (arXiv:2601.09770).

name: SeeClick-9.6
notes: GUI grounding model. Achieves 53.4% on ScreenSpot. Compared in GUI-Eyes paper (arXiv:2601.09770).

name: UGround-V1-7B
notes: GUI grounding model (V1). 7B variant. Achieves 31.1% on ScreenSpot-Pro. Compared in GUI-Eyes paper (arXiv:2601.09770).

name: Claude Computer Use
notes: Anthropic's computer use model for GUI automation. Evaluated in GUI-Eyes paper (arXiv:2601.09770): 17.1% on ScreenSpot-Pro. Proprietary API-based model.

name: Sparse4D-v3
notes: Sparse4D v3: Advancing end-to-end 3D detection and tracking. Query-based spatiotemporal architecture using sparse spatial-temporal fusion. Base architecture adapted in arXiv:2601.10819 for outside-in multi-camera MTMC tracking.

name: MobileNetV3-Small
notes: Used as visual encoder in cross-script handwriting retrieval paper (arXiv:2601.11248). Combined with DistilBERT as frozen text anchor; total model (visual+projector+text+projector) is 1.29M params.

name: OpenThinker-7B
notes: OpenThoughts reasoning model (arXiv:2506.04178). Used in arXiv:2601.11517 for studying cross-LRM CoT generalization.

name: Nemotron-Research-Reasoning-Qwen-1.5B
notes: NVIDIA reasoning model from arXiv:2505.24864. Used in arXiv:2601.11517 for studying cross-LRM CoT generalization.

name: Sonata
notes: Self-supervised 3D encoder pretrained on large-scale 3D data using PTv3 architecture. Used in ReScene4D as frozen backbone with trainable decoder. Pretrained on 3D-only data, producing geometry-driven features.

name: Silero VAD
notes: Pre-trained enterprise-grade Voice Activity Detection (VAD) model. Used in CTC-DID paper (arXiv:2601.12199) for the Language-Agnostic Heuristic (LAH) to estimate speech duration and word count without requiring ASR. Lightweight and language-agnostic.

name: MedImageInsights
notes: Open-source medical imaging embedding model. Trained on diverse medical domains (X-Ray, CT, MRI, dermoscopy, OCT, fundus, ultrasound, histopathology, mammography). arXiv:2410.06542. Used in hierarchical dermatology benchmark (arXiv:2601.12382) where it achieved best coarse-level performance (97.52% on binary malignancy) but declined at fine-grained 40-class classification (65.50%).

name: MedSigLip
notes: Medical image-text foundation model from Google's MedGemma family. Trained on medical image-caption pairs. arXiv:2501.12382 (MedGemma technical report). Used in hierarchical dermatology benchmark (arXiv:2601.12382) where it achieved best fine-grained 40-class performance (69.79%) despite being a general medical model.

name: Derm Foundation
notes: Dermatology-specific vision foundation model from Google. Produces 6144-dimensional embeddings (largest in the benchmark). Used in hierarchical dermatology benchmark (arXiv:2601.12382) achieving 69.50% on 40-class fine-grained classification and 96.04% on binary malignancy.

name: MONET
notes: Transparent medical image AI via image-text foundation model grounded in medical literature. Nature Medicine 30:1154-1165 (2024). Uses ViT-L/14 image encoder with GPT-2 style text decoder. Used in hierarchical dermatology benchmark (arXiv:2601.12382) achieving 69.31% on 40-class fine-grained classification.

name: PanDerm
notes: Multimodal vision foundation model for clinical dermatology. Nature Medicine (2025). Note: in arXiv:2601.12382 benchmark, PanDerm Base (64.12% on 40-class) significantly outperformed PanDerm Large (36.65%), suggesting the publicly released Large checkpoint may be defective.

name: Qwen-2.5-Max
notes: Qwen-2.5-Max is the latest and most capable Qwen-2.5 model, accessed via Qwen API (similar to GPT-4o as an API service). Used in XCR-Bench cross-cultural reasoning benchmark (arXiv:2601.14063). Proprietary API-only model; parameters not publicly disclosed.

name: QwQ-Med-3-32B
access: Not publicly released (referenced in Dedhia et al. 2025 and compared in Kansal & Jha 2026)
notes: Medical domain-specialized reasoning model based on QwQ-32B architecture, fine-tuned on medical KG-derived QA data (ICD-Bench training split). From Dedhia et al. (arXiv:2507.13966). Used as a baseline in KG-RL paper (Kansal & Jha, arXiv:2601.15160). Outperforms base Qwen3-14B but underperforms the KG-RL approach on high-difficulty (5+) and long-hop (4-5) tasks.

name: CodeQwen1.5-7B-Chat
notes: Code-specific instruct-tuned Qwen1.5 variant for code generation, completion, and reasoning. Used in NOIR paper (arXiv:2601.16354) for privacy-preserving code generation experiments.

name: Doubao-1.5-lite-32K
notes: Lightweight version of Doubao-1.5 series by ByteDance, used as attacker-side LLM in RAGCRAWLER paper (arXiv:2601.15678). API pricing: $0.042/M input tokens, $0.084/M output tokens (per paper Table 9). High speed and cost efficiency, independent from victim RAG generator family.

name: Stockfish 17.1
notes: Classical chess engine using alpha-beta search with NNUE evaluation. Not an LLM. Used in arXiv:2601.16823 for centipawn loss evaluation at depth 30. CPU-based, very fast.

name: Leela Chess Zero (Lc0) v0.32.0
notes: Neural network chess engine based on AlphaZero self-play RL. Uses Monte Carlo Tree Search guided by NN evaluations. Upper-bound baseline in arXiv:2601.16823. Requires GPU for efficient inference.

name: mGTE
notes: Multilingual long-context text representation model; uses <s>-token pooling; supports up to 8192 tokens; from EMNLP 2024 industry track

name: Minimax M2.1
notes: MiniMax M2.1 model used in EoG paper (arXiv:2601.17915) for ITBench SRE diagnostic evaluation. API-only model.

name: PAGE-4D
notes: Disentangled pose and geometry estimation for 4D perception. Temporally-aware extension of VGGT that processes monocular video sequences and predicts temporally-consistent point maps in a unified global coordinate system. Used in FreeOrbit4D for global scene reconstruction (static background + geometry-incomplete foreground). Paper: Kaichen Zhou et al., 2025.

name: SV4D2.0 (Spatio-temporal Consistency in Multi-view Video Diffusion)
params: not disclosed (~1B, based on video diffusion architecture)
notes: Object-centric multi-view video diffusion model for 4D generation with improved spatio-temporal consistency. Used in FreeOrbit4D to synthesize novel views of the foreground object at 90-degree azimuthal intervals, which are then used by VGGT to reconstruct geometry-complete foreground point clouds in canonical object space. Paper: Yao et al., ICCV 2025.

name: Seed-1.6-Vision
access: ByteDance API (internal model used in LocationAgent paper)

name: Gemini-2.0-flash-lite
notes: Low-latency, high-efficiency multimodal ARLM. Used in QueerGen paper (arXiv:2601.20731) for evaluating LGBTQIA+ bias in LLM sentence completions.

name: SAM-base (ViT-B)
notes: Segment Anything Model ViT-Base variant. Used in DeepSeek-OCR 2 (arXiv:2601.20552) as the 80M-parameter vision tokenizer for image-to-visual-token compression (16x reduction). Initialized from DeepEncoder and combined with two convolutional layers in the DeepEncoder V2 pipeline.

name: RADIOv2.5 ViT-L (AM-RADIO)
notes: AM-RADIO: Agglomerative Vision Foundation Model that combines multiple pre-training paradigms (DINOv2, CLIP, etc.) into a single efficient model. Used as VFM backbone in AnomalyVFM (arXiv:2601.20524) for zero-shot anomaly detection. ViT-L/16 variant achieves strong performance across diverse vision tasks.

name: IS-Net (High-Quality Dichotomous Image Segmentation)
notes: State-of-the-art salient object segmentation network. Used in AnomalyVFM (arXiv:2601.20524) for extracting foreground object masks during synthetic anomaly dataset generation. Achieves high accuracy on DUTS, DIO, DIS benchmarks.

name: EuroLLM-9B-Instruct
notes: Multilingual LLM specialized in European languages. Used as LLM backbone in SpeechMapper paper (arXiv:2601.20417) for speech-to-LLM embedding projection.

name: REPA-XL/2
params: ~675M (same ViT architecture as DiT-XL/2 and SiT-XL/2, with representation alignment projector)
access: https://github.com/facebookresearch/DiT (REPA extends DiT with representation alignment)
notes: Representation Alignment for Generation (arXiv:2410.06940, 2024); builds on SiT/DiT architecture by adding an 8-layer MLP projector that aligns with DINOv2 features during training, leading to faster convergence and improved FID; used as a backbone in the R-pred paper (2601.22468) which applies training-free representation guidance at inference to further improve sample quality (e.g., FID 5.9->3.3).

name: Infinity-2B
notes: Infinity: Scaling Bitwise Autoregressive Modeling for High-Resolution Image Synthesis (CVPR 2025). Bitwise VAR model with multi-scale visual tokenizer and bitwise self-correction. Base model used in DreamVAR (arXiv:2601.22507) for subject-driven image generation. Inference is significantly faster than diffusion models (~2 seconds per 512x512 image).

name: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M
notes: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct variant with 1M context window support (Yang et al. 2024a). Used in TALC paper (arXiv:2601.22662) as one of three council models for TALC-Lite.

name: Glyph
notes: Specialized long-context VLM for visual-text compression via LLM-guided rendering configuration search and vision-text alignment curriculum. Used in LongCodeOCR paper (arXiv:2602.00746) for evaluating visual code compression at up to 1M token context.

name: Qwen3-Plus
notes: Closed-source multimodal model from Qwen3 family. Used as a baseline in RGBX-R1 paper (arXiv:2602.00504) for RGBX-Grounding evaluation. Performance: 16.59% avg on RGBX-Grounding (below Qwen2.5-VL-32B at 13.24% for some modalities but better on others).

name: SDXL-Turbo
notes: Adversarial diffusion distillation model for fast high-quality image synthesis (2 steps). Used as Recognizability Expert in PolyGen (2602.01370) for high prompt adherence despite limited variance. Paper: Sauer et al., ECCV 2024.

name: Qwen-SEA-LION-v4-4B-VL
access: To be released (see Ng et al., arXiv:2504.05747)
notes: SEA-LION: Southeast Asian Languages in One Network (Ng et al., 2025). Base model for SEA-Guard-4B (arXiv:2602.01618). Trained and optimized for SEA languages and cultures.

name: Qwen-SEA-LION-v4-8B-VL
access: To be released (see Ng et al., arXiv:2504.05747)
notes: SEA-LION: Southeast Asian Languages in One Network (Ng et al., 2025). Base model for SEA-Guard-8B (arXiv:2602.01618). Trained and optimized for SEA languages and cultures.

name: Gemma-SEA-LION-v4-27B-IT
access: To be released (see Ng et al., arXiv:2504.05747)
notes: SEA-LION: Southeast Asian Languages in One Network (Ng et al., 2025). Used for MCRE annotation and prompt generation in SEA-Guard paper (arXiv:2602.01618). Gemma-3 based model specialized for SEA languages.

name: nomic-embed-text-v1.5
notes: Sentence-transformer embedding model used in CPO paper (arXiv:2602.01711) for semantic representations of prompts and queries. Produces 768-dim embeddings reduced via PCA for causal estimation in Double Machine Learning framework.

name: GemmaScope-Gemma-2-9B-SAEs
file_size_bf16: ~4GB per layer SAE, multiple layers available
notes: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) trained on Gemma-2-9B-it residual stream using JumpReLU architecture (Lieberum et al. 2024). Available for layers 9, 20, 31. Used in this paper to decompose refusal directions into sparse latent components.

name: SAEs-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
file_size_bf16: ~4GB per layer SAE, multiple layers available
notes: Community-trained sparse autoencoders for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct residual stream, used in this paper for SAE-based refusal analysis on Llama model.

name: GPT-4o-search-preview
notes: GPT-4o variant with integrated web search capability. Used as surrogate victim model in DECEIVE-AFC (arXiv:2602.02569) for fact-checking evaluation. Combines LLM reasoning with external web retrieval.

name: TIPS-L/14 HR
notes: Text-Image Pretraining with Spatial Awareness (Maninis et al., ICLR 2025). Uses ViT-Large/14 with spatial-aware objectives. Produces two global tokens (object-centric go and spatial gs) plus dense patch embeddings. Backbone used in Tipsomaly (arXiv:2602.03594) for zero-shot anomaly detection. Comparable to CLIP ViT-L/14 (428M params).

name: TIPS-S/14 HR
notes: Small variant of TIPS. Used in ablation study in Tipsomaly paper (arXiv:2602.03594). Embedding dim 384.

name: TIPS-B/14 HR
notes: Base variant of TIPS. Used in ablation study in Tipsomaly paper (arXiv:2602.03594). Embedding dim 768.

name: TIPS-g/14 HR
notes: Giant variant of TIPS. Embedding dim 1536. Used in ablation study in Tipsomaly paper (arXiv:2602.03594).

name: TIPS-SO/14 HR
notes: Super-huge variant of TIPS. Embedding dim 1152. Used in ablation study in Tipsomaly paper (arXiv:2602.03594).

name: DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct
notes: Code-specialized MoE LLM. Used in CAM paper (arXiv:2602.02138) as backend LLM for multi-agent code generation analysis. Achieves performance comparable to GPT4-Turbo on code tasks. Supports 338 programming languages.

name: Qwen-2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct
notes: Instruction-tuned code LLM from Qwen2.5-Coder family. Used in CAM paper (arXiv:2602.02138) as backend LLM for multi-agent code generation analysis.

name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct
notes: MoE code-specialized instruct-tuned model; 30B total params with ~3B active per token; used in FullStack-Agent (arXiv:2602.03798) as backbone LLM for FullStack-Dev multi-agent framework and FullStack-Learn self-improvement training.

name: GenPose
input: Depth point cloud (1024 points) from NOCS/CAMERA datasets
output: Multi-hypothesis 6D pose distribution via score-based diffusion on SE(3)
notes: Generative category-level object pose estimation via diffusion models. Score-based diffusion on SE(3) manifold with energy-based model for candidate ranking. Baseline for RFM-Pose paper (arXiv:2602.05257). Uses 500 sampling steps; RFM-Pose achieves 25x fewer steps with comparable or better accuracy.

name: MVSplat
notes: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from sparse multi-view images. Predicts 3D Gaussians (mean, covariance, opacity) using cost-volume geometry encoder and Gaussian head. Pre-trained on RE10k. Fine-tuned on ScanNet++ in Splat and Distill paper (arXiv:2602.06032). Used as frozen geometric scaffold for lifting 2D DINOv2 features into 3D.

name: SpeechTokenizer
notes: Unified speech tokenizer for speech language models (Zhang et al., ICLR 2024). Uses HuBERT-based semantic distillation at RVQ-1 output. One of the first hybrid acoustic-semantic tokenizers for Speech-LLM integration. Baseline in STACodec paper.

name: X-Codec
notes: Explores semantic shortcomings of audio codecs for language models (Ye et al., AAAI 2025). Adds SSL representations to encoder and performs distillation at combined output of all RVQ layers. Baseline in STACodec paper.

name: PAST
notes: Phonetic-Acoustic Speech Tokenizer (Har-Tuv et al., Interspeech 2025). Uses ASR and phoneme recognition (PR) tasks to directly supervise RVQ-1 output. Baseline in STACodec paper.

name: HASRD
notes: Hierarchical Acoustic and Semantic Representation Disentanglement (Hussein et al., Interspeech 2025). Disentangles semantic features into first codebook. Results used from paper (not open-sourced). Baseline in STACodec paper.

name: Prismatic-VLM-13B
notes: Visually-conditioned language model (VLM) combining vision encoder with LLM backbone. Used in CommCP paper (arXiv:2602.06038) for object detection, question answering, and confidence estimation in multi-agent embodied EQA. Paper reference: Karamcheti et al., ICML 2024.

name: ConvNeXtV2-Nano
notes: ConvNeXt V2 Nano. Used as baseline in TwistNet-2D paper (arXiv:2602.07262). 2.45G FLOPs. Underperforms when trained from scratch (no ImageNet pretraining) on texture benchmarks.

name: FastViT-SA12
notes: FastViT-SA12 (structure-aware variant). Used as baseline in TwistNet-2D paper (arXiv:2602.07262). 1.50G FLOPs. Strong baseline on texture/fine-grained tasks, especially Flowers-102.

name: RepViT-M1.5
notes: RepViT-M1.5. Used as baseline in TwistNet-2D paper (arXiv:2602.07262). 2.31G FLOPs. Good on CUB-200 (59.7%) but weaker on texture datasets.

name: Molmo2-4B
notes: Molmo2 4B variant (Clark et al., 2026). Uses point-based spatial grounding (vs bounding boxes in Qwen3VL). Point-based detection with 256x256 crop resolution. Part of the Molmo2 family (4B, 8B). Paper: arXiv:2601.10611.

name: Molmo2-8B
notes: Molmo2 8B variant (Clark et al., 2026). Uses point-based spatial grounding (vs bounding boxes in Qwen3VL). Point-based detection with 256x256 crop resolution. Used as teacher model for generating synthetic IRD data in SPARC (2602.06566). Paper: arXiv:2601.10611.

name: UniSpeech-SAT Base Plus
notes: Speaker-aware extension of HuBERT. Pretrained on 94,000 hours of speech (Libri-Light 60k + GigaSpeech 10k + VoxPopuli 24k). Uses utterance-wise contrastive loss + SSL objective + utterance mixing. Config: 12 layers, 768 hidden, 12 heads, FFN 3072. Used in MultiSeg paper (arXiv:2602.06647) for audio boundary encoding.

name: RoFormer-base (MultiSeg variant)
params: ~66M (estimated from paper: full MultiSeg is 183M, comprising MiniLM 22M + wav2vec 2.0 95M + RoFormer tagger)
notes: Rotary position embedding (RoPE) transformer encoder. Paper (arXiv:2602.06647) uses 12 layers, 768 hidden (d_in = text 384 + audio 384), 8 attention heads, FFN 2048. Used as tagger for binary sentence boundary classification (topic change vs no change). Architecture diagram in paper Fig 1.

name: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
notes: Multilingual sentence embedding model. 12 layers, 384 hidden dim. Used in MultiSeg paper (arXiv:2602.06647) as text encoder for cross-lingual experiments (Portuguese, German). Replaces English-only MiniLM in multilingual model variants (Ml. MiniSeg+, Ml. MultiSeg).

name: X-vector (SpeechBrain)
notes: TDNN-based speaker embedding from Snyder et al. (2018), implemented in SpeechBrain. Noise-robust variant used in TVTSyn paper for speaker verification and target selection in voice conversion.

name: NISQA
notes: Deep CNN-self-attention model for multidimensional speech quality prediction (MOS prediction). Used in TVTSyn for NISQA-MOS evaluation of voice conversion quality and naturalness.

name: Cosmos-AR-4B
architecture: Next-token prediction transformer for video latent codes; repurposed from NVIDIA Cosmos world foundation model platform
notes: Used as autoregressive transformer in VideoWorld 2 (arXiv:2602.10102) for predicting latent dynamics codes. From 'VideoWorld 2: Learning Transferable Knowledge from Real-world Videos' (ByteDance, 2026).

name: Cosmos-DiT-2B
architecture: Diffusion transformer (DiT) backbone with temporal attention; pretrained video generation model used as appearance prior
resolution: 1280x704 up to 93 frames at 16fps (as used in VideoWorld 2)
notes: Used as pretrained video diffusion model (VDM) appearance prior in VideoWorld 2 (arXiv:2602.10102). Provides high-fidelity frame reconstruction conditioned on latent dynamics codes. From 'VideoWorld 2: Learning Transferable Knowledge from Real-world Videos' (ByteDance, 2026).

name: Gemini Deep Think (IMO Gold)
access: Not publicly available - internal Google model
notes: Gemini Deep Think version that achieved gold medal at 2025 IMO. Uses parallel thinking for extended reasoning. The paper (arXiv:2602.10177) used this as the base model for Aletheia's Generator-Verifier-Reviser architecture.

name: Gemini Deep Think (Advanced, Jan 2026)
access: Not publicly available - internal Google model
notes: Advanced version of Gemini Deep Think (Jan 2026) with ~100x improved inference efficiency over IMO Gold version. Solved IMO 2024 Problem 3 (minor mistake) and Problem 5 (complete) at high compute scales. Used for FirstProof evaluations.

name: Gemini 3 Deep Think
access: Not publicly available - internal Google model
notes: Gemini 3-based Deep Think model referenced in arXiv:2602.10177. November 2025 version used for Erdős problems evaluation (700 problems). February 2026 version used for FirstProof runs.

name: TinyChart
notes: Efficient chart understanding with program-of-thoughts learning and visual token merging. Used as baseline in ChartSpec paper.

name: ChartVLM
notes: ChartX & ChartVLM: A versatile benchmark and foundation model for complicated chart reasoning. ChartVLM-L is the large variant (~14.3B). Used as baseline in ChartSpec paper.

name: ChartAssistant
notes: A universal chart multimodal language model via chart-to-table pre-training. 13B class model. Used as baseline in ChartSpec paper.

name: ChartCoder
notes: Advancing multimodal large language model for chart-to-code generation. Data source for ChartStruct dataset used in ChartSpec paper. 160K training samples.

name: DeBERTa-v3-small
notes: DeBERTa-v3-small fine-tuned on NLI for Natural Language Inference. Used in DiffuTruth paper (arXiv:2602.11364) as the NLI critic for Semantic Energy calculation in hallucination detection. Compares original claim vs reconstructed claim to detect factual contradictions.

name: GPT-oss-120B
notes: Used in arXiv:2602.11898 (Benchmark Illusion paper) for LLM annotation on education and political science case studies. Open-weight GPT OSS model from OpenAI.

name: Olmo-3-7B
notes: Used in arXiv:2602.11898 (Benchmark Illusion paper) for LLM annotation on education case study. OLMo 3 is the Allen Institute for AI's open language model.

name: Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite
notes: Lighter variant of Gemini-2.5-Flash, optimized for high volume and lower cost. Used as one of four evaluated models in the VAT alignment tax paper (arXiv:2602.12134). Typically lower pricing than standard Gemini-2.5-Flash.

name: GVE-7B
notes: General Video Embedding model supporting text, image, and video retrieval. Used as the embedding model in VimRAG (arXiv:2602.12735) for building the multimodal search engine. From Guo et al., 2025 (arXiv:2510.27571).

name: GLM-4.6V
notes: Used as filter in DeViBench construction pipeline (arXiv:2602.12641). Qwen2.5-Omni used as QA generator, GLM-4.6V as judge for semantic consistency.

name: GLM-4.6V-Flash
notes: Evaluation model for Artic RTC system (arXiv:2602.12641). Distinct from filter model used in DeViBench construction to avoid circularity.

name: Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking
notes: Thinking variant of Qwen3-VL-32B with extended chain-of-thought reasoning. Used as backbone for online RL training in OpAgent (arXiv:2602.13559).

name: codefuse-ai/OpAgent-32B
notes: Fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking model from OpAgent paper (arXiv:2602.13559). Multi-task SFT + online RL with hybrid rewards for web navigation. 33B params (BF16). Used as Grounder in OpAgent architecture.

name: UNSB
access: not publicly released (third-party reimplementations may exist)
notes: Unpaired Neural Schrodinger Bridge for image-to-image translation. Multi-step stochastic transport that progressively refines translation through intermediate distributions. Base framework for the hallucination-suppression paper (arXiv:2602.15383). No official code release found.

name: Hiera-T
notes: Hierarchical vision transformer used as frozen encoder backbone in SAM2 and the hallucination-aware discriminator. Paper: 'Hiera: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer without MakeShift Attacks' (Ryali et al., 2023).

name: VideoPainter
notes: Video inpainting/editing model using plug-and-play context control (Bian et al., SIGGRAPH 2025). Uses full-attention over entire video + mask. Introduced VPBench-Edit and VPBench-Inp benchmarks. Baseline in EditCtrl (Litman et al., arXiv:2602.15031) where EditCtrl achieves comparable quality at 10x less compute.

name: ReVideo
notes: Remake a video with motion and content control (Mou et al., NeurIPS 2024). Video editing model requiring first frame to be edited via image inpainting backbone. Baseline in EditCtrl (Litman et al., arXiv:2602.15031) evaluation.

name: ProPainter
notes: Propagation and transformer for video inpainting (Zhou et al., ICCV 2023). Non-generative method using spatiotemporal transformers and convolutional networks with optical flow. Baseline in EditCtrl (Litman et al., arXiv:2602.15031) evaluation.

name: Echo-4o
notes: Text-to-image generation model that leverages GPT-4o synthetic images for improved image generation. Introduced in arXiv:2508.09987. Achieves 0.679 on GenEval++ (vs 0.689 for R3). Uses synthetic image data to improve compositional generation.

name: TRELLIS
notes: Two-stage 3D-native generative framework: Stage 1 generates coarse structure as sparse occupancy grid (64^3), Stage 2 refines to detailed geometry+appearance via Structured LATent (SLAT) representation. Trained on 500K diverse 3D objects. Decodes to multiple formats (NeRF, 3DGS, mesh). Used as pretraining foundation for PAct (fine-tuned for part-decomposed articulated object generation). Paper: arXiv:2412.01506.

name: OmniPart
notes: Part-aware 3D generation with semantic decoupling and structural cohesion. Two-stage: (1) autoregressive structure planning for 3D part bounding boxes, (2) spatially-conditioned rectified flow model adapted from pre-trained holistic 3D generator. PAct initializes Stage 2 sparse transformer from OmniPart checkpoint. Paper: arXiv:2507.06165.

name: Gemini-3-Pro
notes: Google frontier LLM used in arXiv:2602.16050 for clinical reasoning comparison on ESAP 2025 endocrinology exam; achieved 69.8% accuracy vs Mirror's 87.5%

name: Surya OCR
notes: Open-source multilingual document OCR toolkit supporting Indic scripts. Used as a baseline in the Chitrapathak paper (arXiv:2602.16430). Surya achieves strong results on Hindi, Tamil, and other Indic languages.

name: Nanonets-OCR2-3B
access: Not publicly released; used as base model for Chitrapathak-2 fine-tuning
notes: OCR-specialized VLM built on Qwen2.5-VL architecture. Fine-tuned as Chitrapathak-2 in the paper. Native-resolution-capable vision encoder with 2D-RoPE and windowed attention. Base model for Chitrapathak-2 (achieves SOTA on Telugu, 3-6x speedup over Chitrapathak-1).

name: Krutrim-1-7B
access: Not publicly released; Krutrim-2 is released at krutrim-ai-labs/Krutrim-2-instruct
notes: Multilingual LLM supporting Indian languages, used as the decoder in Chitrapathak-1 (LLaVA-style architecture with CLIP-336 vision encoder). From Kallappa et al. (2025, arXiv:2502.09642).

name: Stable Diffusion 3 Medium
notes: SD3 Medium (SD3-M) uses a DiT (Diffusion Transformer) backbone with rectified flow. Used as backbone in GASS (arXiv:2602.17200) for diversity enhancement experiments.

name: DepthAnything3-B
notes: Depth Anything 3 with ViT-B backbone (Yang et al., 2025). Used as feature encoder in StereoAdapter-2 (arXiv:2602.16915) for underwater stereo depth estimation. Replaces DepthAnythingV2 with improved pretraining and architecture.

name: Command-A-Reasoning
notes: 111B reasoning model used in arXiv:2602.14763 for evaluating reasoning on MT. Post-trained on 28k structured reasoning MT examples. Open weights.

name: Command-A-Translate
notes: Proprietary MT model from Cohere used in arXiv:2602.14763 to generate multi-turn translation data (320k→28k filtered examples) for structured reasoning framework.

name: Gurobi
notes: Mathematical optimization solver (LP, MILP, QP, QCP, NLP). Used in ReLoop paper (arXiv:2602.15983) for solving LLM-generated optimization models. Version 11.0 used in the paper. Academic license free at gurobi.com.

name: Ministral-8B-Instruct
notes: Ministral series small model from Mistral AI. Used in PERSONA paper (arXiv:2602.15669) for personality control experiments across diverse model families.

name: ESM-C
access: Evolutionary Scale API / esm3-sm-open-v1 on HuggingFace
notes: ESM Cambrian - protein language model with 300M, 600M, and 6B parameter variants. Uses Pre-LN, rotary embeddings, SwiGLU activations, no biases. The 6B model has 80 layers, 2560 width, 40 heads. Used in BioLM-Score (arXiv:2602.18476) as frozen protein sequence encoder.

name: Chemformer
notes: Pretrained transformer for computational chemistry (Irwin et al., 2022). Based on molecular SMILES strings. Used in BioLM-Score (arXiv:2602.18476) as frozen ligand sequence encoder to provide chemical semantics alongside geometric features.

name: FLUX.2-dev
notes: FLUX.2 dev model used in RoboCurate (arXiv:2602.18742) for image-to-image editing to expand visual diversity in synthetic robot data. Reference: Labs, B. F. FLUX.2: Frontier Visual Intelligence, 2025.

name: V-JEPA2
notes: V-JEPA2 video encoder (0.3B) used in RoboCurate (arXiv:2602.18742) as frozen backbone for attentive probe that classifies motion consistency between generated videos and simulator rollouts. From Assran et al., 2025.

name: SigLIP-2 (ViT-SO400M)
notes: SigLIP-2 vision encoder used in RoboCurate (arXiv:2602.18742) as frozen encoder in the diffusion transformer inverse dynamics model (IDM). From Tschannen et al., 2025.

name: Qwen2-7B
notes: Base Qwen2-7B model (not Instruct variant). Used in ADRA paper (arXiv:2602.19020) for pre-training membership inference on WikiMIA2024 Hard. Knowledge cutoff aligns with dataset cutoff (2023).

name: Tulu2-7B
notes: Tulu2-7B post-trained model from AI2. Used in ADRA paper (arXiv:2602.19020) for controlled contamination (AIME, Olympia Math) and post-training mixture membership inference experiments.

name: Tulu3-8B
notes: Tulu3-8B post-trained model from AI2. Used in ADRA paper (arXiv:2602.19020) for Tulu3 SFT Mix membership inference evaluation (Aya and WildChat subsets).

name: Olmo3-7B-Instruct
notes: Olmo3-7B-Instruct, the fully-open instruction-tuned LLM from AI2. Used in ADRA paper (arXiv:2602.19020) for pre-training MIA on Dolma3 arXiv subset. Trained on Dolma3 mix with knowledge cutoff in 2024.

name: deepseek-v3-0324
notes: Dated snapshot (March 2024) of DeepSeek-V3 used as simulator/monitor in CST paper (arXiv:2602.20710). Accessed via OpenRouter or Together API in the paper. Same architecture as standard DeepSeek-V3 but a specific dated release.

name: GarmentCode
access: https://github.com/xxxxx/GarmentCode (official, from Korosteleva & Sorkine-Hornung, ACM TOG 2023)
notes: Parametric domain-specific language for sewing patterns. Provides a Python API for generating 2D sewing panel geometry and assembly hierarchies from high-level design parameters. Foundation of the NGL-Prompter (arXiv:2602.20700) paper — NGL descriptions are deterministically parsed into GarmentCode parameters.

name: FabricDiffusion
access: https://github.com/xxxxx/FabricDiffusion (from Zhang et al., SIGGRAPH Asia 2024)
notes: Diffusion-based method for high-fidelity texture transfer to 3D garments from in-the-wild images. Used in NGL-Prompter (arXiv:2602.20700) to normalize extracted garment textures and reduce illumination/appearance inconsistencies before applying to 3D meshes.

name: ERA3D
access: https://github.com/era3d/era3d (check NeurIPS paper for official repo)
notes: High-resolution multiview diffusion using efficient row-wise attention. Used in Easy3E (arXiv:2602.21499) as the generation backbone for synthesizing multi-view-consistent textures guided by normal maps. Paper: Li et al., NeurIPS 2024.

name: TripoSG
architecture: Flow-matching-based image-to-3D model using VecSet latent space; transformer-based VAE encodes 3D shapes into latent set z in R^(n x d), denoiser predicts velocity field for rectified flow
notes: Pretrained 3D generative model used as the shared VAE and generation branch backbone in CRAG paper (arXiv:2602.22629). CRAG reuses TripoSG's VAE encoder for fragment embedding and initializes the generation branch with TripoSG's pretrained denoiser weights.

name: GARF
architecture: Generative 3D reassembly model using flow matching on SE(3) manifold; predicts 6-DoF pose for each fragment via iterative denoising
notes: State-of-the-art 3D fracture reassembly method used as baseline in CRAG paper. CRAG extends GARF's assembly branch with 21 layers and couples it with a generation branch.

name: TotalSegmentator
input_resolution: 3D CT volumes at 3mm isotropic resolution (fast mode) or 1.5mm (full resolution)
output: Segmentation masks for 104-118 anatomical structures (organs, glands, bones)
notes: Robust segmentation of 104 anatomical structures in CT images using ensemble of three nnU-Net models (total, head_glands_cavities, appendicular_bones). Used in radiotherapy plan labeling paper (arXiv:2602.23536) for autosegmentation of 118 OARs across 6 anatomic regions. Paper: Wasserthal et al., arXiv:2208.05868.

name: Trident
notes: Training-free open-vocabulary image segmentation using vision foundation models (CLIP-based). Used in LegoOcc paper (arXiv:2602.22667) for rendering Gaussian features to 2D images and aligning with open-vocabulary segmentation features. No training required — uses pre-trained CLIP features with class-agnostic mask proposals.

name: NoPoSplat
notes: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from sparse unposed images. No camera poses required. Used as backbone in SR3R paper. Key innovation: predicts Gaussian parameters directly from image features without pose estimation. SR3R uses NoPoSplat to generate LR 3DGS scaffold, then applies Gaussian offset learning for super-resolution.

name: HAT (Hybrid Attention Transformer)
notes: Hybrid Attention Transformer for image restoration and super-resolution. Used as learning-based upsampler in SR3R ablation study (Table 4). SwinIR used in main experiments; HAT and bilinear bicubic also tested.

name: Stable Diffusion Inpainting v1.5
notes: Stable Diffusion Inpainting v1.5, used as the denoising U-Net initialization in SourceSwap (arXiv:2602.23697). Differs from SDXL-Inpainting which is based on SDXL architecture.

name: SleepLM-T
architecture: Sleep encoder (2 layers, 8 heads, 256 dim) + Text encoder (3 layers, 8 heads, 256 dim) + Sleep decoder (3 layers, 8 heads, 256 dim); ReCoCa pretraining with contrastive + captioning + reconstruction losses
notes: Tiny variant of SleepLM family; smallest model in the scaling study (arXiv:2602.23605)

name: SleepLM-S
architecture: Sleep encoder (2 layers, 12 heads, 768 dim) + Text encoder (4 layers, 12 heads, 768 dim) + Sleep decoder (4 layers, 12 heads, 768 dim); ReCoCa pretraining with contrastive + captioning + reconstruction losses
notes: Small variant of SleepLM family; mid-size model in the scaling study (arXiv:2602.23605)

name: SleepLM-B
architecture: Sleep encoder (6 layers, 12 heads, 768 dim) + Text encoder (12 layers, 12 heads, 768 dim) + Sleep decoder (12 layers, 12 heads, 768 dim); ReCoCa pretraining with contrastive + captioning + reconstruction losses
notes: Base variant of SleepLM family; best-performing model in the paper (arXiv:2602.23605)

name: MoGe-2
notes: MoGe-2: Accurate Monocular Geometry with Metric Scale and Sharp Details (arXiv:2507.02546). Improved version of MoGe with ViT-small variant (moge-2-vits-normal). Used in Dr.Occ (2603.01007) for dense depth cues in 3D occupancy prediction.

name: BioMNI
notes: Domain-specific biomedical AI agent evaluated on native biological protocol generation. Used as a baseline in BioProAgent paper (arXiv:2603.00876). Specialized for biomedical protocol tasks but lacks neuro-symbolic safety interlocks.

name: Centaur
notes: Foundation model of human cognition, fine-tuned on psychology experiments. Claims to predict and capture human behavior better than ad-hoc cognitive models. Used in arXiv:2603.03295 for comparing LLM goal selection with humans in an alchemy game task. Temperature set to 0 for experiments.

name: Olmo-3-7B-Think
notes: Thinking/reasoning variant of Olmo-3-7B with extended chain-of-thought capability. Used as a base model in SiliconMind-V1 paper (arXiv:2603.08719). Despite limited baseline Verilog capabilities, SiliconMind-V1-Olmo-3-7B-Think exceeded CodeV-R1 on multiple benchmarks.

name: CodeV-R1-7B
access: not publicly released (third-party reimplementations may exist)
notes: QiMeng-CodeV-R1 (CodeV-R1): previous state-of-the-art small-scale LLM for Verilog code generation. SFT + RLVR trained from Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct. 87k SFT data + 3.1k RLVR data. Requires 2,656 A100-80G GPU hours for training. Baseline in SiliconMind-V1 paper (arXiv:2603.08719).

name: V-JEPA-Huge
notes: V-JEPA v1 ViT-Huge variant (Bardes et al., arXiv 2024). Flagship model used in Garrido et al. (arXiv 2502.11831) for intuitive physics evaluation. Achieves 98% zero-shot accuracy on IntPhys.

name: V-JEPA-Base
notes: V-JEPA v1 ViT-Base variant (Bardes et al., arXiv 2024). Smallest model in the V-JEPA family. Used in intuitive physics ablations in Garrido et al. (arXiv 2502.11831), still achieves >70% on IntPhys.

name: BERTopic
notes: Neural topic modeling framework using class-based TF-IDF procedure. Combines sentence-transformers for embeddings, UMAP for dimensionality reduction, and HDBSCAN for clustering. Used in GINGER paper (arXiv:2503.18174) for clustering information nuggets by query facet.

name: duoT5
notes: Expando-Mono-Duo design pattern for text ranking with pretrained sequence-to-sequence models. duoT5 performs pairwise reranking (comparing two candidates at a time). Used in GINGER paper (arXiv:2503.18174) for ranking information nugget clusters by relevance to query.

name: voyage-multimodal-3
notes: All-in-one multimodal embedding model for interleaved text, images, and screenshots. Outperforms all other models on ViDoRe benchmark (Faysse et al. 2025). Used in clinical trial patient matching pipeline (arXiv:2503.15374) for efficient medical record search via visual embeddings.

name: ResNet-152
notes: 152-layer residual network. Used as backbone in DLTPose (arXiv:2504.07335) for per-pixel radial distance prediction in 6DoF pose estimation. Larger than ResNet-50 (~26M params) but provides higher accuracy for dense prediction tasks.

name: InternVL2.5-78B
notes: Used in arXiv:2504.11101 (CE-OCR) for multi-model OCR evaluation. InternVL2.5 series base model.

name: Segformer-B5
notes: SegFormer-B5 transformer-based semantic segmentation model (Xie et al., NeurIPS 2021). Used as backbone for segmentation task in TestDG (arXiv:2504.04981) for Cityscapes-to-ACDC continual test-time adaptation. Mix Transformer (MiT) encoder with hierarchical representation and lightweight MLP decoder.

name: Claude-3.5-Sonnet-img
notes: Claude-3.5-Sonnet with image input capability, used in MathCog paper (arXiv:2504.00843) for multimodal evaluation of cognitive skill diagnosis from handwritten student responses.

name: GPT-4o-img
notes: GPT-4o with image input capability. Used in MathCog paper (arXiv:2504.00843) for evaluating cognitive skill diagnosis from student handwritten responses.

name: Gemini-1.5-Flash-8b
notes: Smaller 8B variant of Gemini-1.5-Flash used in MathCog paper (arXiv:2504.00843) as a small model baseline for cognitive skill diagnosis.

name: Gemini-2.0-Flash-Thinking
notes: Gemini 2.0 Flash with thinking/reasoning mode. Used in MathCog paper (arXiv:2504.00843) as a reasoning model baseline for evaluating cognitive skill diagnosis from handwritten math work.

name: Qwen-2.5-72B
notes: Qwen 2.5 72B model used in MathCog paper (arXiv:2504.00843) as a medium-sized model baseline.

name: Bespoke-MiniChart-7B
notes: Specialized chart understanding model fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. From arXiv:2505.13444 (ChartMuseum paper). Achieves 34.0% on CHARTMUSEUM vs 38.5% for Qwen2.5-VL-72B, approaching 72B model performance with 7B parameters.

name: Amazon Nova Pro
notes: Amazon Nova Pro model used as backbone LLM in EXP-Bench paper (arXiv:2505.24785) for evaluating AI agents on end-to-end research experimentation tasks.

name: Hyperseg
notes: Hyperseg: universal visual segmentation model with LLM guidance. Referring expression segmentation model used in ComposeAnything (arXiv:2505.24086) to extract objects and segmentation masks from generated object images. Takes object image + text caption as input, outputs segmentation mask for each object.

name: APE (Aligning and Prompting Everything)
notes: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation model (Shen et al., CVPR 2024). Used in OGGSplat for pixel-dense semantic feature supervision to train the semantic head and semantic VAE.

name: WARP-1.0-3B
notes: Fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct using Reinforcement Learning from Solver-Guided Feedback (RLSGF) with GRPO. Trained on worst-case symbolic constraint dataset generated by SPF-WCA. From arXiv:2506.08171 — achieves 41.08% accuracy on WARP benchmark, outperforming size-matched and larger baselines.

name: Shap-E
notes: Diffusion-based model for generating conditional 3D implicit functions. Encodes shapes with Transformer and generates textured meshes via implicit neural representations. Trained on millions of 3D assets. Used in GIQ paper for monocular 3D reconstruction evaluation.

name: Stable Fast 3D (SF3D)
organization: Stability AI / Arcade AI (Boss et al., 2024/2025)
notes: Fast 3D mesh reconstruction built on TripoSR. Uses DINOv2 for image encoding and outputs triplane-based representations. Trained on curated Objaverse subset. Used in GIQ paper for monocular 3D reconstruction.

name: OpenLRM
notes: Open-source Large Reconstruction Model for single image to 3D. Based on LRM (Large Reconstruction Model) with transformer architecture. Predicts neural radiance fields from single images. Trained end-to-end on Objaverse and MVImgNet. Used in GIQ paper for monocular 3D reconstruction.

name: DreamSim
notes: Learns visual similarity from synthetic data. Optimized for perceptual similarity to human judgment. Used in GIQ paper for 3D symmetry detection via linear probing.

name: LLaVA-3D
notes: Simple pathway to empowering LMMs with 3D-awareness. Uses image inputs for 3D understanding. Evaluated in GIQ paper for zero-shot polyhedron classification but did not outperform generalist frontier VLMs.

name: ShapeLLM
notes: Universal 3D object understanding for embodied interaction. Uses ground truth point clouds as input. Evaluated in GIQ paper for zero-shot polyhedron classification with explicit 3D geometry but did not outperform generalist VLMs.

name: PointBind & PointLLM
organization: CUHK / S-Lab / Shanghai AI Lab (Guo et al., 2023)
notes: Aligns point cloud with multi-modality for 3D understanding, generation, and instruction following. PointLLM is the 3D instruction-following LLM component. Evaluated in GIQ paper for zero-shot polyhedron classification using ground truth point clouds; did not outperform generalist VLMs.

name: LLMLingua-2
notes: Bidirectional encoder model trained for token-level information content estimation and text compression (Pan et al., ACL 2024). Used in BINGO paper (arXiv:2506.08125) to measure token significance for significance-aware length reward in RL-based efficient reasoning.

name: Zero123++
notes: Image-conditioned multi-view diffusion model. Generates consistent 6-view images from a single input view. Used as backbone in EditP23 paper for multi-view 3D editing.

name: InstantMesh
notes: Efficient 3D mesh generation from single image with sparse-view large reconstruction model. Used in EditP23 paper for reconstructing edited 3D meshes from multi-view grids.

name: FLUX.1 [schnell]
notes: Fast text-to-image diffusion model used in EditP23 paper for local inpainting to generate the edited 2D image prompt.

name: FLUX.1 [dev]
notes: High-quality text-to-image diffusion model. FLUX in-painting variant used in EditP23 paper for generating edited image prompts.

name: MUSt3R
organization: NAVER Labs Europe (Cabon et al. CVPR 2025)
notes: Multi-view Network for Stereo 3D Reconstruction. Extends DUSt3R to multi-view setting by adding a decoder with internal memory for encoding both local and global scene geometry. Used in PanSt3R (arXiv:2506.21348) as the 3D-aware backbone for joint 3D reconstruction and panoptic segmentation. ViT-L encoder (1024-dim features) + ViT-B decoder (768-dim features).

name: ESM2-3B
notes: 3B parameter variant of the Evolved Transformer protein language model. Used in AmpLyze paper (arXiv:2507.08162) for per-residue embeddings of antimicrobial peptides in the local encoding branch.

name: ProtT5-XL-UniRef50
notes: ProtT5-XL protein language model from Rostlab. Used in AmpLyze paper (arXiv:2507.08162) for both per-residue and per-sequence embeddings. Provides 1024-dim per-sequence embedding and per-residue embeddings for local encoding.

name: Pythia-1B
notes: Paper 2507.07981 refers to this model as 'Pythia-1B' for Hamiltonian cycle verification experiments. Same model as PYTHIA-1.4B.

name: M3D (3D ViT encoder)
notes: M3D: Advancing 3D Medical Image Analysis with Multi-Modal Large Language Models (arXiv:2404.00578). 3D Vision Transformer pre-trained on Radiopedia for medical CT volume encoding. Used as image encoder in this paper.

name: Phi-3 mini 4B
notes: Phi-3-mini instruction-tuned LLM used as LLM backbone in 3D MLLM experiments in this paper.

name: Phi-3 medium 14B
notes: Phi-3-medium instruction-tuned LLM used as LLM backbone in 3D MLLM experiments.

name: Gemma 2B
notes: Gemma 2B instruction-tuned LLM used as LLM backbone in 3D MLLM experiments.

name: Qwen 2.5 3B
notes: Qwen 2.5 3B instruction-tuned LLM used as LLM backbone in 3D MLLM experiments.

name: Mistral 7B v0.3
notes: Mistral 7B v0.3 instruction-tuned LLM used as LLM backbone in 3D MLLM experiments.

name: AnyResolution
notes: AnyResolution technique from LLaVA-NeXT for handling high-resolution inputs by dividing into crops, concatenating, and compressing embeddings. Used in this paper to process 64x512x512 CT volumes with ViT pre-trained on 32x256x256.

name: VEnhancer
organization: Tencent AI Lab / Shanghai AI Lab (He et al., 2024)
notes: VEnhancer: Generative Space-Time Enhancement for Video Generation (He et al., arXiv:2407.07667). Video latent diffusion model based on Stable Diffusion for video super-resolution. Used as backbone for IP-FVR (arXiv:2507.10293). Supports 24-frame clip processing with temporal consistency.

name: Idefics3-8B-Llama3
notes: Vision-language model used in IConMark paper for watermark detection. Built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct + SigLIP-so400m-patch14-384 vision encoder. Queries concept presence in images for interpretable watermarking detection.

name: XCOMET-lite
notes: Compressed and quantized variant of XCOMET-XXL, retaining over 95% of XXL's performance while reducing computational overhead by 60%. Used in multilingual text detoxification evaluation (arXiv:2507.15557).

name: CompassJudger-1-32B-Instruct
notes: All-in-one judge model for LLM evaluation. Used as LLM-as-judge baseline in multilingual text detoxification evaluation (arXiv:2507.15557). Cao et al., arXiv:2410.16256.

name: Tower+9B
notes: Multilingual LLM specialized for translation, introduced in arXiv:2506.17080 (Tower+: Bridging generality and translation specialization in multilingual LLMs). Paper 2507.18338 uses Tower+9B as the best-performing translation model in gender bias evaluation experiments.

name: mDeberta-v3-base
notes: Multilingual DeBERTa-v3 model used in paper 2507.18338 for Natural Language Inference (NLI) clustering in semantic entropy computation. Finetuned on NLI task following Laurer et al. 2022 approach.

name: multilingual-E5
notes: Multilingual E5 text embeddings used in paper 2507.18338 for computing cosine similarity between MT samples in s3e (Similarity-Sensitive Shannon Entropy) metric. From Wang et al. 2024a (arXiv:2402.05672).

name: Qwen3-Embedding-4B
notes: Used in K4 log anomaly detection paper (arXiv:2507.20051) as one of three Qwen3-Embedding variants.

name: Phi4-Multimodal
notes: Microsoft Phi-4 multimodal instruct model. Evaluated in MCIF benchmark (arXiv:2507.19634). Strong performance on speech tasks.

name: GraniteSpeech 3.3
notes: IBM Granite Speech model. Evaluated in MCIF benchmark (arXiv:2507.19634). Strong English ASR capabilities.

name: UltraVox 0.5
notes: UltraVox multimodal speech model. Evaluated in MCIF benchmark (arXiv:2507.19634). Based on Llama-3.2-1B.

name: VideoLLaMA3
notes: VideoLLaMA3 video-language model. Evaluated in MCIF benchmark (arXiv:2507.19634).

name: Video-XL-2
notes: BAAI Video-XL-2 extra-long video language model. Evaluated in MCIF benchmark (arXiv:2507.19634). Designed for hour-scale video understanding.

name: Tower+
notes: Unbabel Tower+ multilingual translation-specialized LLM. Evaluated in MCIF benchmark (arXiv:2507.19634).

name: Gemma 3n
notes: Google Gemma 3n multimodal model. Evaluated in MCIF benchmark (arXiv:2507.19634).

name: Ming-Lite-Omni
notes: Ming-Lite-Omni unified multimodal model. Evaluated in MCIF benchmark (arXiv:2507.19634). Cannot process long-form inputs.

name: ClinicalBERT
organization: University of Nottingham / Stanford Health Care
notes: BERT-base model fine-tuned on clinical notes from MIMIC-III. From Alsentzer et al. 2019 (arXiv:1904.03323). Used as text backbone in D-MLM paper (arXiv:2507.21794) for medical image-text alignment. Publicly available clinical BERT embeddings for biomedical text.

name: SP22M
notes: Self-supervised pathology foundation model. 22M parameters, pretrained on 1,426 skin slides. Used in paper arXiv:2507.21912 for race prediction from skin histology.

name: Phi-3.5-MoE
notes: Mixture-of-experts model with 16 experts of 3.8B each, 2 active per token. Evaluated in HRIPBench (arXiv:2507.21815) for harm reduction information provision. From Abdin et al. 2024.

name: HuatuoGPT-70B
notes: Medical-domain LLM. Note: the paper (HRIPBench, arXiv:2507.21815) calls this 'HuatuoGPT-70B' while the registry has it as HuatuoGPT-o1-70B — may be the same model or a related variant.

name: MiniCheck-7B
notes: Fact-checking/faithfulness evaluation model based on InternLM2.5-7b-chat. From Tang et al. (EMNLP 2024). Used as SOTA English-only baseline in STEMF paper (arXiv:2507.20752). Throughput >500 docs/min on single A6000 (48GB). Task: MiniCheck-Model(document, claim) -> {0, 1}.

name: ChartGemma
notes: Chart-specific VLM from Google/HuggingFace. ChartGemma was fine-tuned on chart understanding tasks. Used as baseline in ENCQA benchmark (arXiv:2508.04650). Achieved 80.2 on ChartQA.

name: Molmo-7B-D
notes: Molmo-7B-D is the D variant of Ai2's Molmo VLM. Used as baseline in ENCQA benchmark (arXiv:2508.04650). Achieved 84.1 on ChartQA.

name: Qwen1.5-14B-Chat
notes: Chat-tuned variant of Qwen1.5-14B. Used as base model in StyliTruth (arXiv:2508.04530, ICLR 2026) for disentangled style-truth representation steering experiments.

name: DeepSeek-V2
notes: DeepSeek-V2 (236B) baseline in Active Reading paper (2508.09494). Outperformed on SimpleQA by Meta WikiExpert-8B.

name: Depth Anything V2 Small
notes: Depth Anything V2 (Yang et al., NeurIPS 2024). Monocular depth estimation model. Used in ViewBridge (arXiv:2508.10716) as frozen depth estimator for satellite view depth prediction. Smaller variant (small) used in the paper, with base and large variants also available.

name: FLAME (Faces Learned with an Analytic Model)
organization: Li et al. (University of Stuttgart / MPI-IS)
notes: Parametric 3D face model from Li et al. (SIGGRAPH 2017). Provides shape, expression, and pose parameters. Used as proxy 3D model and positional prompt in FastAvatar (arXiv:2508.19754), GaussianAvatars (CVPR 2024), MonoGaussianAvatar (SIGGRAPH 2024), and many other 3D avatar methods. FLAME tracking extracts facial parameters from images for driving the avatar.

name: DUNE
organization: NAVER LABS Europe (Sarıyıldız et al., CVPR 2025)
access: Not yet publicly released at time of paper submission
notes: Distilled universal encoder from heterogeneous 2D and 3D teachers. Fuses representations from DI-NoV2 (general visual), Multi-HMR (human mesh recovery), and MASt3R (3D reconstruction) via UNIC projection. Used as frozen encoder in HAMSt3R for human-aware multi-view stereo 3D reconstruction. From Sarıyıldız et al., CVPR 2025.

name: Selene-1-Mini (Atla Selene Mini)
notes: General-purpose evaluation model from AI21 Labs, specialized for LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. Paper: Alexandru et al., 2025 (arXiv:2501.17195). Used as one of 6 LLM judges in Bridge paper (2508.12792) for human-LLM alignment analysis.

name: Prometheus-v2
notes: Open-source LLM specialized in evaluating other language models. Paper: Kim et al., 2024 (Prometheus 2). Used as one of 6 LLM judges in Bridge paper (2508.12792) for human-LLM alignment analysis.

name: LLaDA-V
notes: Vision-language extension of LLaDA (masked diffusion LLM). Uses SigLIP-2 as vision encoder with MLP projector. Paper: arXiv:2505.16933. Used as pretrained backbone in LLaDA-VLA (arXiv:2509.06932) for robotic manipulation.

name: LaneSegNet
organization: KTH Royal Institute of Technology (Li et al., ICLR 2024)
notes: Lane segment-based HD map learning network. Unified representation for lane segments and pedestrian crossings. Used as backbone in ArgoTweak (arXiv:2509.08764) for prior-aided map updating with element-level change detection.

name: VeRL
notes: VeRL: a scalable and versatile RL training framework for LLM post-training. Implements GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) used in DeepSeekMath. Referenced as implementation basis for Calibrated Reasoning paper (arXiv:2509.19681) Explanatory Verifier training with GRPO.

name: CLAUDE-V2
notes: CLAUDE-V2 was used in Jagadish et al. (2025) paper 'Meta-learning ecological priors from LLMs explains human learning and decision making' for generating ecologically valid cognitive tasks at scale. Capable of processing up to 100K tokens, instruction-tuned, cost-effective. Used to generate ~10K function learning tasks, ~20K+ category learning tasks, and ~21-27K decision making tasks.

name: FaceNet
notes: FaceNet uses Inception ResNet-v1 to produce 128-d or 512-d embedding vectors. The paper evaluates GaP transferability from ArcFace to FaceNet, showing high cross-model attack success rates (~86-99% ASR on FaceNet).

name: SphereFace
notes: SphereFace introduced the multiplicative angular margin loss (A-Softmax) for face recognition. Used as a third target model in the paper's LFW evaluation (in addition to ArcFace and FaceNet).

name: WavTokenizer-large-unify-40token
notes: Single-stream neural audio codec with 4096 codes at 24kHz. Used in CAST paper (arXiv:2509.26276) as frozen speech tokenizer. DVQ-based codec optimizing reconstruction quality.

name: SpiritLM 7B
notes: Interleaved spoken and written language model. Extends text LLM with speech tokens. Baseline in CAST paper (arXiv:2509.26276) showing strong semantic grounding but lower acoustic consistency than smaller CAST models.

name: Twist 7B
notes: Textually pretrained speech LM. Initializes from text LM and models HuBERT units. Baseline in CAST paper (arXiv:2509.26276). Shows high sWUGGY but lower acoustic consistency.

name: LAST 1.3B
notes: Language Model Aware Speech Tokenization. Uses LM-guided tokenization to better align speech tokens with text. Baseline in CAST paper (arXiv:2509.26276).

name: Flow-SLM 1B
notes: Joint learning of linguistic and acoustic information using flow-based objectives for efficiency. Baseline in CAST paper (arXiv:2509.26276).

name: Stable Diffusion 2 Inpainting
notes: Stable Diffusion 2 Inpainting model used as backbone in GeoComplete (arXiv:2510.03110) for reference-driven image completion with geometric guidance. Fine-tuned per-scene with LoRA.

name: Paligemma-3B
