notes: Original Paligemma 3B VLM (Beyer et al., arXiv:2407.07726, 2024). Uses SigLIP SO400M as vision encoder. Not the same as Paligemma2 (2024 sequel). Used as VLM backbone in UniCoD (arXiv:2510.10642) for robot manipulation VLA training.

name: DINOv3-ViT-B/14
notes: DINOv3 ViT-B/14 variant (Siméoni et al., arXiv:2508.10104, 2025). Used as frozen vision encoder for continuous future representation in UniCoD (arXiv:2510.10642) ablation study. Found to underperform SigLIP due to misaligned feature space with Paligemma VLM backbone.

name: GLM-4.5
notes: MoE LLM with 355B total params and 32B activated. From GLM-4.5 technical report (arXiv:2508.06471). Used in WereBench social deduction evaluation (arXiv:2510.11389).

name: Primus-M
notes: 3D medical vision transformer encoder designed for medical image segmentation. Uses 3D RoPE, layer scale, drop path, and post-attention normalization. Used as vision encoder in COLIPRI (arXiv:2510.15042). Architecture from Wald et al. (2025).

name: CXR-BERT
notes: BERT-based text encoder pretrained on chest X-ray reports. Used as text encoder in COLIPRI (arXiv:2510.15042). From Boecking et al. (ECCV 2022). Pretrained on biomedical image-text pairs from chest X-rays.

name: Qwen2.5-1B
notes: Base (pre-trained) variant of Qwen2.5-1B, not instruction-tuned. Used as LLM decoder in COLIPRI report generation evaluation (arXiv:2510.15042), following LLaVA framework. Trained with causal language modeling loss on Findings sections.

name: FsfairX-LLaMA3-RM-v0.1
notes: Scalar reward model based on Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct. Used in arXiv:2510.01394 (Optimal Stopping vs Best-of-N). Also referenced by RLHF workflow paper (arXiv:2405.07863) and Iterative Preference Learning (arXiv:2312.11456).

name: RM-Mistral-7B
access: verify URL from Xiong et al. 2024 (arXiv: Iterative Preference Learning paper)
notes: Scalar reward model based on Mistral-7B. Used in arXiv:2510.01394 (Optimal Stopping vs Best-of-N). Referenced from Xiong et al. (2024) Iterative Preference Learning paper.

name: HRDA
notes: Context-aware High-Resolution Domain-Adaptive Semantic Segmentation. Used as pseudo-labeller in the paper. Trained on GTA5+Synscapes+UrbanSyn+target unlabelled data. 24GB GPU memory, 20h training on 1xA100.

name: Depth Anything V2
notes: Used for depth-map regularisation (20% probability) during diffusion model fine-tuning. Provides geometric layout cues complementary to semantic maps.

name: MUNIT
notes: Multimodal Unsupervised Image-to-Image Translation. Baseline competitor that can generate multiple diverse translations per input.

name: I2I-Turbo
notes: One-step image translation with text-to-image models. Baseline competitor. Uses pretrained SD with minimal adaptation.

name: EnCo
notes: Rethinking content constraints in unpaired image-to-image translation. Baseline competitor that considers unpaired label-to-image translation.

name: Photorealism Enhancement
notes: Enhancing photorealism of synthetic images. Baseline competitor using RGB+depth for translation. Adapted to RGB+depth only in the paper since other buffers unavailable.

name: BEiT-L
notes: BERT Pre-training of Image Transformers. Large ViT with 24 layers, hidden dim 1024, 16x16 patches. Pre-trained on ImageNet-21k. Used as frozen encoder in Controllable-LPMoE paper (arXiv:2510.21114).

name: UniPerceiver-L
organization: Tencent AI Lab / Zhu et al. (CVPR 2022)
notes: Unified architecture for generic perception. Large ViT encoder with ~302M params. Pre-trained on ImageNet-21k. Used as frozen encoder in Controllable-LPMoE paper (arXiv:2510.21114).

name: gte-Qwen2-7B-instruct
notes: General-purpose text embeddings model used as first-stage dense retriever. From Li et al. (2023). Used in hint-augmented reranking paper (arXiv:2511.13994) as the dense retriever.

name: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct
notes: Instruction-tuned 0.5B LLM from Qwen2.5 family. Used in hint-augmented reranking paper (arXiv:2511.13994) as pointwise re-ranker, where it with hints outperforms 72B listwise models.

name: SegFormer (MiT-B3)
params: 189M (as reported in AdaptFly paper, differs from official 45.2M encoder-only)
notes: Paper 2511.11720 reports 189M params for full SegFormer-B3 model with decoder head, compared to official 45.2M encoder-only. May include additional components or be a different configuration.

name: DPR-question-encoder-single-nq-base
notes: DPR question encoder for dense passage retrieval. Used in RADAR paper (arXiv:2601.03981) for retrieval-augmented fake news detection. Paired with dpr-ctx_encoder-single-nq-base for building FAISS index over news corpus.

name: DPR-ctx-encoder-single-nq-base
notes: DPR context encoder for dense passage retrieval. Used in RADAR paper (arXiv:2601.03981) for building FAISS index over ~811K news articles. Paired with dpr-question_encoder-single-nq-base for retrieval-augmented fake news detection.

name: CAMELTrack
params: Context-aware multi-cue exploitation for online MOT; uses pose keypoints and appearance features
notes: Used as baseline and source of pose/appearance features in TDLP paper. Metric-learning-based association using contrastive learning.

name: TransFilter
params: Transformer-based motion encoder with reversed positional encoding (RPE) for robust trajectory modeling
notes: Motion encoder used in TDLP paper. Robust to trajectory truncation via RPE.

name: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507
notes: Qwen3 MoE model with 235B total params / 22B active params, Instruct-tuned variant released July 2025 (2507). Used in EvidFuse paper (arXiv:2601.05487) for text generation in the large-scale hybrid configuration.

name: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507
notes: Thinking/reasoning variant of Qwen3-30B-A3B with extended chain-of-thought reasoning (released July 2025). Used in paper 2601.03154 (Decoupling CoT Effect) to study how long CoT affects human label variation modeling in NLI. Fits on 1xA100 80GB.

name: GLM-Z1-32B-0414
notes: Reasoning-focused GLM variant released April 2024 (0414 date stamp). Used in paper 2601.03154 (Decoupling CoT Effect) as one of 7 reasoning LLMs evaluated on ChaosNLI for distributional alignment with human label distributions. Requires ~64GB in BF16 (1-2xA100 80GB).

name: Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct
notes: ByteDance Seed team's open-source instruction-tuned model with extended reasoning capability. Used in paper 2601.03154 (Decoupling CoT Effect) as one of 7 reasoning LLMs evaluated on ChaosNLI. ~72GB in BF16 (may need 1-2xA100 80GB).

name: OLMo-3-32B-Think
notes: AI2's OLMo-3 32B model with chain-of-thought thinking capability. Used in paper 2601.03154 (Decoupling CoT Effect) as one of 7 reasoning LLMs evaluated on ChaosNLI for distributional alignment vs. accuracy on NLI tasks.

name: LLaDA-Instruct-8B
notes: Instruction-tuned version of LLaDA-8B (masked diffusion LLM). Base model for ρ-EOS paper (arXiv:2601.22527). Achieves ~84% accuracy on GSM8K with variable-length generation.

name: LLaDA-1.5-8B
notes: LLaDA 1.5 version of 8B masked diffusion LLM. Evaluated in ρ-EOS paper (arXiv:2601.22527) Table 2 alongside LLaDA-Instruct-8B.

name: Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct
notes: Math-specialized instruction-tuned 1.5B model from Qwen2.5-Math family. Paper: arXiv:2409.12122. Used in IPG paper (arXiv:2602.02313) as target model.

name: Swin-T
notes: Swin Transformer Tiny. Used as backbone in Mask2Former and various segmentation models.

name: Swin-S
notes: Swin Transformer Small. Stronger variant of Swin-T with more parameters and depth.

name: ConvNeXt-Tiny
notes: ConvNeXt-Tiny from A ConvNet for the 2020s (Liu et al., CVPR 2022).

name: InternImage-T
notes: InternImage Tiny variant using DCNv3 operators. From InternImage (Wang et al., CVPR 2023).

name: InternImage-L
notes: InternImage Large variant using DCNv3 operators. From InternImage (Wang et al., CVPR 2023).

name: CodeT5-Large
notes: Base model for HLSDebugger (arXiv:2507.21485). 24-layer encoder-decoder with 1024 embedding dim, 16 heads. Fine-tuned for HLS bug identification and correction.

name: Phikon
notes: Phikon: Self-supervised histopathology model trained with iBOT (Masked Image Modeling). Pretrained on 40M pan-cancer tiles from TCGA. Used as frozen feature extractor in ScanGen paper (arXiv:2507.22092) for scanner generalization in computational pathology.
